Lemma64-Counterexample/Lemma64.lean.summary: The file formalizes a three-node carrier with root steps, destructor and constructor liftings, and the Down closure. It defines signature closure, the CT extension, consistency and the ConsistencyInvariant hypothesis, and the proof-graph machinery of parent relations, equivalence, fibers, targets, completeness and universality. It proves a concrete trap edge with its target meets consistency, proof-graph, targeted and completeness conditions, yet universality fails, refuting the printed Lemma 64 implication and the promotion of Bar Down to graph equality.
Lemma64-Counterexample/Lemma64.lean.boundary: The witness satisfies ConsistencyInvariant, ProofGraph, Targeted and Complete on one side, while Universal fails on the other. Hence the Lemma 64 hypotheses do not imply universality, placing an exact limit on promotion from Down arguments to graph equality.
Lemma64-Counterexample/Lemma64.lean.conclusion: A three-node witness satisfies the consistency invariant, targetedness and completeness yet fails universality, so Lemma 64 as printed is false.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Root
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Root relates t1 to t0 and t2 to t1 and no other pairs, representing the restricted root steps of d(x) to x.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Bar
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any relation E and nodes a and b, Bar E a b holds when there exist u and v with Root a u and Root b v and E u v.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Hat
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any relation E and nodes a and b, Hat E a b holds exactly when a is t0 and b is t0.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.SignatureClosed
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any relation E, SignatureClosed E means for all a and b, Bar E a b or Hat E a b implies E a b.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.CT
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: CT E is the least signature-closed extension of E with base from E, constructor at t0 t0, and destructor from Root a u and Root b v and CT E u v to CT E a b.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Down
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Down is inductively generated by reflexivity, symmetry, root closure from Root a m and Down m b, and destructor closure from Root a u and Root m v and Down u v and Down m b.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.ConsistencyInvariant
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: S satisfies ConsistencyInvariant when S is Consistent and SignatureClosed, and for every E contained in S that is an Equivalence and ConstructorCompatible, Root a u and Bar E a b and Root b v imply CT E u v for all u a b v.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Star
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any relation R, Star R is its reflexive-transitive closure with refl at each node and step from R a b and Star R b c.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Eqv
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any parent relation rho and nodes a and b, Eqv rho a b means Star of rho or its converse holds from a to b.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Grey
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any rho and nodes a and b, Grey rho a b means Root a b or Bar Down a b or Hat of Eqv rho at a b.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.ProofGraph
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A parent relation rho is a ProofGraph when it is deterministic, its converse is well-founded, every Eqv rho pair is in Down, and every rho edge is Grey.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Complete
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A relation rho is Complete when every ProofGraph beta extending rho equals rho pointwise, assuming beta is a ProofGraph and extends rho.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Fiber
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Fiber holds from a to b exactly when Star of Bar Down holds from a to b.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Target
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A function q is a Target when Fiber a of q a holds for all a, Fiber a b implies q a equals q b, and existence of Fiber a u with Root u v implies existence of v with Root of q a to v.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Targeted
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Targeted rho q requires ProofGraph rho and Target q, plus guided-or-normal and exits conditions relating Bar Down with rho and Fiber.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.Universal
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Universal rho means for all a and b, Eqv rho a b holds if and only if Down a b holds.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.trap
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: trap a b holds exactly when a is t1 and b is t2, the only parent edge of the counterexample.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.target
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: target maps t0 to t0 and both t1 and t2 to t2.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.SameBlock
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: SameBlock a b means a is t0 if and only if b is t0, giving blocks t0 and t1 t2.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.down_consistencyInvariant
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: ConsistencyInvariant Down holds.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.trap_proofGraph
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: ProofGraph trap holds.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.trap_complete
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Complete trap holds against every proof graph beta extending trap, using beta admissibility.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.trap_targeted
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Targeted trap target holds with valid target membership, constancy, redex, guided and exits conditions.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.trap_not_universal
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Universal trap fails because Down t1 t0 holds while Eqv trap t1 t0 does not.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.lemma64_counterexample
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: ConsistencyInvariant Down and ProofGraph trap and Targeted trap target and Complete trap and not Universal trap all hold together.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.lemma64_fails
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that ConsistencyInvariant Down implies that for all rho and q, Targeted rho q and Complete rho imply Universal rho.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.induction_promotion_fails
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Bar Down t1 t2 holds and Bar of Eqv trap at t1 t2 does not hold.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.bar_down_exact
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all nodes a and b, Bar Down a b holds if and only if a is not t0 and b is not t0.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.trap_eqv_exact
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all nodes a and b, Eqv trap a b holds if and only if SameBlock a b holds.

keyDeclarations.name: Lemma64.fiber_exact
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all nodes a and b, Fiber a b holds if and only if SameBlock a b holds.

OperatorKO7.lean.summary: This file is the Lake library root for the public companion release. It imports the six public API roots covering kernel, schemas, orientation and residual methods. It then imports every remaining published Meta, QEC, RH and Test module so that a single `lake build` kernel-checks the whole release.
OperatorKO7.lean.conclusion: This file proves no theorem and only aggregates all published modules under one build root.

theory.name: Confluence and Normalization of the Guarded Kernel Fragment

OperatorKO7/Kernel.lean.summary: The file defines the Trace term language with seven constructors and the full Step root relation with eight unconditional rules. It defines the reflexive-transitive closure StepStar and the predicate NormalForm for terms with no outgoing Step. It proves transitivity of StepStar, that a single Step gives StepStar, and that a StepStar path from a normal form must be trivial.
OperatorKO7/Kernel.lean.conclusion: Any multi-step reduction starting from a normal form ends at the same term.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepStar

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.NormalForm

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.stepstar_of_step

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.nf_no_stepstar_forward
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all traces a b, assuming NormalForm a and StepStar a b, a equals b.

OperatorKO7/Meta/AffineBarrierOrderedFie.summary: The file defines affine measures over an ordered semiring K with nonnegative values, wrapper coefficients at least one, and affine equations for base, successor, wrap and recursor. It defines Lucas delta-orientation and unbounded range, and proves wrap and doubling lower bounds. It proves that one positive value yields unbounded range under an Archimedean hypothesis, and proves a universal barrier: no affine measure delta-orients the duplicating step for any positive delta, via a threshold already attained by a recursor term. It instantiates the barrier for NNRat and NNReal by coercion and gives a lexicographic doubling example showing the unbounded-range route needs the Archimedean hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/AffineBarrierOrderedFie.boundary: No affine measure with wrapper coefficients at least one can delta-orient the duplicating step for any positive delta. The unbounded-range argument needs an Archimedean hypothesis, and lexicographic doubling in Nat x Nat stays below (1,0), so it fails without that hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/AffineBarrierOrderedFie.conclusion: No affine measure over the stated ordered-semiring class delta-orients the duplicating step for any positive delta.
assumptions: CommSemiring K
PartialOrder K
IsStrictOrderedRing K
Archimedean K (only for field_unbounded_of_pos)

OperatorKO7/Meta/AffineThresholdSharpnes.summary: The file defines a canonical schema over Nat whose recursor scales only the counter and a canonical affine measure whose generic contradiction bound equals t. It proves the bound specializes to t and that the distinguished root-step inequality is equivalent to k less than that bound. Below the bound the instance is strictly oriented and at the bound strict orientation fails, so the bound is attained and sharp.
OperatorKO7/Meta/AffineThresholdSharpnes.boundary: Strict orientation of the distinguished root instance holds exactly when k is less than t and fails at k equal to t, so the generic bound t is sharp.
OperatorKO7/Meta/AffineThresholdSharpnes.conclusion: The canonical family attains the generic affine contradiction bound and shows it is an exact cutoff.

theory.name: Uniform Inversion, Positive Binary Quadratic Forms and Hermitian Kernels

OperatorKO7/Meta/Analysis/CompactUniform.summary: The file defines compact-uniform separation from zero for a sequence of complex functions, requiring an eventual uniform positive lower bound on each compact subset. It proves that such separation together with uniform convergence on a compact set yields uniform convergence of the pointwise reciprocals, and hence that separation plus locally uniform convergence on an open set yields locally uniform convergence of reciprocals. It also defines the constant-in-space family F n z = 1/(n+1) and proves it is not compact-uniformly separated on univ, although each stage is pointwise nonzero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Analysis/CompactUniform.boundary: With compact-uniform separation from zero, locally uniform convergence is preserved under pointwise inversion. Pointwise nonvanishing alone lies on the failing side, as the everywhere-nonzero family 1/(n+1) is not compact-uniformly separated.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Analysis/CompactUniform.conclusion: On an open set in ℂ, compact-uniform separation from zero together with locally uniform convergence implies locally uniform convergence of the pointwise reciprocals.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Analysis.UniformSeparation.CompactUniformSeparation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A family F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ satisfies CompactUniformSeparation on U when for every compact K ⊆ U there exist ε > 0 and N such that for all n ≥ N and all z ∈ K, ε ≤ ‖F n z‖.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Analysis.UniformSeparation.reciprocal_tendstoUniformlyOn_of_separation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If there exist ε > 0 and N with ε ≤ ‖F n z‖ for all n ≥ N and z ∈ K, and F converges uniformly on K to f, then fun n z => (F n z)⁻¹ converges uniformly on K to fun z => (f z)⁻¹.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Analysis.UniformSeparation.reciprocal_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If U is open in ℂ, F is compact-uniformly separated from zero on U, and F converges locally uniformly on U to f, then the reciprocal family converges locally uniformly on U to the reciprocal limit.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Analysis.UniformSeparation.guardExpiryFamily
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: guardExpiryFamily n z equals ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹, the constant-in-space value 1/(n+1).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Analysis.UniformSeparation.guardExpiry_not_separated
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that guardExpiryFamily is compact-uniformly separated from zero on univ.

relations.explanation: The open-set locally uniform inversion result is obtained by applying the compact uniform inversion result on compact subsets of U.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ArcticBarrier.lean.summary: The file specializes the arctic primary-projection barrier to the KO7 schema and system. It proves that under an unbounded-range hypothesis on the projected max measure, there is no global ArcticLt orientation. The proof reduces a global orientation to a duplicating-step orientation and applies the general arctic barrier.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArcticBarrier.lean.boundary: With unbounded max projection, no global ArcticLt orientation of KO7 steps exists; without the unbounded hypothesis the file draws no conclusion.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArcticBarrier.lean.conclusion: Unbounded arctic primary range rules out global ArcticLt orientation of the KO7 system.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ArcticBarrier_Schema.le.summary: The file defines the finite arctic carrier ArcticNat, the strict comparison ArcticLt on finite coordinates, and ArcticPrimaryMeasure embedding a MaxMeasure through the finite projection. It proves three obstructions transferring the max barrier to ArcticLt under unbounded-range, successor-pump, and wrap-pump hypotheses. Each proof converts an assumed ArcticLt orientation into a max strict inequality and applies the corresponding max result.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArcticBarrier_Schema.le.boundary: Under each of unbounded range, successor constant at least one, or stated wrap drift, ArcticLt orientation is impossible; below those thresholds the file proves nothing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArcticBarrier_Schema.le.conclusion: Max-barrier obstructions transfer to ArcticLt under unbounded-range, successor-pump, and wrap-pump hypotheses.

It establishes the target value RCA0 with WO of omega cubed, the upper benchmark WO of epsilon zero, their order relation, uninhabited matching bounds, and conjectural status. OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_DerivationalC.summary: The file defines fixed-finite TRS metadata, graph, base-order and soundness budgets, audit records, and affine and pair-count bound witnesses. It proves additive proof-length envelopes and polynomial overhead expressions conditional on those supplied budgets. It bounds head-abstracted call obligations by rule count times signature size for head and first-order engines and instantiates the envelopes there. It specializes to a step-duplicating recursor with rule count two, signature size four, one pair, and a stipulated license overhead.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_DerivationalC.boundary: Total proof length stays inside the additive and polynomial envelopes only under the supplied stage and pair-count budgets; without those supplied bounds no unconditional envelope is claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_DerivationalC.conclusion: One dependency-pair soundness application costs at most graph plus base-order plus soundness budgets, polynomially in rule and signature metadata, with recursor overhead 18 plus residual work.
assumptions: supplied stage budgets and inequalities in each audit

DependencyPairCountBound for metadata-side bounds
DecidableEq and Fintype for finite symbol carriers

OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_LowerBound.le.summary: The file defines a coarse RCA0 Pi02 floor profile and theorem-level lower-bound record, sharp omega-cubed packages with independent well-ordering backing, a gap record comparing coarse and target profiles, SCT transfer records, and a direct sharp package. It proves profile equalities, order and inequality facts, exclusion of the coarse record from the sharp package, and conditional existences of sharp inhabitants from SCT, alignment, exact-transfer, and direct constructions. It also proves the two profile constructions agree on theory, ordinal, status, and erased presentations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_LowerBound.le.boundary: The coarse RCA0 Pi02 record lies strictly below the RCA0 plus WO of omega cubed target and cannot inhabit the sharp package; sharp existence is proved only conditionally through SCT or exact transfers or by direct stipulation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_LowerBound.le.conclusion: Coarse lower bounds stay below the omega-cubed target while sharp packages exist conditionally or directly with independent well-ordering backing.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_ProofLengthBy.summary: The file defines a base-order proof-length function with explicit additivity, finite TRS shapes using maximum rule size, and three stage costs with their total. It proves a bound with constant two derived from the stage definitions under at-least-one-rule and nonzero-size hypotheses. It proves construction cost is unbounded in rule size and gives the recursor closed form four times m plus two with input-independent overhead.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_ProofLengthBy.boundary: The C equals 2 bound needs at least one rule of nonzero size to absorb the unit soundness cost, and construction cost is unbounded in maximum rule size so signature size alone does not bound it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_ProofLengthBy.conclusion: One Arts-Giesl application costs at most twice the rule-size construction term plus base-order length, with an explicit recursor closed form.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_ReverseMathCa.summary: This file packages Arts-Giesl calibration metadata around the target theory RCA0_WO_omega3 with ordinal ceiling omega^3. It defines a conjectural current calibration from the registered WO(epsilon0) upper and RCA0 lower packages, conditional exact-calibration constructors that set status exact only from supplied profile equalities or sharp upper and lower packages, and parallel SCT-transfer and theorem-alignment routes that agree fieldwise after tag erasure. It proves the matching-bounds assumptions are uninhabited for the current lower package and that no exact-theorem-calibration record can reuse the current coarse upper, lower, or combined packages.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_ReverseMathCa.boundary: Exact status holds only with sharp target-matching theory, ordinal and theorem-level evidence; with the current RCA0 lower and WO(epsilon0) upper packages it fails, so no exact-theorem-calibration record can reuse them.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_ReverseMathCa.conclusion: The current coarse packages do not yield an exact-theorem calibration, while supplied sharp target-matching bounds yield only record-field exactness conditional on those equalities.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_UpperBound.le.summary: This file defines the broad Arts-Giesl upper-bound package at theory WO(epsilon0) with ordinal epsilon0 and theorem-level evidence. It proves the target theory RCA0_WO_omega3 lies below it in the finite register and omega^3 is below epsilon0, and it defines sharp exact-target packages that add theory, ordinal and status equalities plus a Lean backing proof for WO(omega^3) with conditional builders from SCT or alignment data. It proves the broad package differs from the target in theory and ordinal and cannot equal any sharp package, while the conditional routes agree on theory, ordinal and status.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_UpperBound.le.boundary: Sharp upper-bound status holds only for packages with theory RCA0_WO_omega3 and ordinal omega^3; the registered WO(epsilon0) package lies strictly above and fails those equalities.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ArtsGiesl_UpperBound.le.conclusion: The broad WO(epsilon0) package is strictly above the RCA0_WO_omega3 target and not sharp, while supplied alignment or transfer data yield sharp exact-target upper packages.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierClass_Classifier.summary: This file defines decidable barrier classes and normalized coefficient tables for scalar and tracked-primary pair measures, with Boolean shape predicates and pump and bounded-regime checks. It provides conversions from additive, affine, restricted-quadratic, cross-term and matrix measures to those tables and classifiers reporting structural tags and pump flags. It proves additive tables carry all four nested tags, affine and restricted-quadratic tables carry tags according to their coefficients, every cross-term table carries the ambient cross-term tag, and pair conversions preserve componentwise versus lex order.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierClass_Classifier.boundary: A structural tag holds only when its coefficient equalities hold and fails otherwise, with narrower shapes implying broader ambient tags while pump and bounded-regime checks remain separate side conditions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierClass_Classifier.conclusion: Normalized coefficient tables are classified into nested additive, affine, restricted-quadratic and bounded cross-term tags and componentwise versus lex pair orders that select the structurally relevant barrier.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierPumpDischarge.le.summary: This file specializes schema pump-discharge barriers to ko7Schema, ko7System and the duplicating step recDelta b s (delta n) to app s (recDelta b s n). It proves unconditional failure of global strict orientation for affine, restricted-quadratic, max-plus, arctic and tropical primary, componentwise vector and pair, functional and mixed measures. It proves conditional failure for cross-term quadratic, multilinear, polynomial and WPO-polynomial families under base-point boundedness or dominance, for lexicographic and scalar-dominance families under one positive tracked value, and for fixed-row and row-sum projections without pump assumptions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierPumpDischarge.le.boundary: No listed measure globally strictly orients KO7 Step: orientation fails unconditionally for most families and fails under the stated dominance, boundedness or single-positive-value hypothesis where the order otherwise permits nonincrease.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierPumpDischarge.le.conclusion: Every listed affine, quadratic, cross-term, multilinear, polynomial, max-plus, arctic, tropical and matrix family fails to globally strictly orient KO7 Step, unconditionally or under its stated dominance or positivity premise.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierPumpDischarge_Sc.summary: Defines the self-nested wrapper chain wrapDouble and proves affine, quadratic, cross-term, multilinear, polynomial, max-plus and projected-primary measures grow unboundedly along it from one positive value. Uses this to discharge explicit unbounded-range hypotheses, proving unconditional strict-orientation impossibility for the duplicating step and global systems, keeping only base-dominance or single-value positivity where needed. Exhibits the identically-zero affine measure to show the nonstrict positivity premise cannot be dropped.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierPumpDischarge_Sc.boundary: No affine, quadratic, max-plus, tropical, arctic or matrix measure in the listed classes can strictly orient the duplicating step, while the identically-zero affine measure shows the nonstrict positivity premise cannot be dropped.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierPumpDischarge_Sc.conclusion: Growth hypotheses are discharged so strict barriers become unconditional and only load-bearing base-dominance or single-positive-value premises remain.
assumptions: positive wrapper coefficients h_wrap_left_pos and h_wrap_right_pos
classical case analysis in affine_zero_or_hasUnboundedRange only; barrier theorems extract a positive value from orientation
Mathlib only; no sorry, axiom or native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierWitness.lean.summary: Defines barrier certificates as bundled triples (b, s, n) on which orientation provably fails. Constructs additive certificates from a wrapper chain, compositional certificates from the all-base triple under successor transparency, and affine certificates from a supplied term meeting a computable threshold.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierWitness.lean.boundary: Each certificate exhibits a concrete triple (b, s, n) on which the claimed strict decrease fails, marking the limit of additive, compositional and affine orientation methods.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BarrierWitness.lean.conclusion: Additive, compositional and affine measures each admit an explicit barrier certificate triple where orientation fails.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BenchmarkedPrimitiveRec.summary: Classifies the six-member family generated by presence or absence of a base rule and absent, linear or duplicating step on RecCore terms. Proves the full linear member has an explicit direct additive witness while any duplicating member has none. Shows duplicating members still have an imported quadratic whole witness and a transformed call witness, giving a complete finite classification.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BenchmarkedPrimitiveRec.boundary: The complete duplicating recursor lacks a direct additive whole-term witness while the complete linear recursor has one; the duplicating member still admits imported-whole and transformed-call witnesses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BenchmarkedPrimitiveRec.conclusion: Among structurally complete members, full duplicating is the unique one with no direct additive witness but with imported and transformed witnesses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryFactorization.l.summary: Packages four ablation facts about the KO7 orientation barrier. Shows removing duplication admits a simple size rank while simple typing preserves additive and affine barriers. Shows a sharing-aware counter decreases on the displayed step, contrasting with the tree obstruction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryFactorization.l.boundary: Removing step duplication dissolves the direct barrier while simple typing preserves it; sharing-aware semantics can make the same step orientable, so the tree barrier depends on duplication under tree semantics.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryFactorization.l.conclusion: The four ablation facts jointly compare duplication, typing and sharing as factors in the KO7 barrier.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Checked.summary: Defines the exact duplicating relation DupStep, the six-member DeclaredDirectFamily, and the CheckedNonOrientationCertificate structure recording evaluator, order, substitution and a proof of order violation. Proves generic soundness that any such certificate refutes global orientation of its relation and of its system, with a system-indexed wrapper. Lifts scalar BarrierCertificate and relational RelationBarrierCertificate objects into checked certificates and supplies extractors for each direct family plus fixed KO7 system adapters, including a closed simpleSize certificate with its non-orientation theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Checked.boundary: An evaluator equipped with a checked certificate and violating substitution cannot globally orient the duplicating step or its system; the file places no claim on methods outside the six declared direct families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Checked.conclusion: The closed simpleSize certificate refutes global orientation of the exact KO7 rewrite system by its stored evaluator and order.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Countab.summary: Defines countableRoleDivergence as a tsum over any index type and relates it to finite sums and to klFromUniform under a uniform reference. Proves a termwise Gibbs bound and from it nonnegativity under equal total mass, strict positivity, and summability, with a mass-one specialization. Shows divergence vanishes at the reference law and that on finite alphabets it recovers the finite role gap, vanishing exactly at uniformity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Countab.boundary: On finite alphabets a uniform reference exists and divergence reduces to a finite sum, while on countably infinite support no uniform law exists so divergence is measured against a chosen reference and is nonnegative only under equal mass and convergence of the series.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Countab.conclusion: Countable divergence from a strictly positive reference is nonnegative under equal mass and summability and recovers the finite role gap with equality to zero exactly at uniformity.
assumptions: nonnegativity of nu and strict positivity of rho
equal total mass via HasSum nu m and HasSum rho m, mass-one specialization HasSum 1
Summable divergence series as explicit hypothesis

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Declare.summary: Defines the declared syntax with proof-bearing inputs for six direct families, plus construction and projection escapes and an explicit outside case for RDRS families. Defines classification into blocked, escape, or outside results and proves every direct method is blocked by its extracted checked certificate, with system-level soundness. OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/DirectM.summary: Introduces a reflected grammar of measures over counter and payload with evaluation, payload monotonicity by structural induction, unbounded payload dependence, and orientation of the duplicating step. Defines syntactic positive-floor and effective-payload certificates with executable checkers and proves the pump barrier that unbounded measures cannot orient. Proves effective certificates imply unboundedness and hence blockage, a payload-section dichotomy yielding payload-blindness as necessary for orientation, an exact equivalence between orientation and payload-blindness plus strict counter response, and incompleteness of the checker on payload times counter.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/DirectM.boundary: Measures with effective or unbounded payload dependence cannot orient the duplicating step, while payload-blind measures with strict counter response can; the executable effective-payload checker is sound but incomplete, rejecting payload times counter despite genuine payload dependence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/DirectM.conclusion: Orientation of a grammar measure holds exactly when it is payload-blind with strict counter response, so effective payload dependence blocks orientation while the counter projection orients.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Distinc.summary: Defines an abstract record-generating surface and distinction completeness requiring non-null records to come from distinct inputs. Proves equal inputs are inert, every non-null record certifies distinction, and completeness is equivalent to absence of reflexive non-null emissions. Instantiates a concrete surface mapping equal inputs to void and distinct inputs to diff, proves it distinction-complete, and proves self-broadcasts impossible while broadcasts require and are realized by distinct inputs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Distinc.boundary: On a distinction-complete surface equal inputs can only emit null records while any non-null emitted record certifies distinct inputs, so self-broadcasts are impossible and broadcasts require distinction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Distinc.conclusion: The concrete eqW surface mapping equal inputs to void and distinct inputs to diff is distinction-complete, so equal inputs are inert and broadcasts require distinct inputs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoDef.summary: Defines the target conditional induced by a posterior map and a sufficiency certificate identifying a conditional with it. Proves an echo state forces zero licensed-channel deficit for normalized object laws, both directly and for any sufficient conditional. Proves positive deficit forces an informative channel one-way, and combines zero deficit with exclusion of licensed non-null records and false-formal-legitimacy diagnosis under soundness and witnessedness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoDef.boundary: Echo forces zero licensed-channel deficit and excludes licensed non-null records, while positive deficit forces an informative channel; zero deficit alone does not imply echo because variation on zero-weight cells is tolerated.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoDef.conclusion: An echo state yields zero deficit for the induced target conditional and, under soundness and witnessedness, no licensed non-null record, with raw non-null emission diagnosed as false formal legitimacy.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoFor.summary: Defines a depth-one raw emission graph with terminal record nodes and proves records are normal forms with trivial reachability and nonjoinability of distinct records. Proves false formal legitimacy yields a one-step peak with unjoinable targets, three distinct nodes, and nonconfluence at the source. Combines echo, zero deficit, legitimacy failure, nonconfluence and fixed-state dynamics with unbounded mass growth into a single trap theorem and packages all echo laws into an EchoLawCrown held by every episode.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoFor.conclusion: Echo with raw non-null emission jointly yields zero deficit, false formal legitimacy, source nonconfluence with three distinct nodes, unbounded mass growth and a fixed state with no licensed non-null record at any depth.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoLaw.summary: Defines a licensed emission episode with answers, distinctions, and raw and licensed surfaces, plus echo as object-independence and informativeness as object-sensitivity. Proves echo is equivalent to non-informativeness and, under licensed soundness and witnessedness, that echo states emit no licensed non-null records while any such record forces informativeness. Defines false formal legitimacy and echo dynamics with iterated runs, proving mass grows by steps, state never moves, echo persists, and no licensed non-null record appears at any depth from echo.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoLaw.boundary: Echo states emit no licensed non-null records while any licensed non-null record forces an informative channel; raw non-null emission at an echo state is false formal legitimacy that still yields two distinct raw targets.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoLaw.conclusion: Under licensed soundness and witnessedness, echo states have no licensed non-null records at any run depth while runs gain unbounded mass with a fixed licensing state.
assumptions: Classical logic via Classical.byContradiction for echo iff not informative

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoLaw.summary: This file builds two echo-law episodes around a quotation peak. The Boolean quoteEpisode answers with the object off peak and with false at peak, with raw and licensed emission relations. The QuoteEvalCfg-based quoteKernelEpisode uses QuoteEvalStar with congruence enabled for raw emissions and disabled for licensed emissions, with null as value void and non-null as diverged. It proves echo at the peak, informativeness off peak, licensed soundness, false formal legitimacy at the peak with no licensed non-null record, a trap run that stays at peak with growing mass, and a combined peak conjunction with nonjoinable raw outcomes; a final bundle records diagonal conclusions from three settings.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoLaw.boundary: At the peak the answer is independent of the object, whereas off peak the answer varies with the object. The raw relation reaches a non-null record at the peak, whereas the licensed relation has no such record.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/EchoLaw.conclusion: The quotation kernels give false formal legitimacy at the peak with raw reachability to both value void and diverged that do not join while licensed reachability to diverged is absent.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/FamilyG.summary: The file introduces AttainedValueFamily, a carrier of source and target Nat readings with orientation meaning target below source at every index, and adapters grammarFamily and schemaFamily that translate grammar measures and schema evaluations into this carrier while preserving and reflecting orientation. It proves a reusable coefficient-gap dominance lemma and counter monotonicity of MeasureExpr, showing one grammar expression cannot realize both frozen source and target sections when a strict reversal holds. For additive, affine, restricted-quadratic, cross-term, multilinear, polynomial and max families it freezes source and target sections at the base and proves each cannot orient the duplicating step under unboundedness and stated side conditions, and packages all seven with their hypotheses in ReflectedScalarFamilyGrammar whose every constructor fails to orient.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/FamilyG.boundary: Orientation requires target below source everywhere, but past an explicit attained threshold each record family reverses to source below target. Counter-monotone grammar expressions cannot span that reversal, so one expression cannot realize both frozen sections.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/FamilyG.conclusion: Every constructor of ReflectedScalarFamilyGrammar with its stored unboundedness and domination hypotheses fails to orient the duplicating step.

HasUnboundedRange and HasUnboundedRangeQ and HasUnboundedRangeX and HasUnboundedRangeML and HasUnboundedRangePoly and HasUnboundedRangeMax
CrossTermBoundedAtBase and MultilinearDominatedAtBase and EventuallyDominatedAtBase side conditions

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/FiniteC.summary: For a finite menu of candidate channels with a zero-cost baseline, capacity at budget b is the maximum licensed gain among eligible channels. The file proves capacity is realized, nonnegative, bounded by the envelope, and monotone in budget, with Omega defined as envelope minus capacity antitone in budget. A two-channel one-bit menu illustrates the theory with capacity zero at budget zero and one at budget one.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/FiniteC.boundary: A channel is usable when its cost does not exceed the budget, and unusable otherwise. Raising the budget from zero to one moves the one-bit menu from zero capacity and Omega one to capacity one and Omega zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/FiniteC.conclusion: Budgeted Omega is antitone in budget, illustrated by the one-bit menu dropping from one to zero as capacity rises from zero to one.
assumptions: Fintype I
zero-cost baseline with cost baseline = 0
gain bounds with gain_nonneg and gain_le_envelope
Classical.choice for noncomputable bestChannel

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/GatedRe.summary: Introduces gated readout: a reading branch on the distinction region, a fixed silence answer off it, and two probes separated by the reading. It proves object-witnessed follows, echo holds off the distinction region, with equivalences linking echo to negated distinction and informativeness to distinction, plus licensed-record consequences under soundness. The Boolean comparator has a gated readout with diagonal echo region, while a flip episode shows the condition is sufficient but not necessary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/GatedRe.boundary: Echo holds where the distinction fails, and informative reading holds where the distinction holds. A licensed non-null record appears where the distinction holds, never at an echo state under licensed soundness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/GatedRe.conclusion: Gated readout yields object-witnessed channels with echo holding off the distinction region, realized by the comparator but not necessary as the flip episode shows.
assumptions: DecidableEq W for comparator instance
Classical.byContradiction for informativeAt_iff_distinction

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Homomor.summary: The file defines finitary signatures, algebras, homomorphisms and free terms with evaluation and substitution. It proves evaluation commutes with homomorphisms and a projection cannot factor through a homomorphism that collapses a pair it separates. It proves a predicate cannot be defined by a term equality with a fixed truth token when a homomorphism fixes the token, holds the predicate on a pair and breaks it after mapping, with disequality as a specialization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Homomor.boundary: Term definability by equality with a truth token holds in general but fails across a homomorphic collapse that fixes truth while identifying a predicate-positive pair whose image breaks the predicate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Homomor.conclusion: If a signature-preserving endomap fixes truth but collapses a predicate-positive pair whose image breaks the predicate, no free term defines that predicate.
assumptions: universe polymorphism

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/OmegaPr.summary: The file shows a relation isomorphism with equivalences of finite evidence alphabets preserves Omega by pullback, including identity transport. It shows equal Omega does not imply a relation isomorphism using two finite chains with equal Omega but different cardinalities. It packages preservation as sufficient and Omega equality alone as insufficient for characterizing transport.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/OmegaPr.boundary: Coupled relation and evidence relabeling always preserves Omega, but equal Omega values do not imply a relation isomorphism exists.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/OmegaPr.conclusion: Coupled relabeling preserves Omega, yet two chains share Omega values without any relation isomorphism between them.
assumptions: Fintype carriers for operational and evidence types
noncomputable relation isomorphism construction

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/OverEvi.summary: Defines over-evidence as strictly negative Omega and its magnitude as max zero minus Omega. It proves over-evidence holds just in case evidence exceeds the envelope, with magnitude equal to minus Omega in the negative regime. Finite chain examples give Omega minus one for one chain and minus two for the product, showing the regime is nontrivial.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/OverEvi.boundary: Negative Omega marks the regime where licensed evidence exceeds the terminal envelope. The one-chain resolving example gives Omega minus one and the product gives minus two, crossing the zero boundary into over-evidence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/OverEvi.conclusion: Licensed resolving evidence can exceed the terminal envelope, giving Omega minus one on one chain and minus two on the product.
assumptions: Fintype carriers T X W C
Real arithmetic

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.summary: The file defines deficitBits for converting licensed deficit from nats to bits, the overproduction gap as terminal Hartley entropy minus licensed bits, and a boundary event as a positive gap. It proves that zero deficit leaves a gap equal to terminal Hartley entropy, that a redundant echo channel forces this case with gap equal to log base 2 of terminal multiplicity, and that two or more reachable terminals then yield a boundary event, while a source-confluent normalizing relation with nonnegative gain never yields one. With explicit unit, uniform, echo and resolving channels it computes zero licensed bits for echo against one licensed bit for resolving, a gap of one for raw Fork3 with echo against zero for licensed Fork3 and for raw Fork3 with resolving, and lifts the echo case to general echo states with a conjoined summary law.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.boundary: A boundary event holds on the side where emitted terminal branch entropy exceeds licensed channel information, giving a positive overproduction gap, and fails on the side where confluence or resolving evidence supplies enough licensed information to close the gap.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.conclusion: In general an echo state with normalized weights leaves a gap equal to the full terminal Hartley entropy and gives a boundary event when at least two terminals are reachable, while the Fork3 conjunction records a one-bit gap and boundary event for raw echo evidence against zero gap and no event after licensing or under resolving evidence.
assumptions: Fintype instances on carrier types T, X, W, Cn and on E.Object
Channel-weight normalization ∀ w, ∑ c, ν w c = 1 where an echo or zero-deficit conclusion is drawn
EchoAt E s for the echo-state theorems
NormalizingAt and ConfluentAt plus 0 ≤ deficit for the no-event theorem
Noncomputable section; kernel-only with no sorry, axiom, admit or native_decide per module header

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.summary: The file defines asynchronous products of relations and independent products of evidence channels with a normalization structure. It proves terminal supports factor as Cartesian products, multiplicities multiply, and Hartley entropy adds under local normalization. It proves direct, licensed, deficit and deficit-bits entropies add for normalized channels, hence Omega adds for independent products. It gives a five-state sequential-overwrite system where the second stage erases the first choice, yielding one bit instead of two, so sequential composition is not additive.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.boundary: Omega adds for independent asynchronous products under normalization, but sequential overwrite composition does not add: two Fork3 factors give two bits separately while the composite gives one bit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.conclusion: Independent normalized products add Omega, while sequential overwrite yields one bit instead of two, so additivity holds for independence but fails for sequential composition.

It proves the star has m terminals and Hartley entropy log2 m when 1 <= m. It proves a role-constant channel leaves Omega equal to log2 m while the resolving channel supplies log2 m bits and closes Omega to zero, so their difference is log2 m, with the binary case recovering the Fork3 one-bit exchange.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.conclusion: Blind versus resolving role evidence differ by log2 m, with resolving gap zero and binary case recovering the one-bit Fork3 exchange.

It proves every scheduler entropy and Shannon gap is at most the Hartley envelope under local normalization, with the uniform scheduler attaining it. When scheduler entropy aligns with direct entropy, the Shannon gap equals licensed residual entropy, giving zero for fully resolving channels, with Fork3 echo one and resolving zero as instances.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.summary: The file proves Hartley entropy and Omega are invariant under relation isomorphism with fixed evidence, and under boundary isomorphism. OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Overpro.conclusion: Isomorphism preserves Omega while forward simulation collapsing Fork3 to Boolean and release data alone provide counterexamples to preservation and determination.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Payload.summary: The file defines cumulative carrier burden for payload length L and depth K as the sum of (i+1)*L. It proves additivity in L and the division-free identity that twice the burden equals (K+1)*(K+2)*L, showing linear growth in L and quadratic growth in K. It proves the burden is at least K+1 for positive L, hence exceeds any bound N and any multiple N*H0 for large depth.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Payload.boundary: For any bound N some depth K has burden at least N, so bounded burden holds for small depths and fails for large depths with no uniform bound.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Payload.conclusion: Cumulative burden has closed doubling form and exceeds every bound for large depth.
assumptions: Nat arithmetic only with 1 <= L for lower bounds
No sorry; #print axioms lines audit axioms without adding assumptions

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Persist.summary: Defines Exogenous as InformativeAt and PersistentExogenous as its Box modality over R-reachable states. Proves persistence is the greatest forward-invariant subpredicate of exogeny and that for exogenous states persistence holds exactly when no reachable state is an echo. Introduces the greatest exogeny-preserving subrelation SafeRel and proves an exogenous source either persists everywhere reachable or reaches an echo emitting no licensed non-null record under LicensedSound and ObjectWitnessed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Persist.boundary: An exogenous state persists at all R-reachable states exactly when no R-reachable state is an echo, and otherwise it expires at a reachable echo that emits no licensed non-null record.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Persist.conclusion: An exogenous source either remains exogenous at every R-reachable state or reaches an echo state emitting no licensed non-null record.
assumptions: Classical logic via Classical.byContradiction in expiry proofs
Arbitrary one-step relation R with Relation.ReflTransGen closure
LicensedSound E and ObjectWitnessed E for echo-state consequences
No sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Project.summary: Defines determination of a statement by a projection and a reversible versus irreversible layer split. Proves that if all base-derivable statements are determined by the reversible projection then any undetermined statement is not base-derivable, with counter exhaustion determined and wrapper parity undetermined in the wrapper example. Defines projection transactions and proves license step-invariance plus license-determined dimension and witness imply staticity along any trace, with a constant canonical static example and an identity counterexample showing step-invariance is load-bearing. Defines answers with optional provenance span and license, proves the fields independent with witness-first acceptance requiring license, and proves exogenous gain collapses when all data lie in closure with a non-empty off-closure example.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Project.boundary: Statements determined by the reversible projection may be base-derivable while statements not determined by it lie outside base derivability. Provenance without license is rejected and endogenous returns collapse to empty gain while off-closure returns give non-empty gain.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Project.conclusion: Statements undetermined by the reversible projection lie outside base derivability, license invariance forces staticity, and provenance and license are mutually non-entailing.
assumptions: No sorry/admit/axiom/native reduction; kernel-only
DecidableEq D for exogenousGain list filter
Nat wrapper state and List closure model

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Quantit.summary: Defines quantitative exogeny as nonzero licensed deficit and its persistent form over reachable states, alongside structural exogeny as informativeness. It proves nonzero deficit persists just in case no reachable state has zero deficit, and that nonzero deficit implies structural exogeny under normalized weights, lifted to persistent forms. A point-mass weighting gives zero deficit for any channel, yielding a Boolean off-diagonal state that is structurally exogenous but not quantitatively so.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Quantit.boundary: Nonzero licensed deficit implies structural informativeness under normalized weights, but structural informativeness can hold with zero deficit. The Boolean comparator at an off-diagonal state witnesses this strict refinement.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Quantit.conclusion: Nonzero licensed deficit implies structural exogeny under normalized weights, yet structural exogeny can hold with zero deficit as the Boolean off-diagonal example shows.
assumptions: Fintype X
Fintype E.Object
DecidableEq Cn for point-mass lemma
normalized weights forall w, sum c, nu w c = 1 for refinement
fixed baseline object o0 for refinement
nonzero deficit hypothesis for expiry equivalence
Classical.byContradiction for expiry direction

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/RoleSpl.summary: Defines value-factoring and role splits with an equal, role-split, or value-split trichotomy. Proves exact refuse, lift, and exogeneity characterizations via Bool separators and packages them as two-action boundaries. Instantiates the law payload-generically and for recursor, payload, and located free-recursor generator occurrences with the activity predicate equal to the extraction channel. Adds a cross-axis conjunction with direct-measure grammar closure and naturality non-discrimination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/RoleSpl.boundary: Value-factored maps refuse by agreeing on a role-split pair while some Bool map lifts by separating the pair and every separator is exogenous to value. The middle role-split case sits between point equality and value difference.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/RoleSpl.conclusion: A pair is a role split exactly when value-factored maps agree on it while a Bool separator distinguishes it exogenously, realized payload-generically and at located free-recursor generator occurrences.
assumptions: Classical logic with open Classical and noncomputable boolSeparator using decide
Occurrence and Role framework with occ_frame_ne_active
FreeBoundaryKernel and successor output for the located instance
No sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide beyond classical choice

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/TwoVoid.summary: Defines the frame and active occurrences of void with equal value projection and distinct roles. Proves swap invariance, self-test complementarity, fiber characterization, collision, maximal licensed sets with no greatest set, and two-versus-one symbol licensing limits. Proves value-only decoders fail while value-plus-role decoders succeed and combines refusal, separation, licensing, swap, decoding, root reducts, and a one-bit gap into the two-void boundary theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/TwoVoid.boundary: Value projection agrees on the two voids while role differs: value-factored maps and swaps preserve value but a Bool separator distinguishes roles. Value-only decoders fail where value-plus-role decoders succeed, and one symbol does not license what two symbols license.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/TwoVoid.conclusion: The frame and active void occurrences share value but differ in role with combined refusal, lift, licensing, swap, decoding and one-bit gap properties.
assumptions: DecidableEq D for the swap section
Occ Trace and void term framework
Kernel-only with no sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/VectorG.summary: Defines weak orientation and vector measures with orders dominated by scalar projections. Proves nonstrict orientation already forces payload-blindness and lifts this through dominated scalarizations to componentwise, primary-first, and weighted-sum orders. Combines scalar strict, scalar weak, and vector dominated results into an unconditional direct-measure barrier.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/VectorG.boundary: Any scalar or vector measure that orients the duplicating step, even nonstrictly, must be payload-blind. A payload-reading scalarization therefore blocks orientation outright.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/VectorG.conclusion: Strict, weak, and dominated vector orientations of the duplicating step all force payload-blindness, so payload-reading blocks orientation.
assumptions: Mathlib-only with no sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide/csimp/unsafe
Nat counter and payload carrier with closed MeasureExpr grammar
Unbounded-or-constant section lemma and payload monotonicity

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/VectorO.summary: Shows PrimaryFirstLt allows secondary decreases on primary ties and has explicit two-cycles in dimension three and in every dimension at least three, hence is not well-founded. Constructs prefix-equality lexicographic order and strict-primary weak-remaining order as well-founded repairs dominated by primary, fixed-coordinate, and row-sum projections. Transfers payload-blindness barriers to these orders with counter-vector orientation examples showing non-vacuity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/VectorO.boundary: Primary-first compatibility is ill-founded with two-cycles while prefix-lexicographic and strict-primary weak-remaining orders are well-founded and still force payload-blindness under orientation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/VectorO.conclusion: Primary-first orders fail well-foundedness in dimension at least three while lexicographic and strict-primary weak orders are well-founded and inherit payload-blindness with non-vacuous counter examples.
assumptions: Mathlib DFinsupp well-founded Pi.Lex
Finite vector dimensions with primaryIdx
No sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide/csimp/unsafe

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryGeneral/Witness.boundary: Acceptance holds exactly when all six obligations hold. Missing externalsLicensed or projectionsCosted moves from acceptance to rejection.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Accept.summary: The file defines certificate interfaces with permission, acceptance and soundness, and proves that accepted and certified membership imply the selected property. It defines observations, readouts and fiber acceptance, proving that a readout exists exactly when each fiber has a certificate and that properties and certificates transfer along abstractions. It develops cumulative availability with a noncomputable first available level characterizing availability and failure, and a path reachability modality with box, exogenous sensitivity, echo, persistence and a guarded safe relation that repairs persistence. Concrete Boolean, collapsing, flag, delayed and destructive-step examples separate pointwise from joint certificates and persistent from repaired behavior.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Accept.boundary: Availability holds at and after the first level and fails strictly before it, while persistence holds unless an echo state is reachable; the guarded relation restores persistence by retaining only sensitivity-preserving steps.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Accept.conclusion: The file establishes sound certificate interfaces with fiber-wise readout criteria, least available levels, box-persistence with guarded repair, and concrete separating examples.
assumptions: Classical.choose for readout existence and firstLevel
Classical.em and Classical.byContradiction for least-element and box negations
noncomputable firstLevel with autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Admiss.summary: The file defines finite action runs, future records and experimental indistinguishability, proving it the greatest stable relation and quotienting to a minimal observer with a unique factor from any surjective sufficient monitor. It proves adaptive experiments coincide with finite words, extracts common prefixes and boundary separating steps from distinguishing words and actual executions, and shows closed records admit no new adaptive distinction. It proves no continuous map from a preconnected space can discretely repair a merged pair, instantiated by the square-versus-sign example. It analyzes a destructive three-state model where no single adaptive run identifies all initials but independent trials do, and proves at most n-1 independent equality tests suffice to realize any finite behavioral record.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Admiss.boundary: States agree on all finite experiments exactly when no distinguishing word exists, and a connected carrier admits no continuous discrete repair of a merged pair; a single destructive adaptive run cannot identify all initials whereas sufficiently many independent trials can.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Admiss.conclusion: The least quotient by finite-experiment indistinguishability is the universal sufficient updateable observer, adaptive experiments add no power beyond words, continuous discrete repair is impossible on connected spaces, and finite independent banks of at most n-1 tests realize the full behavioral record.
assumptions: Classical.choose for the minimal-observer factor map
TopologicalSpace, PreconnectedSpace and DiscreteTopology for the continuous-discrete no-go
Fintype, DecidableEq, Nontrivial and card hypotheses for trial thresholds

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Affine.summary: The file characterizes equality of linear observations by kernel differences and inhabited affine fibers by kernel translates, proving a linear target is forced exactly when it vanishes on the kernel and otherwise yields a TypedBoundary witness with no observation-based readout. It proves unsolvability is equivalent to existence of a left annihilator and develops finite-row certificates with soundness, forced-target and refutation equivalences culminating in a trichotomy of inconsistency, forced value or ambiguity. It instantiates three Boolean equation systems with a bottom-retaining local update, proving the bottom record cannot detect consistency. It embeds the same examples over ZMod 2 with explicit row certificates, a negation refutation, a copy kernel vector and record-preserving kernel translations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Affine.boundary: A target is forced on a nonempty affine fiber exactly when it vanishes on the kernel, otherwise a kernel displacement gives distinct solutions with different values, and solvability fails exactly when an annihilator or row refutation exists while bottom-only records cannot separate consistency from inconsistency.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Affine.conclusion: Every finite linear observation admits either a row inconsistency refutation, a row certificate forcing the target, or a kernel witness of ambiguity, with the Boolean copy, negation and cancellation systems as linear instances and bottom-only records unable to detect consistency.
assumptions: Field K with AddCommGroup and Module structures on V W
Fintype I for finite row families
classical reasoning for kernel-witness dichotomy

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Binary.summary: The file defines the binary entropy deficit κ_ε in bits for bias ε. It proves a lower quadratic bound from a Pinsker inequality and an upper quadratic bound, combined into a two-sided bound for |ε| ≤ 1/2. The count of readings for c bits is bounded on both sides, with end-count ratio 2 ln 2. The lower constant 2/ln 2 is shown to be best possible via a fourth-order expansion.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Binary.boundary: For |ε| ≤ 1/2 the deficit lies between (2/ln 2)ε² and 4ε², and the lower constant 2/ln 2 cannot be improved because every larger constant is violated at some small positive bias.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Binary.conclusion: The binary entropy deficit is two-sided quadratic with sharp lower constant 2/ln 2, giving matching two-sided reading counts whose end ratio is 2 ln 2.
assumptions: |ε| ≤ 1/2 for two-sided bounds
ε ≠ 0 for positivity and count bounds
0 ≤ c for reading counts
kernel-only, no sorry or axiom per header

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: binaryEntropyDeficit ε is defined as 1 minus Real.binEntropy (1/2+ε) divided by Real.log 2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.sq_div_two_log_two_le_one_sub_binEntropy
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For real t with |t| ≤ 1, t^2/(2*Real.log 2) is at most 1 minus Real.binEntropy ((1+t)/2) divided by Real.log 2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.binaryEntropyDeficit_ge_two_div_log_two_mul_sq
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For real ε with |ε| ≤ 1/2, 2/Real.log 2 * ε^2 is at most binaryEntropyDeficit ε.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.binaryEntropyDeficit_le_four_mul_sq
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For real ε with |ε| ≤ 1/2, binaryEntropyDeficit ε is at most 4*ε^2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.binaryEntropyDeficit_two_sided
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For real ε with |ε| ≤ 1/2, both 2/Real.log 2 * ε^2 ≤ binaryEntropyDeficit ε and binaryEntropyDeficit ε ≤ 4*ε^2 hold.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.binaryEntropyDeficit_pos
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For real ε with ε ≠ 0 and |ε| ≤ 1/2, 0 is less than binaryEntropyDeficit ε.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.readings_count_two_sided
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For reals c ε with 0 ≤ c and ε ≠ 0 and |ε| ≤ 1/2, c/(4*ε^2) ≤ c/binaryEntropyDeficit ε and c/binaryEntropyDeficit ε ≤ c*Real.log 2/(2*ε^2).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.gate_count_eq_two_log_two_mul_fisher_count
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For real ε with ε ≠ 0, Real.log 2/(2*ε^2) equals 2*Real.log 2 * (1/(4*ε^2)).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.two_div_log_two_sharp
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For real C with 2/Real.log 2 less than C, there exists ε with 0 less than ε and ε ≤ 1/2 and binaryEntropyDeficit ε less than C*ε^2.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Binary.summary: The file constructs centered binary-pair laws on four sign outcomes with correlation r and computes means, moments, disagreement rates and characteristic functions via the pair kernel of cosines. It proves exact sinc and variance-scale cosine identities giving convergence of normalized n-fold kernels to the Gaussian kernel, and lifts this to characteristic convergence of scaled convolution laws for every linear report. It proves uniform quadratic characteristic bounds yielding coordinate and box tails and tightness, and develops bounded character-polynomial approximation to lift characteristic convergence to weak convergence. The result includes degenerate correlations and gives convergence for every bounded continuous test.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Binary.boundary: Nonnegative pair weights hold exactly for |r|≤1 and fail outside, and normalized n-fold sums converge weakly to the Gaussian with covariance r including the degenerate endpoints r=±1.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Binary.conclusion: Normalized sums of independent centered binary pairs with any correlation in [-1,1] converge weakly to the constructed Gaussian with that covariance, including degenerate endpoints.
assumptions: noncomputable section
IsProbabilityMeasure instances for pair laws
MetricSpace, MeasurableSpace, BorelSpace and normed-space structure for tightness
classical reasoning for finite case splits

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/BitDiv.summary: The file defines finite-weight entropy and joint laws for a binary label with one or N noisy readings of reliability 1/2+ε. It proves the one-reading conditional entropy and mutual information, independence and exactness characterizations, a fourth-order expansion, and N-reading information and majority-error bounds. It then proves uniform-state conditional entropy formulas with constant and injective equality cases, maximal-entropy characterization, and fair-pair and product-projection statements over arbitrary carriers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/BitDiv.boundary: A reading is independent of the label when bias is zero and determines it when bias is 1/2, while a uniform record leaves full entropy for constant observers and vanishing entropy for injective observers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/BitDiv.conclusion: One noisy reading holds log 2 minus binEntropy(1/2+ε), N readings hold at most that scaled by N with exponentially small majority error, and uniform-state conditional entropy is characterized at both extremes.
assumptions: Fintype state and record types
DecidableEq for fiber counting
Nonempty X for uniform laws
0 ≤ ε ≤ 1/2 for reliability and majority bounds
probability laws sum to 1
kernel-only, no sorry per header

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.summary: The file defines factorization of a finite reading through the actual range of a record. It proves fiber-constancy is equivalent to existence of such a range factor, including empty types. It proves the record boundary has three equivalent descriptions at an explicit unequal pair: record equality, existence of a record-preserving permutation sending one state to the other, and vanishing discrimination of all range-factored finite readings. It supplies Boolean controls: the constant record merges false and true with zero discrimination, while the identity record is separated by a deterministic reading of discrimination two.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.boundary: Same record is indistinguishable by every record-factored reading and lies in one stabilizer orbit, while distinct records are separated by a finite reading; the constant Boolean record merges and the identity splits.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.conclusion: Record equality, stabilizer orbit membership and universal zero discrimination coincide, witnessed by merging constant and separating identity Boolean controls.
assumptions: Fintype outcome types; Fintype Q and DecidableEq Q only for boundary_three_descriptions
Classical choice for range representative
No sorry, axiom or native_decide

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any q and finite-output K, RecordDetermined q K holds iff FactorsThroughRecordRange q K, including empty types.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.Boundary.boundary_three_descriptions
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For Fintype Q with DecidableEq and x0 != x1, q x0 = q x1 iff some stabilizer permutation sends x0 to x1, and iff every range-factored finite reading has zero discrimination on x0 x1.

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.summary: The file joins merged-direction blindness and split-direction indicator attainment for adaptive finite protocols about a Boolean label. It defines the one-reading indicator protocol from the Boolean indicator of the record and proves its observation law. It proves a merged pair yields zero terminal mutual information at every horizon and zero limit for every record-determined protocol, while a split pair indicator protocol is record-determined of discrimination two, gains at least one bit at horizon one at expected cost one. It packages these as equivalences: merged iff blind, and merged iff no unit-cost record-determined protocol reaches any target c in (0,1], with a joint goal declaration.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.boundary: Merged pairs are blind to every record-determined protocol at infinite resolution cost, while split pairs are resolved to one bit at cost one.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.conclusion: A distinct pair is merged iff every record-determined protocol is blind and iff no unit-cost protocol reaches any positive target up to one bit, while a split pair is resolved by the indicator protocol at cost one.
assumptions: Fintype action and outcome types
No finiteness or decidability on record type Q
Boolean label so capacity at most one bit
No sorry, axiom or native_decide; kernel-only

OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.summary: The file lifts infinite-cost blindness to conditional protocols with a retained initial record, proving merged pairs give zero conditional information at every horizon and limit. It builds independent-seed and indicator-seed protocols that preserve exact fair-label entropy and unit cost, yielding conditional equivalences for blindness and for infeasibility of any positive target up to one bit. It proves disjoint output supports give exclusive mass one, so the first-exclusive protocol stops after one reading with full prior entropy at cost one, and idle and Bernoulli-seeded variants attain every fraction c of the entropy at cost c. It packages exact finite-horizon and limiting seeded frontiers on the original output alphabet and for fair binary labels.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.boundary: Conditioned on any retained record, merged pairs stay blind at infinite cost for any positive target, while split or disjoint-support readings attain the target at matching finite cost.
OperatorKO7/Meta/BoundaryObserver/Bounda.conclusion: Merged pairs are exactly those blind to every conditional record-determined protocol, while disjoint rows and Bernoulli seeds attain every information-cost fraction c up to the prior entropy.
assumptions: Fintype initial-record, action and outcome types
Positive exclusive masses for stopping; unit-or-higher cost on positive-mass branches for cost bounds
Bernoulli parameter 0 <= c <= 1
No sorry, axiom or native_decide; original stopped law reused
