OperatorKO7/Meta/CompositionalMeasure_Im.summary: The file defines additive, abstract combining-function, and affine constructor-local measures with app positivity and subterm laws. It proves none of them can orient the duplicating rec_succ rule or full Step under transparent-delta or unboundedness hypotheses. It defines a delta-depth counter projection that does orient rec_succ while violating both app subterm laws, and packages simpleSize, tau, nodeCount and linear weights as additive instances.
OperatorKO7/Meta/CompositionalMeasure_Im.boundary: Compositional measures sensitive to duplicated subterm mass cannot orient the duplicating rec_succ rule, while the counter projection that discards wrapper mass can; sensitivity to duplication is the boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/CompositionalMeasure_Im.conclusion: No additive, transparent-delta abstract, or positive-sensitive unbounded affine compositional measure orients rec_succ or full Step, while the delta-depth counter projection does.
assumptions: w_app >= 1 for additive measures
c_app subterm laws forall x y, c_app x y > x and > y for abstract measures
transparent delta hypothesis c_delta c_void = c_void for Tier 2
positive wrapper sensitivity 1 <= app_left and 1 <= app_right for affine measures
unbounded range, succ-bias/scale >= 1, or wrap/base pump >= 1 for affine corollaries

OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputableMeasure.lean.summary: The file defines a computable Nat rank tau, the Dershowitz-Manna order DM, inner and outer lexicographic orders, and the triple measure mu3c from deltaFlag, kappaM and tau. It proves each of the eight SafeStep constructors strictly decreases mu3c, with delta-drop, multiset-drop or tau-drop. A generic pullback wrapper turns the decrease into well-foundedness of SafeStepRev.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputableMeasure.lean.boundary: Every guarded SafeStep rule strictly lowers the computable triple measure, so its reverse is well-founded; the unguarded duplicating step addressed elsewhere is not compositionally orientable.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputableMeasure.lean.conclusion: Every SafeStep step strictly decreases the computable triple measure, so SafeStepRev is well-founded.
assumptions: Classical reasoning used only in Prop-valued well-foundedness arguments; measures themselves computable
Guards deltaFlag t = 0 for merge-void rules and rec_zero
Guards kappaM t = 0 for merge_cancel and case splits for int_delta and eq_refl
No sorry, axiom, native_decide or noncomputable payload in the measure

OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputableMeasure_Verif.summary: The file re-checks tau monotonicity, delta transparency and the eq_diff inequality, well-foundedness of Lex3c and DM lifting. It re-checks all eight rule decreases, nested and large-trace edge cases, and the deltaFlag binary and characterization facts. It aggregates to SafeStep decrease, re-checks SafeStepRev well-foundedness, its computable-only derivation, and derives no infinite SafeStep chain.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputableMeasure_Verif.boundary: Every checked SafeStep rule lowers Lex3c under its guard, so no infinite forward SafeStep chain exists; without the decrease or guards the well-foundedness claim would fail.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputableMeasure_Verif.conclusion: All eight rules lower the computable triple measure, so SafeStepRev is well-founded and no infinite SafeStep chain exists.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputationalLayerCross.summary: Defines record-emission interfaces for a base-duplicating system, including witnesses, faithful emitters, semantic and rank-level projection kernels, and conservation emitters. Proves live coordinates are constant and non-injective while record coordinates are injective and retrieving, yielding sequential uncertainty reduction at stage one and a hidden-state requirement. Realizes all interfaces on free-term syntax with wrapper erasure and counter-depth rank, yielding computation-to-confession bridges and an OperationalIncompleteness package.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputationalLayerCross.boundary: When 1 ≤ K, stage-0 initial access does not directly retrieve the progress index while stage-1 record access does. The constant meta view alone is insufficient and needs hidden state, and live presence separates from terminal absence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ComputationalLayerCross.conclusion: Every faithful and projective record emitter with 1 ≤ K realizes the computation-to-record crossing and, with projection rank, the computation-to-confession bridge, instantiated on free syntax.
assumptions: 1 ≤ K depth-budget hypothesis for crossing and bridge theorems
i ≤ k and i < k stage bounds on canonical traces
DecidableEq LiveObs in FaithfulRecordEmitter
GeneratedByConstructors carrier hypothesis for projection uniqueness

OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionCrossingPoint.summary: Defines doubled carry and confession cost curves, the CarryExceedsConfess predicate, the least crossing point, derived budgets, marginal costs and continuation rules. Proves the crossing is witnessed at the license cost, bounded by it, persistent and exactly characterized, with zero payload never crossing. Proves derived budgets force confession and separates zero-value from bounded-value stopping regimes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionCrossingPoint.boundary: Carrying is cheaper or tied below the crossing point and costlier at and above it, without ever reversing. With payload zero no crossing occurs, and zero-value continuation is dominated everywhere while bounded-value continuation is excluded from vmax onward.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionCrossingPoint.conclusion: For nonzero payload the carry and confession cost curves cross at a computable point bounded by the license price and stay crossed, with sharp zero-payload failure and explicit stopping regimes.
assumptions: 1 ≤ p nonzero payload hypothesis
1 ≤ unitCost for bounded-value stopping
value bounded by vmax
Classical.byContradiction used for the iff characterization

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ConfessionCrossingPoint.confession_crossing_law
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If 1 ≤ p then the crossing point is bounded by licenseCost, holds at the point, fails below, is equivalent to reaching the point, forces confession from any derived budget, and zero payload never crosses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Argume.summary: Defines an argument-filtering witness, counter rank function, constructorwise filter and route evidence into unary counter syntax. Proves the rank equals the registered dependency-pair projection, computes the filtered duplicating shapes and packages the projection-rank profile. The soundness license is only a route-classification tag without a source termination transfer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Argume.boundary: The rank tracks successor depth and the recursive counter while assigning zero to wrappers, so payload is forgotten and the counter retained. The license tag alone does not transfer termination to the source.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Argume.conclusion: Argument filtering yields the same rank as the dependency-pair projection and the same filtered counter step, with only a rank-profile result.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Counte.summary: Defines direct and original-symbol subterm relations, a counter-coordinate witness, its rank function and route evidence. Proves the rank equals the DP projection with strict counter descent and wrapper erasure, and that the witness satisfies the generic semantic profile. The license tag names the intended route without supplying a general termination theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Counte.boundary: The rank tracks successor depth and the recursive counter while erasing wrapper payload to zero. The selected coordinate is only asserted to be the counter, without classifying all descents or proving a termination criterion.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Counte.conclusion: Direct counter projection yields the same rank as the dependency-pair projection with strict counter descent and wrapper erasure.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Family.summary: Collects four confession methods on the KO7 schema with shared DP rank and distinct license tags. Proves duplicating-step orientation, sensitivity violations, certified-forgetting conversion, pair-problem termination and imported polynomial termination. Records the gap with no direct whole-term witness closed by a licensed transformed-call route for every member.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Family.boundary: The direct whole-term witness language has no witness and the benchmark contract admits none at or below imported-whole level, while every family member supplies a licensed transformed-call route. OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Family.conclusion: Four distinctly licensed methods share one rank, orient the duplicating step, supply certified forgetting, and jointly resolve payload-level operational incompleteness.
assumptions: membership C in allConfessionMethods for family quantifiers

OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Optima.summary: The file defines supporting-module tags, hypothesis vocabulary, a boundary-entry record and a lookup assigning each of six universal-confession theorem identifiers a recorded status. All six entries are recorded as theorem-projected with no required hypothesis, one carrying an L2 tag. It defines four ledger buckets and a witness predicate linking statuses to buckets, with three conditional buckets empty. OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Optima.conclusion: The ledger records all six universal-confession theorems as theorem-projected with empty conditional buckets.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ConfessionMethod_Unific.summary: Isolates the convergence layer for dependency-pair, counter-projection, size-change and argument-filtering routes. It proves many safe root-shape cases by uniqueness or vacuity and discharges the global claim that every safe source is locally joinable, with lifts to context closure. OperatorKO7/Meta/Confluence_Safe.lean.boundary: Every safe-fragment source is locally joinable, while the full kernel Step fails local joinability at eqW void void because its two eqW rules overlap; the positive results hold for SafeStep only.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Conjecture_Boundary.lea.summary: This file collects theorem-level barriers for concrete method families. It defines a global-orientation interface and measures including nesting depth, multiplicative polyMul, node count, head precedence, linear weight and tree depth. It proves each cannot orient full kernel Step, with rec_succ and merge_cancel as witnesses, and notes full LPO and MPO succeed so only weaker components are refuted.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Conjecture_Boundary.lea.boundary: No single simple measure among kappa, lex, simpleSize, flags, constellation, depth, polynomial, counting or precedence weights strictly decreases on every full Step; rec_succ and merge_cancel provide complementary counterexamples.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Conjecture_Boundary.lea.conclusion: None of the listed simple measures globally orients full kernel Step.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosedBarrier.le.summary: This file lifts direct root-step barriers to the full context closure StepCtxFull. It defines global orientation of StepCtxFull and proves any such orienter restricts to the root relation via the identity context. It derives eleven context-closed no-orientation theorems for additive, transparent, affine, quadratic, matrix, multilinear, max and mixed families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosedBarrier.le.boundary: Measures that fail to orient the root duplicating step also fail to orient its full one-hole context closure; context closure adds no new orienting power for these families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosedBarrier.le.conclusion: All eleven listed barrier families survive from root Step to full context closure StepCtxFull.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosedBarrier_Pu.summary: This module lifts 26 root-level orientation impossibilities with discharged growth premises to the full context closure StepCtxFull. Each statement keeps exactly the premises of its root source; the lift adds nothing because every root contraction is a contextual contraction under the identity context. Families covered include affine, quadratic, multilinear, polynomial, max, arctic, tropical and many matrix and natural-matrix orders. Root and context-closed inventories stay in step at 106 and 106.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosedBarrier_Pu.boundary: No measure among the 26 listed families globally orients StepCtxFull under its stated boundedness, dominance or positivity premise; each root obstruction persists under arbitrary contexts through the identity-context embedding.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosedBarrier_Pu.conclusion: All 26 pump-discharged root orientation impossibilities lift unchanged to the full context closure StepCtxFull, keeping root and context-closed inventories at 106 each.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosed_Nonconflu.summary: This file proves the full contextual relation StepCtxFull is neither locally confluent nor confluent. It shows integrate void is contextually normal and exhibits eqW void void reaching both void and integrate void as distinct contextual normal forms. It concludes that no function can both identify contextual steps and fix normal forms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosed_Nonconflu.boundary: Confluence fails: one source reaches two distinct irreducible traces, void and integrate void, so neither joinability nor invariant normalization holds for the full context closure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosed_Nonconflu.conclusion: The full context closure has one source with two distinct normal forms, so it is neither locally confluent nor confluent and admits no invariant normalizer.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosed_SN.lean.summary: This file proves unconditional strong normalization for the selected-context closure of the safe fragment. It defines the reverse relation SafeStepCtxRev and the numeric interpretation ctxFuel with constructor-wise accessibility lemmas. It shows ctxFuel strictly decreases on safe root and contextual steps, yielding well-foundedness and accessibility for all traces and discharging the recursor obligation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosed_SN.lean.boundary: Every SafeStepCtx step strictly decreases ctxFuel, so all selected-context safe reductions terminate; the argument applies only to the safe fragment closed under the listed constructors.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextClosed_SN.lean.conclusion: The reverse selected-context safe relation is well-founded through strictly decreasing ctxFuel, so every trace is accessible.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextSCCRewriteTransp.summary: This file supplies the missing transport from finite SCC certificates to a rewrite relation on packet syntax. It defines single-node packets with edges as rewrite steps and lifts graph reachability and the SCC round-trip to a cycle between distinct packets. It proves the induced reverse relation is never well-founded, while no edge-respecting interpretation into terminating Trace steps exists.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextSCCRewriteTransp.boundary: Any finite SCC certificate induces a nonterminating packet rewrite cycle, yet no edge-respecting map into KO7 Step traces exists because Step terminates; transport reaches packets but not Trace.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextSCCRewriteTransp.conclusion: Every finite SCC certificate yields a nonterminating packet rewrite cycle, but no edge-respecting map into terminating KO7 Step exists.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextSCCTransport.lea.summary: This file packages a finite decidable graph with a nontrivial SCC beside independent KO7 boundary results. It defines the FiniteSCCCertificate structure and the canonical two-node Bool certificate with its nontrivial SCC. It proves every certificate yields an abstract round-trip and bundles it with the contextual-to-root orientation projection and the direct-observer barrier as coexistence without edge-to-rewrite transport.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextualCopyBudget.le.summary: This file gives the positive outcome of the contextual copy-budget complexity program. It defines the syntactic control copyBudget monotone under safe and contextual steps and the position-aware multiplicity potential ctxDupPotential. It proves strict contextual decrease, an exact-length bound by ctxDupPotential, and a single-exponential bound in structural term size.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextualCopyBudget.le.boundary: Safe contextual reductions never increase the copy budget and terminate within a single-exponential bound in term size; the position-aware potential achieves what a global max cannot.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextualCopyBudget.le.conclusion: Every SafeStepCtx chain from t has length at most ctxDupPotential t and hence at most 2^(2*termSize t) minus one steps.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextualCopyBudget_No.summary: This companion module records obstructions for contextual SafeStepCtx measures. It defines the rejected coordinates counterBudget and copyMass and concrete SafeStep and SafeStepCtx counterexamples where normalization cost, tau or mass increase while copyBudget stays flat. It defines the monotone expression class CoordExpr with lex-stack certification and proves no stack certifies the payload-recursive rec_succ obstruction, uniformly over a Nat-indexed family.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextualCopyBudget_No.boundary: No monotone arithmetic or lexicographic combination of copyBudget, counterBudget, tau and copyMass can decrease on the payload-recursive rec_succ steps, so that coordinate family cannot certify contextual termination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ContextualCopyBudget_No.conclusion: Every monotone arithmetic expression and every lexicographic stack over the four candidate coordinates fails on the payload-recursive rec_succ family.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DM_OrderType.lean.summary: This module calibrates the DM-based safe measure in ordinals. It defines dmOrdEmbed as a sorted sum of omega powers with inner and outer lex embeddings and unconditional DM and Lex3c ranks. It proves strict monotonicity and order reflection for dmOrdEmbed with bounds below omega^omega and below omega^omega times two and epsilon-zero. It proves strict safe-step decrease both explicitly per rule and via rank, combining rank termination with epsilon-zero calibration.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DM_OrderType.lean.boundary: DM multisets embed below omega^omega and safe triples below omega^omega times two below epsilon-zero, with strict decrease on every safe step; rank gives termination while the explicit embedding gives the epsilon-zero calibration.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DM_OrderType.lean.conclusion: Safe steps strictly decrease both the explicit triple ordinal below epsilon-zero and the unconditional Lex3c rank.
assumptions: classical choice (open scoped Classical)
noncomputable ordinal definitions requiring choice

OperatorKO7/Meta/DM_OrderType_LowerBound.summary: This file builds a canonical finite CNF payload type for ordinals below ω^ω with conversions to and from multisets and ordinal evaluation through dmOrdEmbed. It proves every code lies below ω^ω and, using Mathlib Cantor normal form decomposition, that every ordinal below ω^ω is hit. It proves reflection of order into DM yields equality of dmOrdEmbed and dmRankOrd, plus injectivity, an order-equivalence package, and a ω^ω·2 bound for the triple-lex measure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DM_OrderType_LowerBound.boundary: DM ordinal codes stay strictly below ω^ω and every ordinal below ω^ω occurs; ω^ω is the exact upper limit of the image.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/EchoStoppingMD.summary: Defines a finite-branching echo stopping problem with stop value, current gain, supplied future value and compute cost, plus dynamic and finite-horizon policies that compare stopping with continuation. Proves that zero or nonpositive current gain with positive cost and dominated continuations forces stopping, while a supplied future surplus and a realized two-state transition can make computing optimal. Shows the static decision problem embeds with zero continuation advantage and that horizon values are attained greatest returns independent of the supplied forecast, with exact edge and echo criteria for stopping at all horizons. Extends the theory to finite-support stochastic models with history-dependent policies, attained Bellman values, invariant stopping criteria ignoring zero-probability outcomes, and a three-outcome averaging example.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/EchoStoppingMD.boundary: Stopping is optimal when current gain is nonpositive, cost is positive and continuations are dominated or satisfy the edge inequality, while computing becomes optimal when a supplied or realized future surplus outweighs cost; stochastic criteria ignore zero-probability outcomes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/EchoStoppingMD.conclusion: Finite-horizon and stochastic Bellman values are attained greatest returns that equal immediate stopping exactly under edge and echo conditions, while future surplus can make computing optimal despite zero current gain.
assumptions: DecidableEq S for finite successor Finsets
nonempty successors and echo preservation inside observation fiber
Classical.dec for real order in dynamicPolicy and horizonPolicy
Classical.choose for stochastic attaining policies
no sorry or axiom in the file

OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/RecursorStoppi.summary: Defines execution-derived cumulative and marginal prices from the live r-ary recursor orbit and a closed-form least cutoff where marginal price reaches a benefit bound, with weak and strict variants. Builds a deterministic next-depth stochastic decision model whose Bellman value equals the maximum over exact stopping-time prefix returns, each realized by a policy that extends depth a chosen number of times. Proves exact one-step and all-horizon stopping criteria, closure of the post-cutoff region, and that the cutoff region forces stopping at every horizon against every adaptive policy while constant benefit below the cutoff continues. Includes arity-zero, zero-payload, zero-price and future-reward controls and a universal policy crown.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/RecursorStoppi.boundary: Below the marginal-price cutoff continuation is strictly better, while at and above the cutoff immediate stopping is optimal at every finite horizon against every adaptive policy. Zero price, zero payload or zero arity collapse the price and remove the cutoff.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/RecursorStoppi.conclusion: For duplicating recursors the execution-derived marginal price yields an exact least cutoff where stopping is optimal at every horizon, bounds every adaptive policy, and is attained.
assumptions: 0 < unitCost, 0 < payload and 0 < arity for cutoff lemmas
regional benefit inequality for states at or above cutoff
Nat ceiling division for closed-form cutoff
Classical.choose for attaining stopping times and policies
live r-ary orbit laws from RaryDuplicatorLaws
no sorry, axiom or native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/ReflectiveDepe.summary: Defines meta-query states with budget and obligation multisets, a lexicographic rank using Nat order and the Dershowitz-Manna order, and a licensed step that either drops budget or ties budget with strict multiset descent. Proves every licensed edge strictly decreases rank, so the licensed relation is well-founded and has no cycles, and that identity edges and equal-budget equal-obligation edges are never licensed. Exhibits a three-state terminating deliberation reaching a terminal state and a rank-tie pair with different labels that is blocked.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/ReflectiveDepe.boundary: A deliberation step is licensed exactly when rank strictly descends, while equal budget with equal obligations and identity self-loops are never licensed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/ReflectiveDepe.conclusion: Licensed deliberation strictly decreases a lexicographic budget and obligation rank, so it is well-founded and never contains identity, rank-tie or cyclic edges.
assumptions: MetaQueryState has DecidableEq by deriving
lexicographic rank reuses Nat.lt and MetaCM.DM
well-foundedness reuses MetaSN_DM.wf_dm for Multiset Dershowitz-Manna order
no sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice in the file

OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/ZeroDeficitSto.summary: Defines finite decisions, cell and direct losses, best losses, stop and compute expected losses, value of computation and an optimal meta-policy that computes only on strict improvement after cost. Proves that a channel-constant conditional has zero deficit and zero value of computation, so any positive cost forces stopping, reusing the imported licensed-channel deficit. Computes a two-action two-state instance where the copy channel stops at half cost, the revealing channel computes at half cost, ties at unit cost and stops, packaging the half-cost and unit-cost control.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/ZeroDeficitSto.boundary: With zero deficit any positive cost makes stopping strictly dominate, while positive deficit can make computing strictly better at low cost but still stops on a tie at unit cost.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Decision/ZeroDeficitSto.conclusion: A channel-constant zero-deficit channel has zero value of computation so any positive cost forces stopping, whereas a revealing channel can make computing optimal at low cost.
assumptions: DecidableEq A and Fintype X W Cn for finite decisions
channel law sums to one and channel-constant hypothesis for zero-deficit results
positive cost hypothesis for forced stopping
bounded Nat-valued loss
Classical.dec for real order in optimalMetaPolicy
no sorry, axiom or native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_CallGra.summary: This module derives a binary edge relation from a caller-supplied finite call-graph presentation with node keys and successor-key sets. It builds the induced finite dependency-pair graph and reuses the finite SCC search surface. It repackages discovered SCCs as standard cycle witnesses and exposes contradiction theorems when a candidate measure fails to drop.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_CallGra.boundary: A measure globally orients the graph only if it strictly drops along every SCC path; a non-drop across a discovered pair obstructs global orientation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_CallGra.conclusion: Finite call-graph SCC witnesses yield direct contradictions against any non-dropping global orienter.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_Fragmen.summary: This module packages rank-based pair problems where every extracted pair strictly decreases a projection rank, and finite-path reasoning where a nonempty path forces strict decrease under any global orienter. It defines reverse relations with rank-based well-foundedness and a historically named SCCCycle holding a one-way TransGen path. It proves orientation propagates along paths and non-drop precludes global orientation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_Fragmen.boundary: A global orienter must strictly decrease along any nonempty TransGen path; failure to drop across the stored path precludes global orientation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_Fragmen.conclusion: Rank decrease gives well-founded reverse pairs and any global orienter must drop along TransGen paths.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_Normali.summary: The pair relation contracts only a successor at the head of the counter, and RankedMachine supplies normalization laws for deterministic ranked relations. The file instantiates this for KO7 traces and for free recursor syntax with successor depth rank. It proves step characterizations, determinism, reachability, normality, idempotence, confluence, length and normal-form recurrences, and normalization certificates with length bounded by rank.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_Normali.conclusion: KO7 and free recursor pairs are deterministic, confluent, and normalizing with explicit length and normal-form recurrences.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_Works.l.summary: The file states the single dependency pair for the KO7 duplicating recursor rec_succ and defines a rank keeping only recursion-counter depth. It proves every pair step strictly decreases the rank and packages the data as a reusable projection problem. This yields well-foundedness of the reverse pair relation. It also embeds naturals as iterated delta counters inside the actual pair relation to transport well-foundedness to Nat.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DependencyPairs_Works.l.conclusion: The reverse KO7 dependency-pair relation is well-founded and transports well-founded induction to the natural numbers via an explicit counter embedding.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DepthBarrier.lean.summary: The file defines a KO7 max-aggregative depth family with per-constructor bumps and positivity of the app bump. It evaluates by adding bumps to maxima over arguments. It forgets KO7-only weights to view the family as a schema-level measure. It deduces that no such measure globally orients steps and that standard tree depth in particular does not.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DepthBarrier.lean.boundary: No max-aggregative depth with positive wrap offset can decrease across the duplicating step. The shared-branch instance makes the wrapped target strictly larger, so global orientation by such depths is impossible.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DepthBarrier.lean.conclusion: No KO7 max-depth measure globally orients all steps, and in particular standard unit tree depth does not.
assumptions: MaxDepthMeasure.h_app_pos requiring 1 <= c_app

OperatorKO7/Meta/DepthBarrier_Schema.lea.summary: The file defines a schema-level max-aggregative depth family with equations for succ, wrap and recur plus a positive wrap offset. It proves no such measure strictly orients the duplicating rule uniformly. The contradiction uses base, succ base and base where both sides share frozen branches. It lifts the result to global orientation without an unbounded-range hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DepthBarrier_Schema.lea.boundary: No schema max-depth measure with positive wrap offset orients the duplicating rule. The shared-branch instance makes the wrapped target strictly larger than the source, ruling out uniform strict decrease.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DepthBarrier_Schema.lea.conclusion: No schema-level max-depth measure strictly orients the duplicating rule uniformly, hence none globally orients a duplicating system.
assumptions: MaxDepthMeasure.h_wrap_pos requiring 1 <= c_wrap

OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectBarrierScope.lean.summary: The file records the direct-orientation barrier scope as a nine-field record plus an InScope predicate. It provides a fully true sentinel that is in scope as a positive control. It provides six sentinels for sharing, binders, innermost-only, co-orders, computability and quotients. Each flips exactly one field to False and is proved not in scope.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectBarrierScope.lean.boundary: The direct-orientation no-go holds only inside tree semantics with first-order full rewriting and monotone syntactic-direct observation without equational quotient. Each named sentinel violates exactly one conjunct and lies outside scope.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectBarrierScope.lean.conclusion: The fully true scope is in scope while six sentinels each violating exactly one condition are provably not in scope.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectToolSearchMapping.summary: The file packages tool-facing fragments for additive, affine, restricted quadratic, bounded multilinear and bounded polynomial measures. Each carries its measure plus explicit unbounded, successor-pump, wrap-pump or dominance witnesses. For each of the thirteen fragments it proves the existing schema barrier forbids global orientation. Unrestricted nonlinear families without witnesses and cross-term and matrix continuations stay open.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectToolSearchMapping.boundary: Each listed additive, affine, quadratic, multilinear or polynomial fragment with its stated unbounded, pump or dominance witness cannot globally orient. Unrestricted nonlinear families without such witnesses remain outside the barrier and are left open.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectToolSearchMapping.conclusion: All thirteen tool-facing fragments with their stated witnesses are blocked from global orientation, while unrestricted nonlinear families without witnesses stay open.
assumptions: explicit unbounded-range, successor-pump, wrap-pump and base-dominance or eventual-dominance witnesses carried by each fragment

OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectWholeTermObserver.summary: The file defines a generic direct whole-term observer with carrier, evaluation, visibility, sensitivity and a certificate linking orientation to payload-count drop. It proves an observer seeing a pumped strictly exposed coordinate cannot globally orient the family. It opposes the family rise against the observer-forced drop. It instantiates the payload-count observer and derives its failure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectWholeTermObserver.boundary: An observer that is visible and carrier-sensitive on a pumped strictly exposed payload coordinate cannot globally orient the family. Hypothetical orientation would force a payload-count drop contradicting the strict rise.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DirectWholeTermObserver.conclusion: No visible carrier-sensitive observer on a pumped strictly exposed coordinate globally orients the family, in particular not the payload-count observer.
assumptions: HasUnboundedPayloadPump at the exposed coordinate
ExposesPayloadStrictly at that coordinate
observer visibility and carrier-sensitivity at that coordinate

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Adm.summary: This file defines local admissibility at a fixed diagonal source eqW a a as containment in Step plus retention of the reflexive verdict and local joinability. It proves every admissible relation must refuse the competing diagonal-difference edge to integrate (merge a a). It exhibits the reflexive-only repair, proves it admissible and non-vacuous, and derives its refusal of the difference edge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Adm.boundary: At the fixed source eqW a a, an admissible repair retains the void verdict but must refuse the competing integrate (merge a a) edge; local joinability forces this refusal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Adm.conclusion: Every admissible repair at eqW a a refuses the diagonal-difference edge, and the reflexive-only repair shows the class is inhabited.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.summary: This file proves disequality is the unique and greatest diagonally safe and off-diagonal complete guard, with the empty guard as independence witness. It characterizes the exact relation difference between Step and EqGuardedStep as the diagonal-difference family and records strict inclusions with SafeStep. It defines guard-free admissible repairs, proves EqGuardedStep is the unique greatest one, and forces its difference branch to recognize disequality.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.boundary: Among subrelations of Step retaining non-diagonal branches, the reflexive verdict, and local confluence, EqGuardedStep is the greatest admissible repair and its difference branch fires exactly for distinct pairs; the full kernel Step lies outside by failing admissibility while SafeStep lies strictly inside.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.conclusion: EqGuardedStep is the unique greatest admissible repair and forces the exact disequality guard for the difference branch.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.summary: This file normalizes contextual joinability of the diagonal peak to reduction of the difference verdict to void. It proves a strengthened sufficiency where any a reaching a delta-headed term dissolves the fracture, with congruence closures and cone invariants for integrate and merge. It proves the full biconditional classifier, packages the proven scope, and shows both sides inhabited with proper strengthening.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.boundary: The contextual diagonal peak at eqW a a joins exactly when a contextually reaches a delta-headed term; the void diagonal stays unjoined while every delta-headed diagonal joins, so root uniformity does not lift to context.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.conclusion: The contextual diagonal peak joins iff the weight reaches a delta-headed term, partitioning the carrier into join and nonjoin regions.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.summary: This file completes the two contextual cone lemmas used by the contextual join-region characterization. It proves that integrate X reaches void under contextual closure exactly when X reaches a delta-headed term. It proves that merge a a reaches a delta-headed term exactly when a reaches such a term, using contextual merge steps and merge cancellation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.boundary: integrate X reaches void contextually exactly when X can reach a delta-headed term. Self-merge reaches a delta-headed term exactly when its component can.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.conclusion: Both the integrate-void cone and the self-merge-delta cone hold as if-and-only-if characterizations.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.summary: This file defines the full context closure of the surgical EqGuardedStep repair and its confluence predicate. It introduces the witness eqW of merge void void with void, whose arguments are distinct yet joinable, and builds two routes to the normal forms integrate void and void. It proves the guarded contextual relation is not confluent, isolates disequality-guard instability, and states that contextual repair needs more than a root guard.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.boundary: The surgical repair is confluent at the root but its full context closure is not confluent; a disequality guard licensed at the root can become diagonal after an argument step, so root minimality fails under context.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.conclusion: The full context closure of EqGuardedStep is not confluent because a disequality guard is unstable under reduction, as shown by an explicit witness with two unjoinable normal forms.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.summary: This file fixes the scope of the diagonal fork under full context closure. It proves void is contextually normal and that reducts of the void difference verdict stay in a two-element cone disjoint from void, so the void peak stays unjoined. It proves every delta-headed diagonal peak joins at void via merge cancellation and the integrate-delta rule, and packages survival plus dissolution as the fracture scope.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.boundary: Under full context closure the diagonal fracture survives at the void diagonal but dissolves at every delta-headed diagonal, so the root uniformity in a does not transfer to context.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Con.conclusion: The contextual fracture is instance-dependent, surviving at eqW void void and dissolving at delta-headed diagonals.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Cri.summary: This file proves the eqW reflexive diagonal is the unique source of root non-joinability for full kernel Step. It records the joinable merge overlap at merge void void and absence of recursor root overlap. It proves every non-diagonal source joins by exhaustive analysis and every diagonal source fails, packaging the iff completeness with eqW void void as canonical witness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Cri.boundary: A root source fails local confluence exactly when it is a reflexive eqW diagonal; every other shape including the merge triple overlap and off-diagonal eqW joins, and the recursor rules do not overlap.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Cri.conclusion: The eqW reflexive diagonal is exactly the set of root confluence obstructions, with eqW void void as canonical witness.

It gives a lossy self-evaluation law without faithful quotation, a separated universal evaluator without Bool-Unit identification, closure of all Bool endomaps without one-code universality, and a correct Bool comparator without closure of negation alone. Each pair is packaged as a reverse-separation certificate.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dia.conclusion: The four diagonal-grade capabilities are separated from their converses by explicit finite witnesses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dia.summary: The file declares seven tags with semantic realizations on Trace and on supplied relation and observer data, plus proof-carrying Verdict obstructions. It proves a uniform positive transport table for D1s, D1p and D2 under observer factorization, step lifting and simulation, and code denotation preservation. It gives two finite Bool fixtures showing simulation alone does not move D1p forward and lifting alone does not reflect D2, plus seven reverse separations and four computation-rule families. It packages clauses (i) to (iv) into a finite stratification theorem stated only for the declared tags.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dia.boundary: Stratification is claimed only on the seven declared tags and nothing is claimed outside them. Forward D1p transport fails with simulation alone and D2 reflection fails with lifting alone, so each direction needs its stated hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dia.conclusion: Clauses (i) to (iv) are mechanized jointly on three structural and four dynamic tags and on no wider tag universe.
assumptions: noncomputable obstructionAt and gradeObstruction using classical choice

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dia.summary: The file freezes copy, comparison and self-evaluation structures and gives copy and comparison witnesses on Trace. It shows ambient classical logic supplies a comparator on every carrier, refuting unconditional copy-without-comparison separation, and separates the levels instead by naturality under merging maps with a Fin 3 witness. It shows Trace is free with only the identity signature endomorphism, so the merging carrier cannot be Trace. It defines Sigma-definability and signature internality and proves no Sigma-definable universal evaluator and hence no internal self-evaluation diagonal, closed by a three-level ladder.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dia.boundary: Copy versus comparison separates only clone-relatively by naturality under merging maps and not unconditionally in classical Lean. Comparison versus self-evaluation separates only relative to signature internality, with universality as the failing field.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dia.conclusion: Trace copies and compares, copying and comparison separate only by naturality on a merging carrier, and no self-evaluation diagonal on Trace is internal to the seven-constructor signature.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dis.summary: The file defines the executable structural comparator structEq and proves it sound and complete for syntactic identity. It defines discOp returning the collapse point on the diagonal and proves it is the exact discriminator. It defines the executable guarded relation and proves it coincides with the disequality-guarded relation. It proves natural-under-merging extensions define no discriminator and that the comparator is minimal in the declared two-entry grammar given failure of the empty entry.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dis.boundary: The comparator and discriminator exist as metalanguage operations outside the fixed seven-constructor clone where the no-go lives. Minimality holds only inside the declared none versus comparator grammar.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dis.conclusion: One executable comparator suffices to define the discriminator and is minimal in the declared grammar.
assumptions: Empty-entry failure taken as explicit hypothesis hnone in comparator_is_minimal_in_grammar, discharged externally by SyntacticNonDerivability

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dyn.summary: The file defines D0 with no license, D1s as present observer disequality, D1p as disequality persisting under all independent futures, and D2 as D1p plus an internally represented comparator. It proves the forward ladder D2 to D1p to D1s to D0 and an exact bridge identifying D1p with persistent Box under pair lifting. It shows the KO7 coalescing pair has D1s but not D1p, the stable delta-void pair has D1p and reaches D2, and the write-closed repair blocks the instability branch.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dyn.boundary: Static distinction now does not imply persistent distinction under all futures. The KO7 coalescing pair has D1s but not D1p, while the stable pair reaches D2.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dyn.conclusion: D2 implies D1p implies D1s implies D0 with strictness at D1s versus D1p and D2 witnessed by the stable KO7 pair.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dyn.summary: The file defines observer factorization, one-step simulation and lifting, and represented-by-code with denotation-preserving code maps. It proves simulation and lifting extend to reflexive-transitive paths. It proves D1s moves both ways along factorization, D1p reflects along simulation and transports along lifting, and D2 transports between comparator languages only through an explicit code map.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dyn.boundary: Persistent distinction reflects with simulation but transports only with lifting. D2 moves between languages only through explicit denotation-preserving code maps.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Dyn.conclusion: Static and persistent grades move exactly under the stated factorization, simulation, lifting and code-map hypotheses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Equ.summary: The file defines a certified classification payload for equality modes with fork label and enum reflection. It certifies the raw unguarded totalized rewrite mode as the sole fork-carrying mode and gives no-fork certificates for the other modes, with typed comparison additionally backed by global SafeStep confluence. It proves the five-mode table complete and certifies collapse as the raw diagonal-fork case with explicit non-joinability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Equ.boundary: Only the raw unguarded totalized rewrite mode carries the diagonal-fork label, while the other five modes carry none, with typed comparison backed by global confluence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Equ.conclusion: Exactly the raw mode forks, with collapse certified as the raw non-joinable case.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Fre.summary: The file defines positional constructor flags with split app sides, the positional closure and confluence predicate, and an embedding recovering the constructor-grade closure. It proves necessity of eqW freezing and both recD to appR and recD to appL with instability, B1 and recS peaks, refuting the one-sided candidate. It proves sufficiency by root-peak enumeration and local-to-global join with inherited normalization, yielding the exact two-sided characterization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Fre.boundary: Confluence holds exactly when eqW is frozen and thawing recD thaws both app positions. Thawing recD with only appR thawed still fails at the recS peak.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Fre.conclusion: Positional confluence is exactly eqW frozen with two-sided recD-to-app alignment.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Fre.summary: The file defines the seven-head constructor selection Ctor and the selective closure CtxOn of the surgical EqGuardedStep relation, with its star closure and confluence predicate. It transports an eqW instability peak to prove that eqW congruence breaks confluence, and exhibits a recD-thawed app-frozen peak to refute that freezing eqW alone suffices. It then proves root-peak enumeration, local joinability, Newman lifting to the corrected crown, full-thaw simulation against the compiled contextual relation, and concrete branching-and-joining witnesses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Fre.boundary: Confluence holds exactly when eqW congruence is frozen and thawed recD implies thawed app; enabling eqW, or thawing recD while app stays frozen, breaks confluence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Fre.conclusion: The constructor-selective equality-guarded closure is confluent exactly when eqW is frozen and recD implies app.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Gat.summary: The file defines record-license events and the frame and active occurrences of the duplicated KO7 generator. It proves the pair shares a Trace value but differs in role, refuses a value record while admitting a role record, and identifies that role record with the live R_rec_succ dependency-pair channel separation plus extraction certificates. The capstone conjoins these with the SafeStep guard refusal and the one-bit local-cone accounting, explicitly without proving dependency-pair soundness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Gat.boundary: On the duplicated generator the value record is refused while the role record is admitted; the derivation yields license issuance and accounting but stops short of dependency-pair soundness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Gat.conclusion: The KO7 recursor yields a value-diagonal role-distinct pair whose role record is exactly the certified dependency-pair license with one bit of refusal cost.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file defines polynomial pairing, Godel beta coding, arithmetized substitution on term and formula codes, and first-order graphs for numeral codes, Hilbert-sequence justification, proof and substitution relations, provability and consistency. It proves that every finite function is beta representable, that code substitution matches object substitution, and that proof-code existence is equivalent to Provable. It constructs the diagonal matrix and Godel sentence with its code identity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: The file draws the provable versus unprovable boundary by coding Hilbert proofs as numbers with isProofCode, proofRel, bewOf and ConQ, and by forming the diagonal Godel sentence whose truth and provability will separate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: There is a first-order proof relation and provability predicate with a diagonal Godel sentence whose code identity holds, and proof-code existence is equivalent to Provable.
assumptions: classical reasoning with Classical.not_forall and Classical.not_not in eval_existsF, eval_andF and eval_orF

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.cconsTerm
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: cconsTerm h t is the term succ((h+t)*(h+t)+t) whose Nat evaluation is the pairing ccons of the evaluations of h and t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.beta
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: beta c d i equals c mod (1+(i+1)*d).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.coprime_beta_moduli
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If i < j and (j-i) divides d then betaModulus d i and betaModulus d j are coprime.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.substTermCode
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: substTermCode y n is the primitive-recursive function on codes that mirrors substitution of numeral y for variable 0 by decoding ccons structure, terminating by uncpair_lt.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.substFormCode
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: substFormCode y n is the primitive-recursive function on formula codes that mirrors substNum for variable 0 and numeral y, using substTermCode at equality leaves.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.substTermCode_encode
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every y and term t, substTermCode y (encodeTerm t) equals encodeTerm of substTerm 0 (numeral y) t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.proofRel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: proofRel s t states that s codes a triple of beta parameters whose beta sequence ends at t and every index up to the length is justifiedF or specJustF, covering axiom, modus ponens, generalization and closed instantiation.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: justifiedF c d i states local justification of line i in the beta-coded Hilbert sequence by axiom, earlier modus ponens lines, or earlier generalization lines.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.specJustF
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: specJustF c d i states closed specialization justification of line i by an earlier universal line together with a closed term and formula-substitution table.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.substRel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: substRel x y z states that there is a numeral code for y via numCodeRel and a closed formula-substitution table from x to z for that code.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.GodelArith.bewOf

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file develops Hilbert-Bernays derivability conditions for the proof checker, with D1 packing, D2 modus ponens on proof trees and on Provable, and a meta D3 lift distinguished from the internal implication Bew phi to Bew Bew phi. It proves the final Hilbert-Bernays step from not Bew false implies G to unprovability of consistency, plus soundness-based independence from a Godel equivalence. A constant 0 equals 0 predicate is shown to satisfy internal D3 without representing the checker.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: The boundary is between a genuine provability predicate that represents the checker and dummy predicates such as constant 0 equals 0 that satisfy object-level D3 but do not represent provability, and between meta D3 lift and internal D3 implication.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: A representing checker with a syntactic fixed point G equal not Bew G yields independence of G, while the constant true predicate shows internal D3 alone does not imply representation.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file builds Nat-evaluation infrastructure for numCodeRel and recursive term and formula substitution tables, including freshness, beta chains and code-shape recognizers for Q axioms. It certifies postorder traversals so children precede parents and uses them to prove soundness and completeness of substitution traces. The stated consumers are proofRel and substRel semantics and the diagonal equivalence for the Godel sentence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: none
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Numeral coding and term and formula substitution tables are sound and complete in Nat with certified postorder traces and exact axiom-code recognition.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file proves Godel first incompleteness for the ProofTree checker: a sentence equivalent on Nat to its own unprovability is independent, with a conditional arithmetic instance under an explicit fixed-point premise and a representability form. It shows falsum is not such a sentence, derives semantic and syntactic omega-consistency of Q from Nat soundness, and proves meta-level consistency forbids proving both a formula and its negation. A dummy proof order is shown unused at meta level and q1 is shown not Rosser independent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: The boundary is provability versus truth in the standard model: the Godel sentence is true on Nat exactly when unprovable, while consistency forbids proving both a formula and its negation and omega-consistency separates proved existentials with numeral witnesses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Any sentence true exactly when unprovable is independent, and Q is omega-consistent and consistent, while falsum and q1 are not Godel or Rosser independent sentences.
assumptions: classical logic via Classical.not_forall and Classical.not_not in q_semantic_omega_witness

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file proves that the arithmetized provability predicate bewOf is semantically equivalent to the live proof calculus. It evaluates the Godel matrix body at its own code to obtain provability of the Godel sentence, negates to the fixed-point equivalence that the Godel sentence is true exactly when unprovable, and discharges the previously explicit premise. It concludes unconditional first incompleteness for the compiled Robinson-Q checker, with axiom checks included.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: The boundary is provability in Q versus truth in the standard model: the arithmetized provability predicate matches Provable, while the Godel sentence is true exactly when unprovable, yielding unconditional independence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: The live arithmetized provability predicate is correct and its Godel sentence is true exactly when unprovable, giving unconditional first incompleteness.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: evalForm of envUpdate env0 0 godelMatrixCode at godelMatrix holds if and only if not Provable arithGodelSentence holds.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file interprets live terms, formulas and environments in an arbitrary arithmetic structure and pins this semantics to the existing Nat evaluator. It defines models of the seven Q axioms and proves closed-term substitution and derived-connective semantics generally. It proves the live checker sound in every model of those axioms, hence every Provable formula true in all such models, agreeing with Nat soundness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: The boundary is satisfaction of the seven Q axioms: checked proofs are sound and true in every structure modelling qAxioms, with no guarantee outside ModelsQ.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Every checked Q proof is true in every arithmetic structure modelling the seven Q axioms, specializing to the standard Nat soundness.
assumptions: classical logic via Classical.not_forall, Classical.byContradiction and Classical.not_not in existsF, andF and DNE reasoning

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file adds the full first-order induction schema to the compiled Robinson-Q checker over the same named-variable syntax, with a decidable syntactic recognizer and extended checker checkI and ProvableI. It proves capture-safe substitution semantics for the step term S(x), Nat-validity of every induction instance, and soundness of the extended checker. It also gives an independent Hilbert presentation CompiledIDerives with an exact adequacy equivalence and embedding of Q.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Provability in the decidable checker implies truth in standard Nat, so falsum lies on the unprovable side; induction is added syntactically without a semantic oracle.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Every ProvableI formula is true in Nat, so the induction checker is consistent and exactly captured by CompiledIDerives.
assumptions: standard Nat interpretation for soundness claims
closed-term side condition on specialization rule
decidable syntactic induction recognizer with no semantic oracle
Mathlib baseline only, kernel-checked

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every formula psi, isIndAxiom psi equals true if and only if there exist x and phi with psi equal to inductionAxiom x phi.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file promotes the fixed-point semantic graph of bewOf to the RepresentsChecker interface and records unconditional semantic consequences. It proves ConQ true in the standard model and its negation unprovable, plus the standard-model truth of ConQ implies the Godel sentence. It isolates the remaining Godel-II theorem at the single hypothesis that the checker proves that implication.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: ConQ and ConQ implies G are true in the standard model on one side, while a Hilbert derivation of ConQ implies G remains missing on the other, so full Godel-II stays conditional.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: ConQ is unconditionally true with unprovable negation, while unprovability of ConQ remains conditional on the internal implication.
assumptions: exact standard-model representation theorem for bewOf from fixed-point semantics
inhabited concrete fixed-point semantics for the Godel sentence
no Hilbert proof of ConQ implies Godel sentence is assumed

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file builds a nonstandard model with carrier Option Nat where none is one infinite element absorbing for addition and largely for multiplication. It verifies all seven live Robinson-Q axioms in the model. It then shows an infinite beta-packed sequence certifies the code of falsity, so the internal consistency sentence fails there, yielding unconditional model-theoretic Godel-II and independence of ConQ.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: ConQ is true in the standard Nat model but false in the one-infinite-element model, so the compiled checker proves neither ConQ nor its negation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: The live compiled checker does not prove its consistency sentence, and ConQ is independent of it.
assumptions: general model-relative checker soundness transporting Provable to any ModelsQ structure
live definitions of qAxioms, proofRel, bewOf and ConQ
Mathlib baseline only, kernel-checked

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file fills the Lawvere absence record on a new Godel object over the kernel carrier Trace with external finite schematic codes, evaluation, const-quotation and diagonal. It proves evaluation is never the second projection, every schematic map is identity or constant, and successor is neither schematic nor code-represented. It exports Lawvere code and evaluation maps, Godel packages, and partial and unit-valued escapes, showing every schematic map has a fixed point.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Identity and constants are code-represented on one side while delta composed with self-application is unrepresentable on the other, so the object takes the smaller-class escape.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Successor is not schematic or code-represented, and every schematic map is identity or constant with a fixed point.
assumptions: kernel Trace with void distinct from delta void and injectivity/no-confusion facts
total schematic evaluation on a finite code fragment
no inhabitation of InternalToSignature is claimed

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file views the Godel sentence and its negation through a provability observer versus a standard-truth target. It restates the imported first incompleteness as one shared provability observation with two truth values. It applies the observer calculus to derive no licence, maximal refusals on each side, lift-or-refuse and swap-stabilizer facts, adding no new proof of incompleteness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Provability gives one shared observation to the Godel sentence and its negation while standard truth gives two values, so truth has no licence through provability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: The Godel pair collides provability against truth, yielding refusals and no greatest licensed set.
assumptions: imported first-incompleteness unprovability for the Godel sentence and its negation
observer-calculus definitions of licence, refusal and stabilizer
kernel-only with no sorry, admit, axiom or native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file takes the partiality escape from the total schematic collapse with a fuelled interpreter, tagged encode and decode-quote, and convergence versus divergence behaviours. It shows successor is behaviourally and quote-represented with argument-dependent non-identity behaviour. It proves the compose-succ-call composite diverges at its own code because convergence would fix delta, with Kleene recursion forms and freeze-live substitution contrasts.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: A defined value of the diagonal composite at its own code would be a delta fixed point on one side, so the composite necessarily diverges on the other, while partial representation succeeds where total quotation collapses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Successor is behaviourally quote-represented while its diagonal composite diverges at its own code, escaping the total collapse.
assumptions: free Trace algebra with distinct constructors and no-confusion facts
fuel-indexed partial step semantics with monotone fuel
no totalization of divergence is claimed

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file studies partial codes with composition, successor, projection, constants, divergence and a self-referential call operation, together with convergence, divergence and size measures on traces. It classifies every total code as either constant or iterated successor and proves size bounds that prevent compound or delta-app values from arising from too-small codes. It defines left-head and remainder operations and two generated-operator families, left composition and freeze-substitution of successor. It proves every left-composition operator has an extensional fixed point while freeze-substitution of successor has none, and it shows the eqW freeze restores kernel confluence without stabilizing quotation and blocks rank transport for self-licensing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Left-composition operators admit extensional fixed points while freeze-substitution of successor admits none, separating live substitution from freeze substitution. The eqW freeze restores kernel confluence yet still fails to stabilize decode-quote, and self-representability transported through quotation is refused.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Freeze-substitution of successor has no extensional fixed point whereas every left-composition operator does.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file defines two injective pairings on naturals, an exponential pairing npair with 2-adic inverse and a polynomial pairing cpair with square-based inverse, plus nested cons, head, tail and list encodings with decode round-trips. It introduces a basic combinator type PR with zero, successor, projection, constant, pairing and composition and its evaluator, with concrete successor, pairing, identity and plus-two examples. It defines Lean-level iteration natIter and derives addition from it, showing successor and pairing lie in the basic fragment while addition uses the separate iteration schema. The file states it does not establish standard primitive-recursive closure for later syntax functions and proves no incompleteness theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: The PR type is only a basic fragment without a recursion constructor, so pairing and successor are inside it while addition requires the separate natIter schema and standard primitive-recursive closure for later codings is not established here.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Both exponential and polynomial pairings are injective with explicit inverses and injectively encode finite lists, with successor and pairing in the basic fragment and addition obtained only via separate iteration.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file connects the live polynomial pairing, positive cons constructor and numeral coder to Mathlib's standard primitive-recursive class. It proves cpair is binary primitive recursive from addition and multiplication, ccons is binary primitive recursive from successor and cpair, and numCode is primitive recursive by recursion over the cons algebra. It packages the three facts as code_algebra_primrec and states that syntax, substitution and proof-checking layers remain outside this package.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Only the arithmetic code algebra of pairing, cons and numeral coding is shown primitive recursive here, while recursive syntax, substitution, proof-checking and proof-relation functions remain outside this package.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file builds numeric substitution and axiom recognition directly on Gödel codes. It defines general term and formula substitution on codes and proves they compute the live syntactic substitutions on canonical codes and are primitive recursive by course-of-values recursion. It defines numeric tag, payload and equality operations and Boolean recognizers for the Robinson Q axioms and the equality-reflexivity, identity, K, DNE and S axiom schemas. It proves the full numeric axiom recognizer is primitive recursive and agrees with the live axiom predicate on every encoded formula.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: none
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: General term and formula substitution and the full numeric axiom recognizer are primitive recursive and agree with the live syntactic operations on canonical codes.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file builds beta-packed object-language certificates for term substitution, formula substitution, closed terms, axioms, and Hilbert lines and proves completeness of each trace encoding. It proves every checked recursive proof tree yields a proofRel certificate and every proofRel certificate reconstructs a provable decoded formula. It defines proofRecoding from decoded checker proofs to packed certificates, proves a sound and complete bridge on canonical formula codes with variable-zero and variable-one-two adapters, and proves no total bridge can work because an alias equality code is accepted for the same proof with a different target.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: A sound and complete recoding bridge exists on canonical formula codes, but no total function can preserve the proof relation across all conclusion codes because the alias equality code is accepted for the same proof as the canonical code yet denotes a different target.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Every checked proof recodes to a sound beta-packed proofRel certificate and every proofRel certificate proves the decoded formula, but no total recoding can work for all conclusion codes.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file defines behavior join at a trace and a quote-and-eval configuration with steps for reduction under quotation, convergent evaluation, and divergent evaluation. It shows quotation of merge void void converges while quotation of void diverges, so the kernel merge-void pair does not join. It exhibits a two-reduction freeze peak to a value and to divergence that does not join, shows freezing quote congruence removes the under-quote arm while freezing only eqW leaves the peak, and classifies all extended quote critical pairs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Quotation converges on merge of void with void but diverges on void itself, so the two quotations at the kernel merge-void pair do not join and freezing quote congruence removes the under-quote arm while the confluent kernel with eqW removed still leaves the peak.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: The quoted merge-void peak has converging and diverging reductions that do not join, and the least freeze must include quote congruence because freezing only eqW does not remove the peak.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file defines Hilbert justification, Hilbert sequences allowing axiom, modus ponens, generalization and closed specialization, and Hilbert provability. It defines flattening of recursive proof trees into formula lists and proves the flattened last entry and nonemptiness for checked proofs. It proves every checked proof flattens to a Hilbert sequence and that provability coincides with Hilbert provability in both directions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: none
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Provability by checked proof trees coincides exactly with Hilbert provability via flattening.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file defines arithmetic terms and formulas, numerals, substitution, injective Godel coding with fuelled decoders, the seven Robinson Q axioms, logical axiom recognizers, and a checked ProofTree calculus. It defines standard Nat evaluation and proves that every Q axiom and logical axiom is Nat-true. It proves checker soundness, hence provability soundness and consistency, and contrasts the Nat model of Q1 with a collapsing Unit model that refutes Q1.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Every checked proof is true in Nat, while the collapsing Unit interpretation refutes Q1; provability therefore implies Nat-truth, falsum is unprovable, and distinct syntax has distinct codes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Every proof-tree checked by the Q checker is true in Nat, so falsum is unprovable and the checker is consistent.
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false
Classical reasoning via Classical.not_not.mp in eval_isAxiom

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: This file states conditional Gödel second-incompleteness consequences for the arithmetized checker. It proves that exact representation of the proof checker by bewOf implies truth of the consistency sentence ConQ in the standard model and unprovability of its negation. It proves the final modus-ponens step from fixed-point semantics and a provable implication from ConQ to the Gödel sentence to unprovability of ConQ. It also proves that implication is true in the standard model given the fixed-point semantics, without claiming the representability or D3 premises have been discharged.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Consistency sits on the unprovable side: under exact checker representation and the internal ConQ-to-Gödel implication, ConQ itself is not provable. This places a principled limit on what the formal system can certify about its own consistency.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.conclusion: Under exact fixed-point semantics and a provable implication from consistency to the Gödel sentence, the consistency sentence itself is unprovable.
assumptions: RepresentsChecker bewOf exact representation of the proof checker
ArithGodelFixedPointSemantics exact fixed-point semantics for the Gödel sentence
Provable (imp ConQ arithGodelSentence) internal Hilbert-Bernays implication

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.summary: The file introduces a decidable compiled-Q axiom predicate and an independent inductive Hilbert derivability relation for exactly the implemented fragment. It proves that inductive derivations serialize to checked proof trees and conversely, giving a bidirectional equivalence with live provability. It lists the seven Q axioms, characterizes the arithmetical recognizer by membership, derives each axiom, and separates falsum from that layer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/God.boundary: Inductive compiled-Q derivability holds exactly when live ProofTree provability holds; the arithmetical recognizer accepts a formula exactly when it is one of the seven Q axioms, with falsum outside.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: The file provides a public API that re-exposes the minimal-fork development with all scope hypotheses kept visible. It states a lower bound of three states for a nonjoinable one-step peak and that the three-state Fork3 attains the bound with a categorical initiality property. It gives injective fork embeddings for terminal diagonals, with preservation and reflection of the one-step relation under a determined-diagonal hypothesis, and a local-cone equivalence for determined terminal diagonals. It records termination of minimal and deep equality-witness systems together with failures of confluence or local confluence, a guarded root repair that stays confluent at the root while failing under unrestricted context, three context-stable repair routes, KO7 and independent-comparator realizations of Fork3, a two-to-one terminal-support collapse with Hartley values, a classification of semantic modes, and the crown bundle.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.boundary: A nonjoinable one-step peak requires a carrier with at least three states. Termination holds for the minimal and deep systems while confluence or local confluence fails, and a guarded root repair is confluent at the root while an unrestricted-context counterexample remains nonconfluent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: The API records the full minimal-fork crown together with cardinality minimality, universal fork embedding, termination without confluence, scope-limited repairs, KO7 realization, one-bit collapse and mode classification.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: The file shows the root guard does not survive unrestricted rewriting below eqW. OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: The file reifies the three-symbol two-rule system in the generic first-order rewriting library with a nonlinear reflexive rule. It defines ground encode and decode and proves exact correspondences for root steps, context steps and reachability closures. It proves strong normalization by EqW-symbol count and computes exactly four ordered critical pairs. It shows the same/different pair is unjoinable, so the generic system is terminating but not locally confluent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.boundary: The deep TRS is strongly normalizing yet not locally confluent: termination holds by EqW-count decrease while local confluence fails on the single same/different critical pair.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: The custom minimal system coincides exactly with a two-rule first-order TRS that is strongly normalizing but not locally confluent, with exactly one bad critical pair up to symmetry.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: The file introduces an independent diagonal-safe policy for raw root subrelations. It shows the guarded relation satisfies the policy and contains every other safe restriction, hence is the greatest such restriction. It proves off-diagonal agreement with raw rewriting and exact refusal of diagonal difference steps, with a sound and complete executable evaluator.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.boundary: On off-diagonal queries guarded and raw agree, while on diagonal queries raw admits a difference step that guarded refuses; guarded is the largest subrelation respecting that refusal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: The guarded root relation is the greatest diagonal-safe restriction of the raw relation and is executable and confluent.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: The file defines persistent disequality as current plus future distinctness under all independent guarded-context reductions. It proves propagation, non-expiration, denial on diagonals and common reducts, inhabitation for same and different, and failure for the contextual counterexample. It bridges to the live Box infrastructure and defines full contextual licensed rewriting, proving inclusion, termination, quantitative local confluence and Newman confluence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.boundary: A difference verdict is allowed only while disequality persists under all independent futures; without that license the outer guard can expire, while with it full contextual rewriting becomes confluent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: Full contextual rewriting licensed by persistent disequality is strongly normalizing and confluent.
