OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: The file studies terminal-support multiplicity and Hartley information for raw and licensed fork relations. It proves that raw Fork3 terminal multiplicity at the source is two while licensed multiplicity is one, with structural Hartley collapse equal to one and raw Hartley one and licensed Hartley zero. It proves that the KO7 raw terminal-support finset is the image of Fork3 support under the proved carrier and relation equivalence, that KO7 inherits the two-to-one multiplicities by transport, and that KO7 structural collapse coincides with Fork3 structural collapse.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: Licensed repair reduces terminal support from two alternatives to one with structural Hartley collapse equal to one, and this profile transports to the KO7 local cone.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: This file proves every exact terminal equality-witness diagonal is a pointed nonjoinable fork with a canonical injective Fork3 map from initiality. It defines relation isomorphisms, local-cone carriers and equivalences, proves preservation always and reflection under determinedness, and derives finite-cardinality lower bounds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.boundary: Preservation and injectivity hold for every terminal diagonal, while edge reflection and full local-cone isomorphism require the additional determinedness hypothesis; finite terminal carriers have at least three states.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: Every terminal diagonal contains an injective Fork3, and determined diagonals have Fork3-isomorphic local cones.
assumptions: Classical.choose for local-cone equivalence (noncomputable)
Fintype and DecidableEq for cardinality corollaries

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: Computes ceiling-log terminal choice bits for the Fork3 raw step as one and for the licensed step as zero, with a drop of one, and transports the raw and licensed profiles to the KO7 local cone. Proves the conjunction of Hartley-entropy drop of one and ceiling-log drop of one for Fork3 and the ceiling-log drop of one for the KO7 local cone. Records the scope wall that the collapse counts dimensionless structural bits.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.boundary: The raw Fork3 support needs one binary terminal-choice bit while the licensed support needs zero. Licensing therefore collapses the structural Hartley count by one bit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: The Fork3 raw-to-licensed collapse drops both Hartley entropy and ceiling-log length by one, and the KO7 local cone inherits the one-bit ceiling-log drop.
assumptions: autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.summary: The file defines the licensed one-edge repair deleting the diagonal difference edge and proves it is a subrelation. It proves raw and licensed normalization, exact terminal supports of size two and one, multiplicities two and one, Hartley values one and zero, an exact one-bit structural collapse, source confluence of the licensed fork, and a crown bundle.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.boundary: Raw terminal support has two exits with one Hartley bit while licensed support has one exit with zero bits; licensing removes exactly the diagonal difference edge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Min.conclusion: The canonical fork collapses from two terminal exits and one Hartley bit to one exit and zero bits under licensing.
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.summary: Defines the three-state observational diagonal MapCone with a raw two-edge relation and a licensed one-edge subrelation refusing novelty. Proves the raw fork is unjoinable and not confluent, gives exact raw and licensed isomorphisms with Fork3, and composes them to live KO7 Step and SafeStep edges on three Trace states with confluent licensed repair. Adds observation pairs and record correctness, showing a decoder from observations alone exists exactly when the observer is injective and the truth restriction is confluent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.boundary: The raw two-edge MapCone relation is unjoinable and not confluent at the diagonal, while the licensed one-edge subrelation refusing novelty is confluent with unique verdict stable. An observation decoder exists exactly when the observer is injective; a collapsed unequal pair defeats correctness on the diagonal and off-diagonal simultaneously.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.conclusion: The observational diagonal fork is exactly the Fork3 and live KO7 diagonal cone in raw and licensed form, with confluence repaired by refusing novelty and observability characterized by injectivity.
assumptions: DecidableEq, Fintype and Repr on MapCone
DecidableEq X and DecidableEq Q for intendedRecord and observerDecoder sections
Classical reasoning used in truthLicensed_confluentAt_diagonal
noncomputable for MapCone to KO7 local-cone isomorphisms
No sorry, axiom or native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.summary: Defines sound and complete disequality discriminators and naturality under an endomorphism. Proves a generic clone no-go: a natural operation under a merging, collapse-reflecting endomorphism cannot discriminate disequality, with an explicit Fin 3 witness that the hypotheses are inhabited. Proves a finite-state boundary: no bottom-up observer with finite state recognises the diagonal of the infinite kernel carrier, while an equality test decides it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.boundary: A binary operation natural under an endomorphism that merges distinct points and reflects the collapse point cannot soundly and completely discriminate disequality, and no finite-state bottom-up observer recognises the diagonal. An observer carrying an equality test on the terms themselves does decide the diagonal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.conclusion: No single natural term operation and no finite-state bottom-up observer defines the distinction observer, while an equality test does.
assumptions: Fintype Q for finite-state no-go
Decidable equality for decide in equality-test lemma
No sorry, axiom or native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.summary: Proves a generic Lawvere diagonal no-go: every diagonal-closed language over a fixed-point-free shift lacks a universal evaluator and the obstruction persists under extension, instantiated by the Trace Sigma language. Shows polynomial orientation behaves differently: counter-uncoupled languages are obstructed on every duplicating schema but the full language on the free schema orients via a cross-coupled polynomial. Packages both as obstruction systems to prove exact separation with nondefinability certificates for collapse versus license.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.boundary: Diagonal self-evaluation obstruction survives every carrier-preserving extension retaining diagonal closure, while counter-uncoupled polynomial orientation obstruction is dissolved by passing to the full polynomial language. Hence the diagonal and free-polynomial obstruction systems admit no extension- and obstruction-truth-preserving equivalence, and no surjective truth-preserving map from the diagonal system onto the full polynomial system.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Obs.conclusion: Diagonal obstruction is extension-stable and polynomial orientation obstruction is not, so the two obstruction classes are separated with exact nondefinability certificates.
assumptions: No finiteness, decidability or nonemptiness premise for generic diagonal theorem
Fixed-point-free shift hypothesis for diagonal obstruction
Free-schema cross-coupled polynomial as positive witness
Quot.sound for quotient identification in repair routes background
Kernel and Mathlib only

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Per.summary: Defines the greatest stable sublicense Box of a predicate along a relation and proves containment, star-closed invariance, greatestness and idempotence. Instantiates to componentwise EqGuardedStep on Trace pairs with license disequality, characterizing persistence as never coalescing under independent reduction. Exhibits a negative witness where merge void void coalesces to void and a positive witness where delta void versus void persists by normality.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Per.boundary: Disequality holds at the coalescing pair merge void void versus void but its Box persistence fails after one left step to the diagonal, while the pair delta void versus void is stably distinct because both components are EqGuardedStep-normal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Per.conclusion: Box is the greatest forward-invariant subpredicate of disequality, failing exactly at the coalescing pair and holding at the normal stably distinct pair.
assumptions: Generic relation R and predicate P for Box theory
EqGuardedStep normality facts for void and delta void
Kernel and Mathlib baseline only

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.summary: Defines fixed-length binary certificates BitWord L as functions Fin L to Bool and computes their cardinality as 2^L. Proves that an injective encoding of a finite type E needs at most 2^L alternatives and at least Nat.clog 2 card E bits, with no injective code when 2^L is smaller and a specialized floor for m-1 refused alternatives. Exhibits an explicit injective two-bit code for Fin 4, shows no injective one-bit code exists, and computes Nat.clog 2 4 as 2.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.boundary: Injective fixed-length codes exist only when 2^L reaches the number of alternatives; below that no injective certificate exists. Four alternatives sit on opposite sides with two bits sufficient and one bit impossible.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.conclusion: Every injective fixed-length binary encoding needs at least ceiling log-two bits, so four alternatives need two bits and cannot fit in one.
assumptions: Fintype E
Function.Injective encode
2 ^ L < Fintype.card E for nonexistence
set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.summary: Defines exact-length paths Steps, reachability Reach, normal forms, joinability, source confluence ConfluentAt and local normalization NormalizingAt for a caller-supplied relation. Proves reachability out of a normal form is constant, source confluence forces a unique reachable normal form, and uniqueness plus local normalization implies source confluence. Instantiates a two-node chain that is normalizing and confluent and a two-leaf fork whose leaves are normal but never join.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.boundary: Source-confluent systems have a unique reachable normal form while forked systems have two distinct normals that never join. The chain lies on the confluent side and the fork on the non-confluent side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.conclusion: Exact-length reachability supports unique normal forms under source confluence with local normalization, witnessed by a confluent chain and refuted by a non-confluent fork.
assumptions: caller-supplied relation R
Fintype and DecidableEq for ChainNode and ForkNode fixtures
set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.summary: Defines finite comparison surfaces with an emits map and a nonnull predicate, plus non-null records, diagonal soundness, off-diagonal productivity, false-positive and false-negative counts, and rational and guarded rates. Proves zero diagonal false positives characterizes soundness and zero off-diagonal false negatives characterizes productivity. Provides the exact-equality surface meeting both with zero counts, the always-different surface with diagonal count n and accuracy 1 minus 1 over n including 7 over 8 on Fin 8, and a two-point fixture with one illegal diagonal cell that is not sound.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.boundary: Zero diagonal false positives separates sound surfaces from unsound ones and zero off-diagonal false negatives separates productive surfaces from unproductive ones. The exact-equality surface is sound and productive while the always-different and one-illegal-diagonal surfaces violate soundness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.conclusion: Zero error counts exactly capture diagonal soundness and off-diagonal productivity, achieved by exact equality but violated by always-different and one-illegal-diagonal fixtures.
assumptions: Fintype A
DecidableEq A
Fintype V
DecidableEq V
Nonempty A for uniform accuracy
2 <= Fintype.card A for guarded off-diagonal rate

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.summary: Defines repair covers, candidate families, minimum cover number, counting bounds, singleton repairs, weighted cost and minimum cost for finite defects and interventions. Proves an upper bound by any cover, a k-times-M counting bound, a ceil-division lower bound, singleton upper bounds and equality under at-most-one coverage, and a weighted optimum bounded below by the unweighted number. Exhibits a shared guard covering two defects with number one refuting naive defect equality and a ten-defect three-per-intervention case requiring four.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.boundary: Few shared interventions can cover many defects while per-intervention caps force lower bounds of ceil card over M. The shared guard achieves one for two defects versus two needed under independent singletons, and ten defects capped at three need at least four.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.conclusion: Minimum repair covers obey counting upper and ceil-division lower bounds, with shared coverage able to beat defect count and capped coverage forcing at least four for ten defects at three per intervention.
assumptions: Fintype J
DecidableEq B and J
IsRepairCover coverability by full family
0 < M for lower bounds
1 <= cost for weighted bound
classical and noncomputable for candidate powerset

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.summary: Defines terminal support, multiplicity, Hartley entropy, ceiling log, licensed subrelations and structural collapse, proving confluence equals multiplicity one and entropy zero equals confluence under local normalization. Instantiates a confluent chain of multiplicity one, a fork of multiplicity two and entropy one, and a four-way fork of multiplicity four collapsing to one with log ratio two under a one-edge licensed subrelation. Provides an escape system with a normal terminal plus a looping state showing multiplicity one without normalization does not imply confluence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.boundary: Under local normalization confluence holds exactly when multiplicity is one and Hartley entropy or ceiling log is zero, while non-confluent forks have multiplicity above one and positive entropy. Without normalization multiplicity one no longer implies confluence, as the escape system shows.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.conclusion: Under local normalization source confluence is equivalent to terminal multiplicity one and zero entropy, and this premise cannot be weakened as shown by the escape system.
assumptions: Fintype T
NormalizingAt R source for equivalences
classical reasoning for Finset filters
noncomputable definitions
Real.logb base 2 with Real.log positivity

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.summary: Defines upward-closed graded adequacy profiles and witness rank as the least adequate grade via Nat.find, with adequacy at the rank, minimality, persistence above, antitonicity under gradewise preservation, and scope walls for profiles with no adequate grade. Provides a rank-zero always-adequate base profile, a rank-one licensed profile adequate exactly from one, an empty wall profile, and rank one distinct from zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.boundary: Grades below the witness rank are inadequate and grades at or above remain adequate, while a scope wall has no adequate grade at all. Base rank zero, licensed rank one and the empty wall lie on three sides of this threshold.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Qua.conclusion: Witness rank is the least adequate grade, giving rank zero for always-adequate, rank one for licensed, and a wall for never-adequate profiles.
assumptions: GradedAdequacy upward closure and inhabited grade
classical reasoning for Nat.find
noncomputable witnessRank

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rep.summary: Proves the two-sided repair dichotomy that a locally confluent repair keeping the reflexive verdict either refuses the difference edge or joins the verdicts, with restriction repairs forced to refuse. Declares a six-entry repair grammar with four modes and proves grammar-relative classification and completeness. Adds a repair lattice with a unique maximal clique on the diagonal fiber, completion pricing that joining forces new steps and uniform completion collapses integrate, and an exhaustive trichotomy with inhabited refusal branch.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rep.boundary: A locally confluent repair keeping the reflexive verdict either refuses the diagonal difference edge or joins the two verdicts; a restriction-only repair cannot join because both verdicts are kernel-normal, so it must refuse, while repairing by joining forces a new step out of every diagonal difference verdict.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rep.conclusion: Every locally confluent diagonal repair refuses or joins with the join side priced by new steps, classified by a complete four-mode grammar.
assumptions: Candidate repair R over Trace with retention and local-confluence hypotheses where stated
Kernel Step normality of void and integrate merge self
Surgical EqGuardedStep as refusal-side witness
Kernel and Mathlib baseline

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rol.summary: Carries the duplicating-recursor situation as occurrences with role erasure, proving collapse merges distinct frame and active copies with vacuous reflection at an active collapse point. Instantiates the clone no-go to rule out role-blind discriminators and proves activity does not factor through value. Shows any activity-decoding channel separates value-identified occurrences, while Bool values retain a discriminator, locating the obstruction in the role coordinate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rol.boundary: No role-blind natural operation discriminates occurrences with an active collapse point, while a discriminator exists on Bool values; activity does not factor through value so the dependency-pair license must separate occurrences identified by value.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rol.conclusion: Role erasure realizes the clone no-go on occurrences while values retain a discriminator, making the license external to value observation.
assumptions: Active-role collapse point for vacuous reflection
Bool-valued value functions for non-factorization
Single binary operation scope as in T-E

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rul.summary: Defines nodeCount counting constructors and signed nodeDelta in Int, and computes the delta for each of the eight root Step rules, with six negative rows and two positive rows. Proves the duplicator row is unbounded via delta-towers and the record row has delta one, names the rules with RuleName and RuleInstance, and proves Step coincides with the eight schemas. Defines Census classes with the censusOf table and proves the table is forced by the deltas, yielding a partition of every Step into erasing or growing cases with no neutral step. Shows the limitation that a one-node write occurs for both growing families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rul.boundary: Erasing rows have negative nodeDelta while growing rows have positive nodeDelta, and no root Step has delta zero. A single-step delta of one does not separate the families, since R_rec_succ with s = void and every R_eq_diff instance both have delta one; unboundedness versus constant-one separates them at family level.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Rul.conclusion: The eight kernel rules split into six erasing rows, a record row of delta one and an unbounded writing row, with every growing Step belonging to the latter two families and single-step delta unable to tell those two families apart.
assumptions: autoImplicit false

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.nodeCount
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: nodeCount counts constructors: void has count 1, delta and integrate add one to the inner count, and merge, app, recΔ and eqW sum the argument counts plus one.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.nodeDelta
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: nodeDelta before after equals (nodeCount after : Int) minus (nodeCount before : Int), using Int subtraction so erasure stays negative.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_int_delta
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every t, nodeDelta (integrate (delta t)) void equals -((nodeCount t : Int) + 1).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_merge_void_left
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every t, nodeDelta (merge void t) t equals -2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_merge_void_right
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every t, nodeDelta (merge t void) t equals -2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_merge_cancel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every t, nodeDelta (merge t t) t equals -((nodeCount t : Int) + 1).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_rec_zero
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every b s, nodeDelta (recΔ b s void) b equals -((nodeCount s : Int) + 2).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_eq_refl
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every a, nodeDelta (eqW a a) void equals -(2 * (nodeCount a : Int)).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_rec_succ
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every b s n, nodeDelta (recΔ b s (delta n)) (app s (recΔ b s n)) equals (nodeCount s : Int).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.delta_R_eq_diff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every a b, nodeDelta (eqW a b) (integrate (merge a b)) equals 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.deltaTower
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: deltaTower 0 equals void and deltaTower (n+1) equals delta applied to deltaTower n.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.nodeCount_deltaTower
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every n, nodeCount (deltaTower n) equals n + 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.duplicator_growth_unbounded
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every k : Nat there exists s : Trace such that for all b n : Trace, (k : Int) < nodeDelta (recΔ b s (delta n)) (app s (recΔ b s n)).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.record_growth_constant_one
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all a b : Trace, with no equality hypothesis, nodeDelta (eqW a b) (integrate (merge a b)) equals 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.RuleName
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An inductive with eight constructors R_int_delta, R_merge_void_left, R_merge_void_right, R_merge_cancel, R_rec_zero, R_rec_succ, R_eq_refl and R_eq_diff naming the root Step schemas.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.RuleInstance
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A proposition RuleInstance r t u stating that (t, u) has the literal left- and right-hand side shape of the Step constructor for rule r, with existentially quantified arguments.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.ruleInstance_nonempty
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every r : RuleName there exist t u with RuleInstance r t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.step_iff_exists_rule
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all t u, Step t u holds if and only if there exists r : RuleName with RuleInstance r t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.Census
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An inductive with erasing for rules whose instances all decrease node count, recordForming for rules whose instances all increase node count by one, and writing for rules whose instances all increase node count with unbounded increase.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.censusOf
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A function mapping R_int_delta, R_merge_void_left, R_merge_void_right, R_merge_cancel, R_rec_zero and R_eq_refl to erasing, R_rec_succ to writing, and R_eq_diff to recordForming.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.ruleInstance_erasing_neg
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For r t u, if RuleInstance r t u and censusOf r equals erasing then nodeDelta t u < 0.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.ruleInstance_growing_pos
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For r t u, if RuleInstance r t u and censusOf r is not erasing then 0 < nodeDelta t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.census_erasing_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: censusOf r equals erasing holds if and only if for all t u, RuleInstance r t u implies nodeDelta t u < 0.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.census_recordForming_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: censusOf r equals recordForming holds if and only if for all t u, RuleInstance r t u implies nodeDelta t u = 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.census_writing_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: censusOf r equals writing holds if and only if for every k : Nat there exist t u with RuleInstance r t u and (k : Int) < nodeDelta t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.step_census_partition
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For t u with Step t u, there exists r with RuleInstance r t u and either censusOf r equals erasing with nodeDelta t u < 0 or censusOf r is not erasing with 0 < nodeDelta t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.step_nodeDelta_ne_zero
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For t u with Step t u, nodeDelta t u is not equal to 0.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.step_writes_iff_recSucc_or_eqDiff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For t u with Step t u, 0 < nodeDelta t u holds if and only if RuleInstance R_rec_succ t u or RuleInstance R_eq_diff t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.RuleErasureCensus.census_separation_witnesses
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: There exist t u with Step t u and nodeDelta t u < 0, and there exist t u with Step t u and 0 < nodeDelta t u.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: RuleInstance R_rec_succ holds for recΔ void void (delta void) to app void (recΔ void void void), nodeDelta of that pair equals 1, and nodeDelta (eqW void void) (integrate (merge void void)) equals 1.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Saf.summary: The file defines the constructor-selective closure that enables every congruence except eqW, thawing delta while keeping equality frozen, with SafeDelta and its reflexive-transitive closure. It proves SafeDelta is strongly normalizing as a subrelation of the guarded closure, characterizes blocked shapes via deltaFlag and kappaM, and carries out root-versus-congruence and congruence-versus-congruence local joins. By Newman’s lemma it concludes SafeDelta is confluent, identifies this with the named congruence-confluence conjecture, and notes the delta-free SafeStepCtx was already confluent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Saf.boundary: SafeStepCtx cannot step under delta while SafeDelta can, so the expansion strictly extends the context closure; congruence under eqW stays refused while all other constructors are enabled. Full Step fails confluence at the diagonal, while SafeDelta restores it via strong normalization plus local join.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Saf.conclusion: Contextual SafeStep with delta congruence thawed and eqW frozen is strongly normalizing, locally joinable, and hence confluent, strictly extending SafeStepCtx.
assumptions: deltaFlag equals zero and kappaM equals zero side conditions in SafeStep branches where used

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Saf.summary: The file restricts to the two full-kernel edges from eqW a a, reflexive collapse to void and diagonal difference to integrate-merge, and encodes retention choices as finite Boolean policies. It proves Boolean admissibility, retain reflexive and refuse difference, is equivalent to semantic admissibility as subrelation of Step with reflexive retention and local join. It shows the reflexive-only canonical policy is the greatest admissible policy, lifts this to relations supported on the fiber via finite encoding, and packages admissible repairs as a thin finite preorder where the canonical repair is terminal, with a deflationary monotone idempotent guard.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Saf.boundary: An admissible policy must retain the reflexive edge and refuse the diagonal-difference edge; any policy keeping the difference fails admissibility and local join. The canonical reflexive-only policy is greatest among admissible policies, but the claim is restricted to the exact two-edge fiber with no global maximality.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Saf.conclusion: The reflexive-only canonical policy is the greatest admissible policy on the exact two-edge diagonal fiber and the terminal object of finite critical repairs.
assumptions: classical reasoning for noncomputable policy encoding and finite subtype enumeration
decidable equality and Fintype instances for finite edge and policy types

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Sem.summary: The file defines equality comparison modes and classifies diagonal forking as exactly the unguarded totalized rewrite mode. It defines semantics-preserving subrelations of Step that keep all SafeStep branches, respect deltaFlag and kappaM payload guards, and refuse diagonal difference verdicts. It proves SafeStep satisfies the obligations and that any such subrelation is contained in and hence equal to SafeStep, so SafeStep is the maximal semantics-preserving repair.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Sem.boundary: Any Step subrelation that keeps the reflexive collapse but also keeps the diagonal difference loses local join, so the difference branch must be refused. SafeStep is maximal among subrelations preserving payload semantics; no strictly larger semantics-preserving repair exists.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Sem.conclusion: SafeStep is exactly the maximal semantics-preserving Step subrelation that keeps all safe branches while respecting payload guards and refusing diagonal difference.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Sha.summary: The file defines an abstract substitution-invariance obstruction in which a constant-collapse homomorphism identifies distinct witnesses that an external license separates. It exhibits the distinction-axis instance with sigma-term evaluator collapsing void and delta-void while identity disequality separates them, and the orientation-axis instance with DP collapse to void while a counter projection separates recursor terms of depth zero and one. It proves both instances jointly inhabit the shared shape with genuine witnesses, so the two non-derivabilities are two faces of one root with different license predicates.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Sha.boundary: A signature-homomorphic collapse reads only collapsed structure and so cannot reproduce an external license that separates the collapsed pair; the license is not internal to the rewriting layer. The inside of substitution-invariant evaluation versus the outside of the external license is the shared boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Sha.conclusion: Both the distinction and orientation non-derivabilities are non-vacuous instances of one substitution-invariance obstruction with different external licenses.
assumptions: baseline axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only; no sorry or extra axioms

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.SharedRoot.SubstitutionInvariantObstruction.collapse_not_injective

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Tar.summary: The file builds the diagonal matrix of an arbitrary formula on the coded substitution relation and its self-instantiated diagonal sentence, proving the general diagonal lemma for truth in the standard model and that the sentence is closed. It defines truth-definability and proves Tarski’s theorem that no formula defines truth on sentences via the liar-style diagonal of negated truth. It adds a control showing the formula x equals the code of the Gödel sentence separates the Gödel pair and agrees with truth there, packaged with Tarski’s theorem as the joint goal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Tar.boundary: No formula of the arithmetic defines truth for all sentences, while the single Gödel pair of a sentence and its negation is definably separable; global truth-definability fails where local pair separation succeeds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Tar.conclusion: Truth for sentences is undefinable in the checker’s arithmetic, though the Gödel pair is definably separable.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Uni.summary: This file defines sound and complete Boolean equality comparators and their conjunction IsCheck. It proves any two checks agree pointwise and coincide with the decidable-equality decision procedure, with constant-true and constant-false examples showing both obligations are needed. It proves a factored check forces its abstraction map to be injective, and derives impossibility for finite-state, bounded-depth truncation, fixed-range hashing, payload-blind, and clone-shaped maps, while showing the structural comparator structEq is the canonical check. It packages these as a five-leg one-check boundary linking repair, uniqueness, losslessness, unwritability in the seven-constructor signature, and the extended-signature comparator.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Uni.boundary: A comparator that reads its arguments through h is a sound and complete equality check only if h is injective. Hence finite-state, bounded-depth, fixed-range hash, and payload-blind abstractions cannot be checks, while full-depth structural comparison can.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Uni.conclusion: Every sound and complete Boolean equality comparator coincides with the diagonal characteristic function and must read its inputs through an injective map, so no finite-state, bounded-depth, hashed, or payload-blind shortcut is a check while the full-depth structural comparator is the canonical check.
assumptions: DecidableEq α for decide_isCheck and check_eq_decide
Infinite α for no_finiteState_check and no_hash_check
Finite β for no_finiteState_check
Infinite Trace via dpow and dpow_injective for trace instances

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.DistinctionBoundary.UniqueCheck.IsCheck

OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Wri.summary: This file defines pointwise inclusion of positional selections, write-closed selections, and the writeClosure operator that adds appL and appR whenever recD is thawed. It defines freezeEqW and the canonical confluenceRepair as freeze-then-close, proving the repair freezes eqW, is write-closed, confluent for the live equality-guarded step, and least among confluent extensions. It computes the closure on the recD-only seed, showing the raw seed is not confluent while its closure is, with distinct histories collapsing to the same repair.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Wri.boundary: A positional selection is confluent for the live equality-guarded relation only if eqW stays frozen and thawed recD includes appL and appR. The recD-only seed fails this test while its write closure passes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DistinctionBoundary/Wri.conclusion: Freezing eqW and closing under the recD to appL and appR dependency yields the least confluent repair, turning the non-confluent recD-only seed into a confluent selection.

OperatorKO7/Meta/DominancePremiseSharpne.summary: The file settles the three remaining dominance premises for bounded cross-term quadratic, multilinear and polynomial barriers. It shows each premise follows from wrap positivity alone when the recursor is uncoupled from the counter. It presents one compiled weight with a cross monomial that belongs to all three classes and strictly orients the step. This proves each premise necessary and sharp.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DominancePremiseSharpne.boundary: On uncoupled subclasses with no cross coefficient, no step-counter coupling or no counter exponent the dominance premise is free and the barrier is unconditional. With coupling the cross-monomial weight orients the step, so each dominance premise is load-bearing and sharp.
OperatorKO7/Meta/DominancePremiseSharpne.conclusion: The three dominance premises are free on uncoupled subclasses and necessary in general, witnessed by one cross-coupled weight that orients the step while violating all three.

OperatorKO7/Meta/EqGuardedConfluence.lea.summary: The file isolates an eqW-guarded fragment that keeps all full KO7 root rules but allows the eqW diff branch only on distinct arguments. It shows the fragment sits between SafeStep and full Step and is root-deterministic. It inherits termination from the full-step interpretation and strictly extends SafeStep. Local joinability plus well-founded induction prove the fragment confluent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EqGuardedConfluence.lea.boundary: With the disequality guard on the eqW diff branch the fragment is deterministic and confluent. Without the guard the full relation admits two distinct normal-form reducts at eqW a a and local confluence fails.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EqGuardedConfluence.lea.conclusion: The eqW-guarded fragment strictly between SafeStep and full Step is terminating and confluent by uniqueness of targets and Newman induction.

OperatorKO7/Meta/EscapeRouteRefined.lean.summary: The file splits the fourteen-constructor representability predicate into scalar and structural halves. It proves the exact partition equivalence and derived disjointness. It proves orientation incompatible with each half separately. It retains the three-way direct theorem and its refined restatement. It defines a five-tag route catalog with a licensed universe inhabited everywhere, empty missing structure and computed supported counts.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EscapeRouteRefined.lean.boundary: Any orienter that globally orients KO7 lies outside the scalar and structural representable families. Inside those families orientation is impossible, while all five positive routes are supported and missing structure is empty.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EscapeRouteRefined.lean.conclusion: The represented barrier splits exactly into disjoint scalar and structural halves that never orient, while the retained three-way theorem stays universal and all five positive routes are licensed and supported.

OperatorKO7/Meta/EscapeTrichotomyExtende.summary: The file extends the pump-free escape trichotomy with four added families and records a verdict for each. Finite-diagonal arctic matrices are blocked while a bottom-diagonal arctic member strictly orients, so the arctic family is split. The tropical family escapes with a compiled min-plus orienter, and the unconstrained direct law and textbook duplicating rule are blocked. It separately packages the five TTT2 MAYBE rows, giving universal obstructions for POLY, KBO, MAT(2) and MAT(3) and keeping the no-linear-bound fact as an independent invariant rather than an FBI explanation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EscapeTrichotomyExtende.boundary: Finite-diagonal arctic measures cannot orient while a bottom-diagonal arctic measure can, and only the tropical family escapes; the TTT2 rows separate four typed obstructions from an independent no-linear-bound invariant that does not explain FBI.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EscapeTrichotomyExtende.conclusion: Every added family carries its exact verdict, with the arctic family split, the tropical family escaping, the other two blocked, and the TTT2 rows separated into four obstructions plus an independent invariant.
assumptions: ArcticWrapDiagFinite as blocking hypothesis with no positivity premise
TropicalWrapDiagPositive plus finite coordinate hypothesis
EventuallyDominatedAtBase for POLY
WrapDiagPositive for MAT rows
external TTT2 tool runs taken as inputs, not proofs

OperatorKO7/Meta/EstimatedDPGraphTCAPSou.summary: The file specializes the generic TCAP over-approximation theorem to the KO7 singleton dependency-pair problem. It encodes the KO7 rules as a Nat-coded first-order TRS, defines real and estimated edges on one schema node, and proves every real edge is estimated with path and cycle transport. It adds concrete witnesses showing a real edge that is estimated and a pair with no estimated edge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EstimatedDPGraphTCAPSou.boundary: Every real DP edge is an estimated TCAP edge, so absence of an estimated edge certifies absence of a real chain step; both presence and absence are witnessed non-vacuously.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EstimatedDPGraphTCAPSou.conclusion: The KO7 singleton DP problem inherits TCAP soundness, with both a covered real edge and an absent estimated edge witnessed.
assumptions: TRS left-hand sides are non-variable applications
replayed FAST certificate surface used for pair count
no axioms, sorry or native_decide shown

OperatorKO7/Meta/EstimatedDPGraphTcap.le.summary: The file builds a self-contained first-order term model with substitution, rewriting, and TCAP capping. It proves the tcap invariant and step-closure lemmas culminating in the unconditional theorem that every real DP edge is an estimated edge. Its contrapositive gives a termination certificate that no estimated edge means no real chain step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EstimatedDPGraphTcap.le.boundary: A real rewrite connection always yields an estimated TCAP match, so the estimate over-approximates; absence of an estimated edge is a genuine certificate of no real step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/EstimatedDPGraphTcap.le.conclusion: TCAP estimation unconditionally over-approximates the real DP graph.

kernel-only trust noted in header

OperatorKO7/Meta/ExtendedDirectToolSearc.summary: The file packages hypotheses for three direct scalar families and specializes imported barrier theorems to those packages. It defines bounded cross-term quadratic, max-plus, and WPO-polynomial fragments with unbounded, successor-pump, wrap-pump, or dominance witnesses. It proves each packaged fragment cannot globally orient, and that WPO escape requires failure of base dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ExtendedDirectToolSearc.boundary: Bounded cross-term quadratic, max-plus and WPO-polynomial fragments with unbounded or pump witnesses cannot globally orient; a successful WPO escape would have to violate base dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ExtendedDirectToolSearc.conclusion: All packaged unbounded or pump fragments are blocked from global orientation, and WPO escape requires base-dominance failure.
assumptions: HasUnboundedRangeX, HasUnboundedRangeMax and HasUnboundedRangePoly witnesses
CrossTermBoundedAtBase
EventuallyDominatedAtBase
explicit pump inequalities with 1 as lower bound

OperatorKO7/Meta/FBI_Classification.lean.summary: The file defines the FBI route, closure-status, and final-catalog taxonomy with finite four-row and twelve-row enumerations. It proves list completeness, that every final row is theorem-backed, and that both the route-status catalog and direction-indexed catalog are total. It keeps the external TTT2 FBI status as MAYBE, disjoint from internal closure statuses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/FBI_Classification.lean.conclusion: The four-row and twelve-row FBI catalogs are complete, supported, and total, with external TTT2 fixed at MAYBE.

OperatorKO7/Meta/FBI_GenericAdequacy.lea.summary: The file defines final-catalog coverage as existence of a declared catalog row matching a method route and closure status, plus a constructor-by-constructor admissibility predicate mirroring FBIComparisonWitness. It proves every witness is admissible and every method has a listed closure status and catalog coverage. It adds direction-indexed coverage theorems that consume the instantiation hypothesis, alongside deprecated aliases that ignore it, and classifies the directional row.
OperatorKO7/Meta/FBI_GenericAdequacy.lea.boundary: Every FBI method lies inside the declared final catalog with a listed closure status; no outside-catalog method exists. Direction-specific content comes only from the direction-indexed theorems, since the deprecated unconditional aliases ignore their direction hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/FBI_GenericAdequacy.lea.conclusion: Every FBI method is covered by a declared final-catalog row with listed closure status, with direction-indexed refinements when the instantiation hypothesis is used.

OperatorKO7/Meta/FiniteGraphReachability.summary: The file defines one-step successor closure, bounded iteration and finite reachability at Fintype.card steps for a finite decidable relation. It proves soundness of bounded membership for reflexive-transitive closure and closure stabilization at the cardinality bound. It concludes that finite reachability coincides with reflexive-transitive closure and splits into equality or strict transitive closure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/FiniteGraphReachability.boundary: For finite decidable graphs, bounded successor closure after Fintype.card steps captures the full reflexive-transitive closure; without finiteness no such uniform bound is claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/FiniteGraphReachability.conclusion: Bounded iteration to the cardinality of the finite type exactly characterizes reflexive-transitive reachability.

DecidableEq α
DecidableRel R

OperatorKO7/Meta/FiniteGraphSCC.lean.summary: The file defines distinct mutually reachable pairs and existence of a nontrivial SCC over a finite decidable graph. It builds the filtered finset of SCC pairs and a computable head search, proving the search succeeds exactly when an SCC exists. It packages a chosen witness pair and its two reachability directions via classical choice.
OperatorKO7/Meta/FiniteGraphSCC.lean.boundary: For a fixed finite decidable graph, mere existence of a nontrivial SCC yields a concrete mutually reachable pair; the module does not solve SCC discovery for arbitrary rewriting systems.
OperatorKO7/Meta/FiniteGraphSCC.lean.conclusion: Existence of a nontrivial SCC is equivalent to computable discovery of a concrete mutually reachable distinct pair.

DecidableEq α
DecidableRel R

OperatorKO7/Meta/Frontier/CriticalCircle.summary: The file defines the real binary form commitQuadratic and its integer-lattice nonnegativity, the complex polynomial quadraticValue with its two explicit roots criticalRootPlus and criticalRootMinus, and the symmetric matrix commitMatrix. It proves that real positivity forces the discriminant inequality a^2 <= 4*q, and that under this inequality the polynomial factors and every zero has modulus sqrt q. It transports integer positivity to rationals by clearing denominators and to reals by continuity and density, giving equivalences with real positivity and with the discriminant, plus a generic homogeneous degree-two transport lemma and matrix positive-semidefiniteness. It claims no consequence for the Riemann hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Frontier/CriticalCircle.boundary: The form x^2 + a*x*y + q*y^2 is nonnegative on all real vectors, equivalently on all integer vectors, exactly when a^2 <= 4*q. Only on that side are the zeros of X^2 - a*X + q forced onto the circle of radius sqrt q, and the file claims no consequence for the Riemann hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Frontier/CriticalCircle.conclusion: Integer-lattice nonnegativity of x^2 + a*x*y + q*y^2 is equivalent to a^2 <= 4*q and forces every complex zero of X^2 - a*X + q to have modulus sqrt q.
assumptions: 0 < q assumed for discriminant conclusions
0 <= q and a^2 <= 4*q assumed for circle conclusions
Fintype inst, continuity of f and degree-two homogeneity f (t • x) = t^2 * f x for the generic transport
set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ca.summary: This file evaluates the carrier-free least-lift law on the Church prefix of System T. It defines the finite subtype Prefix n with its finiteness facts, the restricted type observer obs and cost target cost, and proves the prefix has n plus one values, constant observation, and injective cost. It proves the fiber multiplicity is n plus one and the least licensing lift is n plus one with optimality, then bridges the ambient ChannelLicenses predicate to Licensed on the subtype to obtain the least-cardinality law and its equality with the direct statement. It closes with the n equals four instance and the transfer of the attained channel.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ca.boundary: On Prefix n the least licensing side-channel size is exactly n plus one: the type observer has fiber multiplicity n plus one, so every licensing Fin k channel needs n plus one at most k and n plus one always suffices.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ca.conclusion: The Church-prefix count n plus one is the instance of the general least-lift equals fiber-multiplicity law, hence the least licensing channel size.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ca.summary: Defines binder-free, share-free and beta-free predicates over higher-order terms, with linear and DAG-shared abbreviations, beta-free contexts, and capture-safe and context-safe substitution obligations. Introduces direct additive measures that are additive on application, transparent through binders and zero on variables, plus a variable-constant generalization with value c on variables. Proves the pointwise orientation condition is equivalent to eval t < 2 * c, that app (var 0) (var 0) attains 2 * c, and hence no member orients all duplicating beta steps, unconditionally for every c and via an adapter for the zero-variable class. Packages the inhabitation, threshold and no-go results into variable-constant and universal boundary certificates and a capture-subfamily catalog.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ca.boundary: A variable-constant measure orients a duplicating redex (lam 0 (app (var 0) (var 0))) arg into arg arg exactly when all its values lie below 2 * c, but additivity forces app (var 0) (var 0) to attain 2 * c. Hence no direct or variable-constant measure orients the whole duplicating family, closing that orientation method.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ca.conclusion: No direct measure and no variable-constant measure at any constant c orients all duplicating beta steps.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ch.summary: This file proves the channel-capacity law for Church-cost licensing on finite Church prefixes. It defines churchPrefix, the licensing predicate ChannelLicenses, and the syntactic recognizer and index channels. It proves distinct Church applications, the prefix cardinality and typing, that licensing implies injectivity, the lower bound n plus one on any finite licensing channel, impossibility below capacity, attainment with n plus one values, and the least-cardinality characterization. It adds floor-logarithm corollaries and closes finite instances by computation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ch.boundary: n plus one is sharp: no finite channel with fewer than n plus one values licenses the prefix cost, while the index channel with n plus one values does, with monotone logarithm consequences.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ch.conclusion: n plus one is the least finite channel cardinality licensing Church-prefix cost, attained by the index channel.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Cl.summary: Re-exports the eight-row policy taxonomy as closeout rows with projected statuses and indexed row evidence. Proves the row list has length eight, is duplicate-free, never uses the open tag, and that every row carries its evidence proposition, with the full-capture row backed by avoidance-law refutation, target-interface refutation and direct-measure no-gos. Records that the blocked full-capture row does not yield an unrestricted higher-order impossibility, since that universal nonorientation claim is itself refuted, and packages all rows into a closeout catalog.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Cl.conclusion: The eight-row closeout catalog holds with total evidence, blocked full-capture justification, and no unrestricted higher-order impossibility.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Co.summary: This file proves confluence of full System T reduction by Tait-Martin-Lof parallel reduction and Takahashi complete development. It develops shift and substitution algebra, defines the parallel relation Par and the development function dev, and proves reflexivity, shift closure, substitutivity, and the Step-Par-StepStar correspondence. It proves the Takahashi triangle, the parallel diamond, confluence of StepStar, and uniqueness of normal forms when they exist. It exhibits a concrete two-redex fork with distinct one-step reducts joining at succ zero. It proves no termination claim.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Co.boundary: Full reduction is confluent with unique normal forms when they exist, but this yields no termination claim and no claim for extensions with a syntactic equality tester, which would break orthogonality.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Co.conclusion: Full System T reduction is confluent with unique normal forms when they exist, witnessed non-vacuously by a two-redex fork joining at succ zero.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_De.summary: Defines Boolean classifiers isLam, binderFree, shareFree, betaFree, linear, dagShared and context classifiers that mirror the Prop predicates. Proves each classifier returns true exactly when the corresponding Prop holds, provides Decidable instances derived from those equivalences, and shows closed fragments and embeddings satisfy the relevant classifiers with plug-preservation. Packages the equivalences and closure facts into a decidable-classifier catalog.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_De.conclusion: Every Prop subfamily predicate has a correct Boolean classifier with Decidable instances and plug-preservation, packaged in a classifier catalog.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Eq.summary: This file reduces the halting problem to extensional equality of closed System T terms of type nat to nat. It defines the constant-zero term zeroFn, the joinability predicate ExtEqNat, and the primitive-recursive halt-step indicator, and proves numerals are normal and rigid. It proves a representing term equals zeroFn exactly when the represented function is identically zero, that haltStep is primitive recursive and tracks halting, and hence that equality against zeroFn on the represented haltStep family is not a computable predicate. It proves a conditional lift to term pairs under Primcodable and a computable representing map, which are not derived here, plus non-vacuity computations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Eq.boundary: Extensional equality of total System T nat-to-nat functions against zero is hard for non-halting: it is equivalent to non-halting on the haltStep slice, so no computable predicate decides it, even though the system is total and Rice does not apply.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Eq.conclusion: Extensional equality of closed System T nat-to-nat terms against zero is not computable, conditionally lifting to term pairs only under an explicit computable encoding.
assumptions: Classical.choose from primrecRepresentation existence for the haltStep slice
ComputablePred.halting_problem as impossibility of deciding halting
Nat.Partrec.Code.primrec_evaln, evaln_complete and evaln_mono for the haltStep construction
Hypothesis Represents t f for the representation equivalence
Instance hypothesis Primcodable SysTTerm plus existence of a computable representing family T for the conditional term-pair result

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Fi.summary: Packages the M2 rewriting layer into a single catalog recording transported restricted-fragment and no-sharing results, shared and explicit-sharing orienting counters with their counterexamples, binder-free substitution and context closure, beta-step transport and contextual closure, freshness obligations, and the beta-compatible counterexample with its non-orientation blocker. Provides the canonical catalog value and projection theorems that recover each component, including classifier equivalences, subfamily closures and the audit, full-capture and closeout catalogs. States the typed obstruction to an unqualified higher-order lift.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Fi.boundary: Tree, shared-surrogate and explicit-sharing fragments transport and orient their steps, but the beta-compatible policy fails to orient all beta steps and no unqualified lift to every policy holds. The catalog therefore certifies restricted fragments while blocking the full lift.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Fi.conclusion: The canonical M2 rewriting catalog holds, transporting restricted results and blocking the unqualified higher-order lift.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Fu.summary: Enumerates seven full-capture requirement rows with declared statuses and defines the strong capture-avoidance law, its body-fresh repaired variant, the certified-fragment checker interface and the conjunctive target interface. Proves the body-fresh variant holds, exhibits a concrete counterexample refuting the strong law, proves checker success on binder-free and share-free inputs, and refutes the orientation and target interfaces while re-exporting the exact counterexample boundary. Collects the refutations and variable-constant and direct-measure no-gos into a blocked-row justification and a full-capture boundary catalog, explicitly noting that blocking does not give an unrestricted impossibility.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Fu.boundary: Capture-avoidance holds when the body is fresh for the binder but fails as stated without that hypothesis, so the full-capture target and orientation interfaces are blocked. The binder-free and share-free certified fragment still succeeds, and blocking the full interface does not imply that no policy orients any step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Fu.conclusion: The strong capture-avoidance and full-capture target interfaces are refuted while the body-fresh law and certified checker fragment hold.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_In.summary: This file proves the indexed-license boundary for the System T Church family. It defines the syntactic Church index, the retained Church family, the indexed observer, and a subterm occurrence count. It proves the plain type observer fails at fuel at least three, the indexed observer licenses for every fuel, and no fixed finite side channel licenses the full family at the corresponding fuel. It proves singleton retention is licensed while two distinct Church terms with covered costs are not, and that the first Church beta substitution duplicates the successor function exactly n times.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_In.boundary: The plain type observer and any fixed finite side channel fail to license beta cost on the full Church family, while the type observer plus syntactic Church index does; singletons license but any two distinct Church terms with covered costs do not.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_In.conclusion: Indexing by the syntactic Church number licenses Church-family cost where plain and finite observations fail, with exact duplication count n after the first beta step.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Pe.summary: This file proves three finite results about barriers and observation. It shows on Prefix n the type-observer deficit and its closure to zero under the Church-index channel. It defines coordinate and combined probes on Bool times Bool and proves the two-field set is irredundant while a single combined probe suffices, so irredundancy does not imply minimality. It defines a four-state target and update step and proves two labels suffice one-shot, no two-label observer is updateable, and a three-label observer is, giving the one-shot versus updateable separation. Finite claims close by decidable computation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Pe.boundary: On Prefix n the type-observer deficit Nat.clog 2 of n plus one drops to zero once the licensing Church index is observed; on Bool times Bool irredundancy does not imply minimal probe count, and on Fin four two labels read the target one-shot but three are needed for an updateable monitor.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Pe.conclusion: Bounded Church gap closes under the index, irredundancy does not imply minimality, and one-shot reading separates from updateable monitoring by one label.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Po.summary: Defines the eight higher-order policy rows and five status tags with the row list and per-row status assignment, keeping statuses as data separate from semantic content. Defines the indexed evidence family assigning each row its proposition and proves it total, with the full-capture row carrying the exact boundary plus universal and conditional variable-constant no-gos and the unrestricted row carrying the refutation of the universal lift claim. Packages row enumeration facts and representative evidence into a policy-audit catalog.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Po.boundary: Tree is theorem-covered, shared-surrogate, explicit-sharing, beta-compatible, full-capture and unrestricted rows are theorem-blocked, binder-aware is obligation-scoped and capture-safe is a certified fragment, with no row open. Blocked means the named target interface is refuted, and the unrestricted impossibility overclaim is itself refuted by the shared orienter.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Po.conclusion: Every one of the eight policy rows carries its evidence proposition, with blocked tags backed by refutations rather than openness.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Pr.summary: The file defines n-ary System T types, application spines, numeral vectors and the representation predicates RepresentsN and Represents. It proves that zero, successor, projections, composition and primitive recursion preserve representability and combines them by induction on Nat.Primrec' to show every pairing-free primitive recursive function has a closed well-typed representative. It derives the unary corollary for Nat.Primrec functions and exhibits an explicit addition term with a decide-checked 2+3 normalizer fixture.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Pr.conclusion: Every pairing-free primitive recursive function, and in particular every unary primitive recursive function, is represented by a closed well-typed System T term.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Qu.summary: The file restates the Church-prefix capacity result on the subtype Prefix n with type observer obs and cost target cost. It computes the fixed-width code deficit as ceiling log2 and the hidden-progress logarithm, and under the uniform prior proves the linear repair curve for k-valued side channels with attainment by initial segments and zero at capacity. It proves the Bayes-risk floor for type-only decoders with attainment by the constant cost decoder and shows the indexed observer and Church index license cost on the Church family while the plain type is their garbling.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Qu.boundary: On the Church prefix the same type holds for all terms while cost distinguishes them, so type alone does not license cost. With a k-valued side channel the least refused mass is 1 minus k over n plus 1, reaching zero only at capacity k equals n plus 1.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Qu.conclusion: On the Church prefix the type observer needs ceiling log2 bits, any k-valued lift refuses at least 1 minus k over n plus 1 attaining zero at capacity, and type-only decoders err with least refused mass n over n plus 1, while the indexed observer and Church index license cost and type is their garbling.
assumptions: noncomputable Real.logb in hiddenProgressBits

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Re.summary: The file builds explicit denumerable and primcodable encodings of System T types and terms and shows successor, application and numerals are primitive recursive. It defines the binary bounded-halting indicator haltStep2, proves it primitive recursive, chooses a closed representative U and defines the computable code-to-term map codeTerm by applying U to the code numeral. It proves codeTerm is typed, represents bounded halting and is computable, then feeds it to the L7a undecidability theorem to obtain unconditional undecidability of extensional equality of nat to nat terms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Re.boundary: Bounded halting is representable by computable System T terms, but extensional equality of those terms is not decidable. The computable code-to-term map exists on one side and a decision procedure for equality fails on the other.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Re.conclusion: There is a computable map from partial-recursive codes to closed System T terms of type nat to nat representing bounded halting, so extensional equality of such terms is not computable.
assumptions: Classical choice via Classical.choose for U and codeTerm
noncomputable defs U and codeTerm
Primcodable SysTTerm as instance from Denumerable encoding

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Sy.summary: Defines sharing, beta and binder metadata tags with tree, shared, explicit-sharing and beta-compatible policy fixtures, and an untyped term syntax with variables, atom, successor, application, lambda, recursor and sharing nodes. Defines the var- and lam-free closed fragment, a binder-shadowing substitution without renaming that may capture, one-hole contexts with plugging, and embeddings from the sharing-boundary syntax and shared terms, each proved to land in the closed fragment.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Sy.conclusion: The rewriting syntax, closed fragment, substitution, contexts and embeddings are defined with closure of embeddings in the fragment.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Sy.summary: The file defines simple types, de Bruijn terms, shifting, substitution, full one-step reduction and its closure, normality, the leftmost-outermost strategy with fuelled normalizer and cost, typing and inference, and the Church numeral family with successor and numerals. It records decide-checked fixtures for typing and costs of small Church applications. It proves no boundary theorem and serves as the shared carrier imported by the boundary lanes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Sy.conclusion: The file defines the shared System T syntax, reduction, typing, inference and Church family with decide-checked fixtures and proves no boundary theorem.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ty.summary: The file proves soundness of type inference and types the Church family, then establishes the leftmost-outermost cost formula for Church applications via successor chains. It shows distinct Church terms share the same inferred type but have different costs, so cost does not factor through type, packages the 2 versus 5 instance as a TypedBoundary and shows the type fiber contains arbitrarily large finite sets with distinct costs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ty.boundary: All Church applications have inferred type nat while their leftmost-outermost costs are pairwise distinct, so cost does not factor through simple typing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ty.conclusion: Simple typing does not determine leftmost-outermost cost on the Church family because all Church applications share type nat but have distinct costs, so cost does not factor through type and the type fiber is unbounded.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ty.summary: Defines free-variable and closedness predicates for System T de Bruijn terms and proves terms typed in the empty context are closed. Introduces application-additive binder-transparent variable-constant direct measures and the well-typed duplicating beta family from (lambda f. f (f zero)) g. Proves orientation is equivalent to every well-typed g evaluating below 2*c, and via a well-typed pump evaluating to 2*c that no such measure orients the family for any c including zero. Exhibits a concrete additive evaluator showing the class is nonempty and a head-variable reader separating Church indices outside the class.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ty.boundary: No application-additive binder-transparent variable-constant measure orients the well-typed duplicating beta family; orientation would require every well-typed closed g below 2*c, but the well-typed pump attains exactly 2*c.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderRewriting_Ty.conclusion: No typed direct measure orients the well-typed duplicating beta family for any c including zero.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderSharingBound.summary: Defines a minimal higher-order carrier with a closed fragment, a policy-indexed duplicating recursor step, and a policy-sensitive counter that counts both application branches under tree semantics but only the continuation under shared semantics. Proves the shared counter agrees with the first-order shared counter on the embedding, transports shared steps, strictly decreases on shared duplicating steps, and recovers the sharing counterexample. Concludes the shared orienter refutes any unqualified claim that the tree barrier lifts unchanged to every sharing policy.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderSharingBound.boundary: Universal nonorientation holds for the tree and no-sharing fragment but fails once sharing is present, since the shared-policy counter orients every shared duplicating step. The shared policy is therefore the exact obstruction to lifting the tree barrier to all policies.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderSharingBound.conclusion: The shared-policy counter orients all shared duplicating steps, refuting any unqualified lift of the tree barrier to every policy.

OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderSharingBound.summary: This file is a stable API layer over two validated catalogs for higher-order sharing and rewriting. It aliases policies, terms, contexts, steps, counters, fragments and classifiers, and re-exports the final catalogs through projection theorems. It states shared and explicit-sharing counterexamples and blockers against unqualified lifts, plus beta, capture, classifier and subfamily projections.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderSharingBound.boundary: The tree barrier orients without sharing but does not lift unchanged to every sharing policy, with the shared-surrogate branch as counterexample. Full higher-order rewriting lies outside the catalog because the unqualified lift claim is false.
OperatorKO7/Meta/HigherOrderSharingBound.conclusion: The file exposes the validated M2 sharing-boundary and rewriting catalogs, their shared and explicit-sharing counterexamples, and the blockers against unqualified lifts as a stable API.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Impossibility_Lemmas.le.summary: This file records explicit counterexamples for several simple measures on KO7 trace syntax. It shows that adding a fixed constant to kappa, a two-component lexicographic pair, a root delta flag, constellation size and additive simpleSize all fail to decrease on the duplicating rec_succ rule. The imported Lex3c safe-step measure is included only as a contrasting certified decrease on a guarded relation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Impossibility_Lemmas.le.boundary: Naive primary measures such as a fixed additive bump, a two-component lexicographic pair, a root delta flag, constellation node count and additive simpleSize can increase across the duplicating rec_succ step. Only the guarded Lex3c measure decreases on the restricted SafeStep relation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Impossibility_Lemmas.le.conclusion: Each named simple measure fails to orient the duplicating rule while the imported Lex3c measure orients the guarded safe-step fragment.

OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationAccess.lean.summary: This file defines accessibility by factorization and a meta-versus-object access model with direct retrieval and sequential uncertainty reduction. It defines arithmetic progress, recovery and history costs and a primitive-duplicator syntax with canonical stages and terminal records. It proves three executable channels recover progress exactly, attain the universal exact-code minimum width, and carry the full prior entropy with zero-posterior Dirac laws.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationAccess.lean.boundary: Direct retrieval at the initial access point fails for sequential tasks, so the terminal trace state must stay hidden from the meta view alone. History observation costs quadratic bits while structural counting, origin comparison and parallel clocking attain the optimal ceiling-log width.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationAccess.lean.conclusion: The three named channels exactly recover progress with optimal width and carry the full uniform-prior entropy, while history observation incurs quadratic overcost.
assumptions: Finite progress space Fin (K+1) with uniform prior
History cost assumes 1 <= atomWidth for quadratic lower bound
Positive-depth exact theorem assumes 0 < Kmax

It wraps KO7 confession-method ranks as generic moves, builds universal, optimality and discarded-information packages from rank agreement, and proves generic and KO7-specific factorization, convergence-as-H-equivalence, universal-property and discarded-bit minimality theorems.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationTheoreticCon.boundary: The generic factorization and minimality theorems hold only when explicit characterization data is supplied. A cost-floor package forces positive canonical discarded bits, so the canonical zero-bit KO7 profiles admit no such package.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationTheoreticCon.conclusion: Every theorem-backed KO7 confession method factors through the canonical DP move with the canonical discarded-bit floor.

OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.summary: This file works on the two-outcome halt and loop star called starStep 2 as the smallest envelope that can host a halt-versus-loop query, with the echo channel as zero licensed evidence. It proves the echo deficit is zero, the Hartley entropy is one bit and the overproduction gap Omega is one, and it packages lowerBits one against evidenceUpperBits zero as a quantitative obstruction bridge that yields a boundary event. It shows the collapse schema only manufactures a decision procedure and is not Omega, that a resolving audit closes the same gap to zero, and that arity four yields two bits so the bound is carrier-specific.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.boundary: A boundary event holds when the required lower bits of one exceed the licensed evidence upper bits of zero, giving Omega one on the halt and loop star. A resolving audit holding a decision closes the gap to zero, and larger arity raises the gap to log two of m so no uniform constant holds across carriers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.conclusion: On the halt and loop star against zero echo evidence Omega equals one bit, while a resolving audit gives zero and arity four gives two bits, so the bound is carrier-specific and distinct from the decision procedure supplied by collapse.

OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.summary: The file defines a LicensedCollapse over a finite verdict alphabet as a pre-license distribution with strictly positive Shannon entropy together with a determinate post-license verdict, and defines collapseDeficit as the pre-license entropy. It proves the deficit is positive before the license and that the entropy of the post-license point mass is zero. It proves the uniform distribution on Fin 2 has entropy Real.log 2 and builds two instances from it, confluenceCollapse with post-verdict 0 and terminationCollapse with post-verdict 1, with the confluence deficit shown to equal Real.log 2. It packages both instances in a unified collapse statement and records that the real-valued confluence deficit corresponds to the integer one-bit verdictBits collapse from BranchEntropy.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.boundary: Before the external license the verdict distribution has strictly positive entropy so the base system cannot determine the verdict, whereas after the license the verdict is a point mass with zero residual entropy.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.conclusion: Both the confluence and termination instances have strictly positive pre-license deficit with zero post-license residual, and the confluence deficit equals Real.log 2 while verdictBits 2 minus verdictBits 1 equals 1.

noncomputable section

OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.summary: This file defines a concrete RDRS step on Nat times Nat that fixes the counter and strictly decreases the payload with no payload erasure, together with the payload-projection measure. It proves the payload measure orients the step by s less than s plus one on every step, while any counter and base only payload-blind measure is constant on the step and cannot orient it. It obtains an orienting pair that is not counter-dominated, showing the PayloadErasure hypothesis is necessary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.boundary: With a payload erasure every orienting semantic measure is counter-dominated, while without it the conclusion fails. The payload-decreasing step sits on the decisively payload-sensitive side since it is oriented by the payload projection but by no payload-blind measure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/InformationalIncomplete.conclusion: Some orienting semantic measure is not counter-dominated, so the PayloadErasure hypothesis cannot be dropped.

It aliases the KBO comparator abstraction, records the one-versus-two payload count that blocks the duplicating rule, and forwards the already-proved schema and trace-level impossibility corollaries under archive-facing names.
OperatorKO7/Meta/KBO_VariableCondition.l.boundary: The payload variable occurs once in the source and twice in the target, so any comparator with the standard variable condition cannot orient the duplicating rec_succ pattern.
OperatorKO7/Meta/KBO_VariableCondition.l.conclusion: No KBO-style order orients the duplicating schema step or the concrete KO7 rec_succ trace instance.
