OperatorKO7/Meta/KO7EscapeRouteCharacter.summary: This file gives the KO7-instantiated half of the escape-route characterization. It defines five concrete escape clauses and packaged escaping orienters, proves forward coverage from the escape trichotomy and a backward projection, combines them into an iff on the explicit KO7DirectOrienter universe, and closes it together with the schema-generic theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/KO7EscapeRouteCharacter.boundary: Inside the explicit KO7DirectOrienter universe every orienting observer falls into one of five escape clauses, giving an iff; no abstract classification beyond that universe is claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/KO7EscapeRouteCharacter.conclusion: An explicit KO7 direct observer orients KO7 exactly when it packages orientation with one of five concrete escape clauses.
assumptions: Universe restricted to explicit KO7DirectOrienter observers
Relies on ko7_direct_escape_trichotomy_extended for the forward cover

OperatorKO7/Meta/KO7RDRSAdapter.lean.summary: This file adds a role-aware KO7 adapter with formal b, s and n role variables so the payload can be counted exactly. It defines occurrence predicates, counts, left and right terms with counts one and two, and projection to Trace. It packages KO7 as a right-duplicating recursor schema and proves every closed instance projects to a live kernel rec_succ step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/KO7RDRSAdapter.lean.boundary: The payload occurs once on the left and twice on the right, giving duplication gap one; raw Trace counting cannot separate roles under repeated closed instantiations, so role-aware counting is required.
OperatorKO7/Meta/KO7RDRSAdapter.lean.conclusion: KO7 is a right-duplicating recursor schema whose role-aware sides project onto live kernel rec_succ steps.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELAnnotatedReimport.l.summary: Defines proof-carrying annotated derivations that keep base versus licensed provenance, with partial erasure returning none on licensed proofs. Defines license relabeling, licensed-payload projection and total payload sum with an equivalence and round trips. Proves every extension derivation reimports with a license, and that at a boundary sentence with no base derivation no annotated derivation erases to base.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELAnnotatedReimport.l.boundary: Licensed reimports stay on the licensed side and erase to none while base annotations erase to some; a boundary sentence with no base derivation has no annotated derivation erasing to base.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELAnnotatedReimport.l.conclusion: Every extension derivation reimports as a licensed annotated derivation, but no annotated derivation of a boundary sentence erases to a base derivation.
assumptions: typed base theory T and extension theory U with TheoryExtension embed
license type License and sentence phi : T.Sentence
autoImplicit false; no sorry, axiom or native_decide shown

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.AnnotatedDerivation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For typed theories T and U with extension embed, license type License and sentence phi, an annotated derivation is either base carrying a T.Derivation phi or licensed carrying a License and a U.Derivation of embed.onSentence phi.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.eraseToBase?
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any annotated derivation, erasure returns some d for base d and none for any licensed derivation.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.reimportAnnotated
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a license and an extension derivation of embed.onSentence phi, reimportAnnotated builds the licensed annotated derivation.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.annotateBase
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a base derivation d of phi, annotateBase embeds it as a base annotated derivation.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.licensedPayload?
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any annotated derivation, licensedPayload returns none for base and some license and extension derivation pair for licensed.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.AnnotatedPayload
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The total payload for embed, License and phi is the sum of T.Derivation phi and License times U.Derivation of embed.onSentence phi.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.toPayload
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any annotated derivation, toPayload forgets only the constructor wrapper retaining the complete payload.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.ofPayload
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any payload sum, ofPayload reconstructs the corresponding base or licensed annotated derivation.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.annotatedDerivationEquivPayload
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Annotated derivations are equivalent to the payload sum via toFun toPayload and invFun ofPayload with both round trips.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.annotatedPayload_roundTrip
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every annotated derivation d, ofPayload applied to toPayload d equals d.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.eraseToBase?_annotateBase
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every base derivation d, erasing the base annotation returns some d.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.licensedPayload?_reimportAnnotated
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any license and extension derivation d, the licensed payload of the reimport is some license and d, with no erasure to base claimed.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.extension_derivation_reimports_annotated
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a license, if extension derivations of embed.onSentence phi are nonempty then annotated derivations of phi are nonempty via reimportAnnotated.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.annotated_reimport_reversibility_derived
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any license and extension derivation with no base derivation assumed, the licensed payload is recovered exactly and the total payload round-trips; it deliberately supplies no theorem of shape extension proves phi implies base proves phi.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LCELAnnotatedReimport.BoundarySentence
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A sentence phi of T is a boundary sentence when there is no plain base derivation, namely not Nonempty of T.Derivation phi.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis hboundary that phi is a boundary sentence, for every annotated derivation d of phi, erasure equals none.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBenchmarkDpComparis.summary: Builds a support-comparison witness between the benchmark-transport and native DP emitter LCEL instances by composing through the Godel side. Derives the admissible comparison witness and the universal quasi-functor package with inhabitation. The header states this gives proposition-level equivalences from inhabitants, not evidence-preserving direct DP transport.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBenchmarkDpComparis.boundary: Composition through the Godel side yields proposition-level stagewise and support equivalences, but fails to give evidence-preserving direct DP transport.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBenchmarkDpComparis.conclusion: Benchmark-transport and native DP emitter admissible instances are propositionally equivalent via a Godel-composed comparison witness.

six-step StagewiseEquivalent; no sorry or axiom shown

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBenchmarkDpUnrestri.summary: Defines an explicit bijection between two two-constructor sentence types sending base to baseSystem and blocked witness to licensedProjection with nonconstancy. Populates boundary, annotation, base-sentence and proposition-valued license and reimport correspondences with strong preservation laws. Builds route semantics, bridge data, support and unrestricted witnesses yielding quasi-functor inhabitation and admissibility through several routes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBenchmarkDpUnrestri.boundary: The nonconstant two-constructor map distinguishes base-proved from blocked sentences, but the package yields record inhabitation only and fails to establish semantic equivalence between independent benchmark execution and DP rewriting.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBenchmarkDpUnrestri.conclusion: An explicit nonconstant finite correspondence yields inhabited quasi-functors and unrestricted witnesses between benchmark-transport and DP emitter instances via multiple routes.
assumptions: finite two-constructor sentence types on benchmark and DP sides
imported admissibility data and support witnesses for both instances
stagewise equivalence from the Godel-composed comparison witness

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBoundaryReimportRep.summary: Formalizes LCEL clauses on boundary underivability, licensed extension derivability and reimport conservativity over an abstract sentence type. Proves the three clauses force boundary and reimport disjoint. Exhibits a two-sentence Godel-shaped model where the boundary lies in the reimport class, refuting conservativity, then introduces annotated clauses replacing conservativity by licensed annotated return and shows the same configuration inhabits the strictly weaker repair.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBoundaryReimportRep.boundary: Under the original clauses boundary and reimport must be disjoint with overlap impossible, while under the annotated repair overlap is permitted; the Godel and DP configurations lie on the overlapping side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELBoundaryReimportRep.conclusion: Original boundary plus conservativity clauses forbid boundary-reimport overlap, while the annotated repair admits the Godel-shaped overlap and is strictly weaker.

kernel-only per header: no sorry, admit, axiom or native reduction

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELCanonicalInstances..summary: Places Godel-shaped and typed DP fixtures as inhabited annotated-clause records with exact base, extension and annotated derivability characterizations. Gives concrete boundary extension and annotated proofs with payload receipt and erasure none. Proves the unlicensed control underivable on all three layers and that the DP boundary-reimport overlap cannot inhabit old plain-base conservativity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELCanonicalInstances..boundary: Basic and boundary sentences are derivable in the annotated union while the unlicensed control is underivable on all layers; the same boundary-reimport overlap inhabits annotated clauses but cannot inhabit plain-base conservativity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELCanonicalInstances..conclusion: Both Godel-shaped and concrete DP fixtures inhabit annotated clauses with exact derivability, and the DP overlap refutes plain-base conservativity.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELComparisonDegenerac.summary: Shows any two realized LCEL slot profiles are stagewise equivalent and any two realized instances compare via six iff fields ignoring inputs. Exhibits a contentless all-True profile equivalent to every realized profile. Proves both quasi-functor and comparison-witness hom-sets are subsingletons, so the six-slot comparison is a classification and the cited structural identity is conditional transport, not carrier identity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELComparisonDegenerac.boundary: Realized instances always compare and hom-sets are subsingletons, so the method classifies by six truth values on one side but fails to transport stage witnesses on the other; ComparisonWitness still needs six-step stagewise equivalence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELComparisonDegenerac.conclusion: Six-slot LCEL comparison is a subsingleton classification, not a transport of witnesses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELDpInstance.lean.summary: Combines a projection-certification theorem for the free duplicator with a finite two-tag LCEL fixture using constant True predicates and identity maps. Defines base, obstruction, reflection and reimport contents with coherence and a comparison object. Assembles the LCEL instance and projects schema realization with base, license-transfer, reimport-transfer and factorization supports, without external interpretation.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELDpInstance.lean.conclusion: The finite DP emitter fixture realizes the LCEL schema and supplies base, license-transfer, reimport-transfer and factorization supports.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELFactorization.lean.summary: Defines boundary as failure to factor through an observer, equivalent to non-fiber-constancy, and proves a nontrivial kernel forbids any left inverse so split projections can be irreversible. Develops reversible and irreversible coordinate models where sensitivity implies boundary admissibility with set equality under extensional completeness. Realizes the interfaces on a Boolean fixture and on KO7 traces with dpRank versus wrapper multiplicity, including no-transport obstructions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELFactorization.lean.boundary: A target factors through an observer on one side exactly when fiber-constant, and lies on the boundary when it does not; dpRank determines neither wrapper multiplicity nor parity and has no trace left inverse, while base truth factors only through the reversible coordinate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELFactorization.lean.conclusion: Boundary sensitivity to the irreversible coordinate is underivable in the base layer, concretely witnessed by wrapper parity versus dpRank.
assumptions: observer-kernel FactorsThrough and fiber constancy
KO7 Trace with dpRank, DPPair and Step
Bool models with decidable equality; no sorry or axiom shown

It provides projections to correspondences and single theorems, together with equalities showing each transported source theorem equals the stored target theorem. It defines transports of base, license, reimport and boundary theorems through a strong slot correspondence and builds concrete witnesses for the Gödel to benchmark and Gödel to DP-emitter pairs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELMathematicalSupport.conclusion: Source base, license, reimport and boundary theorems transport to target instances along a strong semantic slot correspondence, instantiated for Gödel to benchmark and Gödel to DP pairs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELP4CResidualObligati.summary: This file packages conditional route, admissibility, coherence and boundary data for LCEL pairs and isolates the universal residual that remains an explicit caller obligation. It defines certified instance overlays, certified-pair blueprints with four canonical coherence equations, residual packages, and a certified boundary catalog. It proves conditional reductions showing universal certification plus blueprints yield residual packages, unrestricted witnesses and witness-free structural identity. It also builds the canonical benchmark to DP residual package and its corollaries without claiming raw unconditional P4C.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELP4CResidualObligati.boundary: Witness-free structural identity for all raw pairs holds only under universal certification and universal blueprint data, and any certified boundary catalog still carries those two open obligations so raw unconditional P4C is not proved.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELP4CResidualObligati.conclusion: Universal certification plus universal certified-pair blueprints yield a residual package and witness-free structural identity for every raw pair, while raw unconditional P4C remains unproved without that universal data.
assumptions: UniversalCertification that every raw instance has a certified overlay
UniversalCertifiedRouteLiftBlueprint that every certified pair has a blueprint
per-pair admissibility data and four canonical coherence equations for lift steps

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELReversibility.lean.summary: This file defines witness-parameterized proposition slots for base reversibility, license irreversibility and reimport reversibility, plus asymmetry and boundary factorization records for Paper C Propositions 5.8 and 5.9. It defines stronger proof-carrying base, license, reimport and factorization support records with adapters building them from semantic theorems. It populates canonical Gödel-side and benchmark-side support and witness packages from the available semantic-support fields.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELReversibility.lean.boundary: Base and reimport clauses are reversible while the license clause is irreversible with boundary sensitivity tied to the irreversible quotient, and the records alone do not provide inverse laws, projection maps or composition equations which require separate data.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELReversibility.lean.conclusion: Stronger proof-carrying base, license, reimport and factorization supports assemble into reversibility-asymmetry and boundary-factorization packages, instantiated for Gödel and benchmark instances.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELReversibilityUncond.summary: This file closes Paper C Propositions 5.8 and 5.9 and the artifact-facing structural-identity theorem unconditionally on the typed FormalLCELInstance carrier. It shows every typed instance carries base, license and reimport semantic supports and builds universal proof-carrying support records. It proves any two instances are stagewise equivalent through the DP pivot with universally inhabited license and reimport equivalences, yielding quasi-functors in both directions.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELReversibilityUncond.conclusion: Every pair of typed LCEL instances admits a quasi-functor in both directions, with reversibility asymmetry and boundary factorization holding unconditionally.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELRouteSemanticsClass.summary: This file extends the route-semantics layer into a lift surface for LCEL pairs. Given pair-generic source-sensitive route semantics, per-side admissibility data and four canonical coherence equations, the route lifts to a strong transport bridge, a mathematical-support witness and an unrestricted witness. It derives unrestricted-witness admission and unrestricted and existence-form structural identity corollaries while remaining conditional and not claiming raw-pair P4C.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELRouteSemanticsClass.boundary: The lift to a bridge, unrestricted witness and structural identity holds only with per-side admissibility data and four canonical coherence equations, and without them no raw-pair witness-free P4C claim is made.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELRouteSemanticsClass.conclusion: Route semantics with admissibility and coherence lifts to a transport bridge and unrestricted witness yielding structural identity, conditionally.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSchema.lean.summary: This file represents Paper C Definition 5.7 as a packaged six-slot LCEL structure with its four structural clauses. It defines a light propositional profile with stagewise equivalence, typed boundary and annotation objects with realization lemmas, and a typed FormalLCELInstance adjoining explicit license and reimport slots. It builds canonical Gödel-labelled and benchmark transport instances and proves each realizes the schema.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSchema.lean.boundary: Designated boundary sentences are internally unprovable yet true in the reference model, separating internal derivability from external truth, while schema realization requires all six slots.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSchema.lean.conclusion: The six-slot LCEL schema is packaged as a typed instance carrier with canonical Gödel and benchmark instances each realizing the schema.
assumptions: finite-model scope inherited from ClassicalAscentProfile for the Gödel-labelled adapter

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSemanticCorresponde.summary: The file defines weak maps between LCEL instances for boundary witnesses, external-license propositions, reimport-class propositions and annotations, bundled as LCELSemanticSlotCorrespondence. It defines strengthened records adding one-way preservation implications plus a one-way base-sentence map, bundled as LCELStrongSemanticSlotCorrespondence with a downgrade to the weak bundle. It constructs canonical Godel-to-benchmark and Godel-to-DP maps that are constant to target-designated values, proving the stated equalities and implications from target support fields.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSemanticCorresponde.boundary: The designated boundary sentence is unprovable in the base theory yet true in the reference model, and the translated designated witness preserves both facts. The canonical maps meet only these designated equalities and one-way implications, so they do not establish a faithful source-sensitive correspondence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSemanticCorresponde.conclusion: Constant Godel-to-DP and Godel-to-benchmark maps satisfy the weak and strong slot equations using only target support fields.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELStructuralIdentity..summary: The file defines LCELQuasiFunctor as six proposition-level biconditionals between LCEL slot profiles with clause access, symmetry, composition and transport of realization. It defines comparison, semantic and support witnesses packaging stagewise profile equivalence with license, reimport and support equivalences and rebuilding reversibility and factorization packages. It instantiates these witnesses for Godel-to-benchmark and Godel-to-DP pairs and proves stagewise equivalence with bidirectional realization transport and structural identity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELStructuralIdentity..boundary: Base and reimport slots are reversible while the license slot is irreversible, and the boundary-factorization package separates the reversible projection from the irreversible quotient. Comparison witnesses preserve this split while transporting realization in both directions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELStructuralIdentity..conclusion: Godel, benchmark-transport and DP-emitter LCEL instances are pairwise stagewise equivalent with bidirectional realization transport and structural identity.

It provides extraction functions packaging fields from base, license, reimport and boundary support records. It instantiates all four packages for Godel, benchmark-transport and DP-emitter instances.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSubstrateMathematic.boundary: Each base package pairs a provable sentence with a designated boundary sentence that is distinct, unprovable in the base theory yet true in the reference model. OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELSubstrateMathematic.conclusion: For each of the Godel, benchmark and DP instances the file yields packaged provable-unprovable, reflection, certification and factorization records projected from support records.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELTypedDPInstance.lea.summary: The file builds a typed two-sentence DP theory where the base layer derives only transformed-call termination while source termination is empty, and the extension adds a licensed source proof retaining certificate and KO7 license. It defines the active certificate-consuming license routing the pair certificate through a natural countdown and polynomial rank, keeping the constant map only as a fixture. It proves source termination is reference-true yet underivable, gives an exact alphabet proxy that fails truth preservation, and proves the coarse annotation observer collides with distinct conclusions so no extensional factorization exists.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELTypedDPInstance.lea.boundary: Source termination is true in the fixed KO7 semantics at every trace but underivable in the base theory, while its wrapper-parity proxy is false at the alternate trace. The coarse licensed-base observer holds equally on two licensed states whose typed conclusions differ, so annotation class does not determine conclusion and no extensional factorization exists.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELTypedDPInstance.lea.conclusion: The coarse annotation class fails to determine typed conclusion on actual licensed DP reimports, and actual DP semantics admits no extensional factorization.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUniversalTheorem.le.summary: This file defines admissible LCEL instances bundling a typed instance with schema realization and four substrate support records, and universal quasi-functors carrying a slot-level quasi-functor plus target reversibility and boundary packages. It constructs a universal quasi-functor by genuine source-to-target transport through an admissibility comparison witness, and proves the universal structural-identity theorem and its bidirectional form from such a witness. It also defines a weaker admissibility-only packaging that builds the carrier from target data without transport, and instantiates all constructions on the Godel, benchmark-transport and DP emitter pairs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUniversalTheorem.le.boundary: A universal quasi-functor with genuinely transported target packages exists only for admissibility pairs equipped with a comparison witness. Admissibility alone yields only a weaker carrier built from target-local data, and no parallelism is asserted without comparison data.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUniversalTheorem.le.conclusion: For any admissible pair equipped with a comparison witness, a universal quasi-functor with genuinely transported target packages exists, instantiated on the Godel-DP and Godel-benchmark pairs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedClassif.summary: This file characterizes when a raw pair of LCEL instances admits an unrestricted mathematical witness as the conjunction of schema realization on each side and a cross-instance mathematical support witness. It packages this as classification data and proves the biconditional and its bridge-data refinements using per-side admissibility data plus pairwise slot correspondence and stagewise equivalence. It builds support witnesses by two routes, a weak route with constant target-returning transports and a strong route storing caller-supplied transports with canonical coherence, and instantiates both on the Godel-DP and Godel-benchmark pairs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedClassif.boundary: An unrestricted witness exists exactly when schema realization holds on each side together with a cross-instance mathematical witness or bridge. The weak bridge builder yields only constant target-returning transports, so source-sensitive transport requires the strong transport bridge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedClassif.conclusion: Admission of an unrestricted witness is equivalent to per-side admissibility plus pairwise bridge data, realized on the canonical Godel pairs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedExisten.summary: This file defines the propositional predicate AdmitsLCELUnrestrictedWitness hiding the choice of unrestricted witness. It proves the existence-form universal theorem producing admissible instances with the original carriers and a universal quasi-functor from mere existence of a witness. It discharges witness existence and the existence-form conclusion on the Godel-DP and Godel-benchmark pairs via canonical witnesses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedExisten.boundary: The existence-form conclusion holds only under the hypothesis that a witness exists. The file isolates but does not bridge the still-open question of which raw pairs admit such a witness, and proves no bare witness-free theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedExisten.conclusion: Mere existence of an unrestricted witness yields admissible instances on the original carriers with a universal quasi-functor, instantiated on the two canonical pairs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedTheorem.summary: This file defines unrestricted mathematical witnesses over raw instance pairs packaging per-side realization and a full mathematical support witness. It builds source and target admissible instances internally from the witness and lifts the closed Track G theorem to prove the unrestricted universal structural-identity theorem with Track G transport, plus bidirectional and canonical Godel-pair corollaries. Four hardening lemmas record that the construction coincides definitionally with the Track G and Route E1 pipelines.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedTheorem.boundary: The theorem is unrestricted only in not demanding prepackaged admissible instances, and still requires an unrestricted witness. The bare-quantifier form over arbitrary raw pairs without any witness is explicitly not proved or claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELUnrestrictedTheorem.conclusion: Any raw pair equipped with an unrestricted mathematical witness yields a universal quasi-functor between internally built admissible instances via Track G transport.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELWitnessFreeStructur.summary: This file proves classification-scoped witness-free structural-identity theorems that replace the witness argument by Nonempty hypotheses, per-side admissibility data plus bridges, or concrete classification packages. It gives weak bridge and strong transport-bridge refinements constructing the witness internally with constant versus bridge-supplied transports. It closes Godel-DP, Godel-benchmark and benchmark-DP corollaries through both routes while stating the hypothesis-free universal form is not proved.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELWitnessFreeStructur.boundary: The witness-free conclusion holds only on the classified scope discharging the residual obligation. The universal form over all raw pairs with no hypotheses is not proved and would require new mathematics beyond the LCEL schema.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LCELWitnessFreeStructur.conclusion: On the classified scope, per-side and bridge hypotheses suffice for admissible instances with a universal quasi-functor, closed on the three canonical pairs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LPO_KO7.lean.summary: This file instantiates the generic lexicographic path order on the KO7 kernel with CeTA precedence and full lexicographic status, encoding traces as first-order terms. It proves each root rule and every full-context step is oriented by the one-step order and its transitive closure, yielding well-foundedness of full-context reduction. It also proves the order imports the subterm property while no affine compositional measure can globally orient the system, and that no such measure represents any LPO-respecting rank.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LPO_KO7.lean.boundary: Root precedence cannot orient integrate of delta to void because integrate and void share rank 0, so orientation goes via subterm through delta. No affine compositional measure globally orients the KO7 system, while the transitive LPO does.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LPO_KO7.lean.conclusion: The transitive LPO orients all KO7 full-context steps and proves termination, while affine measures cannot.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LPO_Schema.lean.summary: This file defines first-order signatures with Nat-valued precedence, first-order terms, and the one-step LPO generator with subterm, precedence and full lexicographic clauses, plus its transitive closure as the exported order. It proves stability under substitution, monotonicity under argument updates and arbitrary one-hole contexts, and that the equal-tail clause is a subrelation of the full clause. It proves well-foundedness of the reverse orders by nested accessibility induction on rank, lexicographic argument tuples and right-hand-side size, without Kruskal or minimal bad sequences.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LPO_Schema.lean.conclusion: The generic transitive lexicographic path order is stable, monotone and well-founded.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LawvereYanofskySeparati.summary: This file defines bare Lawvere-Yanofsky ingredients for code objects, evaluation with self-application, fixed-point-free endomaps and their bundle, alongside finite pair-graph certificates and DP confession structures with optional Lawvere slots. It builds the primitive-duplicator confession with a singleton pair node, well-founded pair problem and external Arts-Giesl license but no internal code, evaluation or fixed-point-free data. It proves this constructed object does not furnish a Lawvere-Yanofsky schema and is semantically separated from that route, with an explicit semantic profile.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LawvereYanofskySeparati.boundary: Finite pair-graph certification with an external license is present, while the internal code, evaluation and fixed-point-free package required for a Lawvere-Yanofsky diagonal is absent on the constructed duplicator object. This is a separation for the built object, not a general impossibility theorem that no such schema could exist.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LawvereYanofskySeparati.conclusion: The primitive-duplicator DP confession is a singleton well-founded pair-graph with external license that furnishes no Lawvere-Yanofsky schema.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines AdditiveValuation as an explicit map from event kinds to resource vectors and evaluation of finite ledgers by weighted sum. Proves evaluation is additive over ledger addition, evaluates singletons to scalar multiples of weights, and transports trace concatenation to vector addition. Introduces directUnitValuation with unit weights on directly interpretable dimensions and zero elsewhere, and checks it evaluates the refusal-certificate fixture to 1 bit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Additive vector evaluation holds universally for every explicit valuation, while choice of a scalar exchange rate is excluded from the universal calculus and left to external policy.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Every explicit vector valuation is unconditionally additive and trace concatenation maps to vector addition.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines pointwise relation and predicate inclusion, one-step preservation, and SafeRel as the largest subrelation of R that cannot cross from P to not-P. Proves SafeRel preserves P, is greatest among such subrelations, deletes exactly boundary-crossing edges, and mutually stabilizes with the persistent Box license. Places actual relation-predicate pairs in a partial order with two stable endpoints and exhibits a safe-failed fixture where those endpoints are incomparable.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: SafeRel retains exactly edges that cannot cross from P to not-P; a genuine P-to-not-P boundary edge is on the unsafe side and must be deleted. The fixture shows dynamics repair and predicate repair are incomparable maximal stable endpoints.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Two universal repairs fix each other exactly yet separate into incomparable stable endpoints on a real fixture.
assumptions: Box mutual laws restricted to universe-0 carrier (Type) due to live Box donor scope

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines boundary isomorphisms preserving restricted dynamics and shows they transport finite paths and induce equivalences of path-constant observables. Defines finite release data and pushforward ensemble laws and proves a coupled boundary-mass-release isomorphism determines the law. Exhibits a two-state static Boolean countermodel with identity boundary and release but swapped mass giving different laws, so uncoupled determination fails.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Coupled transport along one boundary isomorphism determines the ensemble law, while independent isomorphisms for boundary, mass and release do not; the two-state swap countermodel lies on the failing side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Coupled boundary-mass-release transport determines the released ensemble law, but separately chosen isomorphisms admit a finite countermodel with different laws.
assumptions: Fintype (BdCarrier A) and Fintype (BdCarrier B) for finite release laws
DecidableEq output type for ensembleLaw
noncomputable Fintype instance on static Boolean boundary
Mathlib NormNum for weight arithmetic

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines the boundary predicate Bd as greatest forward-stable sublicense with its carrier and restricted dynamics, plus step-lifting morphisms. Proves forward transport under lifting plus license preservation and reflection via simulation, with functor laws for identities and composition. Instantiates the same object in four fibers: KO7 persistent distinction, compact-uniform metric separation, empty role boundary, and empty DP boundary with licensed issue.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Licenses inside the persistent boundary survive all future steps while licenses outside it fail at some reachable point; role and dependency-pair licenses lie entirely outside and admit no persistent point.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: The persistent boundary is functorial on lifting preserving morphisms and has the KO7 comparator, metric separation, role and DP channels as four exact fibers.
assumptions: forward transport requires StepLiftingHom and preserves tag equal to true
reflection requires reflects tag equal to true
role and DP emptiness use Role.noConfusion and one-step collapse to frame

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Constructs channel collapse dynamics on Bool times Bool and proves diagonal states are echoes while off-diagonal states are exogenous. Packages these as channelExpiry with licensed issue and unlicensed consume whose expiry discharges through license_expiry_iff_reachable_echo. Proves transport to equality and quote expiry is empty by consume self-loop obstructions and constructs an inhabited morphism into role expiry.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Exogeny holds at the off-diagonal issue and fails at the diagonal consume echo; transport to equality and quote objects is blocked by consume self-loops while transport to role erasure is inhabited.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Channel endogenization is a fourth live expiry object that cannot map to equality or quote expiry but maps into role erasure.
assumptions: kernel-only with no sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide per audit slots
carrier scope is the two-element comparator episode eqwEpisode Bool

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines identity and sequential composition for partial licensed morphisms with domain and admission formulas. Proves left and right unit laws and associativity with explicit domain, admission and map equations. Provides pure rejection, collapse and combined fixtures and proves collapse is not step-reflecting and identity composes with the partial fixture.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Composition retains a state only when the first domain holds and its image lies in the second domain. Forward simulation can hold without reflection, as the collapse target self-step has no source preimage.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Partial licensed morphisms form an associative unital composition algebra where forward simulation need not reflect steps.

Proves extensionality equality and multi-step and reachability transport. Provides the partial-chain fixture with source-only domain undefined at target and a total-domain fixture for the chain morphism.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Partial morphisms lift paths and reachability through the admitted relation with a genuinely partial example.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines the quotientToImage lift from kernel classes to the image range and proves projection compatibility, injectivity and surjectivity, packaging the carrier equivalence quotientImageEquiv and a forward simulation morphism. Proves the equivalence and morphism share the forward map. Proves the partial-chain image inclusion is not surjective onto the ambient target.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Kernel quotient and image are canonically equivalent, while the image can be a proper subset of the ambient target as the partial-chain inclusion shows.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Kernel quotient and image are equivalent carriers with forward simulation, while image inclusion need not be surjective.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines domain and edge restrictions with true, composition, idempotence and commutation laws, plus the totality predicate IsTotal, totalization toTotal and round-trip. Proves the exact criterion that IsTotal holds iff a total morphism with equal toPartial exists. Shows the partial-chain fixture admits no total representative.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Totality holds exactly when every source state lies in the domain; the partial-chain fixture lies outside and has no total licensed representative.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: State and edge restrictions are commuting idempotent operations with totality exactly when a total representative exists.

The file also contains #check and #print axioms checks of the morphism and fixture claims.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines PropositionEvidence, three BoundaryDecisions, inputs with domain and admission evidence, the inspect constructor, decisionTrace, DecisionCertificate and the execute gate. Proves commit occurs iff in-domain and admitted, with soundness for state and edge refusals, correct commit outputs and decision-determined traces. Provides state, edge and commit fixtures covering all three decisions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Commit occurs exactly for in-domain admitted edges; otherwise the gate refuses by state when outside the domain or by edge when in-domain but unadmitted.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: The gate commits exactly on admitted in-domain edges with certified refusals and outputs otherwise.
assumptions: classical choice for decidability in BoundaryExecutionInput.inspect via explicit classical tactic

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines DecisionMatchesMorphism, OutputMatchesMorphism and TraceAdequacy with exactness, soundness, completeness and morphism and output agreement. Proves certificates entail decision and output match and execute is always adequate. Provides empty-trace and fabricated certificate-bit counterexamples failing adequacy and proves commit impossible outside the domain.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Adequacy requires the exact canonical trace and sound events: the empty refusal trace and the fabricated certificate-bit commit trace satisfy certificates yet fail adequacy, and commit outside the domain is impossible.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Generic execution is always adequate while empty and fabricated certificate traces are inadequate.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines exact one-step boundary crossings, proof-relevant finite paths with safe-prefix predicates, and failure objects recording first crossing plus decomposition. Proves constructively that an explicit failed path has a first crossing under decidable P and that any failure object refutes Box persistence. Proves classically that global Box failure is equivalent to reachable failing endpoints and to existence of exact failure objects, with safe-failed and always-true fixtures showing necessity and non-vacuity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: A licensed source that can reach a failing endpoint lies outside persistent Box licensing; an always-true license never crosses while a never-true license cannot start safely.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Global Box failure at a licensed source is classically equivalent to existence of an exact first-crossing failure object.
assumptions: DecidablePred P for constructive first-crossing from an explicit failed path
classical logic for global Box-failure existence and equivalences
Box bridge theorems restricted to Type (universe 0)

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file defines IntegratedBoundaryTransaction, a wrapper that holds only a BoundaryConstructionData record for finite carriers and typed defects and actions. It provides a builder that takes no separate profile or ledger and projections for the licensed morphism, semantic data, event trace, structural profile, semantic profile and event ledger. It proves the semantic scope relation coincides with the morphism admitted relation and that all three quantitative outputs equal the values derived from the single construction datum.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Only construction data may be supplied through the builder, so structural and semantic profiles and the ledger are always derived values. An independently chosen incoherent morphism, profile and ledger tuple is not constructible through this API.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: All quantitative outputs of an integrated transaction equal the values derived from its single construction datum.
assumptions: Fintype A.Carrier
Fintype B.Carrier
DecidableEq Defect
Fintype Action
DecidableEq Action
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable structuralProfile, semanticProfile and ledger definitions
no sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file supplies canonical orientation-chain and KO7 distinction transactions through the construction-data builder, so their profiles and ledgers are computed projections. It proves confluence and terminal multiplicity one for the orientation scope and exactness of both semantic profiles. It proves the corresponding event-ledger counts and bundles both faces as nonvacuous inhabitants of the integrated API.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Exact profiles and ledger counts are proved only for the two canonical finite fixtures. The file makes no claim about every application domain.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Both the orientation chain and the KO7 distinction cone occur as integrated transactions with exactly computed semantic profiles and event ledgers.
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false
concrete finite carriers chainARS_fixture, rawARS and licensedARS
Unit defects and actions for the orientation fixture
CanonicalDefect and RepairAction for the distinction fixture

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file defines certified construction data holding a morphism, semantic data, a semantic adequacy certificate and one typed execution input, plus a wrapper whose execution result, trace, ledger and profiles are computed from those fields. It proves the semantic relation equals the admitted relation, that every such transaction has adequate execution and that its ledger is the counted trace. It instantiates a concrete KO7 edge-refusal fixture with refusal decision, unit refusal ledger count and exact semantic profile.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: With a semantic adequacy certificate the semantic relation equals the admitted relation and execution is trace-adequate with a computed ledger. Without such a certificate the file provides no such guarantee, and costs inside the semantic data remain caller-supplied.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Every certified integrated transaction has adequate execution and a trace-counted ledger, instantiated by a KO7 refusal fixture with exact profile.
assumptions: Fintype A.Carrier
Fintype B.Carrier
DecidableEq Defect
Fintype Action
DecidableEq Action
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section for projections and profiles
no sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file defines certified semantic capabilities and certified composition whose semantic profile comes from a supplied adequacy certificate for the exact composite relation. It proves left and right identity, associativity, trace concatenation, ledger addition and no scope widening or trust upgrade for the structural backbone. It transports adequacy across pure repair-cost recalibration and uses original versus zero-cost KO7 decorations to prove no factor-only rule can equal every adequate composite profile.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Structural morphisms with event accounting compose universally with identities and associativity, while semantic data decorates a composite only through a supplied adequacy certificate. No rule determined solely by the two factor decorations can equal every adequate composite decoration, so a domain law is load-bearing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: No universal semantic composer from factor decorations alone exists for the KO7 identity composite.
assumptions: Fintype carriers for A B and C
DecidableEq defects and Fintype plus DecidableEq actions

noncomputable KO7 capability section
no sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file defines composite semantic capability as semantic data plus an equivalence to the composite admitted relation. It defines composition of integrated records by composing morphisms, keeping the supplied semantics and appending event traces. It proves the morphism, trace, ledger-addition, derived-profile and associativity laws for this backbone.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Composition laws hold only for inputs that supply an explicit composite capability linking the semantic relation to the composite admitted relation. Without that capability the file derives no composite semantics.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Composed integrated transactions concatenate traces, add ledgers and derive their semantic profile from the supplied composite capability.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file proves quantitative laws for integrated composition that carries an explicit composite capability. It shows every additive valuation respects such compositions through ledger addition.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Integrated composition preserves exact structural decompositions, pointwise defect characterizations and additive resource valuations with ledger addition.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file builds a two-alternative variant of the orientation transaction with the same identity morphism and event trace but different certificate data. OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Decides all six ordered transports between equality-coalescence, quote-evaluation and role-erasure expiry: five directions are empty by concrete dynamics or license preservation laws. Constructs the sixth direction from equality to quote through a well-founded guarded rank and canonical merge chain. Adds closure and consumption refinement with canonical full objects and shows the complete table survives that refinement.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Five of six ordered transports between equality, quote and role expiry are blocked by dynamics or license preservation, while only equality-to-quote is inhabited; closure and consumption refinement preserves this exact limit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Exactly one of six expiry transports exists, and the five obstructions plus one construction survive closure refinement.
assumptions: noncomputable rank via Classical.choose and well-founded recursion on reverse EqGuardedStep
Mathlib baseline only

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Proves that replacing one-step dynamics by reflexive-transitive closure preserves Box licenses, forward invariance, persistent diagonal grade D1p and represented grade D2At. Defines datum completion with idempotence and an identity licensing morphism into the completion. Instantiates the rule on natural-number shift where closure is order and compact-uniform separation and metric licenses become exact Box statements.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Passing dynamics to reflexive-transitive closure never changes persistent licensing, so closure is transparent on one side and idempotent on the other; D0 and D1s have no such rule because they mention no dynamics.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Box, forward invariance, D1p, D2At and metric licenses all survive completion exactly with shift and metric instances.
assumptions: Mathlib relation, arithmetic and analysis libraries
IsOpen and TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn hypotheses only where the reciprocal rule states them

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file defines one-step post of a set and studies its commutation with direct-image abstraction. It proves forward simulation gives sound inclusion and that equality for every source set is equivalent to step lifting, with the same criterion for the canonical quotient-to-image map versus quotient-image exactness. It gives a finite fixture where abstract-post equality fails and a control where the quotient map is exact while the underlying observation fails pointwise lifting.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Abstract post commutes with concrete post for all sets exactly when the observation satisfies step lifting; forward simulation alone yields only inclusion. The canonical quotient-to-image map can be exact even when the underlying observation fails pointwise lifting.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Abstract-post equality for every set holds exactly when the observation satisfies step lifting, and the canonical quotient-to-image map can satisfy this exactness even when the underlying observation does not.
assumptions: ForwardStepSimulation on the observation map f
ARS types A and B with carriers and step relations

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: The file defines direct-image abstraction alpha and inverse-image concretization gamma for an arbitrary function. It proves their inclusion adjunction with its two one-sided inclusions and characterizes lossless round-trips by injectivity and surjectivity. It proves that disjointness from a target set pulls back along the observation and that equivalence of avoidance for every target set holds exactly when the source image equals the claimed set.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Round-trip abstraction is lossless for all sets only on the injective or surjective side; otherwise only inclusions hold. Target avoidance transfers to source avoidance, with equivalence for every target set only when the source image equals the claimed target set.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Direct and inverse image form an adjunction whose round-trips are lossless exactly for injective or surjective maps and whose avoidance transfer is exact exactly when the image equals the claimed set.
assumptions: inclusion alpha f S ⊆ T hypothesis for avoid_pullback and avoid_iff_all_iff_alpha_eq

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines the root RDRS relation and source and projected abstract rewriting systems, and packages a static projection transaction as an OrientationFace. Proves the transaction projection induces a licensed reduction morphism that admits every source root edge. Provides a Bool-to-Unit fixture where the projection collapses false and true to one point.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: The morphism admits every source root edge, yet its state map identifies distinct states. Distinctness holds in the source and fails after projection, so the projection boundary is loss of distinguishability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: A Bool-to-Unit orientation fixture admits all source edges but collapses distinct source states false and true to one projected state.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines capability roles, verdicts, exact forward requests, derived provenance and the constructor-closed ProofCarryingLicense family for authorization versus refusal. Proves sound admission from SafeRel and Box evidence, sound refusal from boundary evidence, output-index confinement and type-level exclusion of recovery certificates. Provides accepted and rejected fixtures showing one request is authorizable while the distinct rejected request from the same source is not.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: A safe request with licensed source and target can be authorized, while a boundary request with licensed source but unlicensed target can only be refused. The no-authorization theorem makes this sharp: no boundary-crossing request has an authorization certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: A genuine boundary-crossing request cannot receive a forward authorization certificate and can only receive a typed refusal.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines list-prefix, prefix-free binary codes, and an AlternativeCarrier witness package carrying a finite type, a terminal-support equivalence, two count equalities and an injective prefix-free code. Proves that conditional on such a package, each stored count equals the semantic terminal multiplicity. The file supplies no inhabitant of AlternativeCarrier.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: The stored counts equal true terminal multiplicity only conditional on a supplied AlternativeCarrier package; the file proves no inhabitant and no unconditional identification.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Under a supplied AlternativeCarrier package both stored alternative counts equal the scoped terminal multiplicity.
assumptions: Fintype A.Carrier
DecidableEq Defect
Fintype Action
DecidableEq Action

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.IsPrefixFree
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A code is prefix-free if for distinct inputs a and b it is not the case that code a is a BitListPrefix of code b.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.AlternativeCarrier
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An AlternativeCarrier for construction data consists of a finite Alternative type, an equivalence with the terminal support subtype, equalities fixing both stored counts to the Alternative cardinality, and an injective prefix-free binary code.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.AlternativeCarrier.fixed_count_eq_terminalMultiplicity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every carrier package, assuming Fintype and DecidableEq hypotheses, the stored fixedLengthAlternatives equals the terminal multiplicity of the scope.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.AlternativeCarrier.prefix_count_eq_terminalMultiplicity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every carrier package, assuming Fintype and DecidableEq hypotheses, the stored prefixCodeAlternatives equals the terminal multiplicity of the scope.

relations.explanation: Both count theorems identify the stored fields with terminal multiplicity via the supplied equivalence.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Studies finite target-coverage defects of partial licensed morphisms. Proves the composite image lies in the second-stage image, so composition weakly increases the final-target gap, and gap-zero is equivalent to surjectivity. Exhibits the pure state-collapse fixture as surjective.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Target coverage gap is zero exactly for surjective maps and positive otherwise; composing on the left can only preserve or increase the final-target gap.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Composite coverage gap dominates the second-stage gap and vanishes exactly for surjective partial maps.
assumptions: Fintype source and target carriers
classical finite enumeration

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.mapImage_comp_subset_second
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable partial morphisms F and G over finite carriers, the image of comp F G is contained in the image of G.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.mapImage_comp_card_le_second
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G over finite carriers, the cardinality of the composite image is at most that of the second-stage image.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.targetCoverageGap_second_le_comp
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G over finite carriers, the target coverage gap of G is at most that of comp F G.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.targetCoverageGap_eq_zero_iff_surjective
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a partial morphism F over finite carriers, its target coverage gap equals zero if and only if its state map is surjective onto the target carrier.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.pureStateCollapse_surjective_fixture
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The pure state-collapse fixture map is surjective onto its one-point target.

relations.explanation: Gap monotonicity follows from the composite image inclusion.

relations.explanation: Zero gap characterizes the surjective side of the coverage boundary.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines actual source-local non-joinable peaks, unoriented peak equality up to branch exchange, and finite defect adequacy as sound, complete and irredundant representation. Proves every represented defect is actual and that an empty certified set forces joinability of immediate peaks. Scope is source-local peaks only.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: An empty certified defect set forces source-local confluence of one-step peaks, while a nonempty certified set denotes actual non-joinable peaks.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: An empty certified defect set makes every pair of immediate reducts from the source joinable.
assumptions: Fintype A.Carrier
DecidableEq Defect
Fintype Action
DecidableEq Action
classical decidability for finite membership

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.ActualLocalDefect
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An actual local defect is a source-local peak with left and right reducts from the scope source whose branches are not joinable.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.SameDefectEndpoints
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Two endpoint pairs represent the same unoriented peak if they are equal or swapped.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.DefectAdequacy
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A defect adequacy certificate supplies endpoint pairs with soundness for listed defects, completeness up to branch exchange, and irredundancy of representatives.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.DefectAdequacy.represented_is_actual
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a DefectAdequacy certificate and membership of d in defects, the endpoints of d equal the branches of some actual local defect.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.DefectAdequacy.empty_defects_immediate_peaks_joinable
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a DefectAdequacy certificate with defects equal to the empty set, any two one-step reducts from the source are joinable.

relations.explanation: Soundness projects every certified defect to an actual non-joinable peak.

relations.explanation: Emptiness of the vocabulary obstructs the existence of non-joinable immediate peaks.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Embeds the three-node KO7 local cone into LBC reduction and partial-morphism interfaces without changing relations. Builds raw and licensed semantic scopes and construction data with alternative counts 2 and 1. Proves relation preservation, normalization transport, and that the license rejects the raw difference edge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: The raw cone admits the diagonal difference edge and has two alternatives, while the licensed cone rejects that edge and retains one alternative.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: The three-node KO7 cone embeds into LBC interfaces with raw counts 2, licensed counts 1, and an explicitly rejected difference edge.
assumptions: finite three-node cone
kernel-only definitional equalities

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Splits composite domain failure into first-stage failure versus downstream failure after first-stage success. Builds an explicit disjoint equivalence of finite defect types and derives exact additivity of undefined-state counts. Instantiates the law on the partial-chain fixture.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: A composite state is defined only when both stages are defined; undefinedness splits disjointly into first-stage failure versus downstream failure after first-stage success.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Composite undefined-state count equals first-stage count plus downstream count after first-stage admission.
assumptions: classical case distinction on domain membership
finite carriers for cardinality

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.CompositeDomainDefect

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.DownstreamDomainDefect

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.comp_not_domain_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G and state x, comp F G is undefined at x iff F is undefined at x or F is defined and G is undefined at the image.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.compositeDomainDefectEquiv
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G, composite domain defects are equivalent to the disjoint sum of first-stage defects and downstream defects.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.downstreamUndefinedStateCount
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Downstream undefined-state count is the cardinality of downstream domain defects, requiring Fintype source.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G over finite source, undefined count of the composite equals undefined count of F plus downstream count.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The identity followed by the partial chain fixture instantiates the undefined-count decomposition.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Gives an exact rejected-edge decomposition for composites: rejection occurs at the first license or downstream on its image, disjointly. Encodes the split as an equivalence of finite types and derives exact additivity of rejected-edge counts. Shows the pure-rejection composite rejects the chain edge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: A raw edge is admitted by a composite exactly when admitted first and downstream; otherwise rejection comes disjointly from the first or second license.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Composite rejected-edge count equals first-stage rejected count plus downstream rejected count.
assumptions: classical case distinction on admission
finite source carriers for counts

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.comp_not_admitted_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G and states x y, comp F G does not admit x y iff F does not admit it or F admits it and G rejects its image.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.compositeRejectedEdgeEquiv
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G, rejected edges of the composite are equivalent to the disjoint sum of first-stage rejected edges and downstream rejected edges.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.downstreamRejectedEdgeCount
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Downstream rejected-edge count is the cardinality of downstream rejected edges, requiring finite source.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.rejectedEdgeCount_comp
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable F and G over finite source, composite rejected-edge count equals first-stage count plus downstream count.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Develops finite fiber composition: a dependent-sum equivalence for composite fibers, a pointwise product bound, and a universal maximum-fiber product bound for finite functions. Lifts the bound to partial licensed morphisms via domain inclusions and subtype bounds. Shows the collapse fixture has a genuinely nontrivial fiber.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: State identification can collapse distinct states into one fiber, with composite fibers at most multiplicatively large; the collapse fixture shows the nontrivial-fiber side is nonempty.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Maximum fiber cardinality of a partial composite is at most the product of the two maxima.
assumptions: Fintype domain and codomain types
classical finite instances internal to definitions
noncomputable section

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The dependent sum of first-stage fiber cardinalities over one second-stage fiber, requiring finite types.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For finite f g and target z, composite fiber cardinality equals the dependent sum over the second-stage fiber.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.maximumFiberCardinality_comp_le_mul
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For finite functions f and g, the maximum fiber of the composite is at most the product of the maxima.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Inclusion of the composite domain into the first morphism domain.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For composable partial morphisms over finite carriers, the composite maximum fiber is at most the product of the two maxima.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines option-valued rates and Hartley collapse that return none exactly on empty support. Shows two total extensions agree on positive samples yet disagree at zero, so no unique total rate extension exists. Adapts guarded distinction-surface rates and shows the chain fixture collapse is defined.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Guarded observables return none exactly on empty support and some value otherwise; no total rate operation is uniquely fixed by agreement on positive samples, so the option boundary is intrinsic.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: There is no unique total rate extension agreeing with ordinary rates on positive samples.
assumptions: classical finite enumeration
Nonempty or cardinality hypotheses for guarded adapters
Real.logb for Hartley values

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Raw and licensed profiles equal the stated exact profiles with a drop of one in four coordinates.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Certifies raw and licensed three-node systems with complete adequacy: sound and complete defect vocabularies, repair interpretations preserving the licensed branch, concrete witness carriers at grades 1 and 0, and alternative carriers from terminal supports with explicit prefix-free codes. Shows raw counts two alternatives and licensed counts one.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: The raw system has a genuine diagonal peak and two terminal alternatives, while the licensed system has no defects and one alternative; counts 2 versus 1 mark the licensing boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Both raw and licensed three-node systems receive complete semantic adequacy certificates with 2 and 1 alternatives respectively.
assumptions: finite three-node local cone
noncomputable section
kernel-only finite proofs

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Splits every excluded raw edge into endpoint-domain failure versus in-domain license refusal with disjointness and exact count additivity. Gives a matching upstream-versus-downstream composition law for in-domain refusals and a five-coordinate orthogonal profile. The two fixtures realize opposite 0-versus-1 corners.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Excluded raw edges split disjointly into domain-excluded versus in-domain license-refused edges; pure edge-rejection and partial-domain fixtures realize opposite corners with counts 0 versus 1.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Nonadmitted edges decompose exactly into domain-excluded plus license-rejected counts with a matching in-domain composition law.
assumptions: Fintype source carriers
classical finite case analysis
noncomputable section

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines peak resolution covering both branch removal and joinability of survivors, and repair certificates with protected-relation preservation and sound-complete closes correspondence. Proves closes membership equivalent to resolution, three sufficient resolution conditions, and survival of protected edges.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: A peak is resolved when a branch is removed or surviving endpoints join, and remains unresolved when both branches survive non-joinably; closes membership marks exactly the resolved side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: For represented defects closes membership is equivalent to peak resolution with protected edges always surviving.
assumptions: Fintype A.Carrier
DecidableEq Defect
Fintype Action
DecidableEq Action

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Defines construction data with caller-supplied costs and alternative counts and the eight-coordinate profile builder combining scoped, defect, repair, witness and coding quantities. Proves definitional unfolding, a fixed-length lower bound for injective encodings, Hartley definedness under normalization, and zero cover and cost for empty defects.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Encodings shorter than the binary-log floor are impossible for the stated cardinality, while longer ones may exist; Hartley is defined only under normalization and empty defects give zero cover and cost.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: The profile builder unfolds definitionally and its fixed-length floor lower-bounds every injective binary encoding of the stated size.
assumptions: Fintype carriers

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Builds a one-step fixture from the empty policy to the raw recD seed or its confluence repair, with confluence as the license predicate. Shows the empty and repaired policies are confluent while the raw seed is not, yielding a safe repaired request with forward license and a raw boundary request with refusal. Treats recovery as an external history token and proves the repaired record has two histories, no global left inverse exists, and neither direction upgrades the other capability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Confluent repaired policies can be forward-authorized while the nonconfluent raw seed can only be refused. Repair is many-to-one, so without an extra history token no observer can reconstruct the history, and even with it recovery cannot be upgraded to admission.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Confluence repair has no global deterministic left inverse, recovery evidence cannot manufacture forward admission, and forward admission cannot reconstruct history.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: Replaces scalar repair rankings with Pareto comparison over retained domain, admitted dynamics, observer factorization and license implication, proving reflexivity, transitivity and preorder structure. Exhibits two Bool profiles that are incomparable with a named failing coordinate in each direction, and shows Box is the greatest forward-invariant predicate repair. Proves the live positional repair compiler is monotone, functorial, confluent, minimal among confluent extensions and idempotent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: The Pareto order is genuinely partial: the wide-domain profile keeps more domain but admits less dynamics than the wide-dynamics profile, so neither dominates the other. No scalar or total ranking can order this pair.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: The live repair compiler is monotone, functorial, confluent, minimal and idempotent, while the semantic Pareto order remains partial with an explicit incomparable pair.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: This file defines exactness of the quotient-to-image dynamics as preservation and reflection of the one-step relation. It proves this exactness is equivalent to step lifting of the canonical quotient-to-image map and equivalent to bisimulation on the image. Under exactness it constructs an abstract rewriting system isomorphism between the kernel quotient and the image. It also proves a finite fixture falsifies exactness, showing the lifting condition cannot be dropped.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: The quotient-to-image map always forward-simulates but is dynamically exact exactly when every image step lifts. Without that lifting, the image can have a self-step with no quotient edge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Quotient-to-image dynamics are exact exactly when every image step lifts, in which case the quotient and image are ARS-isomorphic, and the lifting condition cannot be dropped.
assumptions: Classical.choice for the quotient-image equivalence inverse via noncomputable definition, per audit slots
Quot.sound for quotient injectivity, per audit slots

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any morphism F, quotient-image exactness holds if and only if the quotient-to-image map satisfies step lifting from the kernel quotient to the image, with no additional hypotheses.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.LicensedBoundaryCalculus.PartialLicensedReductionMorphism.quotientImageExact_iff_bisimulationOnImage
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any morphism F, quotient-image exactness holds if and only if the quotient-to-image map satisfies bisimulation on the image, with no additional hypotheses.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a morphism F and a proof hExact of quotient-image exactness, constructs an ARS isomorphism between the kernel quotient system and the image system using the quotient-image equivalence and exactness for the step equivalence.

OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.summary: This file defines forward step and reachability simulation, step and reachability reflection, step lifting, terminality and terminal exactness, plus bisimulation on the image, reduction equivalence, and ARS isomorphism. It proves forward step simulation implies forward reachability simulation and bisimulation on the image implies terminal exactness. It also proves every ARS isomorphism yields forward simulation, lifting, bisimulation, reachability preservation and reflection, reduction equivalence, and terminal exactness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.boundary: Strong terminology requires its corresponding proved field, keeping one-step and reachability levels separate. Forward step simulation guarantees forward reachability, while terminal exactness and stronger equivalences need additional lifting, reflection, or isomorphism fields.
OperatorKO7/Meta/LicensedBoundaryCalculu.conclusion: Every ARS isomorphism provides forward simulation, step lifting, bisimulation on the image, forward and reflected reachability, reduction equivalence, and terminal exactness.
