OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: The file enumerates fourteen direct barrier families and their 27 load-bearing hypothesis slots, with carriers that delete exactly one premise and specifications of the deleted premise and excluded orientation. It constructs explicit orienting valuations (counter and step weights, negative and retention-failing additive measures, unbalanced mixed-coordinate and zero-weight functional models, among others) showing each barrier fails without its premise, and proves that restoring the premise restores the live barrier by calling that family's barrier theorem. It also proves joint and auxiliary redundancies: both wrapper coefficients together and several successor, recursor and wrapper-weight fields are not load-bearing. Finally it shows both hypotheses of the barrier cell are individually necessary by independent countermodels.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: With a load-bearing premise present the duplicating rule cannot be oriented; with that premise deleted an explicit valuation orients it. The same boundary holds for the barrier cell, where each of unbounded wrapper margin and bounded counter gain is individually required for non-orientability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Every one of the 27 load-bearing premises across the fourteen direct barrier families is exactly necessary: restoring it restores the orientation barrier, and deleting it admits an explicit orienting countermodel.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.DirectBarrierFamily
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The inductive type lists the fourteen direct families: additiveCompositional, transparentCompositional, affine, restrictedQuadratic, boundedCrossTermQuadratic, boundedMultilinear, generalizedBoundedPolynomial, maxPlus, trackedPrimaryPair, trackedPrimaryLexicographic, balancedMixedCoordinate, weightedScalarProjection, maxDepth and headPrecedence.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.allDirectBarrierFamilies
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The list allDirectBarrierFamilies contains each of the fourteen constructors of DirectBarrierFamily exactly once.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.DupOrientsBy
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a schema S, relation R and valuation e, DupOrientsBy R e means for all b s n, R holds from e (wrap s (recur b s n)) to e (recur b s (succ n)).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.HypothesisSlot
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For each family f, HypothesisSlot f is the indexed type of its load-bearing premises, with four slots for additiveCompositional, two for transparentCompositional, three for affine, two for restrictedQuadratic, one each for boundedCrossTermQuadratic, boundedMultilinear and generalizedBoundedPolynomial, three for trackedPrimaryPair, three for trackedPrimaryLexicographic, four for balancedMixedCoordinate, three for weightedScalarProjection, and no slots for maxPlus, maxDepth and headPrecedence.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.familySlots
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For each family f, familySlots f is the list of all HypothesisSlot f terms, empty for maxPlus, maxDepth and headPrecedence.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.SlotSpec
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A SlotSpec consists of a carrier type Carrier, a deleted-premise predicate Deleted on Carrier, and an excluded-orientation predicate Orients on Carrier.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.slotSpec
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For each slot h, slotSpec h is the SlotSpec whose Carrier is the live class with that premise removed, whose Deleted is that premise, and whose Orients is the corresponding DupOrientsBy statement under strict less-than, nonstrict less-than-or-equal, PairLt, PairLexLt, VecLt or VecLexLt as appropriate to the family.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.DeletedHypothesisCountermodel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a spec P, a DeletedHypothesisCountermodel comprises a datum in P.Carrier, a proof that P.Deleted fails at that datum, and a proof that P.Orients holds at that datum.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.NecessityEvidence
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: NecessityEvidence f h is defined as DeletedHypothesisCountermodel (slotSpec h).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.slot_barrier_restored
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every family f, slot h and datum M of (slotSpec h).Carrier, if (slotSpec h).Deleted M holds then (slotSpec h).Orients M is false; each case calls the live barrier theorem of that family.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.used_hypothesis_has_countermodel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every family f and slot h, there is a Nonempty (NecessityEvidence f h); each of the 27 slots has an explicit deleted-premise countermodel.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.slot_premise_exactly_necessary
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every slot h, both the barrier with the deleted premise holds (for all M, Deleted M implies not Orients M) and the barrier without it is false (not for all M, not Orients M).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.DeletedHypothesisCountermodel.refutes_deleted_barrier
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any spec P and countermodel C with datum, failure of Deleted and proof of Orients, it is false that every M in P.Carrier fails P.Orients.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.familySlots_total
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Summing the lengths of familySlots over allDirectBarrierFamilies gives 27.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.additiveAttainment_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The ordered additive barrier without attainment is false on the free schema, witnessed by negativeOrderedAdditive which orients; attainment fails for the negative-integer measure; and the barrier without attainment is false on the negative-integer schema.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.additiveWrapRetention_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every datum of OrderedAdditiveNoRetention fails to orient the duplicating rule under strict less-than; retentionFailAdditive orients it while failing WrapRetention.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.directLawWrapperRetention_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every datum of DirectLawNoRetention fails to orient under strict less-than; botRightDirectLaw orients it while failing WrapperRetention.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.directLawBoundedCounterGain_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every datum of DirectLawNoGain fails to orient under strict less-than; crossCoupledDirectLaw orients it while failing BoundedCounterGain.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.transparentSuccessor_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every CompositionalMeasure on the free schema fails to orient under strict less-than; compCoupledMeasure orients it while failing successor transparency c_succ c_base = c_base.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.compositionalWrapSubterm2_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every CompositionalNoSubterm2 datum fails to orient under strict less-than; leftWrapCompositional orients it while failing WrapSubterm2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.affineWrapLeftPositive_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Left wrapper positivity is necessary in four senses: the strict affine barrier without 1 ≤ wrap_left is false witnessed by counterAffine; the nonstrict barrier without it is false under the additional hypothesis that some t satisfies 1 ≤ eval t; the witness coefficient indeed violates 1 ≤ wrap_left; and for all coefficient data C and variable-condition orders O, the weighted barrier without wrap₁ positivity is false.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.affineWrapRightPositive_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Right wrapper positivity is necessary in four senses: the strict affine barrier without 1 ≤ wrap_right is false witnessed by stepAffine; the nonstrict barrier without it is false under the additional hypothesis that some t satisfies 1 ≤ eval t; the witness coefficient indeed violates 1 ≤ wrap_right; and for all coefficient data C and variable-condition orders O, the weighted barrier without wrap₂ positivity is false.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.crossTermBaseDominance_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every CrossTermQuadraticMeasure on the free schema fails to orient under strict less-than; the CrossTermBoundedAtBase premise is therefore necessary.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.polynomialEventualDominance_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every BoundedPolynomialMeasure on the free schema fails to orient under strict less-than; the EventuallyDominatedAtBase premise is therefore necessary.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.mix2WrapLeftBalanced_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every Mix2NoWrapLeftBalanced datum fails to orient under PairLt; leftUnbalancedMix2 orients it while its left wrapper map is not Balanced.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.functionalWeightSupport_deleted_barrier_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that every FunctionalNoWeightSupport datum fails to orient under VecLt; zeroWeightFunctional orients via counterStepVec while having no positive weight.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.polynomial_wrapPos_both_nonLoadBearing
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: OB Thm 5.3, short form, and Thm 5.12; ledger row 01-013
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any schema S and any PolynomialCore datum M satisfying the hypothesis EventuallyDominatedAtBase, M does not orient the duplicating step under strict less-than, irrespective of its two wrapper coefficients.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.mix2_auxBalance_nonLoadBearing
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any schema S and any Mix2NoAuxBalance datum M with balanced wrapper maps of positive column sums and no hypothesis on successor or recursor balance, M does not orient the duplicating step under PairLt.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.weighted_barrier_of_wrapPositivity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any coefficient assignment A satisfying hypotheses 1 ≤ A.wrap₁ and 1 ≤ A.wrap₂ and any variable-condition order O, O does not order dupSrc above dupTgt; only the two wrapper coefficients are used.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.HypothesisNecessity.barrier_cell_hypotheses_individually_necessary
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Both barrier-cell statements hold: it is false that GainBoundedAt alone forbids orientation for all valuations at base zero, and it is false that WrapUnboundedAt alone forbids orientation for all valuations at base zero; each hypothesis is individually necessary.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file factors the method data of six singleton exact promotion carriers into carrier-parametric interfaces for argument filtering, neutral processors, size-change, Cichon descent, equational quotients and sharing. Each interface stores its operations and laws, and a concrete KO7 instance is shown to recover the exact promoted rank, relation or functions. The capstone theorem assembles all six recoveries while the other ten historical rows keep their carrier-wide statements.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Every equational quotient collapses distinct source-normal terms and every sharing method with distinct same-read-back representations has noninjective read-back, so neither method can be conservative or injective while performing its identification.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: All six exact historical promotion carriers are recovered as instances of generic carrier-parametric method interfaces.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file defines term size and a polynomial weight for the free two-rule recursor and proves the weight drops on every root and contextual step. It derives an upper bound of fewer than 3 to the term size steps for any derivation and a matching exponential lower bound from a nested payload family that emits and reduces k copies per level. A final dependency-pair escape counts recursive calls by the drop of the successor counter.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Every contextual derivation from t has length below 3 to the size of t, while the nested payload family attains k to the d steps, so the free recursor has single-exponential derivational complexity that is tight.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Every contextual derivation from t has fewer than 3 to the size of t steps and the nested family shows this single-exponential bound is essentially tight.
assumptions: variable ν : Type u

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file bounds ordinal heights by natural-valued decreasing functions and shows heights of a well-founded relation form an initial segment. Applied to the free recursor, both the reversed contextual relation and the reversed recursive-call relation have heights exactly the natural numbers with supremum omega. A four-symbol path order with a Veblen ranking orients both root rules, decreases on every comparison, stays below veblen 4 0 and is cofinal there.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: The contextual and recursive-call relations both have height exactly omega with all finite heights attained, while the MPO ranking at the four schema symbols is bounded by and cofinal in veblen 4 0.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Both the contextual and call heights attain exactly all natural numbers with supremum omega, while the MPO ranking is cofinal in veblen 4 0.
assumptions: variable ν : Type u
IsWellFounded instances for reversed contextual and call relations

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file defines a coupled polynomial interpretation with parameters alpha and beta and proves the whole region alpha at least 1 and beta at least 2 orients both recursor rules. It proves strict monotonicity in every constructor argument and lifts root orientation to a strict decrease on every one-hole contextual step. The generic transfer then yields strong normalization of full contextual rewriting, with alpha 1 beta 2 as a concrete witness, and root rewriting follows as a subrelation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Inside the parameter region alpha at least 1 and beta at least 2 the coupled polynomial interpretation orients both root rules and is strictly monotone, hence the full contextual closure terminates; the witness alpha 1 beta 2 is an explicit certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Every interpretation with alpha at least 1 and beta at least 2 proves strong normalization of the full contextual free recursor, in particular alpha 1 beta 2.
assumptions: WellFounded (<) on Nat

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file translates between payload-blindness and not using the payload and between adequacy and orientation, showing the grammar theorem and the direct-grammar license are the same statement. It proves the license criterion and the equivalence of separation with the payload half of the grammar theorem. It also shows every denotation-preserving self-map preserves both predicates, with sum-commutation as a non-identity example, and records what aggregations of recursive arguments can use.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: A grammar expression orients the duplicating step exactly when it is payload-blind with strict counter response, so no adequate expression uses the payload.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Grammar orientation and the operational-inexpressibility license are the same statement under identity translation, which is not unique.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file gives native higher-order syntax with a well-founded proper-subterm relation and matched and recursive counters. It defines a specialized HORPO fragment and a computability-closure fragment, both admitting the decreasing call, plus general schema calls, guard derivations, sized calls, safe-normal and ramified derivations, resource typing and abstract interpretation. Positive controls accept identity and the decreasing call while reversed, equal-index and duplicating rules are rejected, and finite rewriting is separated from an infinite loop in a final bundle.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: The displayed decreasing recursive call is admitted by HORPO, computability closure, guard, sized and resource typings, while the reversed or equal-index call and the payload-duplicating rule are rejected and finite reductions are separated from an infinite loop.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: The displayed decreasing recursive call is admitted by HORPO, computability closure, guard, sized and resource methods while duplicating and nondecreasing variants are rejected.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file defines evidence carriers for hypothesis necessity with four row classes. Barrier rows use deleted-premise countermodels and retained-premise refutations, including law-free, universal and covered variants without a removable premise. Escape rows use feature lenses and accepted-to-rejected change controls, while rows with no applicable hypothesis use a laws-determine-verdict reason that rules out any feature control.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: none
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Necessity evidence is classified into deleted premise, law-free and universal and covered barriers, defining-feature change, or no applicable hypothesis.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file proves datatype-independent arithmetic for wrapper costs and recursor increments, including Nat and ordered-group orientation equivalences and accumulation of one-step margins across iterates via linear and affine geometric sums. A general no-go shows bounded increments conflict with unbounded attained costs for uniform orientation. Explicit controls separate truncated Nat subtraction from integer differences and separate bounded-cost, coupled-increment and collapsed-payload cases.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: A payload-independent increment bound is incompatible with unbounded attained wrapper costs for uniform orientation, while wrapper orientation is exactly the comparison of wrapper cost against the recursor increment.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Uniform orientation fails under bounded increments with unbounded costs, while one-step margins accumulate linearly and affinely and Nat subtraction needs an integer lift.
assumptions: AddCommGroup α, LinearOrder α and IsOrderedAddMonoid α for the ordered-group version

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If W s y equals y plus C s then wrapper orientation holds iff R plus C s is less than R at U n.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Over an ordered additive group with the same additive wrapper hypothesis, orientation holds iff C s is less than the difference of recursor values.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the increment is bounded by K on P and costs are unbounded on P then uniform orientation on P does not hold.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file defines generic interpretations of the four free constructors with evaluation and a substitution commutation lemma. It defines strict and weak constructor laws and algebraic orientation of the two root rules. Root orientation plus strict laws is shown to decrease every contextual step and to transfer well-foundedness to reverse contextual rewriting, stably under substitution.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: none
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Root orientation plus strict constructor monotonicity lifts to full contextual decrease and well-foundedness, stably under substitution.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file states a single bridge theorem collecting the confession and distinction license event on the free recursor. It conjoins counter adequacy and payload blindness, deterministic role-channel equalities with entropy deficit and one-bit exchange, and observer sufficiency via kernel refinement with call-counter decrease. The recorded relations are channel equality and shared kernel refinement rather than separate bounds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: The counter projection orients the duplicating step while no payload-reading grammar measure does, and the observers licensing a free-call rank are exactly those refining the call-counter kernel whose rank drops on every call.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Counter orientation, payload-blindness license, rary channel equalities with entropy deficit, observer kernel characterization and call-rank decrease hold together as one license event.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file formalizes four method rows for conditional and constrained rewriting around a conditional recursor and its integer and constrained analogues. It defines conditional rewriting as an inference system with goal stacks and proof trees, 2D dependency pairs with minimal chains, the unraveling U(R), integer rewriting with innermost predefined steps, and logically constrained rewriting with calculation steps. It proves soundness of the 2D removal triple, of unraveling termination via a marked algebra, of the integer conditional reduction pair with a bound, and of the LCTRS value criterion, each with a concrete witness, liveness features, and mutations that break acceptance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Operational termination holds for the conditional recursor while its unconditional specialization diverges, and the looping-condition control has an empty rewrite relation with terminating unconditional form yet is not operationally terminating. Each mutation keeps the algebraic laws but loses strict or bounded decrease, so acceptance fails while the laws hold.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: The four witnesses satisfy their laws and acceptance and thereby establish operational termination or innermost termination for the conditional recursor, its unraveling, the integer recursor, and the constrained recursor, while the mutations show the strictness and bound conditions are necessary.
assumptions: DecidableEq nu for the 2D, unraveling, integer and LCTRS development
classical reasoning used in the proof of wf_iChain_of_processor

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A CTRS R is operationally terminating if for all terms s and t the proof goal s to t has only finite well-formed leftmost proof-tree expansions.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: R is deterministic if for every rule in R and every split of its conditions into pre plus s to t plus post, each variable of s occurs in the left-hand side or in the right side of some earlier condition in pre.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsConditionalConstrained.CType3
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: R has type 3 if for every rule in R each variable of the right-hand side occurs in the left-hand side or in the right side of some condition.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsConditionalConstrained.Pair2D
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Pair2D R c d holds if for some rule rho in R and substitution sigma with c equal to sigma applied to the left-hand side, either all conditions hold and d is a defined call from the right-hand side, or for some condition s to t with earlier conditions holding d is a defined call from s.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsConditionalConstrained.MinChain2D
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: MinChain2D R c d holds if both calls have operationally terminating arguments and c.2 reaches some xs by argument rewriting below which Pair2D holds for the call with head c.1 and args xs to d.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsConditionalConstrained.CondAlgebra
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A CondAlgebra packages a base interpretation over Nat, an argument filtering for marked symbols, and a marked interpretation on kept arguments.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsConditionalConstrained.operationallyTerminating_of_2D
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If R needs DecidableEq on variables and R is deterministic and type-3 and the minimal 2D chain relation is well-founded, then R is operationally terminating.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsConditionalConstrained.wf_minChain2D_of_algebra
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If base and marked are monotone, every rule is weak when its conditions are algebraically weak, and every horizontal and vertical pair is strictly decreasing when its relevant conditions hold algebraically, then the minimal 2D chain relation is well-founded.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every CondAlgebra M, if the 2D laws and acceptance for the conditional recursor hold then the conditional recursor is operationally terminating.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file formalises seven dependency-pair processor rows for the free recursor. It defines linear interpretations on calls, weak and strict decrease conditions, reduction pairs and triples, argument filterings, neutral processors, processor sequences, and size-change graphs from dependency pairs. Each row proves a soundness theorem that lawful accepting data imply termination, exhibits a concrete witness, and exhibits mutations where blinding, retaining, erasing or deleting break laws, acceptance or termination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Termination holds when the counter is observed with zero payload coefficient under weak rules and strict pairs; retaining the payload breaks the weak rules and blinding the counter breaks strictness. A self-loop keeps the variable condition but fails the size-change criterion and does not terminate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Seven dependency-pair processor rows each certify termination of the free recursor with an explicit witness, and each is shown tight by mutations that break laws, acceptance or termination.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.FreeTerminates
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Every term t : FTerm is strongly normalising under the free recursor system freeRecursorTRS.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.RulesWeak
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For linear data L and a rewrite system R, every rule of R under every substitution satisfies that linEval of the instantiated right-hand side is at most linEval of the instantiated left-hand side.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.PairsStrict
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For linear data L and a system R, every dependency-pair instance from a left-hand-side application to a subterm application of a defined symbol strictly decreases markedEval.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.linearPair
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given L and R with proofs of RulesWeak and PairsStrict, the call reduction pair with weak as markedEval nonincrease and strict as markedEval strict decrease is well-founded via Nat.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.linear_terminating
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If every rule of R satisfies the variable condition vars rhs subset vars lhs, RulesWeak L R holds and PairsStrict L R holds, then every term is strongly normalising under R.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.counterLinear
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Linear data with constants 1 for zero, succ and recur and 0 for wrap, with selected coefficients for succ, wrap and recur, whose marked call reads the counter position 2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.retainLinear_not_rulesWeak
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: RulesWeak fails for retainLinear on freeRecursorTRS, which retains the payload with wrap coefficient 1, witnessed by the successor rule under a succ-iterated substitution.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.blindLinear_not_pairsStrict
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: PairsStrict fails for blindLinear on freeRecursorTRS, which sets all marked-call coefficients to 0, witnessed by the successor dependency pair under the identity substitution.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpSubtermCriterion_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Hirokawa and Middledorp (Dependency pairs revisited, RTA 2004)
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every projection pi, if pi selects an argument below arity for each defined symbol and every dependency pair strictly decreases the projected argument in the subterm order, then FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpSubtermCriterionWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The witness projection freeProj satisfies dpSubtermCriterionResult, so it accepts and FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpSubtermCriterion_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The payload projection satisfies the laws but does not accept, because the payload of the recursive call equals the payload of the source, so no proper subterm decrease occurs.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpReductionPairProcessor_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Arts and Giesl (Termination of term rewriting using dependency pairs, TCS 236, 2000) with reduction pairs (Kusakari, Nakamura and Toyama 1999)
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every linear interpretation L, if RulesWeak L freeRecursorTRS holds and PairsStrict L freeRecursorTRS holds, then FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpReductionPairProcessorWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: CounterLinear as witness satisfies dpReductionPairProcessorResult, so it accepts and FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpReductionPairProcessor_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: BlindLinear satisfies the laws but not acceptance, and retainLinear does not satisfy the laws.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpArgumentFiltering_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every filtering pi, if every kept position is below arity and the filtered linear data weakly orients rules and strictly orients pairs, then FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpArgumentFilteringWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The filtering keeping base and counter of recur, recursive argument of wrap and argument of succ satisfies dpArgumentFilteringResult, so it accepts and FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpArgumentFiltering_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Counter-only filtering satisfies laws but not acceptance because the weak zero rule fails, and base-only filtering satisfies laws but not acceptance because the pair rank no longer decreases.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpNeutralProcessors_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Giesl, Thiemann and Schneider-Kamp (The dependency pair framework, LPAR 2004)
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every processor M, if M preserves problem edges in both directions and its output on dpPairs freeRecursorTRS is finite, then FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpNeutralProcessorsWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The identity processor satisfies dpNeutralProcessorsResult, since its output is the finite dependency-pair problem and FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpNeutralProcessors_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Delete-all processor is not neutral though its output is finite, and the same deletion on the self-loop problem certifies the empty problem while selfLoop is not finite.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.linearTriple
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given L, R and RulesWeak, the call reduction triple whose rule-weak keeps the call symbol with markedEval nonincrease, pair-weak is markedEval nonincrease, and pair-strict is markedEval strict decrease.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpReductionTriples_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Kop and van Raamsdonk, Dynamic dependency pairs for algebraic functional systems, LMCS 2012
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every L, if RulesWeak and PairsStrict hold on freeRecursorTRS, then FreeTerminates holds via triple finiteness.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpReductionTriplesWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: CounterLinear as witness satisfies dpReductionTriplesResult, so it accepts and FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpReductionTriples_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: BlindLinear satisfies triple laws but not triple acceptance.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpProcessorClassification_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every processor sequence ks, if chain conditions hold on successive intermediate problems and the final output has no edge, then FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpProcessorClassificationWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The sequence [neutral, pair counterLinear] satisfies dpProcessorClassificationResult, so it leaves no edge and FreeTerminates holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.dpProcessorClassification_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The sequence with retainLinear in the second processor breaks laws on the intermediate problem, while the blindLinear sequence satisfies laws but leaves every edge.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.sizeChangeTerminationEscape_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Lee, Jones and Ben-Amram (The size-change principle for program termination, POPL 2001), for term rewriting through dependency pairs (Thiemann and Giesl, AAECC 16, 2005)
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every system R, if the variable condition holds for all rules and every idempotent graph of the composition closure from a symbol to itself has a strict self-arc, then every term is SN under R.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.sizeChangeTerminationEscapeWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: FreeRecursorTRS as witness satisfies sizeChangeTerminationEscapeResult, so the criterion holds and every term is SN.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsDependencyPairs.sizeChangeTerminationEscape_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Self-loop recursor satisfies the variable condition but fails the SCT criterion and the zero-instantiated recur term is not SN.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file formalises three graph-calculi method rows for the free recursor translated to graph rewriting. It defines hypergraphs, type graphs, weight algebras, graph weights as minima over typings, and sharing-aware assignments with read-back to closed terms. Each row proves soundness for termination or a reachable size bound, gives a two-node witness separating sharing the one-node flower cannot, and shows mutations and scope limits where zero weights, arbitrary gluing or weak inequalities alone fail.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Two type nodes distinguish sharing patterns that the one-node flower and tree symbol lists conflate, while zero or constant weights lose positivity or strict decrease. Quasi-interpretations yield a reachable size bound but not termination without a paired reduction order, and arbitrary gluing without multiplicative weight laws does not preserve termination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Weighted, generalized weighted and sharing-aware rows certify the free recursor graph translation with explicit two-node witnesses, while zero and constant weights, unglued contexts and unpaired quasi-interpretations are shown insufficient for termination.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.Hypergraph
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A hypergraph has a node count and a list of hyperedges, each giving a free-signature symbol with one attached node per argument position and a result node.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.TypeGraph
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A weighted type graph has at least two nodes and assigns a natural-number weight to every symbol occurrence pattern from argument types and result type.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.WeightAlgebra
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A weight algebra is a totally ordered commutative semiring with monotone addition and multiplication, strongly ordered addition, and well-founded strict order.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.arithWeight
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The natural numbers with usual order, addition and multiplication form a weight algebra.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.graphWeight
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The weight of a hypergraph is the minimum over all typings into the type graph of the summed edge weights.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.graphWeight_sum
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every type graph T and hypergraphs C and H, the weight of the disjoint sum equals the sum of the weights.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscapeLaws
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Bruggink, König, Nolte and Zantema, "Termination of Graph Rewriting Systems using Weighted Type Graphs over Semirings", ICGT 2015, Definition 6 (weighted type graph) with Definition 5 (ordered semiring)
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A system is lawful if every step is a listed rule applied in a disjoint-sum context, every flower weight is positive, and every closed term symbol graph reads back.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscapeAccepts
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Every listed rule is strictly decreasing: for every left typing there is a right typing with smaller summed edge weight.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscape_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Bruggink, König, Nolte and Zantema, "Termination of Graph Rewriting Systems using Weighted Type Graphs over Semirings", ICGT 2015, Definition 6 (weighted type graph) with Definition 5 (ordered semiring)
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every system M, if laws and acceptance hold then the step relation is well-founded and every step strictly decreases graph weight.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscapeWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The two-rule free-recursor graph system with the two-node type graph satisfies Result, so it accepts, terminates and decreases.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscapeWitness_feature
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The witness accepts, two hypergraphs share symbol lists but have weights 0 versus 3, and the tree encoding reads back zero.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscape_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Replacing edge weights by zero breaks laws because flower positivity fails at zero.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscape_scope_proven
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If strict rules strictly decrease and weak rules weakly decrease for every typing, then the union terminates exactly when the weak part terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.generalizedWeightedTypeGraphsLaws
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Bruggink, König, Nolte and Zantema, ICGT 2015, Definition 5 (ordered semiring, strongly ordered addition), Definition 6 (weighted type graph over the semiring), Definition 9 (strongly decreasing rule) and Lemma 4
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Lawful if steps are root rule applications, graph weight is the minimum of tensor edge products, every edge weight preserves strict inequality under tensor, and read-back contains every term symbol list.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.generalizedWeightedTypeGraphs_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Bruggink, König, Nolte and Zantema, ICGT 2015, Definition 5 (ordered semiring, strongly ordered addition), Definition 6 (weighted type graph over the semiring), Definition 9 (strongly decreasing rule) and Lemma 4
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If laws and strong acceptance hold, where every left typing has a right typing with strictly smaller tensor product, then steps terminate and every step lowers graph weight.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.generalizedWeightedTypeGraphsWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Two root free-recursor rules with arithmetic minimum aggregation satisfy Result.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.constantGTypeGraph_rejected
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The constant unit-weight graph does not satisfy acceptance because the successor rule sides have equal products.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.generalizedWeightedTypeGraphs_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Zeroing all edge weights breaks laws because zero does not preserve strict inequality.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.generalizedWeightedTypeGraphs_scope_proven
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If minima, strict preservation, multiplicative gluing and context strictness hold and rules are strongly accepted, then all glued rule applications terminate.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.generalizedWeightedTypeGraphs_unglued_extension_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that rule-local decreases alone imply termination for arbitrary gluing, witnessed by a one-to-zero-node rule with constant gluing identifying both sides.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.quasiInterpretationsSharingAwareLaws
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Bonfante, Marion and Moyen, "Quasi-interpretations a way to control resources", Theoretical Computer Science 412 (2011), Definition 3 and Proposition 4
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Lawful if leaf is bounded below, node dominates the sum plus one, sharing dominates, sharing contraction is an execution, and read-back size is dominated by eval.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.quasiInterpretationsSharingAware_sound
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Bonfante, Marion and Moyen, "Quasi-interpretations a way to control resources", Theoretical Computer Science 412 (2011), Definition 3 and Proposition 4
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If laws and weak decrease on execution hold, then acceptance holds and every reachable value read-back size is bounded by the initial eval.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.quasiInterpretationsSharingAwareWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Read-back size plus sharing count with sharing contraction satisfies Result with acceptance and reachable bound.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.quasiInterpretationsSharingAwareWitness_feature
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The witness accepts, two distinct sharing graphs share read-back but differ in cost, and no assignment strictly decreases on stutter, so the method yields a bound and not termination.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.quasiInterpretationsSharingAware_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Constant-zero assignment breaks laws because the leaf size bound fails.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.quasiInterpretationsSharingAware_scope_proven
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If laws, acceptance and a compatible well-founded reduction order covering execution hold, then both the reachable bound and termination of execution hold.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.quasiInterpretationsSharingAware_unpaired_termination_false
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that laws plus acceptance alone imply termination, witnessed by a lawful loop with a stutter edge.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsGraphCalculi.weightedTypeGraphEscape_methodIdentity

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: The file formalizes fifteen method rows for orientation of the free duplicating rule recur b s (succ n) to wrap s (recur b s n). It defines rule orientation, free-termination certification, bridges to P3 barrier cells, and for each method its data, admissibility laws, acceptance and barrier or escape verdict. It proves universal barriers for linear, matrix, triangular, arctic, tropical, affine-tuple and finite members and exhibits coupled witnesses for negative-coefficient, max, higher-degree, multilinear, tuple and monotone-algebra methods, each with mutation and signature-lifting controls.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Lawful linear, matrix, triangular, arctic, tropical and finite members lie on the barrier side and cannot orient the free duplicating rule, while coupled nonlinear, max, multilinear, tuple and monotone-algebra witnesses lie on the escape side and do orient it. Each barrier is a P3 barrier cell and each escape carries a P3.1 coupling with unbounded counter gain.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: The file establishes the fifteen-row classification in which lawful linear, matrix, arctic, tropical and finite members are barred from orienting the duplicating rule while the exhibited coupled witnesses orient it and certify termination, with each verdict lifting to arbitrary signatures.
assumptions: Main theorems assume StrictContextLaws, RootRuleOrients and WellFounded lt where stated
Preorder and Add typeclasses for the ordered barrier cell; Zero One LT LE Add Mul for linear coefficients
Fintype finite carrier with irreflexive transitive strict order for finite models
open Classical in belowCount; noncomputable definitions for real witnesses such as linearPolyRWitness and matrixQRScalarProjectionWitness
No sorry, axiom or native_decide visible in the code

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.DupOrientedOn
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any domain predicate D, interpretation I and relation lt, DupOrientedOn D I lt holds when every assignment of the three rule variables with values satisfying D makes the interpreted right side strictly below the interpreted left side in lt.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.CertifiesFreeTermination
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For interpretation I and relation lt, CertifiesFreeTermination I lt means the interpretation strictly decreases along every contextual step under every valuation and the reversed contextual relation is well-founded for every variable type.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.certifiesFreeTermination_of_laws

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.not_dupOriented_of_barrierCell
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If M strictly decreases along lt and, for the schema valueSchema I at base b and counter n, both WrapUnboundedAt and GainBoundedAt hold for M, then DupOriented I lt is false.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.nat_signature_termination
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If a natural-number interpretation satisfies StrictContextLaws for < and orients both root rules, then for any first-order signature and variable type the reversed signature contextual relation is well-founded.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.linearPolyR_universal

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.negativeCoefficientPolynomial_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If M satisfies negativeCoefficientPolynomialLaws and negativeCoefficientPolynomialAccepts, meaning both root rules are oriented for < on Nat, then M certifies free termination for < on Nat.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.negativeCoefficientPolynomialWitness_result

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsInterpretations.maxPolynomial_maxPlus_barrier

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file defines a shared first-order KBO core with weighted evaluation, variable counts, lexicographic and Huet-Oppen multiset clauses, and proves it a reduction order on well-formed terms. It also defines the generalized KBO over weakly monotone strictly simple algebras with the same reduction-order properties. It instantiates eight method rows over the free recursor schema and proves barriers for standard, subterm-coefficient, status, transfinite, lambda-free and AC variants while the generalized and polynomial witnesses orient both free rules and yield termination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Standard, subterm-coefficient, status, transfinite, lambda-free and AC KBO variants cannot orient the payload-duplicating recursor rule because the coefficient-weighted variable condition fails on some instance. Generalized and polynomial KBOs with suitably coupled monotone interpretations can orient both free rules and thereby prove termination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: The shared first-order and generalized KBO cores are reduction orders, six KBO variants are uniformly barred from the duplicating rule by the variable condition, and generalized and polynomial KBOs escape the barrier and terminate the free recursor.
assumptions: AddCommMonoid, LinearOrder and IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid on weight carriers
DecidableEq on symbols and variables where the order needs it
WellFoundedLT on weights for well-foundedness of KR and GKR
classical tactic for multiset filtering; no sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file formalizes nine method rows for the free recursor and free schema: semantic, root, self-labelling and quasi-decreasingness over first-order terms, and match-bound, raise-consistency, left-linear, predictive-labelling and forward-closure rows over raised terms. It defines algebras, labelled terms, flat-context closure, quotient and root algebras, conditional rewriting with quasi-decreasing orders, and raised height certificates. It proves soundness and transfer theorems showing the labelling, raise-consistency, predictive and quasi-decreasingness witnesses terminate the free systems. It proves universal barrier theorems showing no linear match-bound, left-linear or right-linear forward-closure certificate can certify the duplicating system, including a terminating conditional system that is not quasi-decreasing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Labelling, raise-consistency, predictive and quasi-decreasing witnesses prove termination (escape) while linear match-bound, left-linear and right-linear forward-closure certificates cannot (barrier). The duplicating free system has single-exponential complexity that excludes every linear raised height and every label-indexed linear root base, and conditional termination does not imply quasi-decreasingness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Semantic, root, self and predictive labelling with raise-consistency and quasi-decreasingness certify termination of the free recursor and schema, while no linear match-bound, left-linear or right-linear forward-closure certificate can certify the duplicating system and conditional termination does not imply quasi-decreasingness.
assumptions: noncomputable quotient algebra construction using classical choice for quotAlg and selfLab via Quotient.out
Fintype state type for MatchAutomaton
DecidableEq on RaisedTerm and CSym for concrete witnesses

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.IsModel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An algebra I is a model of a rule set P when evaluations of the two sides of every rule in P agree under every valuation.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.lab_lift_model
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If I is a model of P then for every valuation every P-step from s to t lifts to a labelled step from the labelling of s to the labelling of t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.sn_of_model_labelling
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Zantema, Fundamenta Informaticae 24, 1995, model version, as restated in Hirokawa-Middeldorp, RTA 2006, Theorem 2, soundness direction
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If I models the rules of R, J is strictly monotone in every argument, and J strictly decreases on every labelled rule instance for all valuations, then every term is strongly normalizing for R.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.semanticLabeling_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every semantic-labelling data M, if M satisfies the model plus coefficient-positivity laws and orients all labelled instances of freeRecursorTRS then the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.semanticLabelingWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The counter-model with counter labelling and linear base satisfies acceptance and therefore the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.semanticLabeling_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Replacing the counter labelling by the constant-zero labelling preserves the laws but acceptance fails.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.sn_of_rootLabelling
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If J is strictly monotone in every argument and strictly decreases on every root-labelled instance of the flat-context closure fcRules R for all valuations, then R terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.rootLabeling_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every root-labelling base J, if J satisfies strict monotonicity laws and orients every root-labelled instance of the flat-context closure of the free recursor then the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.rootLabelingWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The label-blind coupled-polynomial base satisfies acceptance and therefore the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.rootLabeling_linear_barrier
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under the hypothesis that all coefficients satisfy 1 <= coef g i, no label-indexed linear base linAlg c0 coef satisfies root-labelling acceptance.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.selfLabelingEquational_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every self-labelling data D, if every free-recursor rule is an E-consequence and the class-indexed base orients all self-labelled instances for all valuations then the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.selfLabelingEquationalWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The equational theory freeEqs with wrapper-count reading satisfies acceptance and therefore the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.selfLabelingEquational_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: With the empty equational theory the equational laws fail for the free recursor.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.quasiDecreasingness_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every order gt, if gt satisfies well-foundedness plus closure laws and contains the conditional steps plus condition premises of the free recursor then the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.quasiDecreasingnessWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The coupled-polynomial order satisfies acceptance and therefore the free recursor terminates.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.loopCTRS_not_quasiDecreasing
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The single-rule conditional system with rule f(x) to x under condition f(x) approx c is not quasi-decreasing although its rewrite relation is empty and terminating.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsLabelingBounds.quasiDecreasingness_mutation

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.summary: This file implements two orientation-closure method rows for other calculi. The first formalizes infinitary rewriting with depth truncations, coherent infinite-term presentations, a duplicating stage family converging to an infinite wrap tower, and a soundness theorem from unbounded certified depths to convergence. The second formalizes native higher-order cost-size tuple interpretations with a coupled iterator cost, proves strict cost decrease for the free rules and contexts, and supplies a unit-coefficient witness proving termination of free contextual rewriting.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.boundary: Finite free terms are well founded for contextual rewriting, while the infinitary extension admits an infinite strongly convergent duplicating reduction to the infinite tower, so convergence does not imply normalization. The file records as scope that step conditions alone without an unbounded depth schedule do not force convergence, and the general infinitary termination theorem is not claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/OrientationClos.conclusion: Finite contextual rewriting terminates while the infinitary duplicator admits a strongly convergent infinite reduction, and the coupled higher-order tuple witness proves termination of the free contextual relation at every variable type.
assumptions: infinitaryRewritingTerminationLaws M and infinitaryRewritingTerminationAccepts M for the infinitary soundness theorem
higherOrderTupleInterpretationLaws M and higherOrderTupleInterpretationAccepts M for the tuple-interpretation soundness theorem
no axiom, sorry, native_decide or explicit classical choice in the file; Mathlib only

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.InfinitaryTerm
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An infinitary term is a family trunks k of one-hole skeletons with trunks 0 = var 0 and coherence truncAt k (trunks (k+1)) = trunks k for all k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.omegaTower
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: omegaTower is the infinitary term whose k-th trunk is wrapIter k (var 0), with coherence from truncation of towers.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.dupStage
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: dupStage n is the infinitary term whose k-th trunk is truncAt k applied to wrapIter n of recur (var 0) (var 0) (succIter k (var 0)).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.InfDupStepAt
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: InfDupStepAt d t u holds when below depth d both presentations are towers, and above d they are the trunk presentation of recur b s (succ n) and of its contractum wrap s (recur b s n) at certified depth d.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.ConvergesTo
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A sequence u converges to L when for every k there exists N such that for all n >= N, (u n).trunks k = L.trunks k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTerminationData
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Data consists of stage presentations stages, certified redex depths depths, and a source infinitary term.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTerminationLaws
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Kennaway, Klop, Sleep, de Vries, "Transfinite reductions in orthogonal term rewriting systems", Information and Computation 119(1), 1995, Definitions 2.1-2.6 (infinitary terms, reduction sequences, convergence)
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Laws hold when stages 0 equals source, every step n is InfDupStepAt (depths n) from stages n to stages (n+1), and depths are unbounded in the sense that for every d there is N with d <= depths n for all n >= N.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTerminationAccepts
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Acceptance holds when for every n, InfDupStepAt (depths n) relates stages n to stages (n+1).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTerminationResult
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Result holds when acceptance holds and the stages converge to omegaTower; the verdict is fragment escape.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTermination_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all M, if infinitaryRewritingTerminationLaws M holds and infinitaryRewritingTerminationAccepts M holds, then infinitaryRewritingTerminationResult M holds; strong convergence of certified depths yields convergence to the tower.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTerminationWitness
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The witness has stages dupStage, depths fun n => n, and source dupStage 0.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTerminationWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The witness satisfies infinitaryRewritingTerminationResult, by soundness applied to its laws and acceptance.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTermination_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Shifting the witness stages to fun n => dupStage (n+1) while keeping the anchored source violates the laws, because dupStage 0 differs from dupStage 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.InfDupStep
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: InfDupStep t u holds when there exists a finite certified depth d with InfDupStepAt d t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infDupStep_not_wellFounded
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The unindexed infinitary duplicator relation is not well founded, witnessed by the infinite dupStage reduction.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.infinitaryRewritingTermination_methodIdentity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Finite free contextual rewriting is well founded, the witness satisfies the infinitary result, and the infinitary duplicator is not well founded.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretationData
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Kop and Vale, "Tuple interpretations for higher-order complexity", FSCD 2021, LIPIcs 195, article 31, Definition 8 and Theorem 3.2
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Data are native cost coefficients costBase, costSuccBias, costSuccScale, costAppLeft, costAppRight, costIterBase, costIterStep, costIterCounter and costIterCouple.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.hotiFreeCost
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The free cost assigns 0 to variables, costBase to zero, bias plus scale times cost to succ, weighted sum to wrap, and base plus step plus counter plus coupling times step-counter product to recur.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretationLaws
keyDeclarations.paper_reference: Kop and Vale, "Tuple interpretations for higher-order complexity", FSCD 2021, LIPIcs 195, article 31, Definition 8
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Laws require 1 <= costBase, 1 <= costSuccBias, costSuccScale = 1, costAppLeft = 1, costAppRight = 1, and 1 <= costIterBase, costIterStep, costIterCounter, costIterCouple.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretationAccepts
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Acceptance holds when for every result type A, variable type mu and free terms, the native cost of toA A b is less than that of toA A (recur b s zero) and the cost of toA A (wrap s (recur b s n)) is less than that of toA A (recur b s (succ n)).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretationResult
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Result holds when acceptance holds and for every variable type mu the free contextual relation ContextStep is well founded; the verdict is escape.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretation_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all M, if higherOrderTupleInterpretationLaws M and higherOrderTupleInterpretationAccepts M hold, then higherOrderTupleInterpretationResult M holds via strict free-cost decrease into Nat.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretationWitness
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The witness sets all nine cost coefficients to 1, including unit coupling.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretationWitness_result
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The unit-coefficient witness satisfies higherOrderTupleInterpretationResult.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretation_mutation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Setting costIterCouple to 0 in the witness violates higherOrderTupleInterpretationLaws.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretation_scope
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Scope states that for all admissible accepted M, all types A and variable types mu, every free ContextStep maps under toA to a typed rewrite step with strict hotiCost decrease, and the free source relation is well founded.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretation_scope_proven
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: higherOrderTupleInterpretation_scope holds, with the typed step from toA_contextStep and cost decrease from hotiFreeCost_contextStep_lt plus termination from soundness.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.CostSizeTupleCertificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A cost-size certificate for a relation R assigns to each element a pair of Nats such that R x y implies the tuple of y is lexicographically less than the tuple of x.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.CostSizeTupleCertificate.wellFounded
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every type and relation, any CostSizeTupleCertificate yields well-foundedness of the relation via the lexicographic product of Nat.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Methods.OrientationClosure.MethodRowsOtherCalculi.higherOrderTupleInterpretation_methodIdentity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Every cost-size certificate proves termination, the witness certificate gives well-foundedness of free ContextStep for every variable type, and higherOrderTupleInterpretation_scope holds.
