OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/SemanticStructu.summary: This file defines carriers for twelve semantic and structural rows, including extended monotone algebras, finite-model interpretations, linear-complexity certificates, three match-bound variants, four labelling policies with erasure, deterministic graph transports, relational categories, forward closures and quasi-decreasingness. It proves no finite carrier admits a strictly wrapper-increasing interpretation and no linear derivational-complexity certificate exists for KO7 by an exponential lower family, so match-bound certificates are empty. It proves every erasure-factored variable-condition comparator refuses labelled duplication while a constructor-sensitive root-label order orients it, is well-founded and transitive but not successor-context compatible. It proves deterministic graph transport is impossible by the equality fork while a terminating relational category containing that fork exists, and it records forward-closure right-linearity failure and quasi-decreasingness equivalence to strong normalization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/SemanticStructu.boundary: Erasure-factored variable-condition orders remain blocked on labelled duplication while a label-sensitive root order orients it, and finite carriers cannot host unbounded wrapper-doubling ranks while KO7 has an exponential lower family defeating every linear certificate. Deterministic graph transport is impossible by the equality fork while a terminating relational category containing that fork exists.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/SemanticStructu.conclusion: Finite strictly wrapper-increasing interpretations and linear-complexity hence match-bound certificates are impossible for KO7, erasure-factored labelling stays blocked while a label-sensitive order escapes, and deterministic graph semantics is impossible although a terminating relational category containing the fork exists.
assumptions: Finite-model rows assume Fintype carriers
Match-bound transport relies on the external linear-complexity theorem for match-bounded systems attributed to Geser Hofbauer and Waldmann
Labelling orientation claims assume well-foundedness and transitivity fields where stated

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/SubstrateChange.summary: This file defines the substrate-change predicates and seven escaping rows where the certificate lives on a new carrier with noninjective read-back, including shared term graphs, a merge-commutativity quotient, quasi-interpretations paired with a path order, and weighted type-graph, process and continuation carriers. It proves noninjective read-back alone with a Bool self-loop does not certify termination, while forward simulation into a well-founded target does. It proves the shared size orients duplication without factoring through read-back, merge commutativity identifies two distinct root-normal forms, quasi-interpretation axioms alone force no strict descent, and each graph, process and CPS lift exactly reflects KO7 root steps, decreases a rank, terminates and contains a foreign source outside the encoded image.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/SubstrateChange.boundary: Tree measures that fail the copy budget succeed on the shared graph where two occurrences are one node, but the shared size does not factor through read-back. Noninjective read-back alone certifies nothing, whereas certified forward simulation into a well-founded target does, and each graph, process and CPS lift is exact on the KO7 image yet contains native steps outside it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/SubstrateChange.conclusion: Sharing, equational quotient and paired quasi-interpretation plus path order escape on new substrates, and the graph, process and continuation carriers each exactly reflect KO7 root steps, terminate by a decreasing rank, and strictly extend the encoded image.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/UnarySignatureI.summary: This file defines unary signatures, arity-preserving embeddings and maps, direct arity-preserving encodability, and the KO7 function symbols with their arities. It proves KO7 is not unary because merge has arity two and recDelta has arity three, and that no arity-preserving map or injective direct encoding exists from KO7 into any unary target signature. It concludes the direct unary-signature preconditions for cycle rewriting and string rewriting fail on KO7, without ruling out encodings that change arity or add auxiliary structure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/UnarySignatureI.boundary: Direct arity-preserving maps preserve the unary property with all arities at most one, which holds for unary targets but fails for KO7 because merge has arity two and recDelta has arity three. The obstruction covers only arity-preserving encodings and does not rule out arity-changing encodings.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Methods/UnarySignatureI.conclusion: KO7 is not unary and admits no arity-preserving map or injective direct encoding into any unary signature, so the direct unary preconditions for cycle and string rewriting fail.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Mu3c_Image_LowerBound.l.summary: This file builds descending multiset towers and root-side and flagged trace towers witnessing large mu3c values. It computes their weights, payloads, tau and delta flags and their ordinal embeddings. It proves polynomial omega-power lower bounds inside the delta 0 and delta 1 blocks with matching block caps, giving existential cofinal families for both blocks.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Mu3c_Image_LowerBound.l.boundary: Realized mu3c values climb past every omega power below omega^omega in block 0 and past omega^omega plus every such power in block 1, while staying below omega^omega and omega^omega times 2 respectively.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Mu3c_Image_LowerBound.l.conclusion: Both mu3c blocks contain cofinal realized families below their respective caps.
assumptions: No sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice in the code.
Lower bounds use Mathlib ordinal arithmetic including omega powers and multiset embeddings.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MultilinearBarrier.lean.summary: This file specializes the bounded multilinear barrier to KO7 root orientation. Unbounded range with base-point dominance blocks global orientation. Positive successor drift or wrap drift each supply the needed pump under the same dominance hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MultilinearBarrier.lean.boundary: A bounded multilinear measure whose frozen pumped-step coefficient stays dominated by wrapper gain at the base cannot orient KO7 steps.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MultilinearBarrier.lean.conclusion: Pumped bounded-multilinear measures satisfying base dominance cannot globally orient KO7.
assumptions: No sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice in the code.
Unbounded version assumes unbounded multilinear range and base-point dominance; pump versions assume positive succ or wrap drift plus dominance.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MultilinearBarrier_Sche.summary: This file extends the scalar barrier to finite multilinear recursors where each variable occurs at most once per monomial. After freezing base, the table becomes affine in the pumped step with a frozen coefficient sum. If wrapper gain dominates that coefficient at the base, unbounded, successor-pumped or wrap-pumped measures cannot orient the duplicating step or its global form.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MultilinearBarrier_Sche.boundary: A finite multilinear recursor whose wrapper gain still dominates the total pumped-step coefficient at the base cannot uniformly orient the duplicating step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MultilinearBarrier_Sche.conclusion: Dominated bounded-multilinear measures with unbounded or pumped range cannot orient the duplicating step.
assumptions: No sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice in the code.
Barrier assumes unbounded range and base-point dominance that wrapper gain dominates the frozen step coefficient.
Pump versions assume positive succ scale and bias or positive wrap drift.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_CallG.summary: This file builds delayed and preserving SCC barrier systems from finite extracted call graphs. From node keys and successor-key sets it constructs the relation-level systems automatically. It reexports additive, affine, transparent and scalar-projection barriers guarded by a found nontrivial SCC pair.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_CallG.boundary: A finite call graph with a nontrivial SCC cannot be globally oriented by additive, affine, transparent or scalar-projected measures once the cycle pump or dominance holds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_CallG.conclusion: Call-graph presentations with a found nontrivial SCC inherit the relational additive, affine and transparent barriers.
assumptions: No sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice in the code.
Each barrier assumes a found nontrivial SCC pair plus the matching measure and pump or dominance hypothesis.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Case..summary: This file implements an alternating two-function duplicating example where each root rule copies the step argument. One root step plus one step under wrap yields three occurrences of the step argument. Uniform additive measures with positive wrapper weight are pumped by wrapper chains and cannot orient the displayed two-step composite.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Case..boundary: The displayed two-step alternating composite with three step occurrences cannot be uniformly oriented by any declared additive measure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Case..conclusion: No uniform additive measure orients the alternating two-step duplicating composite.
assumptions: No sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice in the code.
Uniform additive measures assume positive wrapper weight.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Cycle.summary: This file isolates the delayed-duplication cycle from iterated successors to nested wrappers. It transports affine and compositional measures to the derived one-cycle schema. It rederives additive, affine, transparent-compositional and scalar-projection contextual barriers from that single witness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Cycle.boundary: A delayed-duplication cycle with one or more copies cannot be oriented by additive, affine, transparent-compositional or scalar-projected measures once the corresponding pump or transparency holds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Cycle.conclusion: Any contextual relation realizing the delayed cycle is blocked for additive, affine, transparent and projected measures.
assumptions: No sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice in the code.
Additive cycle needs at least one copy; affine needs positive copies and unbounded derived range.
Compositional cycle needs positive copies and succ transparency at base; scalar projection needs strict projection and unbounded affine lift.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.summary: This file introduces first-class finite nonempty mutual-recursion schemas and systems factored through the k+1-node interface, with cycle source and target operations. It proves additive impossibility for direct orienters and affine impossibility under an unbounded one-cycle pump, plus contextual versions via realized TransGen paths. It bridges the native two-rule schema and system to length-2 cycles and supplies concrete two-rule and three-rule witness systems with realized paths.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.boundary: On a bounded finite cycle of length k+1 with realized cycle path, additive measures always fail to orient and affine measures fail when the derived one-cycle witness is unbounded; without a cycle or unboundedness no barrier is claimed and results do not extend to unbounded arbitrary graphs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.conclusion: Every bounded finite-cycle system realizes its one-cycle path and admits no additive and, under unboundedness, no affine global orientation, with concrete two-rule and three-rule witnesses.

It projects cycle realization and additive and affine barriers, soundness, completeness and missing-edge boundaries for successful searches. It adds no new theorem program and records that certified successor edges suffice while raw algorithmic extraction needs a separate bridge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.boundary: The H3 catalog follows from certified successor-edge data; algorithmic extraction from raw data needs a separate implementation and soundness bridge and is not claimed by the certificate alone.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.conclusion: The validated H3 final catalog, its cycle realization and additive and affine barriers, plus executable soundness, completeness and two- and three-rule witnesses, are exposed under stable API names.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.summary: This file defines explicit finite encoded search spaces with edge lookups and the searchCycle? procedure that checks predetermined successor edges. It proves soundness to graph-search certificates, completeness when all successor edges exist, and an iff characterization of failure by a typed missing-edge status. It instantiates concrete two-rule and three-rule encoded spaces on which search succeeds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.boundary: searchCycle? checks only the predetermined successor edges of the supplied encoded cycle; it succeeds exactly when all are present and otherwise yields a typed missing-edge status, so it is not arbitrary graph discovery.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.conclusion: Executable search over an explicit finite edge space is sound, complete when all successor edges are present, and otherwise reports a typed missing edge, with success on two- and three-rule witnesses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.summary: This file exposes the constructor-side hypothesis for arbitrary finite-cycle mutual recursion as a standalone builder with successor steps at each index. It transports the builder to the first-class finite-cycle schema and system with StepCtx and orientation predicates. It proves per-node cycle realization and additive and unbounded-affine contextual barriers for every builder realization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.boundary: A builder supplying a successor step at every cycle index realizes its finite-cycle path and inherits additive and affine impossibilities; without per-index steps no realization or barrier is claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.conclusion: Every builder instance realizes its finite-cycle path and inherits additive and unbounded-affine contextual barriers.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Finit.summary: This file closes the theorem-visible H3 surface by packaging schema, builder, mapping, graph certificate, algorithmic search, typed missing-edge boundary and two-rule and three-rule instances into one finite closeout catalog. OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Gener.summary: This file defines a bounded two-node alternating duplication schema and system with shared additive and affine profiles and a minimal root-plus-wrapper context. It constructs pump and two-step composite schemas and measure conversions with a wrapper-iteration lower bound. It proves that one full cycle defeats additive direct orienters and, under an unbounded pump, affine direct orienters and hence global contextual orientations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Gener.boundary: Each root rule duplicates once while the full two-node composite exposes two copies; additive measures always fail on the composite and affine measures fail when the two-step pump is unbounded, with no claim beyond those families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Gener.conclusion: One alternating two-step duplicate defeats additive and, under unboundedness, affine orientations of the whole minimal-context relation.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_KNode.summary: This file generalizes bounded two-node delayed duplication to a finite cyclic family of k+1 recursors where one cycle peels k+1 successors and nests k+1 wrappers. It defines additive and affine constructor-local measures and their transport to a one-cycle derived schema. It proves exact cycle realization and deduces that no additive and, under an unbounded pump, no affine measure orients the minimal context closure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_KNode.boundary: Additive measures can never orient the cyclic delayed-duplication composite, and affine measures cannot either when the derived one-cycle schema has unbounded range; this limits additive and affine termination methods on finite cyclic SCCs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_KNode.conclusion: No additive measure and, under an unbounded pump, no affine measure orients the minimal context closure of the finite cyclic delayed-duplication system.
assumptions: Positive wrapper weights 1 ≤ w_wrap, wrap_left, wrap_right
Unbounded pump HasUnboundedRange required only for affine branch

It proves preservation under root steps and context closure, realization of the synchronized cycle, and visible exposure. It derives unconditional additive and affine barriers, retaining the older wrapper-dominance statement as a corollary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.boundary: Payload count is preserved exactly by every step while visible wrapper-carried payload strictly increases on synchronized nonempty inputs, so decreasing additive or affine measures cannot orient the cycle; the affine bound is non-strict and optimal because the zero-like measure equates source and target.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.conclusion: No additive and, unconditionally, no affine measure orients the multiplicity-preserving two-node SCC cycle.

No unbounded pump needed for the unconditional affine barrier; dominance plus pump only for the compatibility corollary

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.summary: Defines finite cyclic preserving SCC syntax with explicit latent packets, a root expose rule, and minimal context closure. Proves payload multiplicity is preserved, visible payload grows over a cycle, and one full cycle is realized as a TransGen path. Proves additive measures increase from source to target so no additive measure orients the cycle globally. Proves a conditional affine no-go under wrapper dominance plus unboundedness and provides an affine escape orienting the cycle, packaging an exact maximality certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.boundary: Additive measures rise from synchronized source to target and cannot orient the cycle downward; affine measures fail only under wrapper dominance with an unbounded pump, and without dominance an affine escape orients, giving an exact maximal boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.conclusion: Additive orientation of the preserving finite cycle is impossible, and affine impossibility holds exactly under wrapper dominance with an escape when it fails.

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.summary: This module adds a packet-transparent extension for finite synchronized-packet preserving SCCs where latent packet constructors are evaluation-transparent bookkeeping. It proves packets collapse to the empty constant, wrapper nesting is strictly monotone, and the synchronized target exceeds the source. It derives compositional, global, scalar-projection and weighted matrix-functional impossibilities from visible wrapper exposure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.boundary: Treating latent packets as evaluation-transparent bookkeeping does not restore orientability because visible wrapper exposure still forces a strict increase, blocking decreasing and projected orders.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Prese.conclusion: No packet-transparent, scalar-projected or weighted matrix-functional measure orients the finite preserving synchronized cycle.
assumptions: Wrap strict subterm property for all arguments
No extra pump needed for transparent branch; weight support for matrix-functional lift

OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Relat.summary: This module defines delayed and packet-preserving presentations over an arbitrary relation R and assembles each into a raw graph or packet system. It introduces global-orientation and additive, affine, compositional and transparent measure abbreviations. Its theorems forward explicit round-trip, finite-reachability, nontrivial-SCC, computable-search, projection and unboundedness or dominance hypotheses to imported cycle and packet barriers, showing no global orientation holds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Relat.boundary: When the underlying relation has a two-sided round-trip or a nontrivial strongly connected component, no additive, affine-unbounded, compositional-transparent or projected measure globally orients the step context; without such cyclicity the barriers do not apply.
OperatorKO7/Meta/MutualDuplication_Relat.conclusion: Every cyclic relation presentation admits no global orientation by the stated additive, affine, compositional-transparent or projected measure classes.
assumptions: Arbitrary relation R over type ι
Fintype, DecidableEq and DecidableRel R for finite, SCC and search variants
Two-sided TransGen or Reachable hypotheses plus unbounded-range, wrapper-dominance, transparency and scalar-projection side conditions where stated

OperatorKO7/Meta/Newman_Safe.lean.summary: This file proves Newman's lemma for the guarded safe relation by Acc recursion, joining stars via root local joins. It packages termination from the computable measure with a local-join hypothesis to obtain confluence. It derives parameterized and unconditional unique-normal-form, normalizer-uniqueness and stability corollaries, plus decidability of reachability to a safe normal form.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Newman_Safe.lean.boundary: Termination plus local joinability yields confluence for the guarded SafeStep fragment; the file claims nothing about confluence or termination for the full kernel Step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Newman_Safe.lean.conclusion: The safe fragment is confluent with unique normal forms and a stable normalizer, and reachability to a safe normal form is decidable.

Termination via wf_SafeStepRev_c and well-founded Acc recursion

It proves every relation satisfies a dichotomy between a licensed non-W0 escape and absence of a direct W0 method, packaged as an exact boundary.

OperatorKO7/Meta/NonlinearMethodLawCarri.conclusion: Every nonlinear relation is classified as either having the licensed W1 escape or having no direct first-order method in the carrier.
assumptions: Carrier fixes relation to Step, so off-Step classification is by emptiness

OperatorKO7/Meta/NonlinearUnconstrainedE.summary: This module states an exact unconstrained law of wrapper argument retention plus bounded counter gain and proves it blocks the duplicating step without linearity or range hypotheses. It shows every additive measure satisfies the law and proves both clauses load-bearing via botRightWeight and cross-coupled escapes. It compiles the carrier dichotomy off Step as vacuous emptiness and notes the bounded tropical escape.
OperatorKO7/Meta/NonlinearUnconstrainedE.boundary: Natural-valued interpretations whose wrapper keeps both arguments at fixed cost and whose counter advances at most fixed gain cannot orient the duplicating step, while dropping either clause admits the botRightWeight and cross-coupled escapes; the carrier dichotomy off Step is vacuous emptiness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/NonlinearUnconstrainedE.conclusion: The exact wrapper-retention plus bounded-counter-gain law blocks the duplicating step with both clauses load-bearing.
assumptions: No linearity, compositionality, matrix shape or range hypothesis for the exact law
Classical reasoning is not needed; Mathlib only

OperatorKO7/Meta/Normalize_Safe.lean.conclusion: Every trace safely normalizes to a unique safe normal form via a computable certified normalizer.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ObjectAxiom_Ablation.le.summary: Extends KO7 by one directed collapse rule app t t to t and packages it as a step-duplicating system that still contains the rec_succ duplicating step. Shows the added rule strictly decreases simple additive size and the nonlinear witness W, so every extended step decreases W and the extended root relation is terminating. Proves the additive, transparent-compositional and unbounded-affine global orientation barriers persist unchanged on the extended system.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ObjectAxiom_Ablation.le.boundary: The added collapse rule itself is orientable by simple size and by W, yet global orientation by additive, transparent-compositional or unbounded-affine measures remains impossible because the duplicating rec_succ step survives unchanged.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ObjectAxiom_Ablation.le.conclusion: The directed first-order collapse surrogate is harmless for termination but does not dissolve any of the existing global barrier classes.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalIncompletene.summary: Defines certified-forgetting witnesses that orient the duplicating step while violating wrapper sensitivity on both payload coordinates, with dependency-pair and confession-method constructions. Defines a narrow payload operational incompleteness package combining imported witness-threshold bounds with one certified witness. Instantiates the package for KO7 and proves the conjunction of no direct-whole witness, imported-whole truth, first contract admissibility at transformed-call, and existence of a certified witness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalIncompletene.boundary: No witness exists in the direct whole-term KO7 universe, while truth-level imported-whole witnesses and a first admissible contract witness at the transformed-call layer do exist; the method therefore succeeds only above the direct layer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalIncompletene.conclusion: KO7 exhibits payload-level operational incompleteness with the first admissible contract witness at the transformed-call layer plus one explicit certified-forgetting witness.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file builds the Gödel side of the LCEL comparison from the compiled Robinson-Q checker. It defines a six-stage ascent profile with the Gödel fixed point at stage two and proves it realizes the six-step shape and is compatible with the dependency-pair profile. It builds formal base, obstruction, framework and reimport semantics from provability and truth in the standard model, with the Gödel sentence as blocked sentence. From these it assembles a comparison object and an LCEL instance, proves the instance realizes the LCEL schema with independent true boundary sentence, and proves six-clause comparisons in both directions with the dependency-pair emitter instance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The Gödel sentence is unprovable in the compiled base theory but true in the standard model. It is blocked in the base and resolved in the stronger framework, with licensed reimport by truth.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The compiled Gödel LCEL instance realizes the LCEL schema with an independent true boundary sentence and admits six-clause comparisons in both directions with the dependency-pair instance.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file studies the recursor and circular-reference orbit families. It proves the stipulated relation InformationEquivalentModDP holds for every pair of orbits. It defines successor depth and the dependency-pair counter projection and computes its values on the two families. It shows counter-projection agreement is an equivalence relation that separates the two families, while every linear-growth-invariant direct-mass functional agrees on them.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Every linear-growth-invariant functional of direct mass agrees on the two orbit families, while the counter projection disagrees on them.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Every direct-mass functional agrees on the two orbit families while the counter projection separates them.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file studies direct certificates of the duplicating rule in the reflected direct grammar. It defines a direct certificate as a derivable payload-reading expression decreasing across every successor root step. It proves no such certificate exists, so no direct whole-term certificate exists by restriction. It also shows the payload-free counter expression does decrease and the zero rule admits no decreasing profile measure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A derivable payload-free counter expression decreases across every successor step, but no derivable payload-reading expression does. No profile measure decreases across the zero rule.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: No payload-reading direct grammar expression decreases across the successor rule, so no direct whole-term certificate exists.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file proves Lawvere's fixed-point theorem for weakly point-surjective evaluations and deduces no code type carries a diagonal instance with a fixed-point-free endomap. It identifies the confession code object with the one-node type and shows any point-surjective evaluation there has subsingleton values with identity endomaps. It adds controls showing a diagonal datum exists without surjectivity and the kernel successor is fixed-point-free, so the obstruction rests on evaluation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Under weakly point-surjective evaluation every endomap has a fixed point, so no fixed-point-free diagonal instance exists; without surjectivity such a datum does exist.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: No code type, in particular the confession one-node code object, carries a point-surjective evaluation with a fixed-point-free endomap.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file proves the trace law for the free recursor under context closure. For normal base and payload and counter depth k it shows stage terms and the terminal record form the unique maximal derivation with k+1 steps and residual counts. It defines counter, frame and payload readings along the spine and proves their values, offset and sum laws. It shows counter and frames are invariant under payload relabelling while payload count is not, with counter decreasing and frames increasing along the trace.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Each live stage has a reduct and the terminal record is normal, with remaining length counted by the counter plus one. The counter alone is relabelling-invariant and decreasing, while frames increase and payload count changes under relabelling.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: From the initial recursor term the unique maximal context-closed derivation follows the stages to the record in k+1 steps with counter-driven residual lengths.
assumptions: Normal a
Normal b
i ≤ k
i < k
set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file calibrates the bounded sentence of the projected pair in first-order arithmetic. It defines successor-closure and induction theories and derives the sentence with successor closure using bound S(c). It builds a two-element successor-escape countermodel with sole number zero that models the eight base axioms and all induction sentences while falsifying the pair sentence. It deduces underivability in all subtheories of induction arithmetic, separation of descent from the pair sentence, and the full calibration with bounded strong normalization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: With successor closure the pair sentence is derivable, while without it no subtheory of the eight axioms with all induction sentences derives it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Successor closure derives the bounded pair sentence while induction arithmetic does not, calibrating it with bounded strong normalization of the projected pair.
assumptions: eight basic axioms rca0SimpsonBasic
DeductionFO calculus with soundness
two-element Bool carrier

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines the total real weight of a predicate, signed fiber ratios for an observer, the meet cell of two observers and common knowledge as closure under shared fibers. It proves that common knowledge at a state is containment of the meet cell and proves a fiberwise aggregation lemma for saturated cells. It proves that two observers with a common weighting assign equal ratios whenever those assignments are common knowledge at a state whose meet cell has nonzero weight, without positivity or normalization. It gives two finite fixtures showing that nonzero weight and common knowledge are each necessary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Two observers who commonly know their fiber ratios must agree when the meet cell has nonzero weight; the equality can fail when the meet cell has zero weight or when the assignments hold only pointwise without being common knowledge.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Two observers with a common weighting and common knowledge of their fiber ratios must agree when the meet cell has nonzero weight, and both hypotheses are necessary.
assumptions: finite state type X with Fintype
real-valued weights of any sign with no nonnegativity or normalization for the fiber-ratio theorem
nonzero total weight of the meet cell as hypothesis of agreement theorems
classical decidability for finite sums
counterexample trust notes cite propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.AumannAgreement.AssignsFiberRatio
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Observer q assigns signed fiber ratio a to event E at y when the mass of states sharing the fiber of y and satisfying E equals a times the mass of the fiber of y.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.AumannAgreement.AssignsProbability
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Observer q assigns probability a to E at y under the same equation as AssignsFiberRatio, used as compatibility name for nonnegative normalized laws.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all weights mu, observers q, events E, values a and states y, AssignsFiberRatio holds iff AssignsProbability holds.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all q1 q2 C omega, common knowledge of C at omega holds iff C holds on all y in the meet cell of omega.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all mu q E a and Cell, if Cell is saturated under q-fibers and every y in Cell satisfies AssignsProbability mu q E a y, then the mass of Cell and E equals a times the mass of Cell.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all q1 q2 omega y z, if q1 y equals q1 z then MeetCell omega y holds iff MeetCell omega z holds.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all q1 q2 omega y z, if q2 y equals q2 z then MeetCell omega y holds iff MeetCell omega z holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.AumannAgreement.massOf_eq_mul_of_saturated_fiberRatio
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The same aggregation holds with AssignsFiberRatio in place of AssignsProbability under the same saturation hypothesis.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.AumannAgreement.agreement_of_commonKnowledge_fiberRatio
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all mu q1 q2 E a b omega, if the mass of the meet cell of omega is nonzero and it is common knowledge at omega that q1 assigns fiber ratio a and q2 assigns fiber ratio b to E, then a equals b with no positivity or normalization on mu.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The same conclusion with AssignsProbability in place of AssignsFiberRatio under the same nonzero meet-cell mass and common-knowledge hypotheses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines explicit definition by a derivable denoting statement, the Beth property on a class, and closure under postcomposition. It proves the Padoa direction that explicit definition gives license under soundness and a decomposition of the gap into unlicensed targets and Beth failures. It proves that a complete postcomposition-closed language with nonempty verdicts has the Beth property. It gives fixtures showing soundness, completeness and postcomposition closure are each necessary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A licensed target is explicitly definable when the language is sound, complete, postcomposition-closed with nonempty verdicts; on the other side a licensed target without explicit definition persists if any of those hypotheses is dropped.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: A sound complete postcomposition-closed language with nonempty verdicts has the Beth property, and completeness and postcomposition closure are each necessary.
assumptions: soundness for the Padoa direction
Nonempty verdict type, completeness and postcomposition closure for the Beth property
classical choice in the post-composition construction
arbitrary observed languages in independent universes

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The language is postcomposition-closed when every derivable statement composed with every verdict map is denoted by another derivable statement.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The constant-statement language is neither Complete nor PostcompositionClosed and fails the Beth property on all targets, without separating the two hypotheses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines orienting targets, the direct grammar as an observed language under a chosen observer, and the projection language of strictly increasing counter functions. It proves the grammar fails the Beth property at the payload-sensitive orienter for the full reading and at the bethGap function for the counter observer. It proves orienting grammar denotations are licensed by the counter and that the projection language is sound and has the Beth property on orienting targets with an explicit-definability equivalence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: On orienting targets the projection language turns every licensed target into an explicitly defined one, while the direct grammar leaves a licensed orienting target without any denoting expression even for the counter observer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The direct grammar fails the Beth property on orienting targets for both full and counter readings, while the strictly increasing projection language has it.
assumptions: targets that orient the duplicating step
reflected direct grammar with counter and full readings
kernel-only proofs

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines transport of scopes, constructions and certificates along relation isomorphisms and proves the full semantic profile is invariant under such transport. It computes exact raw and licensed profiles for the Fork3 binary fork with terminal-derived binary witnesses and shows changing the declared repair price changes the profile without changing the relation. It packages forks as presentations and as closed embeddings in ambient systems with transported certificates and terminal counts, realized by a live KO7 instance using kernel steps and SafeStep.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Transport along a relation isomorphism preserves every profile coordinate, while on the other side the relation alone does not fix the profile because declared repair prices can differ with identical relations and certificates.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The raw fork has profile with two terminals and unit repair data and the licensed fork has profile with one terminal and zero repair data, transport preserves profiles, and the same relation admits different prices with full certificates realized in live KO7.
assumptions: finite carriers with Fintype and DecidableEq
foundational axiom baseline with classical choice
noncomputable section
Fork3Step and Fork3LicensedStep at source with declared repair prices as parameters

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file treats deterministic observers with finite rational priors and point-mass kernels. It proves refinement implies Bayes-risk dominance by composing decoders and proves the converse from risk dominance on two-point priors with the second observer as target, giving an equivalence of the two preorders. It shows a single constant target does not determine refinement via the Bool coordinates. It proves for stochastic models that composition with a rational Markov kernel never lowers Bayes risk.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A deterministic observer dominates another in Bayes risk for all targets and priors exactly when it refines it; dominance on a single constant target does not imply refinement, and stochastic garbling only goes one way in this file.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: For deterministic observers, refinement coincides with uniform Bayes-risk dominance, one target does not suffice, and garbling cannot lower risk.
assumptions: finite source, observation and target types with Fintype and DecidableEq and explicit enumerations
rational priors summing to one
classical choice of representatives for the simulating decoder

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines real finite experiments, decision values, garbling by stochastic matrices and domination across decision problems. It proves garbling lowers every decision value and proves the converse by separating the target experiment from the convex hull of deterministic post-processings. It gives observer, gain-function and zero-one corollaries and controls showing nonempty output is required and that a fully noisy binary experiment is a one-way garbling of the perfect one.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: An experiment dominates another in every finite decision problem exactly when the second is a stochastic garbling of the first for nonempty output; without nonempty output domination can hold without garbling, and the noisy binary experiment is a one-way garbling of the perfect one.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Domination in all finite decision problems coincides with garbling by a stochastic matrix for nonempty output, restricting to refinement and Bayes-risk order on observers.
assumptions: finite types with Fintype and DecidableEq
real matrices and utilities with nonempty actions
nonempty output type for the converse
Mathlib Hahn-Banach separation and convex-hull finiteness
classical choice of representatives and codes

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file restricts the exhaustive finite side-encoder search by a computable natural-number cost and budget. It proves the returned encoder is feasible and has minimum Bayes side risk among budget-feasible encoders, characterizes emptiness, and proves candidate monotonicity with risk antitonicity in the budget. It gives zero-cost and unit-cost controls showing unconstrained recovery and empty zero-budget search.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Increasing the budget only adds candidates and never increases the optimum risk, while a zero budget with uniformly positive costs leaves the search empty.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The budgeted search returns a feasible minimum-risk encoder when one exists, with risk antitone in the budget.
assumptions: finite X, O, V, C with Fintype and DecidableEq and enumerations
computable natural-number cost with no efficiency claim
same classical baseline as the Bayes layer

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines padded encodings for naturals, word lists and certificates where the width prefix may announce extra false cells. It proves compact fields decode exactly to padded encodings and that the word decoder accepts only serializations. It proves the strict checker accepts exactly the padded encodings of buildCertificate output and that every accepted bitstring decodes to that certificate. It proves length formulas, canonicality of serializeBits as the unique shortest accepted string, and a padded successor control.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Padding with extra false cells is the only freedom in the compact format: every strictly accepted bitstring is a padded encoding at least as long as serializeBits, which is the unique shortest accepted string.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The strict checker accepts exactly the padded encodings of the constructed certificate, with serializeBits as the unique shortest accepted bitstring.
assumptions: compact certificate format with width prefix and false padding cells
kernel proofs with no extra axioms noted

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines a small-step bit machine that reads certificate bits one cell per step with width, payload, and halted phases and a consumed-cell counter. It proves a termination measure decreases on every non-halted step and that width, payload, field, and word segments simulate the recursive costed decoders with matching inspection counts. The full run for 3*bits.length+1 steps therefore halts with the recursive parser result, and the parser bitInspections equals the consumed count, with controls for empty and truncated inputs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The file places a fuel boundary: every input halts within 3*bits.length+1 steps with the parser's output, while fewer steps need not have halted. It also separates accepted canonical certificates from rejected empty, truncated, or zero-payload inputs, which halt with none.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: On every input the 3*length+1-step machine run halts with the recursive certificate parser's result and its consumed-cell count equals the parser's bitInspections.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A machine state consists of a control phase, the unread Boolean input list, and a consumed-cell counter.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: One step reads the head cell and increments consumed in a width phase or payload phase with cells left, rejects at end of input, completes a field when no payload cells remain, and fixes halted states.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines the generic compact codec for natural numbers and word lists, with unary width prefixes, binary payloads, exact length formulas, and decode-encode round trips. It also defines recursive costed parsers that return both the decoded value and the number of inspected bit cells. It proves the costed parsers erase to the accepted parsers, their costs never exceed input length, and successful parses partition the input into consumed prefix plus untouched suffix.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Successful parses lie on one side with the consumed prefix exactly accounted and the trailing suffix untouched; truncated or noncanonical inputs lie on the other side and are rejected. Parser work is bounded by input length, so inspection count cannot exceed available cells.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The compact codec is lossless with exact lengths and its costed parsers count exactly the consumed prefix while never exceeding the input length.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The recursive prefix splitter takes n words with unit terminating cost, returning none when input is short.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The compact encoding of n is the unary encoding of its binary width followed by the bits of n+1.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file proves the four asymptotic clauses stated for the canonical trace: trace action over squared depth, proof-entropy fraction with constant c0 plus payload, completed cell-mass share of trace action, and crossover stage over depth. Each limit is obtained from an exact closed-form identity by isolating 1/k corrections or applying squeeze bounds. No new definitions are introduced beyond these limit statements.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Each result separates a finite-stage exact identity from its infinite limit as depth k or payload p tends to infinity, with lower-order terms vanishing. The limit value holds only asymptotically, not at any fixed finite stage.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The four trace-law fractions converge to (w+1)/2 over squared depth, i/(i+1), w/(w+1), and 1/(w+1) respectively.
assumptions: 1 ≤ i for the proof-entropy ratio limit
1 ≤ w for the crossover-stage limit

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.ClaimAsymptotics.traceAction_div_sq_tendsto
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all w and c, the real sequence traceAction k w c divided by k squared tends to (w+1)/2 as k tends to infinity.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.ClaimAsymptotics.proof_entropy_tendsto_ratio
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under the hypothesis 1 ≤ i, for all k, i, wrapSize, and c0, proofEntropyValue k i p wrapSize (c0+p) tends to i/(i+1) as p tends to infinity.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.ClaimAsymptotics.conMassCell_div_traceAction_tendsto
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all w and c, conMassCell k w divided by traceAction k w c tends to w/(w+1) as k tends to infinity.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under the hypothesis 1 ≤ w, for all c and w, istar k c w divided by k tends to 1/(w+1) as k tends to infinity.

relations.explanation: The limit is read off the closed-form action identity with vanishing 1/k corrections.

relations.explanation: Upper and lower fractional bounds squeeze the crossover ratio to its limit.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file proves strengthened paper statements not carried by the cited declarations: constancy of license-constant projection families, uniqueness of the record generator bridge and subsingleton LCEL comparison types, a marginal bit-cost identity with geometric lower bound and binary length, opposite explicit-versus-carrier inequalities for large index and index zero, and terminal-record completeness on a sorted model with an unsorted depth-base collision and a quadratic mass bound.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Several sharp reversals hold: the explicit description is shorter than the repeated carrier for index at least two with small glue but longer at index zero, and positive-depth sorted records recover depth, base, and payload while depth-zero records forget payload and unsorted records cannot recover depth and base together. Static projection families stay constant when licenses agree, and each bit crosses a geometrically larger shell.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Positive-depth sorted records are complete for depth, base, and payload with quadratic mass bounded by the confessed burden, while the other strengthened paper inequalities hold under their stated side conditions.
assumptions: 1 ≤ m for the bit-cost identity and lower bound
1 ≤ k for the binary-length specification and for positive-depth record recovery
2 ≤ wrapSize+paySize, 2 ≤ i, and glue < i for the explicit-versus-carrier inequality

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any family tau of projection transactions, if consecutive licenses are equal and equal licenses determine dimension and forgetting witness, then the family is static and all stages are equal.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any record counter n, any two generator tokens are equal and the primitive duplicator right-hand side carries two distinct generator positions.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any two formal LCEL instances, the six-clause comparison type is a subsingleton because every field is a proposition.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file shows correct comparison of observation pairs through an augmented channel holds exactly when the channel licenses repeat depth. It derives the rank channel for comparison, a lower bound by the largest fiber, a construction from capacity, and a two-sided finite capacity law. Both comparison and recurrence therefore share the same feasible alphabets and the same attained minimum.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A k-symbol side channel for comparison exists exactly when k is at least the largest observation fiber size; below that bound no channel suffices. The minimum maxFiberCard is attained, so the boundary is sharp.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Correct pair comparison and exact repeat-depth recording have the same feasible alphabets with least size maxFiberCard.
assumptions: DecidableEq Q for observations on Fin N
Fintype R for the lower-bound alphabet
Finite horizons Fin N and Fin k, including empty and zero-symbol cases

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any observer obs on Fin N and side channel r, existence of a correct joint decoder for paired observations is equivalent to the paired map factoring through repeatDepth obs.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any observer obs, there exists a decoder correct for the pair of obs and its fiber rank channel.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.ComparisonRecurrencePrice.comparison_channel_card_lower
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypotheses that R is a Fintype and a correct comparison decoder exists for r, maxFiberCard obs is at most the cardinality of R.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.ComparisonRecurrencePrice.repeatDepth_channel_of_capacity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under the hypothesis maxFiberCard obs ≤ k, there exists r into Fin k such that the paired map factors through repeatDepth obs.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.ComparisonRecurrencePrice.comparison_channel_exists_iff

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file develops confluence from termination plus unique normal forms for arbitrary relations and first-order rewriting systems, with both directions for terminating systems. It gives transport theorems that move termination via stuttering simulation and uniqueness via faithful simulation to the source. A three-state source maps non-injectively onto a two-state target to obtain confluence, while a terminating fork is not confluent so uniqueness is necessary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Termination plus unique reachable normal forms lies on the confluent side, while termination alone does not: the fork terminates but is not confluent. Transport preserves this boundary, moving termination and uniqueness from target to source.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Terminating relations and systems with unique normal forms are confluent, transported across simulations and sharp without uniqueness.
assumptions: WellFounded termination hypotheses for the source or target relations
Unique reachable normal forms or unique normal forms under conversion for the uniqueness side
Stuttering and normal-form-faithful simulation hypotheses for transport
Classical case analysis via by_cases in the normal-form existence argument

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines confusable pairs, the confusability graph, resolving side channels, and the augmented observer, proving licensing equivalent to proper coloring. It gives exact capacity laws for arbitrary and finite alphabets via fiber target cardinalities, identifies chromatic number with maximum fiber multiplicity and code deficit with its binary logarithm, and tests infinite, growing-fiber, permanent-channel, compactness, and three-pair non-coarsening cases. Finite and infinite examples show attainable and impossible capacities.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A finite resolving alphabet exists exactly when every observer fiber has finitely many target values with one common bound; an infinite fiber or unbounded finite fibers force infinite alphabets. The chromatic number and binary code length mark the least sufficient alphabet, with n-colorability failing below the maximum fiber multiplicity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Licensed augmentation equals graph coloring, so the chromatic number is the maximum fiber multiplicity and its binary logarithm is the least resolving code length.
assumptions: Classical.choice via Classical.choose for fiber representatives and fiber embeddings
Noncomputable definitions for representatives and embeddings
Fintype, DecidableEq, and Finite hypotheses for finite-source and finite-alphabet capacity laws
No sorry, axiom, or native_decide in the checked code

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file builds a four-route confession index with concrete evidence for dependency pairs, direct counter projection, size-change termination and argument filtering, and reads each retained rank from that evidence. It proves all four ranks equal the same counter projection and induce the same full term order, so the confession full-order quotient has exactly one class while route origins and licenses stay distinct. It also builds an infinite base-sensitive family of actual KO7 dependency-pair reduction pairs with pairwise distinct full orders, so the quotient of all such pairs is infinite, as is the construction-side root-orienter quotient. The culminating package contrasts infinitely many construction classes with one confession class and no injective map between them.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The construction full-order quotient is infinite while the four-route confession quotient has exactly one class, so no function from the former to the latter can be injective. The one-class result is exact for the four canonical routes only, since the wider family of actual dependency-pair ranks is infinite.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The file proves the exact moduli package of infinitely many construction classes, one confession class for the four canonical routes with distinct origins and licenses, infinitely many actual dependency-pair classes, and no injective construction-to-confession quotient map.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines weak cost crossing and cost ties for doubled carry and confession burdens, a three-way burden order with an executable comparison, least weak crossing depths with bounded executable weak and strict searches, a cubic cumulative carry sum, and optimal action sets with tie-break policies. It proves that positive payload yields a weak crossing, that ties occur at most at a single depth, that zero payload admits a tie in a single degenerate case and never reaches strict crossing, and that executable searches return the mathematical least thresholds. It orders the weak threshold below the strict threshold, showing the strict threshold equals the weak threshold or its successor according to whether the weak threshold is strict or a tie. It also proves a closed cubic identity for cumulative carry burden and reuses finite-horizon stopping characterizations, including a fixture showing zero immediate gain alone does not imply stopping.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: With positive payload the direct carry burden eventually outweighs the confession burden beyond a least weak or strict threshold, while with zero payload strict crossing never occurs. For finite-horizon stopping, continued value equals stop value at all horizons when a successor edge inequality holds and otherwise continued computation can be optimal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: With positive payload the executable weak and strict searches return the least mathematical thresholds with the strict threshold equal to the weak threshold or its successor depending on tie status.
assumptions: 1 <= payload for crossing existence and threshold ordering results
DecidableEq S for the EchoStoppingMDP stopping equivalence

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This module distinguishes two workload conventions for carry costs, namely charging each depth once versus recomputing every prefix. It proves the once-through sum equals the existing quadratic direct burden and the every-prefix sum equals the existing cubic cumulative burden, with exact closed forms and recurrences. It shows positive payload makes recomputation strictly more expensive and zero payload makes both zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: One incremental execution through a horizon grows quadratically while recomputing every prefix grows cubically, and for positive payload the latter is strictly larger beyond depth zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The file proves that cached single-execution cost is quadratic while every-prefix recomputation is cubic, with exact closed forms and strict separation for positive payload.
assumptions: Positivity 0 < payload for the strict recomputation inequality

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines observed languages with language-level inexpressibility and observer-level collision plus soundness, completeness and dimension visibility. It proves the two levels coincide exactly under all three hypotheses and gives the license form of the second clause. It shows each hypothesis is necessary by fixtures dropping one at a time and exhibits joint satisfiability with both levels false and both levels true.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Under soundness, completeness and dimension visibility, language-level inexpressibility holds exactly when the observer collides with the target inside an outside context, and each of the three hypotheses is necessary as shown by fixtures dropping one hypothesis at a time.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The file proves that soundness, completeness and dimension visibility jointly make the language-level and observer-level definitions equivalent, with each hypothesis necessary and jointly satisfiable.
assumptions: Classical case analysis for the collision extraction direction with no finiteness, decidability or inhabitance assumed

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file identifies functional dependencies with licenses of restrictions and proves Armstrong soundness and completeness, where two Boolean tuples decide every dependency. It gives universe-polymorphic soundness and completeness via lifts and equivalences and shows one tuple is insufficient. It also proves lists of dependencies are families of licenses, with union and indexed forms as license conjunctions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Armstrong derivability ends exactly where semantic implication ends, with two Boolean tuples refuting every underivable dependency while one tuple alone satisfies all dependencies.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The file proves Armstrong soundness and completeness including universe-polymorphic forms, and that lists of dependencies are exactly families of licenses.
assumptions: Decidable equality on attributes for union and augmentation rules
Classical decidability of derivability for completeness with universe lifting via ULift and equivalences

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file proves completeness of the dependency-pair method and the Arts and Giesl equivalence between termination, well-founded minimal chains and absence of infinite minimal chains. It develops a bounded presentation where strong normalization is boundedness of reduction lengths and accessibility coincides with bounded runs under finite successors. It shows the bounded matrix is decidable and every free-recursor term has bounded runs.

Nonempty types where needed for decoders, fibers and uniform prior

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file states the equality-guarded KO7 positional repair built from a selection of constructor positions. It proves the repair freezes the equality-witness position, retains every requested non-equality position, closes recursive-context selection under both application positions, is confluent, and is the least such confluent extension. It also shows selecting only the recursive-context position does not ensure confluence.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The equality-guarded positional repair is the least confluent extension preserving requested non-equality positions, while the recD-only selection is not confluent.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file implements the license criterion, observer refinement, collision search, and target-kernel partition as computations over an explicit complete enumeration of the source. Each executable is proved sound and complete against its propositional notion: true answers coincide with licensing or refinement, and the search returns a colliding pair exactly when licensing fails. Controls include the empty and one-point carriers, where every target is licensed, and the parity fixture on two Booleans.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: An observer licenses a target exactly when equal observations imply equal targets on all enumerated states; otherwise the witness search returns an explicit colliding pair, so failure of licensing is always witnessed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Executable checks decide licensing and refinement, and search certifies failure with an explicit collision.
assumptions: DecidableEq on source, observation and target types
explicit complete enumeration E of the source
executable checks evaluated by decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file gives a deterministic synthesis of an optimal resolving side channel for finite inputs from an explicit enumeration. It orders target values by first appearance in each observer fiber, uses the local rank as code, proves resolving and licensing, proves optimality with no smaller Fin alphabet, and gives a fixed-width binary codec. It also synthesizes a channel at the computed stabilization stage that remains licensing for all dynamic orbit stages.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: No channel into a smaller Fin n alphabet can license the target when n is below fiber multiplicity; the synthesized local-rank channel with exactly fiber-multiplicity symbols attains the bound, and one stabilization stage suffices for dynamic observers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Local-rank synthesis yields an optimal resolving channel attaining fiber-multiplicity capacity and permanent licensing from the stabilization stage.
assumptions: DecidableEq on source, observation and target types
Fintype X for capacity and bridge theorems
explicit complete enumeration of finite inputs
BitVec for fixed-width binary codec
no Classical.choice in executable definitions

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given E, q, P and x, localRank is the index of P x in orderedFiberValues for q x.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file classifies rank functions in every faithful realization of the free recursor. Generated root steps and transformed calls each admit infinitely many full strict orders via parameterized rank families. Among transformed-call ranks, those constant on counter fibers are exactly strictly increasing recodings of the counter, and their full-order quotient has one class.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: All root and transformed-call ranks admit infinitely many full-order classes, while ranks constant on counter fibers collapse to a single order class; counter-determined order is unique, unrestricted order is not.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Every faithful realization has infinitely many rank-order classes for root and call steps, yet counter-determined ranks have exactly one order class.
assumptions: noncomputable equivalences and rank families
faithful realization e of the free recursor
strict orders on represented states

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every faithful realization e, traceEquiv e is an equivalence between constructor traces and e.State via point and decode.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines faithful realizations as signature algebras with injective fold and realizes root, call and contextual steps as images of free relations. It transports well-foundedness, determinism, confluence, machines, orbits and witness hierarchies through closed embeddings. It shows the KO7 constructor interpretation realizes exactly the two recursor rules, gives collapsed and escaping counterexamples, and exhibits construction and confession responses on the KO7 schema.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Reflection of steps on represented pairs alone permits escape to an unrepresented self-loop and fails to transport termination; both reflection and closure under outgoing steps are required to transport termination and confluence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Faithful injective realizations transport well-foundedness, determinism, confluence and machines, but reflection without outgoing closure does not suffice for ambient termination.
assumptions: noncomputable equivalences and transport constructions
classical reasoning in closed-embedding proofs
injective constructor fold for faithful realizations

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file specializes the generic fiber-capacity theory to the two-role fixture and Fork3. The value observer collapsing both roles has fiber multiplicity two and deficit one bit, the role coordinate closes the deficit, the two roles collide for value-only reading, and the deficit equals the zero-evidence overproduction gap of Fork3.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The value-only observer collides on the two roles and needs one extra bit; adjoining the role coordinate closes the deficit and the fiber deficit equals the Fork3 zero-evidence gap of one bit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The two-role fixture has multiplicity two and deficit one bit, closed by the role channel and equal to the Fork3 zero-evidence gap.
assumptions: Fintype and DecidableEq from fiber core
decide evaluation for multiplicity
value-blind channel for Fork3 gap

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file develops finite observer-target fiber capacity with no rewrite-system dependency. It defines realized target sets, their maximum size, and the ceiling-log deficit, proves zero deficit is factorization and positive deficit is a collision, and proves tight lower bounds. It constructs an optimal side channel with exactly multiplicity symbols and shows deficit bits are both sufficient and minimal, with monotonicity under kernel refinement.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Zero deficit holds exactly when the target factors through the observer and positive deficit exactly when a collision exists; any licensing joint channel needs at least fiber-multiplicity symbols and ceiling-log bits.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Fiber multiplicity is the exact minimum side-alphabet size and its ceiling log is the exact minimum fixed-length bit width.
assumptions: Fintype X with DecidableEq Q and V
Classical.choice for optimal code construction
classical reasoning for empty versus inhabited carriers

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file bounds conditional Shannon entropy by the logarithm of fiber multiplicity for finite sources with a prior, observer and target. It proves the bound in nats and bits, characterizes zero entropy as licensing on the support, and characterizes equality as full uniform fibers. Controls show a nonuniform fiber lies strictly below the bound and a zero-mass collision leaves entropy at zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Conditional target entropy is at most log fiber multiplicity and vanishes exactly when the target is licensed on the support; equality needs full uniform fibers, and a zero-mass collision leaves entropy at zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Conditional Shannon entropy is bounded by log fiber multiplicity with equality exactly for full uniform fibers and zero exactly for support licensing.
assumptions: Fintype X, Q and V
nonnegative prior mu summing to one
noncomputable entropy definitions and real analysis with negMulLog and Jensen

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.condLaw_sum_one
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If fiberMass mu q u is nonzero then condLaw sums to one over target values.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.H_condLaw_le_log_card
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If mu is nonnegative and fiberMass is nonzero then entropy of condLaw is at most log card of fiberVerdicts.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.conditionalEntropy_le_log_fiberMultiplicity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If mu is nonnegative and sums to one then targetCondEntropy mu q P is at most log fiberMultiplicity q P.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.conditionalEntropyBits_le_logb_fiberMultiplicity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under the same nonnegative unit-mass hypotheses, targetCondEntropy divided by log 2 is at most log base 2 of fiberMultiplicity.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.H_eq_zero_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If p takes values in zero to one then entropy H p equals zero iff every value is zero or one.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.conditionalEntropy_eq_zero_iff_licensedOnSupport
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If mu is nonnegative then targetCondEntropy equals zero iff LicensedOnSupport mu q P holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.eq_uniform_of_H_eq_log_card
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If p is nonnegative summing to one with entropy equal to log card then every value equals one divided by card, requiring Nonempty.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.H_condLaw_eq_log_of_uniform
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If fiber card equals m and condLaw is uniform one over m on the fiber then its entropy equals log m.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiberEntropy.conditionalEntropy_eq_log_fiberMultiplicity_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If mu is nonnegative summing to one then entropy equals log multiplicity iff every positive-mass fiber has full multiplicity card with uniform condLaw.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines executable Boolean procedures over explicitly enumerated finite relation tables for reachability, normality, joinability, source confluence, path reconstruction, nonjoinability witnesses, defect filtering, repair-cover optimization and bounded witness-rank search. It proves each procedure sound and complete against reflexive-transitive closure and the noncomputable cover and rank references under the same enumeration. It adds semantic peak inputs, first-order critical-pair origins and a finite adapter that transfers finite nonjoinability to term rewriting, plus controls showing auxiliary prices, coverage and adequacy are not fixed by relation data.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Boolean search over the supplied enumeration succeeds exactly when the unbounded existential holds and fails exactly at source confluence; relation-only table data alone do not fix auxiliary repair prices, coverage, adequacy predicates or witness-rank bounds.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: All finite reachability, normality, joinability, confluence, path, nonjoinability, repair-cover and bounded-rank queries are decided soundly and completely relative to the supplied enumeration, and finite nonjoinability transfers to represented term rewriting while auxiliary coordinates remain independent of the relation table.
assumptions: DecidableEq on finite carriers
Explicit complete Enumeration supplied with each RelationTable
Noncomputable Real.logb used only for Hartley interpretation
