OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file builds joint and observation-mass models for finite rational parametric families with a rational prior. It proves that equal posteriors on positive-mass samples coincide with proportional likelihoods. It proves sufficiency equals Fisher-Neyman factorization under a strictly positive prior and that the posterior map is minimal sufficient, plus a two-point fixture showing full support is required.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Sufficiency coincides with Fisher-Neyman factorization when the prior has full support, but a zero-prior entry breaks the coincidence: a constant statistic can be sufficient without factorization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: For full-support priors, sufficiency is factorization and the posterior map is minimal sufficient, while full support is necessary.
assumptions: Fintype parameter and sample types with DecidableEq
Rational likelihood family with nonnegativity and sum one
Prior nonnegativity and sum one, with strict positivity where stated
Classical.choice for representative samples in factorization construction

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.FiniteFamily
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A finite family of rational probability vectors on Y indexed by the parameter, with pointwise nonnegativity and total mass one for each parameter.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.familyModel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a finite family and a prior with nonnegativity and sum one, the joint model draws the parameter from the prior and the observation from the corresponding likelihood with identity observation.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.FactorizationSufficient
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A statistic T is factorization-sufficient when each likelihood factors as a nonnegative parameter-statistic term times a nonnegative sample term.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.LikelihoodProportional
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Two samples are likelihood-proportional when their likelihood vectors differ by a positive rational multiple uniformly in the parameter.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.posterior?_familyModel_eq_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under a strictly positive prior and nonzero observation masses, two samples have equal posteriors exactly when they are likelihood-proportional.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.sufficient_familyModel_iff_factorization
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under a strictly positive prior, a statistic is sufficient for the parameter in the family model exactly when the likelihood factorizes through it.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.posterior_minimalSufficient
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under a strictly positive prior, the posterior map is factorization-sufficient and is a function of every factorization-sufficient statistic on samples of nonzero mass.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteFamilySufficiency.fullSupport_is_required
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: There exist a finite family on Fin 2 and a prior with a zero entry such that the constant statistic is sufficient but the likelihood does not factor through it.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file proves pigeonhole recurrence for finite observers and shows the first repeat occurs by card Q with earlier stages new. It proves no memoryless function of the current observation determines repeat status, with a parity-orbit instance, and characterizes compatible observers by unique image dynamics with eventual periodicity and kernel and license stabilization by card Q minus one. It refutes persistence without compatibility via a power-of-two observer and proves sharpness by countdown examples plus finite-attained-image generalizations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Every finite-observer orbit repeats an observation within card Q steps and compatible licenses stabilize by card Q minus one, yet the current observation alone cannot determine repeat status and recurrence need not become eventually periodic.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Finite observers always recur within the pigeonhole bound and compatible licenses stabilize by that bound sharply, but memoryless repeat detection and eventual periodicity are impossible in general.
assumptions: Fintype observation alphabet with DecidableEq for universal repeat theorems
Finite attained observation image or finite Set.range for image theorems
Classical.choice for finite-image first-repeat arguments
No sorry, admit, axiom or native_decide; kernel only

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every dynamics F, finite observation type Q and start x, there are indices i below j at most card Q with equal observations along the orbit.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every dynamics, finite decidable observer and start, there are stages i below j at most card Q with the same current observation but different repeat-status verdicts.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every dynamics, finite decidable observer and start, repeat status never factors through the current observation.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every dynamics and observer, compatibility with one transition holds exactly when there is a unique induced dynamics on the attained observation image.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This module packages finite probability masses with nonnegativity and total-mass-one laws and finite-output conditional kernels normalized at every input. It provides row, deterministic and fair-binary constructions and computes the fair-binary entropy as log 2. It defines typed finite channels with source prior, target, observation and normalized posterior rows plus prior-weighted residual entropy, without imposing Bayes consistency.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: none
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Finite distributions, kernels, deterministic and fair-binary examples, and typed finite channels with normalized rows and prior-weighted residual entropy are packaged with the fair-binary entropy equal to log 2.
assumptions: Fintype source, target and kernel output types where stated
DecidableEq for point-mass and deterministic-kernel constructions
Noncomputable section for real-valued masses and entropy

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines computable finite root and one-step reduct sets for finite first-order systems by matching left-hand sides and rewriting one argument. It proves the root and full reduct membership statements are sound and complete for the rewrite relation when right-hand-side variables are contained in left-hand-side variables. It shows the condition is required by exhibiting one rule with infinitely many variable reducts.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Under the condition that right-hand-side variables are contained in left-hand-side variables, one-step reducts form a finite sound and complete set; without that condition a single rule already branches infinitely.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Finite first-order systems satisfying the variable condition are finitely branching with an exact finite reduct set, and the condition is sharp.
assumptions: DecidableEq on signature and variable types
Variable condition that every right-hand-side variable occurs on the left for the positive direction
Kernel-only trust with no extra axioms

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.FiniteTRSReducts.reducts
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every rule list, the one-step reducts of a variable are empty and of an application combine root reducts with rewrites of one argument.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every rule list, the one-argument-step successors of an argument list are empty for the empty list and otherwise rewrite either the head or the tail.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This module packages fixed-input languages whose derivable statements factor through a declared observer and whose distinguished pair fixes input and context while colliding observations and separating dimensions and targets. It proves derivable denotations factor through observation and hence cannot constrain or decide the target, and the target has no observer or quotient factorization. It bridges this semantic boundary to the legacy abstract operational-incompleteness predicate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Inside a fixed input and same outside context, derivable observation-only statements are constant on observer fibers and therefore cannot constrain or pointwise decide the target across the colliding pair.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: No derivable observation-only statement constrains or decides the target, and the target has no factorization through the observer or its kernel quotient.
assumptions: Supplied derivability judgment and observer, dimension, target and same-context fields of the boundary structure
No extra type-class or classical hypotheses beyond the structure witnesses

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file closes the two-rule free recursor under one-hole contexts and proves every step strictly decreases a root-weight measure, giving well-founded termination. It defines evaluation of the recursor counter and a normalizer, proves every term reaches its normal form and normal forms are step-free and unique. It concludes confluence, a joinability-by-normal-form-equality characterization with a Boolean decision procedure, and an example separating contextual from root steps.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: none
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Contextual closure of the two-rule recursor terminates, is confluent with unique normal forms, and has decidable joinability by normal-form equality.
assumptions: Seven-constructor free recursor syntax
Root-weight measure strictly decreased by root and contextual steps
Well-founded recursion on root weight for normalization

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines the free recursor root relation with zero and successor rules and the transformed-call dependency-pair relation on closed recursor syntax, together with executable next-step functions and an extractor that recovers the callee from a successor step. It proves soundness and completeness of extraction and that both relations are deterministic, well-founded, and confluent with exact rank and cost functions. It classifies extensions of the root relation, showing extraction completeness holds exactly for compatible extras, equivalently for pair-free new edges, and exhibits counterexamples for wrong right-hand sides and repeated rules.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Extraction completeness holds for the base root relation and for extensions whose new edges never share a source with a dependency pair, but it fails once an added edge reuses a successor source with a different right-hand side; compatibility of added edges is therefore the exact dividing line.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Every root extension is extraction-complete exactly when its genuinely new edges never share a source with a dependency pair.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file builds a boundary kernel with source, callee, and output terms and locates the generator at two output paths for frame and active roles. It defines the actual Boolean channel comparing each branch to the extracted call and proves it separates roles exogenously while refusing value factorization and unit collapse. It identifies the uniform channel evidence with the binary role-resolving channel, computes one spent bit, and extends deficit, gap, and joint-posterior factorization to arbitrary binary role laws.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The same generator value at two output positions cannot determine the extracted-call channel, while the role distinction can; value-only and unit channels are therefore impossible, and the role channel carries the bit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The extracted call yields an exogenous Boolean channel that no value-only function can reproduce and that carries exactly one bit, with joint factorization for arbitrary binary role laws.
assumptions: classical reasoning for channel decoding
noncomputable definitions for spentBits and decisionMass
decide for finite role equalities

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines counter and payload observations, profile measures, direct whole witnesses in a reflected grammar, imported natural rankings, transformed-call witnesses, and counter-erasing signature decoders. It proves every successor profile occurs, no direct witness orients all steps, the executable derivation height is the least imported ranking and is not profile-factored, and no erased-counter decoder exists. It builds truth and boundary witness hierarchies whose adequate depths are exactly at least one and at least two, giving representation-shift bottlenecks at depths one and two.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: No payload-sensitive expression in the declared two-coordinate grammar orients all successor steps, so depth zero is impossible; imported natural rankings succeed at depth one and the counter-erasing decoder requirement pushes the boundary hierarchy to depth two.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Truth needs depth one and the counter-erasing boundary needs depth two, with no direct whole witness.
assumptions: classical choice for Nat.find in kappa definitions
noncomputable definitions for kappaTruth and kappaBoundary

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines the injective map from closed four-constructor free terms to seven-constructor recursor terms preserving zero, successor, wrap, and recur. It proves the map preserves delta-prefix length, counter and payload observations, and profile measures, and that root steps correspond exactly forward and backward from the image. It defines the least root height on free terms, proves exact decrease, zero characterization, pointwise leastness, non-factorization through profiles, and equality with derivationHeight on closed images.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Root height is zero exactly for root-normal terms and the embedding is faithful inside its image, while terms headed by integrate, merge, or eqWit lie outside and height does not factor through the counter-payload profile.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The four-constructor root theory embeds faithfully in the seven-constructor recursor theory with identical steps, profiles, and least root height.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file records fixtures showing hypotheses of the package theorems cannot be dropped, with most fixtures beside their theorems. It adds a three-state rotation read by the zero test whose orbit-observer kernels do not stabilize, the naturals under constant observation whose infinite fiber admits no finite side channel, and an empty certificate task whose capacity search returns none. It conjoins twenty-five fixture statements grouped as fifteen necessity items, excluding the duplicated-target product control which carries no distinctness hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Each listed hypothesis is sharp: without observation compatibility the orbit-observer kernels keep changing, without finiteness no finite side channel resolves the infinite fiber, and without an admissible certificate the capacity search returns none.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Every listed hypothesis is necessary, witnessed by an explicit fixture where hypothesis and conclusion fail together.
assumptions: decide evaluation for finite fixtures
propext
Classical.choice
Quot.sound

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file represents two operational tasks by a product target and proves joint licensing is exactly the conjunction of component licenses. It shows separately sufficient side labels compose by product while the exact finite minimum is the realized joint fiber multiplicity. A constant-observer Boolean example with duplicated targets has joint multiplicity two rather than four, so the product of separate minima strictly overcounts.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The minimum side alphabet is the realized joint fiber multiplicity, which can be strictly smaller than the product of separate minima; naive additive or multiplicative accounting therefore overcounts, as the duplicated target shows.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Joint minimum side-alphabet size is the realized joint fiber multiplicity, which can be strictly below the product of separate minima.
assumptions: Fintype and DecidableEq instances for the finite section
decide evaluation for Boolean fiber computations

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file closes the union of fourteen proof-bearing direct-profile families and the separate 76-row termination method atlas without conflating them. It proves each direct tag has a concrete candidate with relation-correct non-orientation for both the root and self-embedding relations and each atlas family has an exact non-residual classification receipt. It forms the 90-row disjoint ledger, proves length, nodup, completeness, branch disjointness, exact U6 counts, total coverage, and a propositional closeout certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Direct-profile rows carry candidate non-orientation proofs for both root relations while atlas rows carry only exact classification receipts; the atlas enum lacks measure and order data, so candidate coverage cannot be upgraded and the 14 plus 76 union is the maximum honest closure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: All 14 direct-profile rows have relation-correct non-orientation receipts and all 76 atlas rows have exact non-residual classification receipts, totaling 90 disjoint covered rows.

DecidableEq for inventory rows

It instantiates the generic boundary with recursor and self-embedding worlds that share context and complete candidate profile yet differ in system dimension and termination verdict. It proves the fixed-input counterfactual, that no derivable statement decides termination, that the imported verdict would decide it but is not derivable, and that derivability is nonempty.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Admitted observation-only statements never decide global termination, while the target-deciding imported verdict lies outside the derivable fragment; equal context and observation coexist with distinct dimension and verdict.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: With common input and observation but different systems and verdicts, no derivable observation-only statement decides termination while the non-derivable imported verdict would.
assumptions: DecidableEq for statements
decide for dimension inequality

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file builds a normalized channel on the two recursor and self-embedding systems with uniform prior, full-profile direct observation with fair posterior, and a proof-backed licensed decision from transformed-call and license certificates. It proves the direct profile collides while verdicts differ, the licensed decision separates without inspecting the verdict, and both posteriors are calibrated. It computes fair cell entropy log 2 versus licensed entropy zero, residuals log 2 versus zero, deficit log 2, headline composition, and nonvacuity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The full direct profile collides on both systems leaving log 2 residual uncertainty, while the proof-backed licensed decision separates them leaving zero residual; channel separation and rule provenance remain separate propositions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The licensed certificate channel separates the two systems with deficit log 2 while the direct profile cannot, without inspecting the verdict to decide.
assumptions: noncomputable section with Real-valued distributions
decide for two-system cardinality
normalized posterior models without derived Bayes joint law

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file builds the complete meta-observer over an explicit fourteen-constructor declared universe with concrete linear, max, pair, vector and lex witnesses. It defines relation-relative orientation and proves every declared candidate orients neither the terminating KO7 Step nor SelfEmbeddingStep. It then shows the full candidate profile coincides on the two systems while the finite strong-normalization verdict splits, giving operational inexpressibility and no profile decoder.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Every declared candidate fails to orient both the KO7 root relation Step and SelfEmbeddingStep, so the full candidate profile is constantly false on both systems. Strong normalization holds for the recursor system but fails for the self-embedding system, and no decoder from the profile recovers the verdict.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The fourteen-family declared profile agrees on both actual relations yet the finite termination verdict distinguishes them, yielding operational inexpressibility with no profile decoder.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file instantiates the schema-generic operational-incompleteness predicate on the reflected direct-measure grammar at the payload coordinate pi_y. It defines the canonical counter-payload carrier and the complete positive-copy duplicating relation and proves global orientation equivalent to the earlier duplicating-root predicate. The payload projection witnesses dimension use without orientation while the counter witnesses orientation without dimension use, giving a non-vacuous incompleteness theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A derivable claim that reads the step-argument payload cannot globally orient the complete duplicating-carrier relation, while a payload-blind claim does not read that dimension. The question is therefore operationally incomplete with both sides witnessed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The reflected direct grammar at the step-argument dimension is operationally incomplete for global orientation of the fixed duplicating-carrier system.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines kept mass for guessing within a list and k-try vulnerability as summed suprema over menus of at most k values. It proves the repair frontier equals total weight minus vulnerability, with normalized and Bayes-risk forms. It proves concavity in k, the exact-size supremum form under nonnegativity, and a two-state uniform computation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Total weight splits into kept k-try vulnerability and refused repair frontier for menus of at most k values. Enlarging k cannot increase the frontier, and exact-k menus suffice under nonnegativity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The repair frontier equals total weight minus k-try vulnerability, with exact-size form, concavity, and a computed two-state uniform example.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines the license as observer-kernel inclusion and refinement as factorization of the coarse observer through the fine one. It proves factorization through the attained image with a unique decoder, full decoders under nonempty codomain with an empty-source control, and failure as collision. It characterizes refinement by license-theory inclusion including Boolean and fixed-target forms, and proves licenses are lost at most once along coarsenings with first-loss existence, uniqueness, witnesses and dichotomy.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A target is licensed exactly when observer equality implies target equality, and failure is exactly a collision pair. Along a coarsening chain a license once lost never returns, with an exact first-loss stage when failure occurs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Licensing is kernel inclusion with attained-image decoders, refinement is license-theory inclusion, and coarsening loses license at most once with an exact cutoff.
assumptions: Classical.choice for choosing preimages in attained-image decoder
Classical proposition decidability for full decoder and coarsening arguments

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file supplies recursor instances of the generic license theory with the counter, residual-work and payload coordinates on finite traces. It shows the counter is injective hence licenses every target while the constant observer fails for payload with an explicit collision. It proves rank computes dependency-pair cost and licenses it but not the erased payload, and analyzes payload-governed loop extensions where rank licenses termination exactly when no payload loops, ending in a scope dichotomy.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The rank and counter observer licenses residual work, call costs and base-system termination but not the payload or payload-sensitive termination. OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: On one carrier the counter licenses base termination and costs but fails after a payload-sensitive loop extension that retains every base step.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file sends an equivalence kernel to its Boolean licensed targets and a target family to its common kernel, proving the antitone Galois law. Boolean class indicators reconstruct every setoid exactly, giving injectivity, idempotent closure with fixed-point classification, and non-strict and strict refinement as reverse inclusion. It packages the complete Galois correspondence with kernel reconstruction for observer license theories.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Enlarging an observer kernel can only shrink its Boolean license family, with exact reconstruction of the kernel. Proper kernel refinement is exactly proper reverse inclusion of license families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Kernels and Boolean license families form a Galois connection with exact reconstruction, idempotent closure, and strict refinement as strict reverse inclusion.
assumptions: Classical proposition decidability for Boolean class indicators
Quot.sound and propext for reconstruction

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file treats observer kernels as equivalence relations with refinement and licensing as inclusions. Every relation is the kernel of its quotient map, so observers modulo kernel are order-isomorphic to setoids and partitions. The joint observer gives the infimum kernel and the common coarsening the supremum with an EqvGen chain description, and license theories meet and join accordingly with parity as strictness control.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A target is licensed by the common coarsening iff licensed by each observer, while the joint observer licenses anything licensed by either with strict enlargement witnessed by parity. Two worlds merge in the coarsening exactly along finite agreement chains.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Observers modulo kernel are the partition lattice with joint infimum and coarsening supremum governing license theories, strictly separated by parity.
assumptions: Quot.sound for quotient equality
Choice of quotient representatives for inverse isomorphism

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines the stabilizer of permutations preserving each observer value with fiber transpositions. It proves licensed targets are exactly stabilizer invariants, fibers are stabilizer orbits, refinement is subgroup inclusion with kernel equality as stabilizer equality, and injectivity as trivial stabilizer. It gives the fiber-product decomposition with factorial counting and a two-point example where observer symmetry strictly exceeds named-constant automorphisms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A target is licensed iff invariant under all observer-preserving permutations, and refinement is stabilizer inclusion. Injectivity is exactly trivial stabilizer, while constant observers admit symmetries beyond fixed-constant automorphisms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Licensing, fibers, refinement and injectivity are exactly stabilizer invariance, orbits, inclusion and triviality with fiber-product structure, not language automorphisms.
assumptions: Classical decidability for defining transpositions without public decidability hypotheses

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines licensing on retained sets, correctness sets of decoders, maximal licensed sets, fiber-attained decoders, refused weight, menus and the repair frontier. It proves that every collision is either separated by a side channel or refused, that licensed sets are exactly decoder correctness sets, and that maximal ones correspond to fiber-attained decoders. It proves the least refusal equals the Bayes risk, the least lift equals the fiber multiplicity, and the frontier interpolates from total weight to Bayes risk to zero with diminishing returns.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: An observer licenses a target exactly when no collision exists; at a collision every repair must add distinguishing side information or drop a colliding state. With finite carriers the k-symbol frontier is total weight at k=0, Bayes risk at k=1, and zero exactly from the fiber multiplicity on.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The k-symbol repair frontier starts at total weight, equals Bayes risk at one symbol, vanishes exactly from the fiber multiplicity on, is antitone with diminishing returns, and every collision forces lift or refusal with both repairs non-unique.
assumptions: AddCommGroup Weight with LinearOrder and IsOrderedAddMonoid for finite cost sections
Fintype and DecidableEq for carriers, observations and targets in frontier sections
Nonempty V for retainedDecoder construction via Classical.choose
Classical choice for decoders, codes and exchanges
Rational priors with nonnegativity and sum one for Bayes-risk adapters
No sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file instantiates lift-or-refuse on the free recursor role gate and the diagonal guard. The dependency-pair channel is a least two-symbol lift of the role collision with refusal cost one half, while the blind pair observer has diagonal versus off-diagonal maximal refusals. The diagonal needs one side bit that exists abstractly but no Sigma void test supplies, yielding disequality inexpressibility and the SafeStep guard as the off-diagonal refusal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The recursor value observer licenses the role only after adding the dependency-pair bit, while the blind pair observer never licenses the diagonal without dropping states. No one-symbol lift repairs the diagonal, and no Sigma term read through its void test supplies the missing bit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The recursor role takes the lift via the dependency-pair channel with least two symbols while the diagonal guard takes the refusal with diagonal versus off-diagonal maximal sets and no Sigma void-test lift.
assumptions: FreeBoundaryKernel and Role types with generatorValue and actualDPChannel
SigmaTerm, evalSigma and void test
SafeStep and Step rewrite relations on Trace

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file proves the universal property of the lift and the absence of a universal refusal. Every observer refining q and licensing P refines their joint observer, which has the meet kernel. A greatest retained set on which q licenses P exists exactly when q licenses P, so no collision admits a greatest refusal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Lifts admit a universal greatest solution via the joint observer, while refusals admit no greatest retained set once a collision exists. The two-void collision is the control exhibiting the absent greatest refusal.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The joint observer is the greatest licensing refinement, but no greatest licensed retained set exists at any collision.
assumptions: Arbitrary types X Q V R
No Fintype, DecidableEq or prior hypotheses
No sorry, axiom, native_decide or classical choice visible

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Any r refining q, licensing P and universal among such has kernel equal to the meet of the two kernels.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines finite rational observation models, joints, marginals, derived posteriors, and the executable 0-1 Bayes decoder and risk by finite maximization. It proves Bayes optimality against deterministic and randomized decoders and the deterministic and randomized data-processing inequalities. It characterizes zero Bayes risk as licensing on joint support and exhibits the zero-mass collision where support purity holds without full-carrier licensing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: No deterministic, randomized or post-processed decoder beats the Bayes risk, and deterministic or randomized post-processing cannot lower it. Zero Bayes risk means licensing on positive joint support, which is strictly weaker than full-carrier licensing because a zero-mass collision is invisible to risk.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The executable Bayes decoder is optimal among deterministic and randomized decoders, post-processing cannot improve it, and zero Bayes error characterizes support licensing rather than full-carrier licensing.
assumptions: Fintype and DecidableEq on X O V C and O2
LinearOrder for argmax and argmin scores
Normalized rational prior with kernel row sums one
Enumeration EV with completeness for executable Bayes targets
No sorry or axiom; exhaustive finite search only, no efficiency claim

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines normal-form faithful simulations and proves transfer of unique reachable normals and unique normals under conversion. It proves termination transport through stuttering simulations with lexicographic descent. Fork collapse and loop-versus-empty controls show injectivity on normals and stutter descent are each necessary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Uniqueness and termination transfer only with normal preservation plus injectivity on normals and strict descent on stuttering steps. Collapsing distinct normals in the fork and erasing a loop without a rank both defeat transfer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Normal-form uniqueness and termination transfer through faithful simulations, while injectivity on normals and stutter descent are each necessary as shown by fork and loop controls.
assumptions: Arbitrary binary relations and first-order TRS Step and StepStar
Well-founded target and rank relations for termination transport
No sorry, axiom or native_decide; uses Relation.ReflTransGen and TransGen

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines the kernel Setoid of an observer, its quotient type with canonical projection and descended observer, kernel-respecting functions with a universal factor, and finite distributions with deterministic pushforward plus Shannon and Hartley functionals. It proves quotient equality coincides with observer equality, that every kernel-respecting function factors through the projection with a unique factor, and that pointwise-equal channels share pushforwards. It further proves pushforward, Shannon and Hartley quantities are preserved by the quotient factorization and exhibits a four-state parity observer that identifies even states while separating even from odd.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Two source states project to the same quotient point when their observer outputs agree and remain separate otherwise. Factorization through the projection is established for functions constant on observer fibers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Any function constant on observer fibers factors uniquely through the kernel quotient, preserving finite pushforward, Shannon and Hartley quantities.
assumptions: Fintype X with Fintype Y or Z and DecidableEq for finite pushforward and Hartley results
Quot.sound for quotient equality with function extensionality and Quotient induction for factorization and channel equalities

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This module defines verdict determination, collisions, fiber constancy and quotient factorization. It proves decoders imply fiber constancy, converse with inhabited verdicts or surjective observers, and quotient factorization equivalent to fiber constancy with failure exactly equivalent to a collision. The empty-world fixture has fiber constancy and no collision yet no total decoder.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Total decoder existence coincides with fiber constancy given inhabited verdicts or surjectivity, and quotient factorization fails exactly when a collision exists. The empty-world fixture has fiber constancy and no collision yet no total Unit to Empty decoder.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Decoder existence, fiber constancy and quotient factorization coincide up to inhabitance or surjectivity, with collisions as exact obstructions and the empty world showing why inhabitance is needed.
assumptions: Arbitrary World Observation Verdict types
Nonempty Verdict for decoder from fiber constancy, removed under surjectivity
Classical choice of image representatives; classical normalization isolated in negated-universal direction
No DecidableEq or inhabitance elsewhere; no sorry, axiom or native_decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines three trace coordinates for a duplicating trace and their step values, with the counter given by trace_ctr, the stack by trace_wraps and the copies by trace_pay. It shows the frame slot and the active-site slot of record terms both take the generator token gen, and combines these facts with emission and preservation to exhibit two distinct generator positions in the primitive duplicator right-hand side. It shows two distinct indices yield two distinct points of the progress-licensed quotient, giving nontriviality of the quotient from nontriviality of the index set. It shows the guarded step from eqW void void has void as its single reduct, giving guarded local joinability there.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: While i < k, the counter is the permutation-invariant strictly descending trace coordinate, separating it from stack and copy counts. The guard a ≠ b removes the reflexive overlap, so the guarded relation joins locally at eqW void void where the unguarded relation does not.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Together the file establishes the four paper clauses: counter uniqueness, the generator-token bridge with two distinct generator positions, nontriviality of the progress quotient, and guarded local joinability at eqW void void.
assumptions: i < k for counter descent
i ≠ j for two quotient points
Nontrivial I for quotient nontriviality
SafeStep hypothesis for single-reduct claim
set_option autoImplicit false with universes u v w

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines injective indexed orbit systems with progress observations, generated steps, and progress quotients identifying equal indices. It proves index relations are isomorphic to generated and quotient steps. On recursor terms, increasing indices are converse to transformed calls and isomorphic to wrapper expansion, finite countdowns match bounded prefixes, yet no infinite forward-call execution and no wrap-to-call simulation exist.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Forward transformed calls strictly decrease rank so no infinite execution exists and no map preserves all wrapper steps as forward calls. Finite countdowns match bounded wrapper prefixes, but the top of any prefix has an outgoing wrapper successor outside the prefix.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Increasing recursor indices are converse to transformed calls and match finite wrapper prefixes, yet infinite wrapper expansion cannot be simulated by forward calls.
assumptions: Injective indexed families over arbitrary index types
Classical choice for index equivalences and progress observations
RecursorTerm with dpRank, deltaPrefix, rootWeight and transformed-call relation
No sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines root steps for the r-ary duplicator and a same-input checker over shared certificate syntax. The base rule rewrites F x y Z to x and the step rule rewrites F x y (S n) to G (replicate r y) (F x y n). It proves the checker is sound and that canonical zero and successor certificates are accepted. It proves a strict compact binary certificate exists exactly for r-ary root steps, and for F-headed sources exactly for duplicator steps, while G-headed sources admit no such certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A strict compact binary certificate exists exactly for F-headed r-ary root steps. No G-framed source admits such a certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: For every arity r, strict compact binary certificates exist exactly for r-ary root steps and never for G-framed sources.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines a finite certificate syntax with rule tag, occurrence path, projection argument and two ranks, plus prefix-free serialization and a total deserializer. It defines a same-input Boolean checker that recomputes structural equalities and rank decrease without trusting claimed values. It proves the checker agrees with declarative meaning, is sound for free-recursion root steps, and is complete via an executable constructor that also survives faithful realizations. It lifts checking to serialized words and compact strict binary messages, proves existence of a strict binary certificate is equivalent to the root-step relation, and separates the serialized cost from an older assembly-cost formula.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Strict binary certificates exist exactly for free-recursion root steps and are rejected otherwise, including malformed or trailing inputs. The serialized seven-word successor cost differs from the old six-word assembly formula, so that formula is not a serialized-cost theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Strict compact binary certificates exist exactly for free-recursion root steps, with checked constructions that survive every faithful realization.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.ExtractionCertificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: ExtractionCertificate is a record with rule, activePath, projectionArg, rankBefore and rankAfter.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.serialize
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: serialize c lists certificate version, rule code, path length, path, projection argument and ranks.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.deserialize
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: deserialize xs returns some certificate when xs has the correct version, a known rule code, enough path words and exactly three suffix words, otherwise none.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.deserialize_serialize
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every certificate c, deserialize (serialize c) = some c.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.CertificateMeaning
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: CertificateMeaning source rhs c holds when for rule zero source is recR b s void with rhs b and empty path and zero ranks, and for rule succ source is recR b s (delta n) with rhs app s (recR b s n), path [1], projection 2 and ranks dpRank source and dpRank callee with before = after + 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.check
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: check source rhs c pattern-matches the rule and source and decides the same structural equalities and rank equations as CertificateMeaning without trusting claimed values.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.check_eq_true_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all source rhs c, check source rhs c = true if and only if CertificateMeaning source rhs c holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.check_sound_rootStep
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If check source rhs c = true then FreeRecursorStep source rhs holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.check_sound_successor
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If c.rule = succ and check (recR b s (delta n)) rhs c = true then rhs is app s (recR b s n), extractCall returns the callee, FreeRecursorDPPair holds and dpRank drops by one.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.zeroCertificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: zeroCertificate b s is the certificate with rule zero, empty path, projection 0 and zero ranks.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.successorCertificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: successorCertificate b s n uses rule succ, path [1], projection 2 and ranks dpRank (recR b s (delta n)) and dpRank (recR b s n).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.buildCertificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: buildCertificate source rhs returns the zero certificate when source is recR b s void and rhs is b, the successor certificate when source is recR b s (delta n) and rhs matches, otherwise none.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.buildCertificate_isSome_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all source rhs, (buildCertificate source rhs).isSome holds if and only if FreeRecursorStep source rhs holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.rootStep_has_checked_certificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If FreeRecursorStep source rhs holds then there is c with buildCertificate source rhs = some c and check source rhs c = true.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.faithful_rootStep_has_checked_certificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every faithful realization e and every FreeRecursorStep source rhs, there is c with buildCertificate source rhs = some c, check source rhs c = true and e.Root (e.encode source) (e.encode rhs).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.faithful_successor_certificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every faithful realization e and all b s n, the successor certificate checks true and the realized extractor returns the encoded callee.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.malformed_rule_rejected
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: deserialize [certificateVersion, 9, 0, 0, 0, 0] = none.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.trailing_words_rejected
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: deserialize [certificateVersion, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 99] = none.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.serializeBits
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: serializeBits c encodes the word count and then all certificate words with compact encodings.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.deserializeBitsPrefix
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: deserializeBitsPrefix bits decodes the word count, then the words, then a certificate, preserving the unconsumed tail, otherwise none.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.checkSerializedBitsStrict
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: checkSerializedBitsStrict source rhs bits is true only when prefix parsing consumes all bits and check holds for the parsed certificate.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.checkSerializedBitsStrict_sound_rootStep
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If checkSerializedBitsStrict source rhs bits = true then FreeRecursorStep source rhs holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.rootStep_has_strict_binary_certificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If FreeRecursorStep source rhs holds then there is c with buildCertificate source rhs = some c and checkSerializedBitsStrict source rhs (serializeBits c) = true.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.exists_strict_binary_certificate_iff_rootStep
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all source rhs, there exist bits with checkSerializedBitsStrict source rhs bits = true if and only if FreeRecursorStep source rhs holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.checkSerializedBitsStrict_rejects_trailing
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all source rhs c bit tail, checkSerializedBitsStrict source rhs (serializeBits c ++ bit :: tail) = false.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.sharedCertificateBits
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: sharedCertificateBits c is the sum of compact field-bit costs of the serialized certificate words.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.sharedCertificateBits_decomposition
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every c, sharedCertificateBits c = certificateEnvelopeBits c + descentEvidenceBits c.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorCertificateSyntax.assembly_model_not_serialized_word_count
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The length of serialize (successorCertificate void void void) is not equal to 4 * 1 + 2 + 0, so the old assembly formula is not a serialized word-count theorem.

relations.explanation: Strict binary certificate existence holds exactly for the free-recursion root-step relation.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file proves closed forms for the unary duplicator cumulative mass, including that twice the mass at height one equals beta times (k+1)(k+2). It derives the exact ratio of that mass to k squared and shows the ratio tends to beta over two as k grows. It also proves that the inefficiency coefficient at odd index 2N+1 is at least N when payload weight is at least one.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: The mass-to-square ratio converges to beta over two. Odd-index inefficiency grows without bound, with coefficient at 2N+1 at least N.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The unary mass-to-square ratio tends to half the payload size, and odd-index inefficiency grows at least linearly.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorRatioLimits.two_mul_conMassR_one
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all k and beta, 2 * conMassR k beta 1 = beta * ((k + 1) * (k + 2)).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorRatioLimits.conMassR_one_div_sq
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If 1 <= k then (conMassR k beta 1 : Real) / (k : Real)^2 = ((k : Real) + 1) * ((k : Real) + 2) * beta / (2 * (k : Real)^2).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorRatioLimits.tendsto_conMassR_one_div_sq
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every beta, the function k |-> (conMassR k beta 1 : Real) / (k : Real)^2 tends to (beta : Real) / 2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorRatioLimits.inefficiencyCoefficient_odd_index_ge
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If 1 <= w then (N : Real) <= inefficiencyCoefficient (2 * N + 1) w, for all N w.

relations.explanation: The exact closed form is used to compute the ratio and its limit.
relations.subject: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorRatioLimits.tendsto_conMassR_one_div_sq

relations.explanation: Odd-index inefficiency has an unbounded linear lower bound.
relations.subject: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorRatioLimits.inefficiencyCoefficient_odd_index_ge

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file proves that the schema step rule adds one frame and removes one successor layer from the counter. It shows frame count rises by one on each recursive firing of the canonical orbit, never decreases through the terminal base step, and that counter plus frames equals depth. It proves payload mass grows at least linearly with stage while the counter drops, and exhibits a base-rule case where payload frames leave with the erased argument.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Frame persistence holds for frames outside the erased payload along the canonical leaf-payload trace. The base rule erases payload-internal frames, so persistence fails for those frames.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Each recursive firing adds one frame while removing one counter layer, with frames monotone along the canonical trace except for payload frames erased by the base rule.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.stepRule_countG
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all x y n, countG (G y (F x y n)) = countG (F x y (S n)) + 1 + countG y.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.stepRule_ctr
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all x y n, ctr (F x y (S n)) = ctr (G y (F x y n)) + 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.baseRule_countG
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all x y, countG x <= countG (F x y Z).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.congG_countG_sub
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all y t t', countG (G y t') - countG (G y t) = countG t' - countG t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.orbit_countG_succ
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If i < k then countG (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k (i + 1)) = countG (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i) + 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.orbit_ctr_succ
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If i < k then ctr (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i) = ctr (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k (i + 1)) + 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.orbit_countG_mono
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If i <= j and j <= k + 1 then countG (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i) <= countG (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k j).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.orbit_frames_and_counter
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If i <= k then countG (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k (k + 1)) = k and ctr (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i) + countG (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i) = k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.orbit_payload_mass_ge
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If i <= k then (i + 1) * beta <= wsize alpha beta gamma phi zeta (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.orbit_counter_drop_payload_rise
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If i <= k then ctr (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i) + i = k and countPay (orbitState (base ia) (pay ib) k i) = i + 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RecursorTraceAsymmetry.baseRule_erases_payload_frames
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: countG (F (base 0) (G (pay 0) (base 1)) Z) = 1 and countG (base 0) = 0.

relations.explanation: Each firing increases frames by one along the canonical trace.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines common witnesses for observer fibers and decoders on the observer quotient for set-valued admissibility. It proves quotient recovery exists exactly when every fiber has a common witness, and that a conflicting pair refutes recovery. It shows pairwise compatibility follows from a common witness but does not imply it via a three-state fixture, embeds function-valued targets as singleton admissibility, and shows a constant-false decoder language can fail despite complete information.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Pairwise fiber compatibility holds on the three-state single fiber while global common-witness recovery fails. Direct information-level recovery can hold while a restricted constant-false language fails.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Quotient set-valued recovery holds exactly with fiber common witnesses, while pairwise compatibility and restricted languages do not suffice.
assumptions: classical choice via Classical.choose for the quotient decoder
classical tactic

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RelationalRecovery.FiberCommonWitness

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RelationalRecovery.PairConflictAt

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines fiber colorings where each nonempty color class shares an admissible certificate and proves a k-symbol side channel exists exactly when every fiber is k-colorable. It defines fiber chromatic numbers and their maximum as exact capacity, proving a side channel exists exactly above capacity and that singleton targets recover fiber multiplicity. It gives an exhaustive executable search returning least feasible alphabet or none, and shows the three-state fixture has capacity two with two colors succeeding and one failing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A side channel exists exactly when k reaches the capacity. The three-state fixture needs two symbols so one fails, and a certless state blocks all k.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The least side alphabet equals the maximum fiber chromatic number, two on the three-state fixture.
assumptions: classical choice for fiber chromatic numbers via Nat.find and choose
Fintype X for finite existence and optimality
DecidableEq X Q W and decidable admissibility for executable search
noncomputable definitions for fiber chromatic number and capacity

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: FiberColorable q admissible u k holds when some coloring X -> Fin k gives each nonempty color class a common admissible witness.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all q admissible k, there is a k-symbol partial side channel if and only if every fiber u is k-colorable.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RelationalSideCapacity.not_fiberColorable_of_no_certificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If x has no admissible certificate then its fiber is not k-colorable for any k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RelationalSideCapacity.no_sideChannel_of_no_certificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If x has no admissible certificate then no k-symbol side channel exists for any k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RelationalSideCapacity.singleton_sideChannel_iff_factorsThrough
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For singleton admissibility and any color c, a side channel exists if and only if the joint observation (q x, c x) determines P.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RelationalSideCapacity.fiberColorable_card
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If every state has a certificate then each fiber is (Fintype.card X)-colorable.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: fiberChromatic q admissible hadm u is the least k with k-colorability, defined by Nat.find.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.RelationalSideCapacity.fiberChromatic_spec

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines observer/color cells, common witnesses on sets, and partial decoders defined only on realized pairs. It proves a partial decoder exists exactly when every realized cell has a common witness, equivalently when every bad fiber subset without a common certificate is non-monochromatic. It exhibits a three-state fixture where every pair shares a certificate yet one side symbol fails while two symbols succeed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: One side symbol fails on the three-state fixture while two succeed. Pairwise compatibility holds, so the true requirement is higher-order hypergraph coloring.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Set-valued side channels are exactly fiber-hypergraph colorings, with the three-state case separating pairwise compatibility from two-color necessity.
assumptions: classical choice via Classical.choose for cell decoders
classical tactic

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: The file defines observation fibers, prior repeats, repeat depth as prior-repeat count, repeat status, and largest fiber size for finite-horizon observers. It proves depth values on a size-k fiber are exactly 0 to k-1, so target multiplicity equals largest fiber size and deficit equals its binary ceiling logarithm, attained by a rank channel. It classifies repeat status multiplicity and bit cost as zero/one for injective observers and one/two for noninjective ones, derives ceiling-average pigeonhole lower bounds, and proves no fixed finite side alphabet licenses exact depth at every horizon via the constant observer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Current observation alone licenses repeat status exactly for injective observers, with zero bits and multiplicity one, versus one bit and multiplicity two when noninjective. No fixed finite side alphabet licenses exact repeat depth at every horizon.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Largest fiber size gives exact depth cost and rank-channel optimality, status costs zero or one bit by injectivity, and no fixed finite alphabet works at all horizons.
assumptions: DecidableEq Q for finite-horizon fiber definitions
Fintype Q for pigeonhole corollaries
Classical.choice for arbitrary-Q statements via open Classical
Fintype R for side-channel minimality

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines rule-determined data families, imported data witnesses, and proof-valued soundness licenses. It extracts the actual KO7 rec_succ dependency pair with its singleton call graph and projection coordinate, certifies it, and shows renaming equivariance. It shows construction-rank selection and license availability are imported and hence not rule-determined, and supplies a concrete instance-level license from transformed to source termination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A data family is rule-determined when it factors through the declared rule view. Construction-rank choice and license availability share the rule view with different outputs, so they are imported and not rule-determined.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The concrete KO7 pair extraction is rule-determined with renaming invariance, while construction-rank choice and license availability are imported and not rule-determined, with a concrete proof-valued bridge to source termination.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file proves finite entropy laws for deterministic role partitions with explicit handling of zero-mass cells. Role entropy splits into partition-label entropy plus conditional within-cell entropy, in nats and in bits. The nonuniform active-versus-frame specialization spends exactly the binary entropy of the active mass and leaves frame-mass-weighted frame entropy, vanishing at the endpoints and for a single frame.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Finite role entropy splits into spent partition-label entropy and residual within-cell entropy. At active mass zero or one, or with a single frame role, one side vanishes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Every finite deterministic partition splits role entropy into spent label entropy plus residual within-cell entropy, with the active-frame case spending exactly the binary entropy of the active mass.
assumptions: Fintype and DecidableEq on role and cell types
normalized nonnegative finite laws
zero-mass cells use arbitrary default point mass

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file lifts partition entropy to arbitrary finite carriers, licensed-channel deficit, and overproduction gap. Mixing partition conditionals reconstructs the law and identifies deficit with spent label entropy. The r-ary dependency-pair channel is identified with the active-frame partition, with uniform spent and residual formulas and zero gap for binary one-frame.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Licensed-channel deficit equals spent partition information and the overproduction gap subtracts it from terminal Hartley entropy. In the uniform binary one-frame case the gap is zero, so the split resolves all role uncertainty.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Deterministic partitions realize the licensed deficit as spent bits and the r-ary dependency-pair channel is the active-frame partition, with zero gap in the binary one-frame case.
assumptions: arbitrary-universe finite carriers with DecidableEq and explicit Enumeration
normalized nonnegative laws on finite index carriers
one-cell evidence channel

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file builds a generic rule-invariant Galois connection for an arbitrary rule-indexed relation. Rule families and predicate families determine each other by one-step preservation, with antitone maps, idempotent closures, and singleton and family repairs. Deleting violators gives the greatest preserving subfamily and least exclusion, which partition the request.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Rules preserving every requested invariant are retained and rules failing one are excluded. Repair and exclusion partition the requested family into greatest preserving part and least exclusion.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Rule families and invariant families form an antitone Galois connection whose repair is the greatest preserving subfamily with least exclusion partitioning the request.
assumptions: arbitrary Rule and carrier types
one-step preservation only
propext and Quot.sound
Classical.choice only in union partition proof

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file proves the first-sufficient-horizon dichotomy for retained observation histories and the coarsest licensing memory. Licensing persists to longer horizons, so either no horizon licenses or exactly those above a unique first horizon do. The revealing observer first licenses the Boolean identity at one and the forgetting observer from zero, with the target-kernel quotient as coarsest memory.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Along retained histories a target is either licensed at no horizon or licensed exactly from a first horizon on. The revealing observer fixes that horizon at one and the forgetting observer at zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Retained histories admit a unique first licensing horizon, realized at one by the revealing observer and at zero by the forgetting observer, with the target-kernel quotient as coarsest licensing memory.
assumptions: arbitrary state, observation and target types
Classical choice via Nat.find for least horizon
propext and Quot.sound via licensing background

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines finite retained observation histories and proves refinement and licensing monotonicity. A history refines every stage it contains and longer histories refine shorter ones, so stage licensing transports to histories. The forgetting control shows current observation can lose the Boolean identity while the retained two-stage history keeps it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: A target licensed at a retained stage stays licensed by the whole history and longer histories. The forgetting observer loses the identity at stage one while the two-stage history retains it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Retained histories preserve licensing monotonically, so the forgetting observer history still licenses what its current stage forgets.
assumptions: arbitrary state and observation types
no concrete rewrite system or KO7 rule
finite retained histories

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file proves the finite-horizon Snell envelope for stopping models. Bellman values dominate stopping and every continuation, hence are the least excessive majorant. Where value differs from stopping value an attaining continuation exists, and stopping exactly at equality attains the value.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Bellman values dominate stopping and every legal continuation. The envelope stops exactly where value meets stopping value and otherwise continues with an attaining action.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Bellman values are the least excessive majorant and are attained by stopping exactly when value equals stopping value.
assumptions: arbitrary state and action types with DecidableEq
real rewards
Classical.choose for attaining action

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file defines sound Boolean verdicts and their weighted output laws. At an instance where the property holds every sound verdict returns true, so the output is a point mass with zero Shannon entropy. Since the free recursor terminates, this applies to termination verdicts at the recursor.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: At an instance where the property holds every sound verdict returns true, so any weighted family has point-mass output and zero entropy. The free recursor terminates, so this holds for termination verdicts there.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Every finite family of sound verdicts has zero-entropy output at any holding instance, in particular termination verdicts at the free recursor.
assumptions: arbitrary instance types
finite verdict families with real weights summing to one

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under the same weight and soundness hypotheses at a holding instance, Shannon entropy of the output law is zero.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file instantiates sufficiency with full observation as the deterministic identity model. Sufficiency there means constancy on positive-prior fibers, coinciding with licensing under full support and with Bayes-risk attainment. The target-kernel quotient is the coarsest sufficient observer, while the fully noisy binary identity and the empty world separate sufficiency from joint-support licensing and definability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: With a full-support prior an observer is sufficient exactly when it licenses the target and attains full-observation risk. In stochastic models this collapses, and Padoa definability fails for empty verdicts.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The target-kernel quotient is the coarsest sufficient observer, with stochastic separation and empty-verdict failure as sharp limits.
assumptions: finite source and observation types with rational priors for sufficiency
full-support prior for licensed equivalence
Nonempty verdict type for Padoa
arbitrary types for definability

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file constructs finite adapters for rewrite systems whose rules rewrite one nullary symbol to another, with step and reachability matching the symbol graph. The fork with s to a and b and both to c joins a and b, while the table observed without c has no common reduct and admits no adapter. The one-rule orbit f of x to f of S of x admits no finite adapter realizing any f of t.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: Constant systems rewriting one nullary symbol to another admit finite reduction-closed adapters with matching reachability. The fork observed without its join and the orbit f of S powers admit no such adapter.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: Every constant TRS has a finite adapter, while the observed fork and the infinite orbit give sharp no-adapter controls.
assumptions: explicit enumeration of signature
DecidableEq for symbols and variables
constant rules only for positive construction

OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: This file builds the canonical quotient of states by equality of target values. Any licensed observer refines this quotient and the quotient itself is licensed, giving the coarsest sufficient observer unique up to kernel. Joint observers give least common refinements and family licensing, with Boolean coordinates and a parity fixture showing non-vacuity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: An observer licenses a target exactly when it refines the target-kernel quotient, the coarsest such observer. Neither Boolean coordinate alone licenses the other.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: The target-kernel quotient is the unique-up-to-kernel coarsest licensed observer, with joint observers as least common refinements.
assumptions: arbitrary types with no finiteness or decidability
Quot.sound for quotient equality
Classical.choose only for range equivalence
