OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.summary: Defines integer dot product, coordinate increments and affine readings of finite coordinate observations, with constancy from a source and annihilation of reachable increments. Proves a relation-generic criterion: a reading is constant on all states reachable from a source iff its coefficients annihilate every reachable transition increment, and classifies agreement of two readings by initial equality plus annihilation by the coefficient difference. Builds an executable checker over a duplicate-free enumeration that searches for a reachable violating edge and proves it sound and complete against the generic criterion. Specializes to binary and arbitrary-arity recursor orbits, recovering trace conservation and trace-equivalence classifications and showing abstract coordinates equal readings of actual r-ary execution terms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.boundary: An affine reading is constant from a source exactly when its coefficients annihilate every reachable transition increment; otherwise a reachable violating edge exists and the finite checker returns one. On r-ary orbits this becomes the sharp alternative k = 0 or a = r·b + c, while trace equality fixes only a, b+d and r·b+c, leaving a one-integer offset ambiguity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OperationalInexpressibi.conclusion: An affine observation is conserved from a source exactly when its coefficients annihilate every reachable transition increment, decidable by a finite checker and classified as k=0 or a=r·b+c on r-ary orbits.
assumptions: DecidableEq S for the finite checker section
DecidableRel R for executable reachability and edge tests
duplicate-free complete Enumeration S supplying the finite index presentation
universe variables u v for carrier types

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.dot
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a dimension d, dot takes coefficient and coordinate vectors c x : Fin d → Int to the sum over i of c i * x i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.increment
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a state type S, dimension d and observation obs : S → Fin d → Int, increment obs s t at states s t is fun i => obs t i - obs s i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.reading
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For coeff : Fin d → Int, offset : Int and obs : S → Fin d → Int, reading coeff offset obs s equals offset + dot coeff (obs s) at state s.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.ConstantFrom
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a relation R on S, source : S, coeff, offset and obs, ConstantFrom R source coeff offset obs means for every t with ReflTransGen R source t, reading coeff offset obs t equals reading at source.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.AnnihilatesReachableIncrements
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For R, source, coeff and obs, AnnihilatesReachableIncrements R source coeff obs means for all s t with ReflTransGen R source s and R s t, dot coeff (increment obs s t) = 0.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.constantFrom_iff_annihilatesReachableIncrements
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every R, source, coeff, offset and obs, ConstantFrom R source coeff offset obs holds if and only if AnnihilatesReachableIncrements R source coeff obs holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.coeffDiff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For c1 c2 : Fin d → Int, coeffDiff c1 c2 is fun i => c1 i - c2 i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.ReadingsAgreeFrom
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For R, source, c1 c2 : Fin d → Int, o1 o2 : Int and obs, ReadingsAgreeFrom means for every t with ReflTransGen R source t, reading c1 o1 obs t equals reading c2 o2 obs t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.readingsAgreeFrom_iff_initial_and_increment_difference
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every R, source, c1 c2, o1 o2 and obs, ReadingsAgreeFrom holds iff reading c1 o1 obs source equals reading c2 o2 obs source and AnnihilatesReachableIncrements R source (coeffDiff c1 c2) obs holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.IsViolatingEdge
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For R, source, coeff : Fin d → Int, obs and e : S x S, IsViolatingEdge R source coeff obs e means ReflTransGen R source e.1 and R e.1 e.2 and dot coeff (increment obs e.1 e.2) != 0.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.failingReachableEdge?
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Assuming DecidableEq S, enumeration E : Enumeration S, DecidableRel R, source, coeff and obs, failingReachableEdge? E R source coeff obs is the first element of enumeratedPairs E satisfying violatingEdgeB E R source coeff obs, if any.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.conservedFromB
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Assuming DecidableEq S, E : Enumeration S, DecidableRel R, source, coeff and obs with no offset argument, conservedFromB E R source coeff obs is decide (failingReachableEdge? E R source coeff obs = none).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.failingReachableEdge?_eq_none_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Assuming DecidableEq S, E, DecidableRel R, source, coeff and obs, failingReachableEdge? E R source coeff obs = none iff AnnihilatesReachableIncrements R source coeff obs holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.conservedFromB_eq_true_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Assuming DecidableEq S, E, DecidableRel R, source, coeff, offset and obs, conservedFromB E R source coeff obs = true iff ConstantFrom R source coeff offset obs holds, for every offset.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.binary_trace_conservation_classification
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c : Int and k : Nat, (k = 0 or a = b + c) iff ConservedAlong a b c k holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.binary_full_affine_conservation_classification
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c d : Int, FullAffineConservedEverywhere a b c d holds iff a = b + c.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.binary_trace_equivalence_classification
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c d a' b' c' d' : Int, TraceEquivalent a b c d a' b' c' d' holds iff a = a' and b + c = b' + c' and b + d = b' + d'.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.binary_trace_equivalence_offset_shift
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c d a' b' c' d' : Int, TraceEquivalent holds iff there exists z : Int with a' = a and b' = b + z and c' = c - z and d' = d - z.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.raryAffineCoordinate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c : Int and k arity i : Nat, raryAffineCoordinate a b c k arity i equals a * ((k - i : Nat) : Int) + b * ((arity * i + 1 : Nat) : Int) + c * (i : Int).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.RaryConservedAlong
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c : Int and k arity : Nat, RaryConservedAlong a b c k arity means for every i with i < k, raryAffineCoordinate at (i+1) equals raryAffineCoordinate at i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.raryConservedAlong_iff_zeroDepth_or_balance
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every a b c k arity, RaryConservedAlong a b c k arity holds iff k = 0 or a = (arity : Int) * b + c.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.RaryTraceEquivalent
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For arity : Nat and a b c d a' b' c' d' : Int, RaryTraceEquivalent means for all k i with i <= k, raryFullAffineCoordinate a b c d k arity i equals raryFullAffineCoordinate a' b' c' d' k arity i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.raryTraceEquivalent_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every arity and a b c d a' b' c' d', RaryTraceEquivalent holds iff a = a' and b + d = b' + d' and (arity : Int) * b + c = (arity : Int) * b' + c'.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.raryTraceEquivalent_iff_offsetShift
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every arity and coefficients, RaryTraceEquivalent holds iff there exists z : Int with a' = a and b' = b + z and c' = c - (arity : Int) * z and d' = d - z.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.actualRaryReading
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c : Int and ia ib k arity i : Nat, actualRaryReading a b c ia ib k arity i is a * (countSuccR t : Int) + b * (countPayR t : Int) + c * (countWrapR t : Int) where t is rOrbit (.base ia) (.pay ib) k arity i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.ActualRaryConservedAlong
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For a b c ia ib k arity, ActualRaryConservedAlong means for every i < k, actualRaryReading at (i+1) equals actualRaryReading at i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.actualRaryConservedAlong_iff_zeroDepth_or_balance
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every a b c ia ib k arity, ActualRaryConservedAlong holds iff k = 0 or a = (arity : Int) * b + c.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.ActualRaryTraceEquivalent
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For arity and a b c d a' b' c' d' : Int, ActualRaryTraceEquivalent means for all ia ib k i with i <= k, actualRaryFullReading at ia ib k arity i agrees for the two coefficient tuples.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.actualRaryTraceEquivalent_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every arity and coefficients, ActualRaryTraceEquivalent holds iff a = a' and b + d = b' + d' and (arity : Int) * b + c = (arity : Int) * b' + c'.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.TransitionConservation.actualRaryReading_eq_affine
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every a b c ia ib k arity i with hypothesis i <= k, actualRaryReading a b c ia ib k arity i equals raryAffineCoordinate a b c k arity i.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.summary: Records a closed seven-row tag-level universe of named ordered-semiring bases and their matrix-algebra targets. Defines the total lift function, the uniform preservesMonotonicity tag, and the exhaustive enumerations. Proves the unconditional five-part conjunction of totality, exhaustiveness, image structure, universal monotonicity status and non-vacuity by decide and rfl.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.conclusion: Over the closed seven-row universe every named base semiring lifts to a matrix algebra with monotone status, exhaustively and non-vacuously.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.summary: Packages a uniform tag-keyed barrier certificate with affine Nat-valued scalarization, order-respect and unboundedness. Proves unconditionally that no such certificate-backed monotone matrix interpretation over any base-semiring lift orients the duplicating step, with a global-system version. Discharges the arctic, tropical and natural rows explicitly from existing matrix measures and dominance shims.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.boundary: For every base-semiring tag equipped with a Nat-valued affine scalarization certificate with order-respect and unboundedness, no monotone matrix interpretation over its lift can orient the duplicating step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.conclusion: No certificate-backed monotone matrix interpretation over any of the seven lifted algebras orients the duplicating step, discharged explicitly for arctic, tropical and natural rows.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.summary: Isolates the theorem-backed subclass of natural, arctic and tropical rows and characterizes it exactly. Constructs a concrete monotone 1x1 Boolean interpretation on a two-point schema whose induced system globally orients the duplicating step. Packages this as a boundary theorem showing the certificate-free blanket barrier fails on the Boolean row.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.boundary: The certificate-backed barrier holds on the natural, arctic and tropical rows but the blanket certificate-free claim fails on the Boolean row, where a monotone 1x1 Boolean interpretation globally orients the duplicating step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.conclusion: The unconditional certificate-free matrix-lift barrier is false because the Boolean row admits an explicit monotone globally orienting interpretation.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy.lean.summary: Provides generic slow-growing and Cichon hierarchy definitions on ordinal notations below epsilon-zero by well-founded recursion on fundamental sequences. Proves their unfolding equations for successor and limit notations and their values at zero, one and two. The file intentionally makes no connection to KO7 relations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy.lean.conclusion: Slow-growing and Cichon hierarchies are defined by well-founded recursion on ordinal notations below epsilon-zero.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.slowGrowing
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Function from ONote and Nat to Nat defined by recursion on fundamental sequences: zero at empty sequence, successor case adds one, limit case evaluates at f i, terminating by ordinal decrease.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.slowGrowing_def
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis fundamentalSequence o equals x, slowGrowing o unfolds to the corresponding match on x and fundamental-sequence property.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.slowGrowing_succ
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis fundamentalSequence o equals inl (some a), slowGrowing o equals fun i => slowGrowing a i plus one.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.slowGrowing_limit
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis fundamentalSequence o equals inr f, slowGrowing o equals fun i => slowGrowing (f i) i.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.cichon
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Function from ONote and Nat to Nat defined by recursion: zero at empty sequence, successor case is succ of cichon a at i+1, limit case is succ of cichon (f i) at i+1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.cichon_def
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis fundamentalSequence o equals x, cichon o unfolds to the corresponding match on x and fundamental-sequence property.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.cichon_succ
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis fundamentalSequence o equals inl (some a), cichon o equals fun i => succ of cichon a at i+1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.cichon_limit
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis fundamentalSequence o equals inr f, cichon o equals fun i => succ of cichon (f i) at i+1.

relations.explanation: Both hierarchies recurse on the same fundamental-sequence structure for ordinal notations.
relations.subject: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.slowGrowing

relations.explanation: The Cichon hierarchy is the controlled-length variant alongside the slow-growing hierarchy.

OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy_Contro.summary: Defines exact controlled descent that must land exactly on the fundamental-sequence approximant, with an endpoint-tracking relation and its length projection. Proves by induction that any such exact chain of length n from o with control k satisfies n at most cichon o k. Notes this does not allow smaller descendants beneath the approximant.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy_Contro.boundary: Exact fundamental-sequence descent has length at most cichon o k, while descent to arbitrary smaller notations below the approximant is not covered and remains the gap for a full Moser-Weiermann extraction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy_Contro.conclusion: Every exact fundamental-sequence descent chain has length bounded by the Cichon value.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.ExactControlledPow
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Inductive endpoint-tracking relation with refl at length zero, succ step via predecessor a, and limit step via f k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.ExactControlledPath
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Existential length-only projection stating there exist endpoint r and control k-prime with ExactControlledPow o k n r k-prime.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.exactControlledPow_length_le_cichon
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all o r k k-prime n, if ExactControlledPow o k n r k-prime then n is at most cichon o k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.exactControlledPath_length_le_cichon
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypothesis ExactControlledPath o k n, n is at most cichon o k.

relations.explanation: The length-only path is the existential projection of the endpoint-tracking descent.
relations.subject: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.ExactControlledPath

relations.explanation: The path bound follows directly from the endpoint-tracking Cichon bound.
relations.subject: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.exactControlledPath_length_le_cichon

OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy_Contro.summary: Computes cichon 5 at 1 equals 5 and cichon omega at 1 equals 3 by kernel unfolding to refute same-control monotonicity of cichon in ordinal representation. Defines an exploratory relaxed controlled descent allowing jumps to any notation below the fundamental-sequence approximant. Records that this relaxed route is unsound for the attempted Cichon bound and provides no derivation-length bound.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy_Contro.boundary: Ordinal order does not imply Cichon order: 5 is below omega yet cichon 5 at 1 equals 5 exceeds cichon omega at 1 equals 3, so same-control monotonicity is false and cannot justify relaxed descent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/OrdinalHierarchy_Contro.conclusion: Same-control Cichon monotonicity is false, so the relaxed below-approximant route cannot be bounded that way.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.omegaNote
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The ordinal notation oadd 1 1 0 representing omega, with no hypotheses.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.cichon_ofNat_five_one_eq_five
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Cichon of the numeral 5 at control 1 equals 5.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Cichon of omegaNote at control 1 equals 3, using that its fundamental sequence is fun i => ofNat (i+1).

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: It is false that for all notations a b and control k, a.repr at most b.repr implies cichon a k at most cichon b k.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.OrdinalHierarchy.ControlledPath
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Length-only abbreviation for ControlledPow o k n.

Provides the canonical matrix using the count function itself. Lifts any such matrix to a direct whole-term observer that evaluates the distinguished coordinate with natural order.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PayloadExposureMatrix.l.conclusion: The canonical payload exposure matrix lifts to a direct whole-term observer that reads the distinguished payload coordinate.

OperatorKO7/Meta/PolyInterpretation_Fami.summary: Introduces the parametric nonlinear family Wa with recursor offset a and its positive rescaling Wam, proving every member with a at least 1 orients all eight root rules and yields well-foundedness. Classifies orientation, literal equality, projective equivalence and full-order equivalence exactly by the parameters, with scale contributing no new shape. Proves unbounded discrete multiplicity and infinitely many full-order classes among actual orienters, while all orienters share one rewrite-edge order class.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolyInterpretation_Fami.boundary: Members orient all root steps exactly when recursor offset a is at least 1 and scale m is at least 1; full strict orders distinguish every a while the rewrite-edge-only order collapses all orienting members to one class.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolyInterpretation_Fami.conclusion: There are infinitely many pairwise non-equivalent full-order root orienters with scale contributing no new projective shape and all sharing one rewrite-edge order.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Parametric interpretation replacing recursor constant 1 by a: Wa a of recDelta b s n equals (Wa a n +1) times (Wa a s + Wa a b + a), other clauses add one.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.wf_StepRev_Wa

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wa_mono_parameter

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wa_parameter_le_iff_pointwise_le
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all a a-prime, a at most a-prime iff Wa a t at most Wa a-prime t for every t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wa_one_eq_W
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every t, Wa 1 t equals W t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wa_recΔ_void

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wa_injective

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wa_not_proportional

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wam

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wam_orients_step

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wam_orients_all_steps_iff

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.NatProjectivelyEquivalent

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wam_projectivelyEquivalent_iff
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under hypotheses 1 at most m and 1 at most m-prime, Wam a m is projectively equivalent to Wam a-prime m-prime iff a equals a-prime.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.two_nonproportional_orienters

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.Wam_same_full_order_iff

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.Family.rootOrienterFullOrderQuotient_infinite

OperatorKO7/Meta/PolyInterpretation_Full.summary: Defines the nonlinear polynomial interpretation W with multiplicative recursor coupling. Proves W is everywhere positive, strictly orients all eight KO7 root rules, and yields well-foundedness of the reverse step relation. Separately proves W violates successor transparency and is neither additive nor affine in the listed senses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolyInterpretation_Full.boundary: The nonlinear W orients all eight root rules and proves termination, while it lies outside the transparent, additive and affine classes that the barrier theorems rule out.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolyInterpretation_Full.conclusion: The nonlinear polynomial interpretation W strictly orients every KO7 root step and proves full root termination while violating transparency, additivity and affinity.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.PolyInterpretation.W_not_affine
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: There are no constants alpha beta gamma delta-r with W of recDelta b s n equal to alpha + beta W b + gamma W s + delta-r W n for all b s n.

OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialBarrierGenera.summary: Specializes the generalized degree-bounded polynomial barrier to KO7. Proves no global orientation under unboundedness plus frozen base dominance, with successor-pump and wrap-pump variants. States the necessary shape condition that any successful polynomial escape must violate base dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialBarrierGenera.boundary: A bounded polynomial measure that is unbounded and eventually dominated at the base cannot globally orient KO7; any successful polynomial escape must therefore violate base dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialBarrierGenera.conclusion: KO7 admits no globally orienting bounded polynomial measure under unboundedness plus frozen base dominance, via successor or wrap pumps.

OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialBarrierGenera.summary: Defines finite polynomial monomials and bounded polynomial-table measures with affine succ and wrap plus a polynomial recursor table and frozen source and target polynomials at the base point. Proves the generalized barrier that unbounded range plus eventual frozen dominance rules out uniform dup-step orientation, with successor and wrap pump specializations. Lifts the barrier to global orientation and states escape requires failure of base dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialBarrierGenera.boundary: Finite polynomial tables with unbounded range that are eventually dominated at the frozen base point cannot orient the duplicating step; orienting tables must break that dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialBarrierGenera.conclusion: Unbounded finite polynomial measures satisfying frozen base dominance cannot orient the duplicating step or its global system.

OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialPayloadObserv.summary: Develops finite monomial tables over payload-count vectors with cross-coupling and net algebraic dominance conditions that force strict table increase when the target coordinate rises. Builds a direct whole-term observer from dominance data and proves it cannot orient its rule or globally orient its family. Exhibits a cross-coupled dominance inhabitant and a dominance-free two-coordinate escape table and family that globally orients despite duplicating the distinguished payload.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialPayloadObserv.boundary: When algebraic net dominance holds a strict rise in the target coordinate forces the table to rise, ruling out observer orientation; without dominance a table can fall while the distinguished coordinate rises and can globally orient its family.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PolynomialPayloadObserv.conclusion: Dominance forces strict table increase and rules out global orientation, while the dominance-free escape table and family show orientation is possible without it.

OperatorKO7/Meta/PrecedenceBarrier.lean.summary: Defines pure head-precedence measures that rank a term solely by its outermost constructor. Evaluates them via the head-precedence measure. Proves no such family globally orients the step relation, using the collapsing merge_cancel obstruction.

OperatorKO7/Meta/PrecedenceBarrier.lean.conclusion: No pure head-precedence measure globally orients the step relation.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectedPrimaryBarrier.summary: Packages the projected-primary dominance pattern where an ambient order forces a designated scalar projection to be nonincreasing while that scalar is an unbounded affine measure. Proves the stronger nonstrict scalar barrier with successor and wrap pump corollaries and the generic dominance theorem with its global version. Specializes back to tracked componentwise and tracked-primary lexicographic vector families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectedPrimaryBarrier.boundary: If an ambient order only forces a Nat-valued affine primary projection to be nonincreasing while the duplicating step forces that primary scalar to rise without bound, the ambient order cannot orient the step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectedPrimaryBarrier.conclusion: Any ambient order dominated by an unbounded affine primary projection cannot orient the duplicating step, covering componentwise and lexicographic vector families.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectionAsConservativ.summary: Defines witness languages and one-way conservative extensions as implications between HasWitness propositions, with transport to HasWitness and kappaLe. Instantiates the benchmark projection from imported-whole to transformed-call by ignoring the source and returning the independently available transformed-call witness. Packages this as a reflection-family ascent profile that realizes the six-step shape and is compatible with DP.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectionAsConservativ.boundary: The benchmark projection is one-way: it proves target transformed-call availability from any source proof but does not transport source dependence or reflect back without stronger assumptions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectionAsConservativ.conclusion: The benchmark imported-whole to transformed-call projection is sound one-way and instantiates a reflection-family ascent profile compatible with DP.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectionTransactionDy.summary: The file builds licensed rank, projective-emitter, coherent, semantic-kernel, generator-preserving, conservation and stage-indexed transaction layers over duplicating systems and reads each as a projection transaction with dimension, license and forgetting boundary. It proves that on constructor-generated schemas, and on the free primitive duplicator, stage-indexed families with invariant licenses and with invariant projection, invariant dimension or a semantic-kernel completion induce static projection families, including canonical-trace, terminal and shadow staticity. It also constructs free instances realizing the computation-to-confession bridge and counterexamples showing that license invariance alone does not imply ambient staticity and that raw emitters need not admit semantic-kernel completions on arbitrary carriers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectionTransactionDy.boundary: With invariant licenses on a constructor-generated carrier, stage-indexed projection families are static. Without dimension control or without a semantic-kernel completion on an arbitrary carrier, staticity fails, as shown by an off-trace anomalous emitter and an obstructed carrier with no projection rank.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProjectionTransactionDy.conclusion: On constructor-generated carriers with invariant licenses, each packaged transaction layer induces a static projection-transaction family, while raw projective data alone and raw faithful data on arbitrary carriers do not force ambient staticity or completion.
assumptions: GeneratedByConstructors hypothesis for all generated-carrier theorems
LicenseInvariant or stage-indexed license invariance at every stage
EmitterProjectionInvariant and EmitterDimensionInvariant where stated
projectedSeedZero normalization at the base seed
1 ≤ K for computation-to-confession bridge theorems
Classical.choice in the noncomputable inducedProjectionTransaction; no sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.EmitterProjectionInvariant

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.EmitterLicenseInvariant

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.EmitterDimensionInvariant

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.IsCanonicalStaticProjectionFamily
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A family is canonically static when its induced dimension agrees on every canonical trace and wrap chain, its licenses agree, and its forgetting boundaries agree with stage zero.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.IsCanonicalShadowStaticStageIndexedFamily
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A raw stage-indexed family is shadow-static when its shadow dimensions, shadow record coordinates and licenses all agree with stage zero at every shadow observation.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.FaithfulEmitterSemanticKernelCompletion
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A semantic-kernel completion of a faithful emitter is a semantic projection kernel together with a proof that its projected rank at the base seed is zero.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.FaithfulEmitterSemanticKernelCompletion.inducedProjectionTransaction
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a faithful emitter, a nonempty completion, a license and its proof, the choice-based completion determines a canonical projection transaction using classical choice.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.generated_rank_projection_transaction_static_of_licenseInvariant
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the schema is generated by constructors and a rank-transaction family has invariant licenses, then its induced projection-transaction family is static.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.generated_projective_emitter_transaction_static_of_invariants
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the schema is generated by constructors and a licensed projective-emitter family has invariant projection maps and invariant licenses, then its induced projection-transaction family is static.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.generated_projective_emitter_transaction_canonical_static_of_licenseInvariant
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the schema is generated by constructors and licenses are invariant, then a licensed projective-emitter family is already static on the canonical trace and terminal image with matching forgetting boundary and without any dimension hypothesis.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.generated_semanticKernel_emitter_transaction_static_of_licenseInvariant
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the schema is generated by constructors and licenses are invariant, then the semantic-kernel transaction family induces a fully ambient-static projection family because the semantic kernel is unique.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.generated_faithful_emitter_transaction_static_of_completionExists

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.freeAnomalousProjectiveRecordEmitter

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.freeRawProjectiveEmitterCounterexample

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.freeRawProjectiveEmitterCounterexample_not_static

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.obstructionBaseSystem

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary.lea.summary: The file models proof-search states with target, known constraints, open obligations, proposal and claim status, and defines consumption of applicable blockers, its persistence along proposal steps, sound audits, self-application gaps and diagnostic-consumption boundaries. It proves that a sound gap refutes consumption, that a reachable gap refutes persistence, and that an explicit trace to a gap or an unsupported promotion yields a first-crossing failure object. It further separates correction discharge from promotion migration, characterizes unsupported promotion and demotion, and shows that a refusal clause makes consumption equivalent to licensing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary.lea.boundary: Consumption holds while every known applicable blocker is handled and fails at the first proposal edge to a non-consuming state. A soundly audited self-application gap or a certified unsupported promotion lies on the failing side and refutes persistence of the prescription or license.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary.lea.conclusion: Sound self-application gaps and certified unsupported promotions locate the exact first boundary where diagnostic consumption or licensing is lost and refute persistence along the proposal dynamics.
assumptions: DecidablePred for Consumes in first-crossing extraction theorems
DecidablePred for Licensed in the licensed first-crossing theorem
AuditSound linking audit rejection to failure of handling
DecidableEq on ClaimStatus for Commits and license decidability
Classical.byContradiction used for consumption as emptiness of Bad; no sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.ClaimStatus
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A proposal claim status is one of open, conditional, certified or withdrawn.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.ProofSearchState
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A proof-search state consists of a target, known constraints, open obligations, a proposal and its claim status.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.Consumes
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A state consumes when every known constraint applicable to its target, obligations and proposal is handled by that proposal.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.PrescriptionPersistent
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A prescription is persistent at a source when consumption holds at the source and at every state reachable under the proposal dynamics.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.SelfApplicationGap
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A self-application gap holds when some known constraint applies to the state's own proposal and the audit rejects that proposal under that constraint.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DiagnosticConsumptionBoundary
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A diagnostic-consumption boundary is a proposal edge from a consuming state to a non-consuming state.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.UnsupportedPromotion
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An unsupported promotion is a certified state whose proposal leaves some known applicable blocker unhandled, hence which does not consume.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.UnsupportedDemotion
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: An unsupported demotion is a withdrawn state in which every known applicable blocker is handled.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.PersistentLicensed
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Persistent licensing requires every state reachable under the proposal dynamics to be licensed, meaning certification implies consumption.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.Bad
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A constraint is bad for a state when it is known, applicable to the current proposal, and unhandled.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.CorrectionDischarges
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A correction discharges a constraint when it was known, applicable and unhandled before revision and the revised proposal handles it or it no longer applies.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.PromotionMigrates
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A promotion migrates when a constraint is known, applicable and unhandled both before and after revision.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.CertifiedPromotionMigration
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A certified promotion migration holds when a prior active defect still applies and remains unhandled in a revised certified state, without requiring the defect to stay in the revised known list.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.ConsumesWithRefusal
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Consumption with refusal holds when every known applicable blocker is handled or the state does not certify.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.not_prescriptionPersistent_iff_exists_failureObject
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given that the source consumes and consumption is decidable, failure of prescription persistence is equivalent to existence of a proof-relevant first-crossing failure object from the source.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.selfApplicationGap_not_consumes
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the audit is sound and a state has a self-application gap, then that state does not consume.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.selfApplicationGap_implies_not_prescriptionPersistent
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the audit is sound and a gap state is reachable from a source under the proposal dynamics, then the prescription is not persistent at the source, with no decidability hypothesis.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.selfApplicationGap_implies_first_diagnosticConsumption_boundary
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given decidable consumption, a sound audit, an explicit path from a consuming source to a self-application gap, consumption at the source, and the gap, there is a failure object whose last-safe to first-fail edge is a diagnostic-consumption boundary.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.reachable_selfApplicationGap_yields_failureObject_and_refutes_persistence
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given decidable consumption, a sound audit, consumption at the source, reachability of a gap, and the gap itself, there is a finite path carrying a failure object to the gap and prescription persistence fails at the source.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.promotionMigrates_not_consumes
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If a constraint migrates from an old state to a revised state in the sense of PromotionMigrates, then the revised state does not consume.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.not_correctionDischarges_of_promotionMigrates
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If a constraint migrates across a revision, then that revision does not discharge the same constraint.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.unsupportedPromotion_iff_not_licensed
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every state, being an unsupported promotion is equivalent to being unlicensed, proved by splitting on the decidable certified status.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.unsupportedPromotion_yields_first_diagnosticConsumption_boundary
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given decidable consumption, an explicit path from a consuming source to an unsupported promotion yields a failure object whose crossing edge is a diagnostic-consumption boundary.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.first_unsupportedPromotion_boundary
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given decidable licensing, an explicit path from a licensed source to an unsupported promotion yields a licensed failure object with a licensing crossing edge whose first-fail state is itself an unsupported promotion.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.consumesWithRefusal_iff_licensed
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every state, consumption with the refusal clause is equivalent to being licensed.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.downgrade_removes_promotion_with_refusal
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the revised state does not certify, then with the refusal clause it resolves every prior active defect and is licensed.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.sameProposal_not_correctionRemovesPromotion
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the revised state keeps the same target, obligations and proposal and the old state has an active defect, then the revision does not remove the promotion without the refusal clause.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Dow.summary: This file gives a Horn-calculus characterization of the DownOn invariant as the intersection of relations closed under DownStepOn. It defines ordered pairs, diagonal facts on a carrier list, and rules that use finite premise-set membership as support. It proves soundness and completeness between DownOn and Horn derivability, yielding an iff and a least-closed property. It then excludes unfounded and self-certified pairs, illustrated by distinct variables x and y in the empty system that cite each other locally but never enter DownOn.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Dow.boundary: Pairs whose every supporting step stays inside an unfounded set or cites the pair itself lie outside DownOn despite local justification. Grounded derivability as least fixed point is the boundary between such cyclic self-support and membership in the invariant.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Dow.conclusion: DownOn is exactly the Horn-derivable least closed relation, so unfounded and self-citing pairs never belong to it.
assumptions: DecidableEq (Term (sigma plus sigma) nu) for Finset premises, omitted in hornDeriv_downOn and downOn_least_closed

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.DownPair
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: DownPair sigma nu is the type of ordered pairs of terms over sigma plus sigma with variables nu.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.downFacts
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For carrier list A, downFacts A holds of p when p first equals p second and p first is in A.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.downRule
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For A, R, Finset P and q, downRule A R P q holds when DownStepOn A R with support membership in P holds for q first and second.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.hornDeriv_downOn
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If HornDeriv from downFacts A and downRule A R derives p then DownOn A R holds for p first and second.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.downOn_hornDeriv
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If DownOn A R holds for a and b then HornDeriv from downFacts A and downRule A R derives pair a comma b.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.downOn_iff_hornDeriv
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: DownOn A R a b holds if and only if HornDeriv from downFacts A and downRule A R derives a comma b.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.downOn_least_closed
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If E is closed under DownStepOn for A and R and DownStepOn with DownOn support holds for a and b then E holds for a and b.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.downOn_excludes_unfounded
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If U contains no downFacts and every downRule concluding in U needs a premise in U then DownOn A R a b implies not U of a comma b.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.downOn_not_self_certified
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If t is not equal to u and every Finset P with downRule A R P of t comma u contains t comma u then not DownOn A R t u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.selfCertified_hypothesis_fails_in_carrier
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If t and u are in A and t is not equal to u then it is false that every downRule derivation of t comma u cites t comma u, by symmetry from singleton u comma t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.MutualCitation.emptyTRS
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: emptyTRS is the empty rewrite system over Unit plus Unit with variable type Nat.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.MutualCitation.varX
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: varX is term var 0 over Unit plus Unit.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.MutualCitation.varY
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: varY is term var 1 over Unit plus Unit.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.MutualCitation.xyCarrier
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: xyCarrier is the list containing varX and varY.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.MutualCitation.xy_mutual_local_justification
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: downRule with xyCarrier and emptyTRS derives varX comma varY from singleton varY comma varX and symmetrically.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.MutualCitation.xy_not_downOn
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Neither DownOn xyCarrier emptyTRS varX varY nor DownOn with varY varX holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ProofSearchBoundary.DownLeast.MutualCitation.mutual_citation_locally_justified_not_derivable
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Mutual local justification for both pairs holds while neither pair is in DownOn.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Ech.summary: The file builds psEpisode instantiating the echo-law Episode with proof-search states, constraints as objects, audit rejection as answers, claim statuses as records and Consumes as distinction. It proves unsupported promotion coincides with false formal legitimacy and that an object-witnessed distinction excludes echo states by clearing the known list. It instantiates KlopTrace and O3 episodes with decidable audits, showing s2 and t2 are false formally legitimate with informative channel at s2 while the withdrawn state is not. It defines five-axis and four-axis grade projections and records full classifications of s2 and t2 with grade (1,1,0,0,0).
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Ech.boundary: A licensed emission needs both status equality and licensed consumption, so unlicensed certified status is false formal legitimacy. When the distinction is object-witnessed, no echo state can coexist, separating informative channels from echo states.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Ech.conclusion: Object-witnessed distinction excludes echo states, and the KlopTrace celebration s2 and the O3 state t2 are classified as unsupported promotions with false formal legitimacy and grade (1,1,0,0,0).
assumptions: Applicable, Handles and AuditRejects parameters with Decidable AuditRejects
kernel only with Mathlib baseline
set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/F65.summary: This file models a proof-search episode around unique normal forms with target problem79UN and a self-containment blocker for a proposed reduction to linHub NoFeasibleOverlap. It defines certified and withdrawn states and proves the certified claim does not consume while the withdrawn state is licensed, with a self-application gap and unsupported promotion on the certified side. It proves the residual NoFeasibleOverlap forces constants c and d apart, giving distinct normal forms whose non-convertibility follows from the residual. It shows the residual hypothesis fails for Huet and KO7 controls that admit feasible overlaps and records support arithmetic and the episode grade.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/F65.boundary: A certified reduction that does not consume its blocker is audit-rejected on one side of the boundary while withdrawal is licensed on the other. The residual separates c and d where it holds, while Huet and KO7 systems lie outside by admitting feasible overlaps.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/F65.conclusion: The residual forces distinct normal forms c and d apart to give a unique-normal-form instance, while the certified reduction is an unsupported promotion that must be withdrawn and the residual fails on Huet and KO7 controls.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Gra.summary: This file defines five-axis grade vectors for recognition construction transport progress and supervision and a diagnostically closed predicate for proof-search states. It assigns grades to O3 state t2, celebration state s2, withdrawn state s2withdraw and the two-element Boolean model. It proves each coordinate from blocker membership, proposal identity, Consumes behavior, concrete counterexamples or underivability, and audit rejection. It shows t2 and s2 are diagnostically closed yet prescriptively open while withdrawal restores license and the Boolean model achieves transport and progress.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Gra.boundary: Diagnostically closed states that handle or audit-reject every applicable blocker still lie outside prescription when Consumes fails, as at t2 and s2. Only the exact state t3 and the Boolean model cross to consuming behavior and unique normal forms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Gra.conclusion: O3 t2 and celebration s2 are diagnostically closed yet prescriptively open, withdrawal restores license, and the Boolean model achieves transport with unique normal forms.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Gro.summary: This file defines grounded finite Horn derivability with fact and rule cases and its iterated finset closure hornClosure. It proves unfounded components with no facts and premise-closed rules never enter derivations at any finite stage. It develops support substitution for explicit proof expressions with named assumptions, giving erase-then-union identities with exact cardinality costs and strict drop only for grounded replacements.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Gro.boundary: Grounded derivability as least fixed point excludes unfounded self-supporting sets at every finite stage, while cyclic rational-tree data may remain legitimate under separate coinductive conditions. For support, circular replacement keeps size while grounded replacement with h not in D strictly shrinks it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Gro.conclusion: Unfounded components never enter Horn closure and assumption substitution obeys erase-then-union with exact cardinality costs, dropping strictly only for grounded replacements.
assumptions: DecidableEq alpha for Finset support operations

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Klo.summary: This file models a proof-search episode for transitivity of Down R with open, certified, withdrawn and recommendation states. It builds NextProposal and EpisodeStep paths and extracts distinct Consumes and Licensed failure boundaries on different edges. It links lemma36 at Down R to leave transitivity as the remaining premise and shows the closing claim needs transitivity. It proves the celebration Horn rules with same-rule join as fact do not derive transitivity or closure but do close once transitivity is added.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Klo.boundary: Consumes fails at the s0 to s1 edge while Licensed fails only at the s1 to s2 certification edge, so diagnosis and prescription have different boundaries. Transitivity and closure lie outside grounded derivation from the same-rule join alone but inside once transitivity is granted.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/Klo.conclusion: Consumes and Licensed boundaries occur on different edges and the closing claim is underivable from the same-rule join alone, becoming derivable only with transitivity.
assumptions: Classical propDecidable for Consumes via noncomputable instance

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/O3R.summary: This file defines O3 terms with zero succ G and F and the counting measure rho with residual indicator eps and exact step change. It gives counterexamples where naive and corrected drop identities fail while the exact identity holds and a polynomial interpretation polyM orients both rules to prove contextual termination. It models a four-state proof-search trace from diagnose to exact identity where correction discharges duplication but migrates the nested residual, leaving t2 non-consuming with the first Consumes boundary at t0 to t1. It characterizes handling semantically via actual versus claimed delta.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/O3R.boundary: Proposed one-unit and payload-corrected drops hold on one side but fail on successor-headed and copied-payload instances, while the exact rho plus eps identity and polyM decrease hold generally. Prescriptively t2 remains non-consuming after correction, with the Consumes boundary at t0 to t1 and diagnostic closure without prescription.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofSearchBoundary/O3R.conclusion: Exact rho change plus polynomial decrease prove contextual termination while naive and corrected drops fail and t2 stays non-consuming with the first boundary at t0 to t1.
assumptions: Classical propDecidable for Consumes via noncomputable instance

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofTheoreticRegister..summary: The file defines ascent families, formula classes and formal theories, plus six-step structural profiles and reflection and diagonal evidence structures. It registers the dependency-pair confession on the primitive duplicator as realizing the six-step shape and as a reflection-family ascent with the Arts-Giesl 2000 license, explicitly not a Lawvere-Yanofsky diagonal. It records the Arts-Giesl license as Pi02, formalizable in ISigma1 and provable in PRA for fixed finite TRSs, stores a reverse-mathematical calibration target as a conjecture, and proves a constant-overhead linear bound for residual proof work.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofTheoreticRegister..boundary: The base layer is blocked with no direct-whole witness while the transformed layer succeeds only after admitting the external Arts-Giesl license. The dependency-pair confession lies on the reflection side of the diagonal versus reflection divide, not on the Lawvere-Yanofsky diagonal side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofTheoreticRegister..conclusion: The dependency-pair confession is a reflection-family ascent with singleton certificate and Arts-Giesl license, not a Lawvere-Yanofsky diagonal, with Pi02 ISigma1 PRA licensing and linear residual work plus constant overhead.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofTheoreticRegister/.summary: The file places the dependency-pair confession profile and the Godel compiled-arithmetic ascent profile under one six-step licensed-ascent shape. It proves both profiles realize the shape, the Godel side with provable arithmetic facts and no stage stipulated True. It proves comparison at the shape layer is degenerate: membership is six true stages plus the reflection tag, any two realized profiles of the same family compare, and hom-sets are subsingletons, with the same degeneracy for LCEL comparison. It then separates layers by showing the Godel checker maps into quotation while orientation and quotation admit no morphism either way, although all three realize the shape and compare at the shape layer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofTheoreticRegister/.boundary: At the six-step shape layer any two realized reflection-family profiles compare with subsingleton hom-sets, so the classification transports; at the carrier and witness layer it does not: the Godel checker maps into quotation while orientation and quotation admit no morphism either way.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ProofTheoreticRegister/.conclusion: Both the dependency-pair and Godel profiles realize the same six-step reflection shape with degenerate comparison, while witness-layer morphisms do not transfer.

OperatorKO7/Meta/PumpedBarrierClasses.le.summary: The file specializes schema-level pumped barriers to the concrete KO7 system and schema. For ten measure classes including affine, quadratic, cross-quadratic, matrix pairs, multilinear, max-plus, polynomial, matrix-functional and matrix-mix, it proves no measure globally orients KO7. Each theorem takes the pumped measure as input and applies the corresponding schema theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PumpedBarrierClasses.le.boundary: No measure in any of the ten listed pumped classes can globally orient KO7, because the explicit successor or wrapper pump in the input forces failure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PumpedBarrierClasses.le.conclusion: No pumped measure in any of the ten listed classes globally orients the KO7 system.
concepts: affine quadratic polynomial matrix max-plus measures
assumptions: each theorem hypothesizes a measure M in the named with-pump class, which carries its explicit pump witness

OperatorKO7/Meta/PumpedBarrierClasses_Sc.summary: The file defines nine schema-generic pumped measure classes carrying explicit successor or wrapper growth witnesses. It proves unconditional duplicating-step barriers for each class and lifts them to global non-orientation for any step-duplicating system. Matrix-functional and matrix-mix cases are reduced to affine pumps through projection and coordinate sums.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PumpedBarrierClasses_Sc.boundary: For any step-duplicating schema or system, a measure carrying an explicit pump cannot orient the duplicating step and hence cannot globally orient the system.
OperatorKO7/Meta/PumpedBarrierClasses_Sc.conclusion: Every pumped class fails to orient the duplicating step and therefore fails globally.
assumptions: pump witnesses has_pump, has_primary_pump and has_sum_pump carried by each class
packaged boundedness and dominance witnesses h_bounded and h_dominated for cross-term, multilinear and polynomial classes

OperatorKO7/Meta/QuadraticBarrier.lean.boundary: Restricted quadratic counter measures with unbounded range or an explicit pump cannot globally orient KO7.

OperatorKO7/Meta/QuadraticBarrier_Schema.summary: The file defines constructor-local quadratic counter measures with an affine successor and wrapper plus a counter-square recursor term. It proves pump lower bounds for successor and wrapper iterates. It proves duplicating-step and global barriers under unboundedness or pump hypotheses, plus non-representability of any global orienter.
OperatorKO7/Meta/QuadraticBarrier_Schema.boundary: Quadratic counter measures with unbounded range or pump cannot orient the duplicating step and hence cannot globally orient any step-duplicating system containing it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/QuadraticBarrier_Schema.conclusion: Unbounded or pumped quadratic counter measures cannot orient the duplicating step or any global system containing it.
assumptions: unbounded-range hypothesis or explicit pump inequalities, with wrap_left and wrap_right positivity fields in the measure

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSAlgebraicInterpreta.summary: Fixes the 14-row algebraic-interpretation inventory with length, duplicate-freeness and membership completeness. Assigns each row a barrier, conditional-barrier or escape status matching the universe and one of eight positive mechanisms. Introduces explicit hypothesis structures for the five conditional rows and proves a closure marker bundling inventory, status, mechanism and hypotheses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSAlgebraicInterpreta.conclusion: The 14-row algebraic-interpretation layer is closed with exact statuses, mechanisms and conditional hypotheses.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSBoundaryBottleneck..summary: The file defines three witness layers W0, W1 and W2 with distinct Nat truth-level and Bool boundary-admissibility orderings. It defines layered witnesses with direct, abstract construction and projection-transaction cases plus per-layer admissibility lemmas. It packages a W0 and W2 premise into a bottleneck structure, proves W0 blocked with W2 admissible, and separates boundary-relative acceptance from truth-level existence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSBoundaryBottleneck..boundary: Only W2 projection-transaction witnesses are boundary-admissible while W0 direct and W1 construction witnesses are blocked, and truth-level order is explicitly distinct from boundary admissibility.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSBoundaryBottleneck..conclusion: Under a W0 and W2 premise the W0 witness is boundary-blocked while the W2 witness succeeds, with truth-level distinct from boundary-level.
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false
BoundaryBottleneck existence requires a supplied ProjectionTransactionEscape R; layered-witness nonemptiness via W1_construction needs no payload

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSConditionalTypedAtl.summary: The file closes the 13 conditional, constrained, higher-order and type-based rows with length, nodup, completeness and terminal statuses. It defines local row, mechanism and typing-hypothesis enums with atlas projection and per-row status, mechanism and hypothesis pins. It proves non-typing rows carry no hypothesis, typing rows carry one, with mechanism-status alignment, packed into a layer-closed marker.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSConditionalTypedAtl.boundary: Definitional admitters admit RDRS without reaching orientation, typing-barrier rows reject RDRS by forbidding duplication under an explicit hypothesis, and remaining rows need conditional escape or imports.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSConditionalTypedAtl.conclusion: The 13-row conditional and typed lane is closed with aligned mechanisms, terminal statuses and explicit typing-barrier hypotheses.
concepts: conditional constrained higher-order and type-based methods
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageEvidenceLed.summary: This file adds the semantic layer over the 76-row status ledger, defining a finite standard KBO, its weight and precedence order, and proving no such KBO orients the KO7 duplicating rule. It defines the exact DP subterm certificate and the finite usable-rules root closure with its least fixed point and projection descent. It then defines RowClaim, closed MethodInterpretation carriers, curated reasons and the total 16 theorem-backed versus 60 curated disposition, closing both the legacy evidence ledger and the full 76-row native ledger.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageEvidenceLed.boundary: In the legacy adapter interface 16 rows carry exact method propositions while 60 curated rows carry no semantic claim and have no interpretation; the native layer closes the gap so all 76 rows carry method-native evidence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageEvidenceLed.conclusion: The 76-row ledger is closed with 16 theorem-backed rows carrying exact carrier propositions, 60 curated legacy rows carrying provably no claim, and all 76 rows carrying native method evidence.
assumptions: noncomputable definition OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.Native.nativeMethodInterpretation

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.StandardKBO
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Structure of an admissible finite standard KBO on the schema signature: positive variable weight, symbol weights with constant weight at least variable weight, injective precedence rank, zero weight allowed only for succ, and if succ has zero weight it is precedence-maximal.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.SchemaKBOGt
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Inductive finite standard KBO greater-than on schema terms with weight-strict, zero-weight unary-variable, strict root-precedence at equal weight, and lexicographic arms for succ, wrap and recur, where every arm carries the standard variable condition.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.StandardKBORecSuccObstruction
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Structure for a carrier K stating no schema orientation between dupSrc and dupTgt, source and target instantiations equal the stated KO7 traces, and the corresponding Step.R_rec_succ root step holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.standardKBO_no_ko7_rec_succ
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every StandardKBO K, StandardKBORecSuccObstruction K holds: no finite standard KBO orients the KO7 duplicating recursor-successor root rule, with schema terms tied to an actual Step.R_rec_succ instance.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.StandardKBORowClaim
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Proposition that for all StandardKBO K, StandardKBORecSuccObstruction K holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.DPSubtermCriterionRowClaim
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Conjunction stating the canonical certificate has projectionIndex equal to 2 and projectionIndex_paper equal to 3, strict rank descent on every DPPair, and WellFounded DPPairRev.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.ko7_dpSubtermCriterion_row_anchor
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: With no hypotheses, DPSubtermCriterionRowClaim holds via the canonical exact KO7 DP certificate, its strict descent and reverse well-foundedness.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.KO7DPPairUsableRulesCertificate
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Structure indexed by a symbolic RHS schema and rule list stating exact RHS, exact defined roots, generated rules, extraction of every DPPair to the schema, exact rule list, fixed point, root closure, leastness among root-closed candidates containing recSucc, retention of the duplicating rule, complete Step enumeration, retained projection strictness, and reverse well-foundedness.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.ko7_usableRules_rootClosure_minimality_anchor
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: With no hypotheses, KO7DPPairUsableRulesCertificate holds at ko7DPRhsSchema and ko7GeneratedUsableRules ko7DPRhsSchema, giving the least root-closed usable set with exact DP projection descent.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.UsableRulesConcreteRowClaim
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Proposition that KO7DPPairUsableRulesCertificate holds at ko7DPRhsSchema and its generated usable rules.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.RowClaim
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Function from RDRSMethodFamily and U6Classification to Prop that on the 16 theorem-backed pairs returns the exact full anchor proposition for that row and on every other pair returns False, so curated rows make no semantic claim.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.MethodInterpretation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Indexed inductive family of concrete method objects with one constructor per theorem-backed row, including finite KBOs, exact DP certificate, usable-rules pair, filters, processors, sharing, quotient and size-change methods, with the row fixed by the constructor.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.rowClaim_of_interpretation
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every family f and every MethodInterpretation i for f, RowClaim f (u6ClassOf f) holds via the row's exact anchor theorem.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.RDRSCoverageLedger.Evidence.AnchorInstanceHolds
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Proposition matching on a MethodInterpretation to state its anchor theorem instantiated at its own carrier, including KBO obstructions, descent denials, DP strict descent, retained projection decrease, and unary-signature negations.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageLedger.lean.summary: This file is the status audit ledger assigning each of the 76 termination-method families a ten-column record with constructor, certificate, lens, seed-collapse, projection, coordinate, six-way class and Lean identifier. It defines the U6Classification refinement and proves the bucket counts partition the universe with the temporaryUnclassified bucket empty. It closes the ledger with CoverageLedgerClosed and its inhabitant rdrs_coverage_ledger_closed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageLedger.lean.boundary: Direct payload-sensitive certificates are blocked by the lens-pump barrier while other methods escape only through projection transactions, path-order or typing constructions, licensed transformations, or by violating direct syntax, with no row left temporarily unclassified.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageLedger.lean.conclusion: The six-way classification is total over the 76 families with counts 28, 8, 7, 13, 20 and 0 partitioning the universe and every ledger row agreeing with its classifier.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageLedgerSeed..summary: The file defines a five-way coverage classification for the 76-family RDRS termination-method universe and a ledger row recording family, Lean module, theorem identifier, classification, and friction note. It defines the master lookup coverageClassOf with module, theorem, and friction maps, plus the full row list and five filtered family lists. It proves by decide that the counts are 21 blocked, 8 projection-escape, 15 construction-escape, 20 not-direct, and 12 needs-proof, totaling 76, with every family classified. It packages these facts in CoverageSeedClosed and proves the seed-closed theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageLedgerSeed..boundary: Families classified .blocked admit a direct payload-sensitive barrier with extractable lens or pump certificate, while .projectionEscape, .constructionEscape, .notDirect, and .needsDirectUniverseProof families escape it by projection, construction, definitional exclusion, or a missing hypothesis certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSCoverageLedgerSeed..conclusion: The 76-family universe is fully classified with proved counts 21, 8, 15, 20, and 12 and a closed seed certificate.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDPProcessorClassifi.summary: Defines a 16-row DP-processor inventory split into seven projection, three inheritance and five neutral rows plus a usable-rules boundary. Characterizes projection as closing by erasing the duplicated slot, inheritance as requiring a duplication-tolerant base order, and neutral rows as needing projection pairing. Matches local statuses to universe statuses, bounds usable-rules elimination to projection pairing, and packages a closed classification certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDPProcessorClassifi.boundary: Projection rows close by erasing the duplicated slot; inheritance rows inherit a duplication-tolerant base-order obligation; neutral and usable-rules rows do not eliminate the duplicating rule without projection pairing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDPProcessorClassifi.conclusion: The 16-row DP-processor classification is closed with projection and inheritance exactness and projection-only usable-rules elimination.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDescentLens.lean.summary: The file defines an abstract one-step interface RDRSStep with left and right sides, an orientation predicate Orients, a descent lens with projected order and nonincrease clause, and a pump-violation existence predicate. It proves that a lens together with an exhibited violation implies negation of orientation. It records an audit anchor string for that local-contradiction theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDescentLens.lean.boundary: Orientation is refuted by exhibiting a single pump violation; the file proves only this local one-step contradiction and makes no claim about ruling out infinite runs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDescentLens.lean.conclusion: A single descent-lens pump violation implies the step relation is not oriented.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDescentLensWellFoun.summary: The file adds a well-founded strict codomain order to the descent lens and proves that a well-founded lens makes the reverse projected relation well founded. It proves no well-founded relation admits an infinite descending sequence and hence no infinite chain exists for an oriented step relation with such a lens. It constructs natStep and increasingLens on the reverse natural order with orientation and an infinite identity chain, proving the reverse order not well founded. It packages these as an exact counterexample to deleting the well-foundedness field.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDescentLensWellFoun.boundary: With a well-founded strict codomain order, an oriented step relation admits no infinite chain; without that field, orientation plus a lens does not bound the run, as the increasing lens with an infinite identity chain shows.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDescentLensWellFoun.conclusion: A well-founded lens rules out infinite oriented chains, and deleting well-foundedness makes that global claim false.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDirectBarrierScope..summary: The file defines the fourteen-family formalized direct-barrier grammar, seven named escape mechanisms, and a 21-method universe with classifiers for family, reason, scope, and scope witnesses. It proves unconditionally that inside holds exactly with a grammar family, escape holds exactly with a reason, the two exclude and exhaust, and families lie in the fourteen-list. It proves escape totality and that the four scope-violation escapes violate their InScope sentinels, with witnesses that both sides are nonempty.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDirectBarrierScope..boundary: Fourteen method representatives fall inside the formalized direct-barrier grammar while seven escape by named transform, oracle, labeling, computability, quotient, sharing, or co-order mechanisms; the four scope-violation escapes provably violate their InScope sentinels.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSDirectBarrierScope..conclusion: Every method is either inside the fourteen-family grammar or escapes by a named mechanism, exclusively and exhaustively, with scope-violation escapes provably out of scope.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSFreeRecursorErasure.summary: The file presents the free-recursor successor rule as an RDRS step and proves its instances are exactly successor-counter root steps. It defines an erasure replacing step arguments by zero and proves it is a payload erasure. It deduces that erased measures orient, every orienting measure is counter-dominated, and no semantic or certified direct measure is decisively payload-sensitive. It exhibits a counter-plus-payload weight that orients, reads the payload, and is counter-dominated.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSFreeRecursorErasure.boundary: Every orienting semantic measure is counter-dominated and none is decisively payload-sensitive, although payload-reading orienting measures exist, as the counter-plus-payload weight shows.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSFreeRecursorErasure.conclusion: No semantic or certified direct measure is decisively payload-sensitive on the successor rule and every orienting measure is counter-dominated, even one that reads the payload.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSMechanicalDirectnes.summary: The file defines closed-code mechanical measures, five forbidden routes, route environments with discriminators, single-route variation, and nondependence with inhabited variations. It proves mechanical evaluation independent of each route and all routes together, with a route-sensitive control showing dependence is possible. It bridges each mechanical measure to a semantic certificate preserving the measure, proves every reflected evaluator payload-monotone, and exhibits a non-monotone semantic measure outside the mechanical image, with the counter projection as an orienting counter-dominated witness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSMechanicalDirectnes.boundary: Mechanical evaluation is extensionally independent of all five modeled route inputs, but the mechanical image is strictly smaller than the semantic certificate tier; the claim covers only modeled slots and not historical provenance or unmodeled channels.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSMechanicalDirectnes.conclusion: Every mechanical measure is route-independent and payload-monotone, yet a non-monotone semantic measure with the same nondependence proofs lies outside the mechanical image.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSMethodCertificate.l.summary: The file pairs raw direct-measure syntax with a normalized certificate of strict descent or abstain, plus deterministic normalization and a decidable syntactic payloadSensitive? test. It proves normalization total, soundness and completeness of the test against containsPayloadOccur, abstain behavior at both levels, and a raw-level biconditional for strict payload-containing certificates. It includes payload-only and counter-only smoke pins and imports no semantic substrate.

Each carrier has a counted distinguished payload with one occurrence on the left and two on the right and a positive duplication gap. Each system is also realized as a semantic RDRS step with a payload-erasure witness, proving every certified semantic direct measure is blocked from decisive payload-sensitive orientation, conjoined in one unconditional theorem.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSNonKO7Instances.lea.conclusion: Every certified semantic direct measure on each of the three named non-KO7 RDRS steps is blocked from decisive payload-sensitive orientation.
