OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSRecursiveFamilyBoun.summary: This file lands the foundational unconditional boundary for step-duplicating recursive families. It defines families, orbits, and uniform-cost measures with delta, recursor and merge equations. It proves orbit mass is linear in counter depth, hence outside uniform-cost orientation, and mass-indistinguishable from circular references, with a catalog builder for downstream clusters.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSRecursiveFamilyBoun.boundary: Uniform-cost measures satisfying delta, recursor and merge cost equations see linear orbit mass and cannot orient; escape requires violating a cost equation such as DP counter projection.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSRecursiveFamilyBoun.conclusion: Every step-duplicating recursive family has linear orbit mass under any uniform-cost measure and is mass-indistinguishable from a circular reference.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSReflectedDirectMeas.summary: This file gives a computable classifier over owned additive syntax for direct measures on the counter-payload carrier. It defines counter, payload and constant coefficients with an evaluation function equal to its linear form. It proves counter-positive expressions orient and are counter-dominated while zero-counter expressions never orient, with payload coefficient separating blocked from blind, and total sound classification.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSReflectedDirectMeas.boundary: Positive counter coefficient orients and is counter-dominated, while zero counter coefficient never orients; positive payload coefficient is payload-sensitive blocked and zero is payload-blind.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSReflectedDirectMeas.conclusion: The computable reflected classifier is total and sound, splitting additive measures into counter-dominated orienting, payload-sensitive blocked, and payload-blind non-orienting.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSRetainedCoordinate..summary: This file defines static retained hypotheses with multiplicity coordinates, counter, and gauge invariance, plus non-descending and seed-collapse descent obstructions. It proves retained-coordinate factorisation through the counter only in factor-map-hypothesis form. A Boolean two-point step and identity transaction show unrestricted factorization is false, packaged as an exact sufficient-versus-false boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSRetainedCoordinate..boundary: With an explicit factor map the retained coordinate factors through the recursion counter, while without it unconditional factorization is false via a two-point Bool counterexample.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSRetainedCoordinate..conclusion: Counter factorisation holds exactly under an explicit factor map and fails unconditionally, as shown by a two-point Bool counterexample.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticArbitraryCl.summary: This file states semantic theorems over arbitrary measure functions rather than inspecting Lean source. It proves a payload-erasure dominance lemma where the erased measure is payload-independent and orienting, hence every orienting measure is counter-dominated and none is decisively payload-sensitive. It gives a classical total two-label classifier with soundness and a canonical counter-first-lex instance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticArbitraryCl.boundary: Under payload erasure every orienting semantic measure is counter-dominated and none is decisively payload-sensitive; the total classifier splits into lens-pump blocked versus counter-dominated orientation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticArbitraryCl.conclusion: On any payload-erasing step, and in particular the canonical counter-first-lex step, no arbitrary semantic measure is decisively payload-sensitive.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticClassifier..summary: Defines a six-label semantic certificate class and a five-constructor normalized certificate carrying either typed descent or escape evidence or String audit notes. Defines a total classifier from normalized certificates to labels. Proves totality, zero unclassified output, and soundness: blocked cases carry a decisive lens-pump descent refuting orientation, escape cases carry projected orientation, and construction, transform and not-direct cases are structurally outside the direct branch.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticClassifier..boundary: Every normalized certificate classifies to a productive label and never to TEMPORARY_UNCLASSIFIED, but only inside the closed five-constructor grammar and not for arbitrary raw Lean evidence. A blocked certificate refutes orientation for its measure while a projection-escape certificate transports orientation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticClassifier..conclusion: Every normalized semantic certificate classifies to a productive label with soundness: blocked cases do not orient and escape cases orient in the stated single-step sense.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticCoverageLed.summary: Defines a sixteen-row ledger combining nine counterexample rows with adjudication, lens-pump, classifier, and four hardening rows, each with directness and payload metadata. Adds a proof-bearing mirror where six projection rows store anchor-indexed hardened witnesses and a row-indexed claim system splits twelve typed rows from four curated rows. Proves sixteen-row length, bucket partition, zero unclassified, zero axiom-footprint strings, agreement with the audit, no plain-erasure escapes, and typed evidence for every projection row.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticCoverageLed.boundary: Inside the closed sixteen-row ledger every row has a productive label with zero TEMPORARY_UNCLASSIFIED and every projection-escape row carries hardened four-obligation evidence. The ledger does not certify termination of any concrete rewriting system, arbitrary Lean normalization, or the separate 76-row method atlas.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticCoverageLed.conclusion: The sixteen-row semantic ledger is closed with the stated 1 plus 6 plus 3 plus 1 plus 5 plus 0 partition, no unclassified rows, no plain-erasure escapes, and typed evidence for every projection row.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticDirectMeasu.summary: Defines bare semantic measure data with carrier, strict order, well-foundedness, and measure function, plus caller-selected directness evidence with five propositions and proofs. Packages both into a certified semantic direct measure with projections and a five-part direct-constructor law. Proves the law holds by projection and exhibits a constant Nat measure to show the interface is nonempty.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticDirectMeasu.boundary: A packaged SemanticDirectMeasure satisfies the five-part DirectConstructorLaw by projection, while bare measure data alone does not. The five evidence fields may be True, so the package records attestation rather than verified source directness and does not decide directness of arbitrary Lean functions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticDirectMeasu.conclusion: Every certified semantic direct measure satisfies its direct-constructor law, and such measures exist.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticLensPump.le.summary: Defines a semantic lens-pump witness as a triple where the strict measure order fails between right- and left-hand sides. Packages a decisive payload-sensitive certificate together with such a witness as a separate obligation. Proves that any witness contradicts universal orientation and projects that barrier to packaged descents.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticLensPump.le.boundary: A single triple where the strict order fails suffices to refute universal orientation for that measure. Without such a witness the barrier yields no refutation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticLensPump.le.conclusion: Any measure with a lens-pump witness does not orient its step, including the packaged decisive-descent form.
assumptions: for all B S N T, R : RDRSStep B S N T, and M : SemanticMeasureData T; lens-pump witness is a separate stored obligation

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticNormalizedR.summary: Introduces the canonical counter-first-lex step on Nat times Nat and a closed five-shape raw grammar with total compilation to measure data. Uses grammar membership itself as structural directness evidence and defines a total raw classifier. Derives lens-pump witnesses structurally for blocked shapes, proves they do not orient, and characterizes not-direct shapes as orienting or payload-blind, closing with a grammar-closed certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticNormalizedR.boundary: Totality, zero residual, and derived lens-pump witnesses hold over the closed five-shape grammar on the canonical step. They do not extend to arbitrary raw Lean functions, which is recorded as mathematically impossible without source-code reflection.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticNormalizedR.conclusion: The closed raw grammar has total classification with derived witnesses for blocked shapes refuting orientation and the stated orienting-or-blind split for not-direct shapes.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticPayloadSens.summary: Defines payload observables and lenses over abstract RDRS steps, with raw, counter-forgetting, counter-dominated and decisive payload-sensitivity predicates over semantic measure data. Proves that decisive payload sensitivity implies not counter-forgetting by using the orientation conjunct with the forgetting witness as a forbidden dominated alternative. Provides the counter-first-lex step on Nat times Nat with identity measure as a worked example that is raw payload-sensitive but not decisive through an explicit payload-blind orienter. Records that counter-domination constrains only the lhs and rhs images and that directness certificates live elsewhere.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticPayloadSens.boundary: Raw payload sensitivity holds on one side of the boundary and decisive payload sensitivity fails on the other, as shown by the counter-first-lex measure. Decisive sensitivity therefore excludes counter-forgetting and counter-dominated measures.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticPayloadSens.conclusion: Decisive payload sensitivity strictly refines raw payload sensitivity, with the counter-first-lex measure raw-sensitive but not decisive.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticProjectionT.summary: Defines a semantic projection transaction packaging a commuting projection with a projected step and well-founded semantic measure data, plus an escape adding projected orientation. Proves that the lifted measure orients the source step and that every commuting projection with an orienting measure yields an escape. Proves an escape exists exactly when some semantic measure orients the step and extracts sigma, seed-collapse, orientation and well-foundedness from every escape. Gives an identity-projection Nat witness for non-vacuity while stressing single-step transport is not a termination theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticProjectionT.boundary: Single-step orientation transport holds while source-system strong normalization and full dependency-pair soundness fail to follow. Every map factors through the identity seed collapse, so the escape adds no condition beyond orientability and does not imply payload forgetting.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticProjectionT.conclusion: Projected orientation transports back to the source through a commuting projection, and an escape exists exactly when some well-founded semantic measure orients the step.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticProjectionT.summary: Records four facts about every semantic projection escape and wires escapes into the legacy bridge through the identity seed collapse with trivial counter data. Proves retained-coordinate factorisation only under a caller-supplied factor map and recasts lifted orientation as witness transport for the dependency-pair bridge. Exhibits a canonical first-projection on the counter-first-lex step that forgets payload and factors through a payload-forgetting collapse, alongside an identity-projection control that keeps payload. Packages a canonical DP chain, hardened soundness, a W0-blocked and W2-succeeds bottleneck split, and search-budget invariance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticProjectionT.boundary: Payload forgetting holds for the canonical first-projection but fails for the identity projection, so the escape record itself does not imply forgetting. W0 witnesses stay boundary-nonadmissible at every budget while the W2 escape witness stays admissible, and single-step transport does not yield strong normalization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticProjectionT.conclusion: The hardened semantic escape bundles four extractions with witness transport, realized by a payload-forgetting canonical projection and contrasted with a payload-keeping identity control.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticRawUniversa.summary: Defines raw semantic measures without directness discipline and the naive universal claim that no such measure orients any RDRS step. Exhibits four named countermodel pairs with explicit single-step orientation proofs for counter-first-lex, term-algebra oracle, nonlinear coupling and projection forgetting. Proves the naive universal false through the counter-first-lex model and records an adjudicated marker alias.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticRawUniversa.boundary: Arbitrary raw semantic measures can orient steps, so the strongest universal barrier claim fails while the refined direct-measure question remains separate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSSemanticRawUniversa.conclusion: The naive claim that no raw semantic measure orients any RDRS step is false, refuted by the counter-first-lex countermodel with three further countermodels.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSWitnessTransport.le.summary: Reconciles DP-style projection escapes with static projection transactions for single-step witness transport. OperatorKO7/Meta/RDRSWitnessTransport.le.conclusion: Every DP projection escape yields a source orientation via its underlying projection transaction, without implying termination.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecCore.lean.summary: Restates the compositional-impossibility boundary on the four-constructor RecDelta core with schema, embedding and pumping constructors. Defines additive and abstract compositional measures with evaluations and schema views. Proves Tier-1 additive impossibility and Tier-2 transparent-delta impossibility for the duplicating recursor. Gives a counter-depth DP projection that orients the step but violates both app-subterm laws, plus a quadratic witness that orients while breaking transparency. Concludes transparency is essential for Tier-2.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecCore.lean.boundary: Additive measures and transparent-delta compositional measures cannot orient the duplicating recursor, while the DP projection and a nonlinear quadratic witness can, so transparency is the exact divide.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecCore.lean.conclusion: No additive or transparent-delta compositional measure orients the duplicating recursor, yet DP projection and a nonlinear witness do, so transparency is essential.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionDynamic.l.summary: This file defines the canonical rewrite sequence of the record-emitting schema using counter terms, frame stacks, and a frame-closed step rule. It proves consecutive canonical stages are related by the step rule below the starting counter height. It proves every positive stage both emits a record frame and preserves the recursive generator, and discharges the manuscript dynamic condition from the positional necessity theorem. It also gives the universally quantified duplication form and inhabitation of the first step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionDynamic.l.boundary: Every positive canonical stage carries two distinct generator occurrences, while stage zero need not; the duplication property holds for stages with 1 ≤ i and is not claimed below the first firing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionDynamic.l.conclusion: Every positive stage of the canonical record-emitting sequence carries distinct frame-slot and active-site generator occurrences.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.RecordEmissionDynamic.every_positive_stage_duplicates_the_generator
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all i with 1 ≤ i and i ≤ k, the canonical stage has two distinct generator positions.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionNecessity.summary: This file introduces a minimal first-order RecordTerm language with one generator constructor and enumerates generator-occurrence positions. It defines frame emission and recursive-generator preservation predicates with frame and active position tags. It proves that joint frame presence and active-site presence yields two distinct generator positions, with a no-record contrapositive and a primitive-duplicator witness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionNecessity.boundary: A right-hand side that both emits a new record frame and preserves the recursive generator must contain two distinct generator occurrences; with only one unique generator position, emission and preservation cannot co-occur.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionNecessity.conclusion: Frame emission together with generator preservation forces two syntactically distinct generator occurrences, one in a frame slot and one at the active site.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionNecessity.summary: This file extends the record-emission necessity result from single-sort syntax to three broader regimes. It lifts the theorem to many-sorted families per sort, to externalized traces under a faithful-decoder hypothesis, and to richer semantic regimes under a coherence hypothesis. It packages coverage as a three-way unified classifier discharged by decide.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionNecessity.boundary: The many-sorted lift holds per sort under the same two hypotheses, while the externalized-trace and richer-regime lifts hold only under the named faithfulness-decoder and semantic-coherence hypotheses; without those hypotheses the transfer is not claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordEmissionNecessity.conclusion: Architectural necessity lifts to many-sorted syntax, faithful externalized traces, and coherent richer semantic regimes, covered by an exact three-way classifier.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordStorageForm.lean.summary: This file studies injective natural-number codes with decoders and strictly increasing normalized codes. It proves codes are injective and normalized codes satisfy an index lower bound by strict monotonicity. It builds terminal and terminal-normalized storage forms from a record-emission witness with identity codes and transfers the lower bound to them.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordStorageForm.lean.boundary: Injective codes give distinct observations, while normalized strictly monotone codes additionally satisfy the linear lower bound i ≤ code i; richer coding models need extra assumptions beyond this file.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecordStorageForm.lean.conclusion: Every normalized storage code satisfies the index lower bound, instantiated by the terminal witness with identity code.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyBoundary.summary: This file is a surface layer cataloguing eleven recursive-family boundary deliverables as a finite row inventory. It records per-row projection witnesses onto existing theorem-backed substrate identifiers without asserting new schema content. It proves the catalog has length eleven without duplicates and is complete, and that every projection holds by reusing substrate theorems. It closes with a phase-G marker conjoining completeness and projection.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyBoundary.boundary: Direct whole-term and additive observers cannot globally orient duplicating steps with an unbounded pump, so orientation holds only outside that direct universe via the catalogued vector, SCC, typed, escape, and dependency-pair routes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyBoundary.conclusion: All eleven recursive-family boundary rows project onto existing theorem-backed substrate identifiers with an exact complete catalog.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyEscapeCa.summary: This file turns the recursive-family escape surfaces into one exact three-route finite catalog. It defines projection-or-DP, nonlinear-out-of-class, and ablation routes with length, nodup, and completeness lemmas. It packages boundary-lifted catalogs and proves every orienting KO7 direct observer lands in one of the three routes via the existing trichotomy. It claims no converse beyond the formalized class.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyEscapeCa.boundary: An orienting observer in the explicit KO7 direct universe cannot stay inside the direct barrier; it must land in projection-or-DP, nonlinear-out-of-class, or ablation escape, with no converse claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyEscapeCa.conclusion: Every orienting KO7 direct observer lands in one of the three exact recursive-family escape routes.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyEscapeCh.summary: This file gives the schema-generic half of escape-route characterization. It defines a four-clause escape disjunction over exposure, pump, visibility, and sensitivity failures. It proves by classical case-split that any globally orienting observer must fall into a clause, using the unconditional barrier theorem. It packages this as a certificate available for every duplicating family, with the converse deferred to KO7.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyEscapeCh.boundary: Joint satisfaction of strict exposure, unbounded pump, visibility, and carrier-sensitivity is incompatible with global orientation; an orienting observer must fail at least one of the four preconditions at every coordinate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyEscapeCh.conclusion: Every duplicating family admits the one-way classification from orienting observers to failure of a DWO precondition.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyTypedPol.summary: This file catalogues existing typed, many-sorted, and policy-indexed claims as seven named rows. It records per-row projection witnesses onto existing theorem-backed identifiers without reopening proofs. It proves the seven-row catalog exact and every projection holds by reusing substrate theorems. It closes with a marker conjoining completeness and projection.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyTypedPol.boundary: No additive typed or many-sorted measure orients the recursive successor step, and higher-order tree lifts need the no-sharing hypothesis while full-capture avoidance needs body freshness; innermost-only and AC-quotient scopes lie outside the barrier scope.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RecursiveFamilyTypedPol.conclusion: All seven typed and policy rows project onto existing theorem-backed substrate surfaces with an exact complete catalog.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CanonicalExecu.summary: This file distinguishes the input-varying family RecursorInputFamily from the fixed-source finite execution canonicalExecution obtained from BaseDuplicatingSystem.canonicalTrace. It proves the source identity, stepwise StepStar connectivity under wrap closure, counter descent by one, payload ascent by one, terminal form, and source-to-output reachability. It defines a named projected counter observer and proves it reads the remaining counter and drops by one at each step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CanonicalExecu.boundary: RecursorInputFamily varies its source input with its index and claims no edges between indices, while canonicalExecution is a fixed-source execution whose consecutive stages are StepStar-connected and whose source reaches the wrapped output.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CanonicalExecu.conclusion: The fixed-source canonical execution starts from the counter-depth source and reaches the wrapped output with stepwise connections and a projected counter that drops by one.
assumptions: WrapContextClosed Sys as explicit hypothesis for stage-step and reachability theorems
SemanticProjectionKernel Sys for projected-observer theorems

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CanonicalExecu.summary: This file packages the Trace recursor with its full contextual KO7 relation as ko7BaseSystem and connects adjacent canonical stages by exact contextual edges. It defines general weighted and uniform constructor-cost algebras and proves exact mass formulas with slopes appCost minus deltaCost and deltaCost respectively. It proves pointwise and profile equality with the self-embedding orbit exactly under the sharp factor-two calibration, proves the uniform-cost equality fails past the initial stage, and exhibits a genuine nonterminating two-cycle with the same constant mass profile.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CanonicalExecu.boundary: Pointwise mass equality with the delta self-embedding orbit holds exactly on the factor-two calibration side and fails otherwise, with uniform cost as the explicit failing instance. The terminating canonical execution and a non-strongly-normalizing two-cycle share the same finite mass profile, so mass-profile observers cannot separate termination.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CanonicalExecu.conclusion: Weighted mass of the real canonical execution matches the self-embedding orbit exactly under and only under the factor-two calibration, while uniform mass is constant on the execution and a genuine two-cycle reproduces that constant profile despite nontermination.
assumptions: WeightedCostExecutionAlgebra constructor-cost equations for void, delta, app and recDelta
UniformCostExecutionAlgebra unit-cost equations
Sharp calibration hypothesis appCost = 2 * deltaCost for equality theorems
No sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CircularIdenti.summary: This file defines direct-measure proof systems, counter traces, the step-duplicating recursor orbit and a merge-chain circular-reference orbit, plus the LinearGrowth predicate. It proves exact linear mass formulas for both orbits under uniform-cost equations and that each profile satisfies LinearGrowth. The headline theorem is that both orbits satisfy LinearGrowth under any conforming direct measure, so whole-term mass shape alone does not separate them.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CircularIdenti.boundary: Any whole-term direct measure satisfying the uniform-cost equations sees only the LinearGrowth mass shape and cannot separate recursor growth from circular growth, while a counter-coordinate projection violates the non-projection condition and can separate them.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/CircularIdenti.conclusion: Under any uniform-cost direct measure both the recursor orbit and the circular-reference orbit satisfy LinearGrowth, so mass shape alone cannot distinguish them.
assumptions: Uniform unit-cost constructor equations mu_delta, mu_rec and mu_merge
DirectMeasureProofSystem with ignoresCounterCoord flag
No sorry, axiom or native_decide; headline has #print axioms

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/DPConfessionLi.summary: This file preserves compatibility identifiers around a closed seven-constructor syntax, a constant collapse map, and a two-term noninjectivity witness. It packages scope and dependency text in a diagnostic record with a default value. It imports the mass-growth comparison to prove that recursor and circular measures satisfy MassIndistinguishable under the three displayed normalization equations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/DPConfessionLi.boundary: The constant collapse map identifies two distinct closed terms while carrying no homomorphism laws, so local noninjectivity holds inside compatibility scope and signature expressibility requires the separate unconditional free-algebra result. A whole-term direct measure cannot separate the orbits without an external counter-privileging observer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/DPConfessionLi.conclusion: The constant map identifies distinct closed recursor terms and the recursor and circular mass profiles satisfy MassIndistinguishable under the three normalization equations.
assumptions: Unit-cost normalization equations mu_delta, mu_rec and mu_merge for the imported mass theorem
No sorry, axiom or native_decide in this file

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/DPConfessionLi.summary: This file proves equality of two recursor terms under any Sigma homomorphism into an algebra whose recR ignores its third argument, with a corollary contradiction from an added distinguishing hypothesis. It proves both orbit mass functions satisfy MassIndistinguishable under the three normalization equations. It proves licensed acceptance coincides with the strong-normalization verdict and that the concrete recursor system is accepted by its transformed-call certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/DPConfessionLi.boundary: A homomorphism into an algebra whose recR ignores its third input identifies the witness pair, while a separating syntactic reading distinguishes them, so license acceptance coincides with actual strong normalization rather than with direct-measure separation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/DPConfessionLi.conclusion: A Sigma homomorphism into a third-constant algebra identifies the two witnesses, both orbit mass profiles satisfy MassIndistinguishable, and licensed acceptance for KO7 systems holds exactly for strongly normalizing systems with the recursor system accepted.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/GaugeCost.lean.summary: This file proves arithmetic identities and bounds for cumulative cell and marginal bit costs, including the exact subtraction-free identity and geometric lower bound with sufficient projection width. It defines a partial decoder for schema records and proves correctness and injectivity only for canonical positive-depth orbitState records. It records the zero-depth absence, a concrete rejection witness, and the coexistence of exact decoding with a quadratic confessed-mass lower bound.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/GaugeCost.lean.boundary: Canonical positive-depth orbitState records decode exactly and injectively, while zero-depth records omit the payload and inconsistent frame payloads are rejected. OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/HomomorphicPro.summary: This file places the seven-constructor RecursorTerm fold inside a generic proof-carrying AlgebraHom interface with free and target algebras. It proves the fold identifies the closed witness pair whenever the target recR ignores its third input. It defines an explicit syntactic counter projection that separates the witnesses and proves it cannot factor through any such homomorphism or through the fold itself.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/HomomorphicPro.boundary: Any homomorphism into an algebra whose recR ignores its third input identifies the witness pair, while the explicit outer-counter projection separates that pair, so the projection cannot factor through any such homomorphism or through the recursive fold.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/HomomorphicPro.conclusion: The syntactic counter projection separates the witnesses that every third-ignoring homomorphic fold identifies, so it does not factor through the fold.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/InformationEqu.summary: The file defines an entropy measure whose discarded-information functional is invariant on LinearGrowth mass profiles, the discarded information of an orbit under such a measure, and information equivalence modulo the Dependency Pair projection as equality of discarded information under all such measures and uniform-cost direct-measure systems. It proves that any two LinearGrowth profiles share discarded information and that mass indistinguishability implies the same equality. Its headline theorems state that the step-duplicating primitive recursor orbit and a true circular-reference orbit are information-equivalent modulo the DP projection, with corollaries packaging the same equality under uniform-cost hypotheses and a cost-floor reading. It also records H-equivalence reflexivity for the canonical confession move, the definitional fact that canonical discarded bits are zero, and convergence of the canonical move to itself.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/InformationEqu.boundary: An observer restricted to entropy measures satisfying LinearGrowth invariance and to orbits viewed through the Dependency Pair projection, which forgets the counter coordinate, assigns the same discarded-information value to the step-duplicator orbit and the circular-reference orbit. The equality is established under that invariance together with the uniform-cost equations and LinearGrowth hypotheses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/InformationEqu.conclusion: Under any LinearGrowth-invariant entropy measure and uniform-cost direct-measure system, the step-duplicator recursor orbit and the circular-reference orbit have equal discarded-information values modulo the Dependency Pair projection.
assumptions: EntropyMeasure.respects_linear_growth invariance on the LinearGrowth class
uniform constructor-cost equations for D.mu on delta, recΔ and merge
LinearGrowth of both orbit mass profiles where required by InformationEquivalentModDP
MassIndistinguishable witness where required
no sorry and no new axiom, as stated in the module header

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/MassProfileIde.summary: This file names the self-embedding circular rule t to delta t, its orbit, and its nontermination properties including absence of normal forms and of strictly decreasing natural measures. It proves the self-embedding mass formula, shared initial state with the recursor orbit, and unconditional pointwise and functional mass-profile identity with identical descent verdicts. It proves the upstream merge-chain orbit never matches the recursor pointwise, explaining why LinearGrowth alone does not give separation failure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/MassProfileIde.boundary: The merge-chain circular orbit never matches the recursor pointwise, while the self-embedding delta orbit from the shared start matches pointwise, so mass-profile observers cannot separate the latter pair even though only the circular side admits no strictly decreasing natural measure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/MassProfileIde.conclusion: The recursor and self-embedding orbits share initial state and pointwise mass with identical descent verdicts, while the merge-chain orbit never matches and no natural measure descends on the self-embedding rule.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/NonvacuousClos.summary: This file replaces three vacuous closure forms with contentful statements resting on pointwise mass identity. It defines a mass-profile licensed quotient that is non-constant yet identifies the recursor and circular orbits. It proves index bijections do not transport termination via the DupDP descent versus self-embedding non-descent contrast. It proves information agreement for every functional without an invariance field, witnessed non-vacuously by a slope functional.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/NonvacuousClos.boundary: The mass-profile quotient is non-constant yet still identifies the recursor and circular orbits, unlike the trivial PUnit quotient. The index bijection preserves indices but does not transport termination because the DupDP side is well-founded while the self-embedding side admits no decreasing measure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/NonvacuousClos.conclusion: A non-trivial mass-profile quotient identifies the two orbits, index bijections carry no termination content, and every functional agrees on the two pointwise-identical profiles.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RaryDuplicator.summary: This file defines an r-ary duplicator emitting r payload copies per step with functional steps, orbit states, payload counts and counted derivations. It proves payload multiplicity r*i+1, payload- and r-blind runtime k+1 with uniqueness of normalizing length and endpoint, and exact cumulative mass with a linear scaling envelope. Its architectural section counts generator positions in a constructed multi-frame term without claiming necessity for arbitrary encodings.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RaryDuplicator.boundary: Derivation length k+1 is blind to payload and duplication order, while payload multiplicity r*i+1 scales with r, so unary and binary duplication already differ at stage two.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RaryDuplicator.conclusion: The r-ary duplicator has payload multiplicity r*i+1, unique normalizing runtime k+1, closed cumulative mass with linear scaling envelope, and a constructed multi-frame term with m+1 generator positions.
assumptions: Index bound i <= k for live orbit states
Positivity 1 <= m for multi-frame emission
No sorry, axiom or native_decide visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RaryDuplicator.summary: The file defines r-ary analogues of the binary duplicator quantities, scaling wrapper weight to r*w while keeping the single active payload explicit. It proves live-orbit bridges showing the closed sums equal sums over the actual r-orbit and an exact gap formula for naive weight substitution. It proves the six quantitative laws at every arity r, with positivity-dependent clauses stated as implications. It packages all laws with their bridges into one structure inhabited for every r and shows r = 1 recovers the binary statements as equalities.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RaryDuplicator.boundary: At r = 0 the confessed frame mass is zero while the live payload mass remains (k+1)*w, so the frame laws carry no content; at r ≥1 with 1≤r*w the crossover, dominance and unbounded-inefficiency laws hold, and duplication is exactly the additional mass term.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RaryDuplicator.conclusion: Every r-ary quantitative law holds at all arities and the whole package is inhabited for every r with r = 1 recovering the binary laws as equalities.
assumptions: positivity hypothesis 1 ≤ r * w for crossover, dominance and unboundedness clauses
noncomputable real division by Real.log (k + 1) in inefficiencyCoefficientR

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RecursorFreeAl.summary: The file defines SigmaAlgebra interpretations for the seven-constructor RecursorTerm signature and the recursive fold evaluator. It proves fold is a Sigma-homomorphism and that any function satisfying the seven homomorphism equations equals the fold. It defines the constant-void algebra and shows folding through it equals dpCollapseToVoid. It defines FactorsThroughCollapse as constancy and proves homomorphisms into constant algebras are constant and hence cannot distinguish terms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RecursorFreeAl.boundary: A homomorphism into an algebra whose operations are all constant with value k is constant with value k and takes equal values on every two terms; algebras that read constructor arguments can separate terms, so constancy holds on one side and fails on the other.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/RecursorFreeAl.conclusion: Any homomorphism into a constant algebra is constant and therefore takes equal values on any two recursor terms.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/SchemaTraceKer.summary: The file defines the SchemaTerm syntax with base and payload leaves and the rewrite relation SStep with root rules and G-context closure. It defines the canonical orbit orbitState and measures wsize, countG, countPay, ctr and hasF. It proves each live state takes a unique canonical next step and the leaf-instantiated terminal record is normal. It proves exact closed forms for size, G-count, payload-count, counter height and frame presence on live and terminal states.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/SchemaTraceKer.boundary: For i≤k the canonical state is live, has F true and steps uniquely to the next orbit state; at i = k+1 the record is terminal, normal and admits no step with hasF false.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/SchemaTraceKer.conclusion: Every live canonical state steps uniquely along the orbit to a normal terminal record with exact size and count closed forms.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/SignatureDeriv.summary: The file defines the recursor fragment RecTerm and its Sigma-algebras with a ternary recursor slot. It proves any algebra whose recursor slot is constant in its third argument identifies the two witness terms differing only in that argument. It defines the counter-height algebra that reads the third argument and separates the witnesses while failing the constancy hypothesis. It combines both facts to state non-derivability is relative to the constant-third-argument class.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/SignatureDeriv.boundary: Algebras whose recursor slot ignores its third argument identify the witness pair, while the counter-height algebra that reads the third argument separates them, so the hypothesis is load-bearing and the conclusion is scoped to that class.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/SignatureDeriv.conclusion: Non-derivability holds relative to constant-third-argument evaluators and fails for an evaluator that reads the third argument.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TRSEquivalence.summary: The file defines a constant licensed quotient on Nat to Trace and a compatibility predicate requiring equal quotient images plus LinearGrowth of both mass profiles. It proves the recursor and circular-reference orbits satisfy this agreement under three constructor-cost equations and pairs it with independent toy-operator factorization facts. It proves both canonical orbits are injective and builds an index-preserving transport map commuting with the one-step successor, yielding a bidirectional orbit-system isomorphism. It defines the constructor-cost measure satisfying the three equations and instantiates licensed-quotient and information agreement at it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TRSEquivalence.boundary: Licensed-quotient images agree and mass profiles share only the LinearGrowth class, not pointwise values, and the proved isomorphism is of the canonical orbit systems, not a simulation of the full kernel rewrite relation Step.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TRSEquivalence.conclusion: The recursor and circular-reference orbits agree under the constant licensed quotient with shared linear growth and are isomorphic as one-step orbit systems, instantiated without open hypotheses at the constructor-cost measure.

constructor-cost equations mu_delta, mu_rec and mu_merge as hypotheses

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TerminalDecode.summary: The file proves base and payload identifiers are never frame-headed in the sorted schema syntax and that the decoder is defined on canonical positive-depth terminal records. It defines an unsorted record syntax without sort separation and its frame stack. It exhibits a depth collision where different depths and bases yield the same terminal record and shows barring frame-headed bases restores depth recoverability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TerminalDecode.boundary: With sort separation the decoder is total on canonical positive-depth records and depth is recoverable; without it two configurations of different depth and base collide to the same record so depth and injectivity fail.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TerminalDecode.conclusion: The unrestricted total decoder is false without sort separation, while the sorted decoder is total on canonical positive-depth records.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceAction.le.summary: The file defines the triangular number tri, the live-trace action traceAction and confession masses conMassCell and conMassPayManuscript. It proves summation bridges and exact division-free closed forms for the syntactic sum, the action and the partition between wrapper-cell and retained mass. It proves integer envelopes for the second quadratic invariant, confession dominance and the manuscript payload mass.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceAction.le.conclusion: The live-trace action and confession masses satisfy exact division-free closed forms and partitions with quadratic envelopes.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For all k w cstar, w times twice traceAction equals (w + 1) times twice conMassCell plus 2 * w * (k + 1) * cstar.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceConservat.summary: The file defines integer linear and full affine readings of the canonical coordinates trace_ctr, trace_pay and trace_wraps. It proves a functional is conserved along live stages iff k = 0 or a = b+c, with rank-two basis ctr+wraps and pay-wraps and values k and 1. It classifies conserved coefficient vectors, observational equivalence of readings and conserved observations, showing three conserved coefficients collapse to two observable parameters.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceConservat.boundary: At depth k = 0 every functional is vacuously conserved, while at every positive depth conservation holds exactly when a = b+c; ctr alone and pay alone lie on the failing side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceConservat.conclusion: Conservation along a trace holds exactly under coefficient balance a = b+c except for vacuous zero depth, with a rank-two basis and two observable parameters.
assumptions: vacuous conservation at depth k = 0; positive depth 0 < k for the balance criterion a = b + c

OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceInvariant.summary: The file defines multi-step reachability StepsTo and proves determinism gives unique normal lengths and records. It proves Law 1 exact length and payload blindness, Law 2 mass rate and terminal drop, Law 5 crossover envelope and minimality, Laws 6-7 step budget, offset and sufficient-statistic with uniqueness, and Law 11 orbit injectivity and carrier dimension.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceInvariant.boundary: Live states with i≤k satisfy step, budget and offset identities and step toward the terminal record, while the terminal record at k+1 is normal with no outgoing step; payload identities lie on the blind side sharing the same length.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Recursor/TraceInvariant.conclusion: Canonical traces have exact length k+1 with unique normal records, conserved budgets and injectively indexed orbits.
assumptions: runtime and vector-space dimension not formalized

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReflectionSchema.lean.summary: This file compares six-field proposition-valued structural profiles stage by stage. It defines stage selectors, pointwise realization and equivalence, and a comparison package with transport theorems. It proves realization is equivalent to stagewise realization and that stagewise agreement preserves realization. It derives a stagewise realization and self-comparison for the mechanized dependency-pair profile.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReflectionSchema.lean.conclusion: Pointwise six-stage agreement transports realization of the six-step shape from one profile to another.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift/FoundationalIn.summary: The file builds truth-level and boundary-relative witness hierarchies for the KO7 termination predicate and proves they realize representation-shift bottlenecks at depths one and two respectively, with sharp wrong-depth failures on either side. It then builds proof-carrying layers and a constant Nat-to-unit layer interface satisfying the unit law. That interface is many-to-one with no left inverse, fails canonical preservation of isZeroState, yet supports a sound transport of belowSuccessor, so property soundness does not yield faithful state reconstruction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift/FoundationalIn.boundary: KO7 termination has no adequate witness below depth 1 at truth level and none below depth 2 boundary-relatively, is realized at those depths, and loses bottleneck minimality above them. The LayerInterface unit law and a sound property transport hold without implying injectivity, left-invertibility, or canonical preservation of arbitrary properties.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift/FoundationalIn.conclusion: KO7 termination realizes the truth-level bottleneck at depth one and the boundary-relative bottleneck at depth two with sharp wrong-depth failures, while a constant Nat-to-unit interface shows property transport coexists with noninjective abstraction.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_BottleneckPred.summary: This file defines abstract witness hierarchies with accepted witnesses and minimal-order relations. It defines single-layer bottlenecks as true properties first witnessed at depth k, with upper- and lower-bound corollaries. It defines interface bottlenecks across two-layer towers with empty lower and witnessed higher layers plus transfer. It packages a decidable-instance pre-undecidability fracture without claiming an undecidability boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_BottleneckPred.boundary: A true property may have no adequate witness below depth k while gaining one at k, and across layers the lower layer may be empty while the higher layer has a witness with sound transfer; the decidable-instance package does not by itself establish undecidability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_BottleneckPred.conclusion: Bottlenecks are characterized as true properties with no adequate witness below k but one at k, lifted to cross-layer interface form.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_CrossLayerComp.summary: This file composes state interfaces and backward property implications along finite chains. It composes witness transports under intermediate realization and propagates accepted certificates through prefix states. It proves cross-layer transfer, semantic transfer, prefix transfer, and an endpoint bottleneck from an interior gap. It shows soundness alone need not realize and implications alone need not transport, with axiom checks.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_CrossLayerComp.boundary: Soundness alone does not realize even a true property, and semantic implications alone do not supply forward witness maps; realization and transfer need explicit completeness and forward maps, otherwise only backward property implications compose.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_CrossLayerComp.conclusion: Interfaces and property transfers compose along chains, and an interior witness gap induces an endpoint interface bottleneck while soundness alone realizes nothing.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_LayeredSemanti.summary: This file packages abstract semantic layers with transitions and witness families. It externalizes verifiers with soundness and defines adequate witnesses with a soundness corollary. It defines abstraction and concretization maps with a unit-only layer interface weaker than a Galois connection. It defines witness transport, canonical abstracted properties, and two-layer towers with extractors.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_LayeredSemanti.conclusion: Layers, interfaces with unit condition, and sound witness transport are packaged with canonical abstracted properties and tower extractors.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_RecursorInstan.summary: This file connects the abstract bottleneck framework to the concrete KO7 stack. It defines KO7 termination and property-fixed witness families at direct, imported-whole, transformed-call, and external depths. It proves a truth-level bottleneck at depth one via polynomial and MPO witnesses with none at zero. It proves a boundary-relative bottleneck at depth two via dependency pairs, with WitnessOrder bridges and a decidable termination instance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_RecursorInstan.boundary: At truth level no depth-zero direct witness is accepted while depth-one polynomial and MPO witnesses exist, and under the benchmark contract depths zero and one are excluded so the first admissible witness appears only at depth two.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RepShift_RecursorInstan.conclusion: KO7 exhibits a truth-level bottleneck at depth one and a boundary-relative bottleneck at depth two via dependency pairs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ResidualMethodClosureCa.summary: This file closes a twenty-five-row cross-family residual inventory with theorem-backed support per row. It assigns source families and five terminal statuses with no open constructors. It proves exact length, nodup, support, terminal status, and an explicit non-overclaim boundary separating terminal classification from universal closure. It packages these as a universal completion certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ResidualMethodClosureCa.boundary: Terminal classification of all twenty-five rows is weaker than universal closure: blocked rows record standing obstructions and licensed-escape rows need external soundness, so the inventory is terminally classified without being universally closed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ResidualMethodClosureCa.conclusion: The twenty-five-row residual inventory is terminally classified with universal support but explicitly not universally closed.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ResidualReductionGraph..summary: This file adds typed cross-family reduction edges over the residual ledger. It defines a meet operation on coverage statuses and three canonical edges with proof anchors. It defines paths and cycles and proves the canonical graph acyclic with no self-loops or two-cycles because targets are never sources. It defines meet-closure under one reduction step with a weakening law.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ResidualReductionGraph..boundary: Reduction can only weaken coverage status to the meet of source and target, and the canonical graph has no self-loops or two-cycles with targets never reused as sources, so reduction walks terminate without cycles.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ResidualReductionGraph..conclusion: The three-edge canonical reduction graph is acyclic with meet-weakening status closure.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseBridge/BinEntrop.summary: The file defines the gap function F p = binEntropy p minus 4*log 2*p*(1-p) and proves auxiliary derivative and monotonicity facts for it. It proves the log-ratio bound, nonpositivity of the gap derivative on (2/9, 1/2), the left-piece inequality on (0, 2/9], and nonnegativity of F on [0, 1/2]. From these plus binEntropy symmetry it proves the sharp quadratic bound 4*log 2*p*(1-p) <= binEntropy p for p in [0, 1], a bound noted as absent from Mathlib. It also proves equality at p = 1/2 where both sides equal log 2.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseBridge/BinEntrop.conclusion: For every real p in [0, 1], 4*log 2*p*(1-p) is at most binEntropy p, with equality at p = 1/2.
assumptions: 0 <= p <= 1 for the headline; interval hypotheses 0 <= u <= 1/2, p in (2/9, 1/2), (0, 2/9] and [0, 1/2] for the pieces
Mathlib bounds Real.log_two_gt_d9 and Real.log_two_lt_d9 through the 2/3 and 7/10 lemmas
axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound reported by the #print axioms lines; no sorry, axiom or native_decide in the proofs
set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslFa.summary: Defines the elementary arithmetical content forall m exists n (n < m or m = 0) behind the historically named predecessor-descent sentence, with a canonical alias. Proves the single-sorted standard carrier satisfies the object sentence if and only if the arithmetical property holds, with set elements satisfying the matrix vacuously and number elements carrying the Nat-statement. Deduces the standard model satisfies the sentence under both historical and canonical names from its truth over Nat by case on zero versus successor.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslFa.conclusion: The standard model satisfies the predecessor-descent sentence because every natural number is zero or has a smaller predecessor.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslPr.summary: Defines a product record parameterized by a theory T grouping five facts: Pi02 shape and derivability of the predecessor sentence, canonical omega-cubed well-order descriptor, standard-model faithfulness, and KO7 rank-descent implication. Proves the record can be assembled from a supplied derivation plus imported component theorems. States explicitly the record does not prove SCT equivalence or that the predecessor sentence expresses Arts-Giesl soundness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslPr.boundary: The conjunction of the five components holds as assembled, while an SCT reverse-mathematics equivalence and identification with dependency-pair soundness do not follow.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslPr.conclusion: The five predecessor, omega-cubed, faithfulness and KO7 facts assemble into one product record given a derivation of the predecessor sentence.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslUp.summary: Proves every model of the five-sentence finite predecessor-arithmetic theory satisfies the predecessor-descent sentence, using zero-or-successor to supply zero or a smaller predecessor and vacuous satisfaction at set elements. Restates this as first-order semantic entailment. Retains historical SCT names as compatibility aliases that do not formalize size-change or dependency-pair soundness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslUp.boundary: Semantic entailment holds for the elementary predecessor-descent sentence, while formalization of Arts-Giesl or size-change soundness is not claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslUp.conclusion: Every model of finite predecessor arithmetic satisfies the predecessor-descent sentence.

Nonempty M structure instance for the quantified model

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslUp.summary: Constructs a syntactic Hilbert derivation of the predecessor-descent sentence from zero-or-successor after all-introduction by case on IsSet via excluded middle. Uses self-witness with ex falso for the IsSet branch, self-witness with the equality disjunct for the zero branch, and predecessor mapping via ex_mono for the successor branch. Specializes to rca0BasicAxioms and to the product record.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslUp.boundary: Derivability holds for the elementary predecessor-descent sentence from zero-or-successor, while formalization of the Arts-Giesl dependency-pair theorem is not claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/ArtsGieslUp.conclusion: rca0BasicAxioms syntactically derives the predecessor-descent sentence, yielding the product record at that theory.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/Complexity..summary: Defines a cumulative prenex-prefix classifier as an inductive family with quantifier-free base, level bump, existential and universal introduction, and polarity dual, with Sigma and Pi wrappers and historical IsPi02. Proves base bridges, cumulativity, polarity change, quantifier introduction, and that every classified formula is prenex. Provides constructors for universal-existential level two, noting bump and dual break bijection with formula quantifiers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/Complexity..boundary: Classification at a level holds via cumulative bump and dual steps, while exact quantifier-prefix shape does not follow.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/Complexity..conclusion: Every classified formula is prenex with explicit universal-existential level-two constructors.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/Language.le.summary: Defines the single-sorted L2 language with function symbols zero, successor, addition and multiplication and relations less-than, membership and IsSet for Simpson-style RCA0 encoding. Provides term builders including numerals and free and bounded atomic formula builders. Proves atoms quantifier-free and sample sentences prenex, including successor-ne-zero and no-greatest forall-exists shape.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/Language.le.conclusion: L2 with its term and atomic builders provides the reusable base for RCA0-style sentences with verified quantifier-free and prenex facts.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/NewmanCompl.summary: Defines the arithmetical closure under negation, implication and number quantifiers and bare-Newman blocks conclusion, inductive step, body and sentence forall X IsSet X to (Ind to Concl). Defines set-guarded arithmetical and Pi11 as leading set universal over arithmetical body. Proves the body arithmetical and the sentence Pi11, and that fixed-system critical-pair joinability equality is quantifier-free and Sigma-zero.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/NewmanCompl.boundary: Newman well-founded induction is Pi11 with leading set quantifier, distinct from the orientation-axis Pi02 and far above low quantifier-free joinability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/NewmanCompl.conclusion: The bare-Newman sentence is Pi11 over an arithmetical body while fixed critical-pair joinability is quantifier-free.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/NewmanRCA0U.summary: Proves the standard carrier satisfies the bare-Newman sentence by strong induction on Nat, with a set witness as Set Nat and number case by the predecessor hypothesis. Proves the standard model satisfies the five-sentence predecessor fragment and the eight Simpson basic axioms, giving satisfiability of each theory with Newman. Notes the lift to every model would need induction beyond the basic axioms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/NewmanRCA0U.boundary: The principle holds in the standard model by well-foundedness of Nat, while entailment in every basic-axiom model is not claimed and would need stronger induction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/NewmanRCA0U.conclusion: The standard model satisfies the bare-Newman sentence and both basic theories with it are satisfiable.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0.lean.summary: Defines five number-relativized basic axioms zero-or-successor, less-than successor, successor-ne-zero, add-zero and irreflexivity, grouped as rca0BasicAxioms with canonical finite predecessor-arithmetic alias. Proves each holds in the standard carrier by number-or-set case analysis. Deduces the standard model satisfies the finite fragment, establishing satisfiability without induction or comprehension schemes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0.lean.boundary: Satisfiability of the finite basic fragment holds in the standard model, while full RCA0 with induction and comprehension is not claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0.lean.conclusion: The finite predecessor-arithmetic fragment is satisfiable in the standard model.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0Derivat.summary: Defines the two-induction fragment as Simpson base plus two induction instances and builds a two-element Bool countermodel with zero as set, successor identity and less-than as equality. Shows it models the base and both induction instances but refutes irreflexivity, giving non-entailment and non-derivability via soundness. Builds a three-element Fin-3 countermodel with sole number modeling the Simpson base but refuting zero-or-successor, giving its non-entailment and non-derivability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0Derivat.boundary: Simpson base plus two induction instances holds while irreflexivity fails, and Simpson base holds while zero-or-successor fails, separating actual consequences from false strengthenings.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0Derivat.conclusion: Neither irreflexivity follows from the two-instance extension nor zero-or-successor follows from the Simpson base.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0Derivat.summary: This file defines number-relativized Simpson basic axioms, the induction-instance operator IND, bounded-quantifier formulas, and the theories built from them. It proves the Simpson base derives x less than its successor without induction and proves a theory-translation cut lemma. It then shows one bounded zero-or-successor induction instance derives the zero-or-successor axiom and the predecessor-descent sentence, and that any theory containing the base and that instance, including the full bounded-induction theory, does the same.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0Derivat.boundary: One bounded zero-or-successor induction instance already crosses from the finite Simpson base to deriving the zero-or-successor axiom and predecessor descent, while the finite fragment remains below full RCA0, which would add comprehension and an induction scheme.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/RCA0Derivat.conclusion: A single bounded zero-or-successor induction instance added to finite Simpson arithmetic derives predecessor descent, and so does every theory containing them.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/SizeChangeS.summary: This file arithmetizes a singleton dependency-pair bound as an explicit for-all exists L2 sentence and proves it Pi02 with standard-model semantics equivalent to a natural-number counter bound. It defines one-thread size-change graphs and proves no infinite call chain exists, a bounded for-all exists form, and well-foundedness. It extracts the DupDPStep pair from the step-duplicating recursor, instantiates the general results, and computes its exact well-founded rank and ordinal height omega.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/SizeChangeS.boundary: A call relation carrying an everywhere-strict descent thread lies on the terminating side with no infinite chain and an explicit finite length bound. Chains of every finite length still exist, so the ordinal bound omega is tight.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/SizeChangeS.conclusion: The extracted DupDPStep relation is chain-free, well-founded and bounded with exact pointwise rank equal to its counter and global ordinal height omega, equivalent to satisfaction of the displayed Pi02 sentence.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/StandardMod.summary: This file defines the standard model carrier N plus powersets of N and its interpretations of L2 function and relation symbols, with order as less-than, membership, and IsSet as the set side. It packages these as the L2-structure stdStructure with inhabited and nonempty instances. It includes six computational smoke examples checking zero, successor, addition, order, and positive and negative IsSet cases.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/StandardMod.conclusion: The file fixes the standard L2-structure on N plus Set N with totalized arithmetic and set-membership semantics.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/Substitutio.summary: This file defines parallel capture-avoiding substitution substAll for de Bruijn bound variables with lifting under quantifiers, plus the single-variable instantiation instantiateTop. It proves realization lemmas saying syntactic substitution commutes with semantic realization in any structure. These lemmas support the specialization axiom and existential introduction of the first-order derivation system.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMath/Substitutio.conclusion: Parallel substitution and top instantiation commute with realization, giving the semantic content of universal specialization.
assumptions: arbitrary first-order language L
arbitrary L-structure M for the realization lemmas

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathFramework.le.summary: This file defines profile records for second-order theories and principles with implication, conservativity and equivalence, plus upper bounds, lower bounds and calibrations carrying evidence status. It instantiates PRA, IΣ1, RCA0, RCA0 + WO(ω^3) and WO(ε₀) profiles and gives an exact SCT calibration alongside a conjectural Arts–Giesl calibration. It proves the two calibrations share target theory and ordinal, that the Arts–Giesl target lies below its ε₀ benchmark, and that justification and presentation erasures preserve theory and status while clearing metadata.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathFramework.le.boundary: Size-change termination has a theorem-level exact calibration at RCA0 + WO(ω^3), while the Arts–Giesl calibration is only conjectural with an upper benchmark WO(ε₀). Semantic upper and lower bounds require proof-bearing data beyond these stored records.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathFramework.le.conclusion: Size-change termination is exactly calibrated at RCA0 + WO(ω^3) sharing that target with the conjectural Arts–Giesl calibration below WO(ε₀), with exactness transferable across principles.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathOmega3WellOr.summary: This file defines the ordinal ω^3 and its canonical carrier with proofs that it is positive, below ε₀, well-founded and of order type ω^3. It proves general ordinal descent soundness and its ω^3 and Nat-measure specializations with a strictly monotone Nat embedding. It proves every ordinal below ω^3 occurs as a carrier rank and packages a canonical order-type witness and WO(ω^3) backing proposition.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathOmega3WellOr.boundary: Ambient well-foundedness and rank-descent termination are proved in Lean, but deductive provability in RCA0 and method-specific termination adapters are not proved here and require additional syntax and transport theorems.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathOmega3WellOr.conclusion: The canonical ω^3 carrier is well-founded with order type ω^3 and every ordinal below ω^3 occurs as a rank while decreasing ranks guarantee termination.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathSupport.lean.summary: This file defines calibration statuses, theory and ordinal windows and combined profiles with explicit ω^3 and ω^ω constants proved below ε₀. It registers exact SCT windows and conjectural Arts–Giesl windows sharing theory and ordinal targets, plus a packaged ε₀ artifact upper bound already supplied by the KO7 measure stack. It models constant-overhead transformation with a step-duplicating recursor instance preserving linear growth and summarizes the supported Arts–Giesl target facts.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ReverseMathSupport.lean.conclusion: Registered SCT exact and Arts–Giesl conjectural profiles share theory target RCA0 + WO(ω^3) and ordinal target ω^3 below ε₀ with a constant-overhead recursor transformation preserving linear growth.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Commutation.l.summary: This file develops abstract rewriting over an arbitrary relation. It defines the diamond property, confluence, the Church-Rosser property and commutation, and shows each is inhabited by equality. It proves the Church-Rosser property equivalent to confluence and that the diamond property lifts to confluence of the reflexive-transitive closure, then proves the Hindley-Rosen theorem that commuting confluent closures have a confluent union and specializes the diamond lemma to StepStar.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Commutation.l.boundary: Confluence of a union holds on the side where the two reflexive-transitive closures are each confluent and commute, and may fail without commutation; the diamond property marks the side where closure confluence follows from a one-step closing condition.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Commutation.l.conclusion: Commuting confluent closures have a confluent union, with the Church-Rosser property equivalent to confluence and the diamond property lifting to closure confluence.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPair..summary: This file sets up capture-free renaming of two rules into disjoint variable summands and enumerates non-variable overlap positions. It defines overlapAt, overlapPairs and criticalPairs via unification of overlapped subterms and proves every emitted pair is a genuine two-step overlap peak in the renamed system. A concrete two-rule system witnesses that the enumeration is nonempty and that a witnessed pair is a real peak.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPair..boundary: The construction covers non-variable overlaps at function positions, while variable-position and disjoint overlaps lie outside it and always join by separate arguments. Every emitted pair is a real overlap peak, while the converse that every genuine overlap is an instance of an emitted pair is not proved here.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPair..conclusion: Every enumerated critical pair is a genuine overlap peak in the renamed system, with a concrete two-rule demo showing the enumeration is nonempty.
assumptions: DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu
set_option autoImplicit false
baseline axioms {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} via Finset and DecidableEq plumbing

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.nonVarPositions
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: nonVarPositions t is the list of positions of t whose subterm is an application, root first.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.renameRule
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: renameRule g rule renames the variables of its left-hand side and right-hand side by Term.rename g, preserving that the left-hand side is an application.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.RenVar
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: RenVar nu is Sum nu nu, with Sum.inl used for the first rule and Sum.inr for the second rule of an overlap.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.renameTRS
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq nu, renameTRS R is R.map (renameRule Sum.inl) appended with R.map (renameRule Sum.inr).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.renameRule_vars_disjoint
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq nu, for all t1 and t2 and every z, if z is in the variables of rename Sum.inl t1 then z is not in the variables of rename Sum.inr t2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.nonVarPositions_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If p is in nonVarPositions t then there exist f and args with subtermAt t p equal to some (app f args).

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.overlapAt
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, overlapAt r1 r2 p reads the subterm of r1.lhs at p and unifies it with r2.lhs, returning (mu applied to r1.rhs, mu applied to replaceAt r1.lhs p r2.rhs) on success.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.overlapPairs
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: overlapPairs r1 r2 is the filterMap of overlapAt r1 r2 over nonVarPositions r1.lhs.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.criticalPairs
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, criticalPairs R flatMaps overlapPairs (renameRule Sum.inl r1) (renameRule Sum.inr r2) over all ordered pairs r1 and r2 in R.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.overlapAt_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if r1 is in renameTRS R and r2 is in renameTRS R and overlapAt r1 r2 p equals some (s, t) then there exists w with Step (renameTRS R) w s and Step (renameTRS R) w t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.overlapPairs_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if r1 and r2 are in renameTRS R and (s, t) is in overlapPairs r1 r2 then there exists w with Step (renameTRS R) w s and Step (renameTRS R) w t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.criticalPairs_sound
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if (s, t) is in criticalPairs R then there exists w with Step (renameTRS R) w s and Step (renameTRS R) w t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.Step.at_pos
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If subtermAt u p equals some a and Step R a b holds then Step R u (replaceAt u p b) holds.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: ruleA is f(g(x), y) to h(x, y) with the stated Nat encodings.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.Demo.ruleB

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.Demo.demoTRS

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: There exist s and t with (s, t) in criticalPairs demoTRS and a w with Step (renameTRS demoTRS) w s and Step (renameTRS demoTRS) w t.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPairC.summary: This file proves completeness of the overlap enumeration via the most general unifier and develops the backward direction of the Critical Pair Lemma. It handles root overlaps, classifies positions inside substitution instances, proves position-append algebra and a position trichotomy, and reconciles variable overlaps. It assembles the Huet biconditional between local confluence and critical-pair joinability and derives confluence under strong normalization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPairC.boundary: Local confluence holds exactly when all critical pairs are joinable, while full confluence needs the additional strong-normalization side. Without termination, local confluence does not imply confluence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPairC.conclusion: Joinability of all critical pairs is equivalent to local confluence and yields confluence under strong normalization.
assumptions: DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu
WellFounded reverse Step for the confluence corollary
classical tactic for the variable-overlap case
set_option autoImplicit false
baseline axioms {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.renL
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: renL nu is Sum.inl into RenVar nu, used to rename the first rule of an overlap.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.renR
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: renR nu is Sum.inr into RenVar nu, used to rename the second rule of an overlap.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.overlapAt_complete
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if subtermAt r1.lhs p equals some sub and nu applied to sub equals nu applied to r2.lhs, then overlapAt r1 r2 p emits some (c1, c2) and there exists rho with nu applied to r1.rhs equal to rho applied to c1 and nu applied to the replaced lhs equal to rho applied to c2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.mem_criticalPairs_of_overlapAt
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if r1 and r2 are in R and p is a non-variable position of the renamed r1.lhs and overlapAt emits (c1, c2) then (c1, c2) is in criticalPairs R.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.criticalPairs_complete
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if r1 and r2 are in R and overlap at a non-variable position p under a common instance nu, then there is an emitted (c1, c2) in criticalPairs R and a rho making the two concrete reducts rho-instances of c1 and c2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.joinable_rootOverlap_of_cp_joinable
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if every critical pair of R is joinable in renameTRS R and two renamed rules share a common source instance, then their two root reducts are joinable in renameTRS R.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.subtermAt_apply_cases
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For any substitution, term, position and read redex, either the position lands on a function subterm instantiated by the substitution or it factors through a variable position into the variable image.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.mem_nonVarPositions_of_subtermAt
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If subtermAt t q equals some s and s.isApp is true then q is in nonVarPositions t.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.stepStar_replaceAt_pointwise
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If every variable image reduces from sigma to tau and subtermAt u pv equals some (var x), then replaceAt (sigma applied to u) pv (tau x) reduces to tau applied to u.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.joinable_nested_of_cp_joinable
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if every critical pair is joinable and an inner root contraction sits strictly inside an outer root instance, then the outer rhs and the inner-rewritten lhs are joinable.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.Step.rootStep_or_arg
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If Step R s t holds then either rootStep R s t holds or s and t share a head with one argument stepping.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.cp_joinable_imp_localConfluent
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if every p in criticalPairs R is joinable in renameTRS R then localConfluent (renameTRS R) holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.critical_pair_lemma
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, localConfluent (renameTRS R) holds if and only if for every q in criticalPairs R, joinable (renameTRS R) q.1 q.2 holds.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.confluent_of_cp_joinable_of_SN
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if Step (renameTRS R) is strongly normalizing and every critical pair is joinable, then any two StepStar sequences from a common source join.
