OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPairL.summary: This file provides substitution stability of rewriting and positional lifting of sequences and joinability. It proves the always-join disjoint-peak and variable-overlap cases, the forward direction that local confluence makes every critical pair joinable, and a generic accessibility-based Newman lemma with its rewriting specialization. These are the reusable engines for the full Critical Pair Lemma and for confluence from termination plus local confluence.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPairL.boundary: Local confluence always yields joinable critical pairs, but the upgrade from local to global confluence holds only on the strongly normalizing side. Parallel and variable overlaps always join, while critical overlaps may fail without a joinability hypothesis.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/CriticalPairL.conclusion: Substitution-stable rewriting has parallel and variable peaks always joinable, local confluence implies critical-pair joinability, and strong normalization upgrades local to global confluence.
assumptions: DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu for the forward direction
WellFounded reverse relation for Newman
set_option autoImplicit false
baseline axioms {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Under DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu, if localConfluent (renameTRS R) holds then for every p in criticalPairs R, joinable (renameTRS R) p.1 p.2 holds.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If AbsLocalConfluent r holds and a is accessible under the reverse relation, then any two ReflTransGen sequences from a join.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If WellFounded (fun x y => r y x) holds and AbsLocalConfluent r holds then AbsConfluent r holds.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Match.lean.summary: Defines one-sided matching for first-order terms, threading a partial association list that is closed to a total substitution. Proves that bindings persist, that successful matches bind all pattern variables, and that the resulting substitution carries the pattern onto the target. Illustrates the matcher on a binary symbol and constant with success, head-mismatch, and nonlinear-conflict examples.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Match.lean.boundary: The matcher is one-sided: only pattern variables are instantiated while the target stays fixed, so an application pattern against a variable target always fails.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Match.lean.conclusion: A successful match returns a substitution that carries the pattern onto the target.
assumptions: DecidableEq sigma
DecidableEq nu
set_option autoImplicit false
baseline axioms subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} via Finset/DecidableEq plumbing; no sorry, axiom, or native_decide in code

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.Rewriting.PartialMap

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Orthogonality.summary: Introduces variable-occurrence lists, linearity, left-linearity, and strong and weak orthogonality via critical-pair enumeration. Derives local confluence of the renamed system from either orthogonality notion through the Critical Pair Lemma. Upgrades to confluence under strong normalization via the Newman lemma and exhibits the empty system and a linear left-hand side as witnesses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Orthogonality.boundary: Left-linear systems with empty or trivial critical pairs are locally confluent and, with termination, confluent; systems with genuine critical overlaps need not be.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Orthogonality.conclusion: Orthogonal or weakly orthogonal systems are locally confluent, and confluent under strong normalization.
assumptions: DecidableEq sigma
DecidableEq nu
WellFounded reverse of Step (renameTRS R) for confluence upgrade
set_option autoImplicit false
baseline axioms subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; no sorry, axiom, or native_decide in code

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/ParallelReduc.summary: Defines Tait and Martin-Lof parallel reduction contracting non-overlapping redexes simultaneously with a list companion. Shows a single step is a parallel step and a parallel step unfolds to a rewrite sequence, so the reflexive-transitive closures coincide. Proves stability under parallel-reducing substitutions and exhibits concrete root and contextual steps.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/ParallelReduc.conclusion: Parallel reduction sits between single steps and rewrite sequences with coincident closures and is stable under substitution.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/ParallelReduc.summary: Proves completeness of the syntactic matcher, inversion principles for parallel steps, and that weak orthogonality forces coincident root reducts via renamed-apart critical pairs. Defines shallowness and proves the Takahashi triangle that every parallel reduct reaches the complete development. Lifts the triangle to the parallel diamond and to termination-free confluence of shallow weakly orthogonal systems, witnessed by a one-rule demo.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/ParallelReduc.boundary: Shallow weakly orthogonal systems enjoy termination-free confluence via the triangle; without shallowness or weak orthogonality the reconciliation of root overlaps fails.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/ParallelReduc.conclusion: Every parallel reduct of a shallow weakly orthogonal system parallel-reduces to its complete development, yielding termination-free confluence.
assumptions: DecidableEq sigma
DecidableEq nu
weaklyOrthogonal R
shallow R
set_option autoImplicit false
baseline axioms subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; no sorry, axiom, or native_decide in code

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/ParallelReduc.summary: Defines the first-match root search and the Takahashi complete development by well-founded recursion on term size. Proves the development is always a parallel reduct and hence a rewrite-sequence reduct. Shows parallel reduction over the empty system is equality with the diamond property, yielding termination-free confluence there, and demonstrates the development on a one-rule system.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/ParallelReduc.conclusion: The complete development is always a parallel and hence rewrite reduct, and the empty system is confluent without termination.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Position.lean.summary: Defines positions, subterm lookup, replacement and list replacement, valid positions, and prefix and parallel relations. Proves lookup-after-replacement returns the inserted term at valid positions and that replacements at parallel positions commute. Establishes supporting length, indexing, and case-analysis lemmas for argument lists and parallel positions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Position.lean.boundary: Replacements at parallel non-prefix positions commute; the theorem applies only on that side and does not cover prefix-overlapping positions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Position.lean.conclusion: Valid-position replacement retrieves the inserted term and parallel replacements commute.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/RankOrderClas.summary: Studies natural-valued ranks decreasing on an arbitrary relation, same-order equivalence, and counter systems with realized countdown transitions. Classifies counter-only fiber-constant ranks as strictly monotone recodings with a unique order class, while an invariant coordinate varying independently yields infinitely many orders. Exhibits a product countdown with both phenomena and an empty-relation example where sound ranks disagree.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/RankOrderClas.boundary: Counter-only fiber-constant ranks all induce the same order, while allowing an independently variable invariant coordinate yields infinitely many distinct rank orders.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/RankOrderClas.conclusion: Counter-only ranks have a unique order while an independently variable invariant forces infinitely many rank orders.
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false
Function.Surjective joint-coordinate hypothesis for infinitude
realized countdown transitions counter_state and step_succ for counter systems; no sorry, axiom, or native_decide in code

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/RankedNormali.summary: Defines RankedMachine as a decidable next-step function with a natural-number rank that strictly decreases along every step. Defines iteration to a terminal state as normalize and step counting as cost by well-founded recursion on rank, plus an exact-step relation Steps. Proves every state reaches a terminal normal form, the system is confluent with unique normal forms, joinability coincides with equality of normal forms, and cost equals the length of any normalizing sequence and is bounded by rank.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/RankedNormali.boundary: Reducible states satisfy next equals some successor while terminal states satisfy next equals none. The strictly decreasing rank guarantees termination and unique normalization, which is the limit the file places on deterministic rewriting.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/RankedNormali.conclusion: Every state reaches a unique terminal normal form with deterministic cost bounded by rank and joinability decided by equality of normal forms.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Rewrite.lean.summary: Defines rewrite rules with an application left-hand side and no variable-containment requirement, term rewriting systems as lists of rules, root contraction as a substitution instance of a rule, and the one-step relation Step as the context closure of root steps. Defines the reflexive-transitive closure StepStar, joinability as existence of a common reduct, and local confluence as joinability of every one-step peak. Proves reflexivity transitivity and single-step embeddings for the closure, symmetry and closure properties for joinability, lifting of steps sequences and joinability through a one-argument context, and exhibits a concrete one-rule example with root contextual and joinable witnesses.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Rewrite.lean.boundary: A peak with joinable reducts lies on the locally confluent side while a peak with no common reduct lies on the nonconfluent side. The file characterizes exactly this joinability boundary and permits fresh right-side variables by imposing no containment condition.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Rewrite.lean.conclusion: The file fixes the rewrite relation with its closure and confluence vocabulary and shows the vocabulary is inhabited by a concrete one-rule system.

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Subst.lean.summary: Defines substitutions as total maps from variables to terms with application to terms and lists, identity and composition with the key algebra that applying a composite equals sequential application. Defines a structural occurs-check with its equivalence to variable-set membership and single-point substitution subst1. Proves the variable-image characterization of substituted terms and the load-bearing elimination lemma that applying subst1 x t when x does not occur in t removes x and bounds the result variables.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Subst.lean.boundary: A substitution with occurs x t equal to false lies on the eliminable side while occurs x t equal to true lies on the blocked side. The elimination lemma places this occurs-check limit on removing a variable and bounding introduced variables.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Subst.lean.conclusion: Single-point substitution under a passing occurs-check strictly removes the eliminated variable while bounding introduced variables for unification termination.
assumptions: DecidableEq nu for vars occurs and elimination lemmas
kernel-only with baseline axioms from Finset DecidableEq plumbing and no sorry axiom native_decide partial or unsafe

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Term.lean.summary: Defines first-order terms as variables or function symbols applied to lists of argument terms with a custom nested-list recursor that supplies induction hypotheses on every argument. OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/TerminationCr.summary: Proves strong normalization from a measure into a well-founded order that strictly decreases on every rewrite step and specializes it to Nat-valued measures. Composes the measure bridge with the Critical Pair Lemma corollary so a decreasing measure plus joinable critical pairs yields confluence of the renamed system. Exhibits the one-rule projection system c of x to x where structural size strictly decreases on every step and concludes its strong normalization as a non-vacuous instance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/TerminationCr.boundary: Steps that strictly decrease the measure lie on the terminating confluent side while steps without such a decrease lie outside the criterion. Joinable critical pairs give confluence and a nonjoinable pair would block it, which is the limit the composition enforces.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/TerminationCr.conclusion: A strictly decreasing measure proves strong normalization and with joinable critical pairs proves confluence as witnessed by the terminating projection system.
assumptions: WellFoundedRelation beta for general bridge with Nat specialization
DecidableEq sigma and DecidableEq nu for confluence composition
kernel-only with baseline axioms from Finset DecidableEq plumbing

OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Unify.lean.summary: Defines worklist variable sets and symbol sizes with a single-point substitution across worklists and a zip of argument lists for decomposition. Proves the eliminate move strictly shrinks the variable count, the decompose move preserves variables while strictly shrinking size, and the delete move shrinks the worklist length with size. Defines the Martelli-Montanari solver solve by lexicographic recursion on card size and length with unify as the singleton case and checks binding clash arity and occurs-check behavior on concrete examples.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Unify.lean.boundary: Equations with matching heads equal arity and passing occurs-checks lie on the solvable side returning a substitution while head or arity clashes and occurring variables lie on the failing side returning none. The lexicographic variable size and length measure places the termination limit that each move respects.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Rewriting/Unify.lean.conclusion: The file delivers a terminating worklist unifier that returns idempotent substitution data and fails exactly on clashes and occurs-check violations.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RightDuplicatingRecurso.summary: This file isolates the minimum honest interface for a single rewrite rule whose right side duplicates a distinguished payload variable, with term, coordinate and position types plus occurrence data. It requires one lhs occurrence and at least two rhs occurrences plus a declared closed-firability proposition that is metadata only. It proves the duplication gap is at least one, the rhs count strictly exceeds the lhs count, and the rhs count is positive.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RightDuplicatingRecurso.boundary: Pure abstract-rewriting parametricity is excluded by construction because a position oracle and occurrence counter are required, and duplication is the gap between one lhs occurrence and at least two rhs occurrences.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RightDuplicatingRecurso.conclusion: Any right-duplicating schema has strictly larger rhs payload count with a duplication gap of at least one.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RightDuplicatingRecurso.summary: This file embeds each right-duplicating schema with base and step traces into an RDRS recursive family and lifts the family boundary predicate to schemas. It proves unconditionally that every schema lies outside the uniform-cost direct-measure orientation boundary and that every schema orbit is mass-indistinguishable from any circular-reference orbit. It provides a barrier catalog carrier with empty and list constructors, size and a membership corollary for downstream extensions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RightDuplicatingRecurso.boundary: No uniform-cost direct measure can orient any schema orbit by mass alone, since every such orbit lies outside the direct-measure boundary and is mass-indistinguishable from a circular-reference orbit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RightDuplicatingRecurso.conclusion: Every right-duplicating recursor schema is outside the uniform-cost direct-measure orientation boundary.

OperatorKO7/Meta/RootStrategyNormalizati.summary: This file defines a Boolean-parameterized root-step function for the unguarded KO7 relation and proves it sound and complete with respect to Step. It builds a ranked machine and normalizer with reachability, normality, idempotence and cost bounded by the polynomial weight. It computes both Boolean normal forms of eqW void void and proves they differ, so root normalization depends on strategy.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RootStrategyNormalizati.boundary: The same term eqW void void normalizes to void under the reflexive choice and to integrate of merge void void under the difference choice, so root normalization is strategy-dependent rather than canonical.
OperatorKO7/Meta/RootStrategyNormalizati.conclusion: Root normalization depends on the Boolean strategy, with distinct normal forms for eqW void void.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeRoot_Complexity.lea.summary: This file proves the root tail measure is linear in structural term size and that exact guarded root reductions are linearly bounded and lift to context-closed chains. It shows the counted root normalizer length is realized by an exact path and therefore bounded by computable fuel, the size-based tower bound, the MW root bound and a linear size bound. It restates the merge-spine exact lower bound to give matching linear lower and size families.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeRoot_Complexity.lea.boundary: Guarded root normalizer length is at most linear in term size and this is tight because the merge-void chain realizes exact linear length, so a sublinear upper bound is impossible.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeRoot_Complexity.lea.conclusion: The certified root normalizer runs in linear term size with a matching linear lower family.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep.lean.summary: This file contains no new definitions or theorems and only imports the seven SafeStep gauge-fixing modules as one namespace surface. It documents the canonical citation chain from payload discarding through the EqW anomaly, guard, non-derivability, smuggling and functor results. It lists audit anchors pointing to the local-confluence, guard-restoration, fracture and non-faithfulness theorems proved elsewhere.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep.lean.conclusion: The file provides a single import surface with no additional declarations.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/AscentProfileD.summary: This file measures the six-step licensed-ascent comparison category. It proves any two realized profiles of the same family are stagewise equivalent and that compatibility with the dependency-pair profile is exactly six realized stages plus the reflection tag. It builds the contentless all-True profile with witnesses both ways to the distinction profile, shows hom-sets are subsingletons, and bundles these as the identity-is-classification theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/AscentProfileD.boundary: A profile is compatible or comparable with the dependency-pair profile exactly when it has six true stages and the reflection tag; the limit is that comparison is degenerate, with subsingleton hom-sets carrying no witness data beyond the classification.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/AscentProfileD.conclusion: The six-step identity classifies by family tag and six truth values with subsingleton hom-sets and transports no witness data.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/BoundaryDualit.summary: The file defines a collapse boundary operator that sends every in-domain optional-trace input to a single verdict while discarding payload, and proves it satisfies the partiality, irreversibility, gauge-covariance, channel, payload-discarding and cost-floor laws. It defines boundary morphisms with identity and composition, then instantiates the collapse operator as distinction and orientation boundaries with verdicts void and delta void. It defines the verdict swap from Equiv.swap and two inverse morphisms that are the identity on queries and the swap on verdicts. It proves the two boundaries are isomorphic as boundary operators, with an explicit honest-scope note that the isomorphism captures collapse structure rather than full rewrite dynamics.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/BoundaryDualit.boundary: The boundary operator is defined on some inputs, namely all non-none queries, where every input collapses irreversibly to one verdict with payload unrecoverable, while none lies outside the domain. The duality holds at the collapse level and does not imply reconstructibility of the full rewrite dynamics from the verdict.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/BoundaryDualit.conclusion: The distinction and orientation boundaries are isomorphic objects in the category of boundary operators through the verdict-swapping morphisms.
assumptions: no sorry, no new axiom, no native_decide and no csimp, as stated in the header
baseline axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound reported by the #print axioms spot-check noted in the header
noncomputable definitions using classical choice, including Equiv.swap and the collapse operator

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/CrossAxisConfe.summary: This file supplies termination-side evidence for cross-axis comparison using the payload projection of the reflected direct grammar. It builds a payload-only and a counter-plus-payload semantic measure, proves the latter orients iiRecursor while remaining counter-dominated so no decisive support exists, and keeps the fixed-duplicator refusal independent with no relation transport. It packages refusal evidence, defines a classifier emitting T3 confession when refusal exists and T4 abstention otherwise, and proves both axes share the T3 constructor while full outputs differ.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/CrossAxisConfe.boundary: No measure both reads payload and orients the duplicating relation, so decisive support is refused and classified as T3 confession; the limit is constructor-level sharing between axes without full-output identity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/CrossAxisConfe.conclusion: Termination and confluence refusals share only the T3 confession constructor, not full outputs.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/EqualityWitnes.summary: This file defines comparison interfaces with sound and complete difference verdicts and distinction generators that register distinctions exactly off the diagonal. It shows every carrier has an external comparison interface and that a decidable interface yields DecidableEq and an exact comparator. It proves sound comparison never emits difference on the diagonal, while an internalized unguarded totalized equality witness forks exactly when its two verdicts do not join. It exhibits guarded, delete and quotient repairs that restore joinability and proves not every equality-witness interface forks, with KO7 eqW as the minimal unguarded instance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/EqualityWitnes.boundary: Sound comparison refuses the difference verdict on the diagonal, while an internalized unguarded totalized witness forks there; guarded, delete and quotient modes restore diagonal joinability.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/EqualityWitnes.conclusion: Comparison is necessary and universally available, but only the internalized unguarded totalized mode forks on the diagonal while guarded interfaces provide explicit counterexamples to universal failure.
assumptions: Classical.choice via by_contra in ComparisonInterface.toDecidableEq
Decidable difference verdicts for resource constructions
DiagonalDetermined hypothesis for classification and repair-exhaustiveness theorems

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/FaithfulnessNo.summary: This file defines payload-faithful dynamical boundary functors and proves a general no-go: a functor whose object map covers the boundary domain is never payload-faithful because image recovery would contradict payloadDiscarding. It instantiates the no-go for the full-kernel distinction and orientation functors and the guarded distinction functor, and shows the collapse functors are verdict-constant. It also proves the generic image-section characterization that a projection has an exact section iff it is injective.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/FaithfulnessNo.boundary: Payload-discarding boundaries admit no covering payload-faithful dynamical functor: the boundary verdict cannot be inverted to recover its source payload.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/FaithfulnessNo.conclusion: No payload-discarding boundary admits a covering payload-faithful dynamical functor, in particular not the distinction and orientation collapse functors.
assumptions: Classical.choice via Classical.choose in image-section proof
propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound baseline per #print axioms
covering hypothesis that object map hits every boundary-domain point for the no-go

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep/NonlinearityDi.summary: The file models KO7 rule schemas with metavariables b, s, n and a and terms over seven constructors, counting occurrences with occ and defining left-nonlinearity and right-duplication. It proves eqW a a is left-nonlinear and the successor recursor rule is right-duplicating, packaging the shared double-occurrence fact as a uniform dichotomy. It bundles the dual nonlinearity with the real unjoinable fork at eqW void void as RawMechanismCorrespondence and proves the KO7 instance. It proves right-duplication does not force nontermination since the duplicating recursor lives in a globally well-founded reverse step relation, and packages the complete boundary.

It establishes Newman lemma, the equivalence between confluence and everywhere local joinability, and unconditional confluence.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStepCtx_Confluence..conclusion: SafeStepCtx is unconditionally confluent via strong normalization plus exhaustive local joinability.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_Fas.summary: This file defines a finite fast-growing hierarchy with monotonicity, inflationary and level-raising lemmas plus closed forms at levels one and two dominating powers. It defines a size-indexed envelope rising in hierarchy level with size. It proves the tower bound lies below that envelope and hence contextual derivation lengths are bounded by it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_Fas.boundary: The tower-exponential contextual bound is subsumed by an explicit finite-level fast-growing envelope, so lengths cannot exceed fgOmegaEnvelope of size.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_Fas.conclusion: Contextual derivation lengths are bounded by an explicit fast-growing envelope dominating the tower bound.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.summary: This file packages contextual fuel into the lex3Note and Cichon family with representation below ω^ω times 2. It exhibits a concrete contextual rec_succ step under integrate whose calibrated triple-lex measure and root note strictly increase. It proves no universal root-note or mu3c drop holds for SafeStepCtx, explaining why direct root descent cannot certify contexts, then bounds lengths by the fuel-based MW Cichon value.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.boundary: The calibrated root measure strictly increases on an exhibited SafeStepCtx step, so no direct mu3c descent can certify the full contextual relation and the bound must package ctxFuel separately.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.conclusion: Root mu3c descent fails for contexts via an explicit increasing step while a ctxFuel-based MW Cichon bound still holds.
assumptions: scoped Classical opened for ordinal reasoning

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.summary: This file gives direct contextual fundamental-sequence extraction on a fresh note keeping only contextual fuel. It proves concatenation of exact chains, that every contextual step induces exact predecessor descent by strict fuel drop, and that fuel is antitone along chains. It shows path length equals fuel drop and is bounded by the Cichon value of the new note, with a paper-facing alias.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.boundary: The fresh fuel-only note below ω supports exact predecessor descent for every SafeStepCtx step via strict fuel drop, succeeding where the root-calibrated note fails under contexts.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.conclusion: Contextual lengths are bounded by a direct exact-control Cichon value on a fresh fuel-only note.
assumptions: scoped Classical opened for ordinal reasoning

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.summary: This file builds the notation bridge from the triple-lex ordinal calibration to ONote and NONote with representation equalities and calibration below ω^ω times 2. It characterizes successor fundamental sequences in the lex3Note family and shows every guarded root source is a successor with an explicit predecessor bounding its target. It defines the MW root Cichon bound and proves root chain lengths bounded by tau and hence by that bound.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.boundary: Guarded root reductions are bounded by the finite tau tail inside the ω^ω times 2 block because a rec_succ target is an app with no further root step, while the full context-closed relation needs a separate fuel argument.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_MW_.conclusion: Guarded root derivation lengths are bounded by a notation-level MW Cichon value inside the calibrated block.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_Ord.summary: This file extracts concrete derivation bounds from well-foundedness via the computable ctxFuel measure for iterated context-closed reduction. It defines structural term size and a tower-exponential function with positivity and monotonicity. It proves ctxFuel lies below the tower of term size and hence every context-closed chain length is bounded by that tower function.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_Ord.boundary: No SafeStepCtx chain from a term of size n can exceed towerBound n, giving a tower-exponential limit that the later single-exponential analysis refines.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Complexity_Ord.conclusion: Any SafeStepCtx chain length is bounded by the tower of its source term size.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Core.lean.summary: This file defines a computable weight and multiset payload kappaM for KO7 traces and a binary deltaFlag, together with simp equations for each trace constructor. It proves well-foundedness of the Dershowitz-Manna order on multisets of naturals and extension lemmas that enlarge a multiset while staying larger in that order. It then defines the guarded root relation SafeStep with eight rules for integrate, merge, recursor and equality witnesses, and its reverse SafeStepRev for strong-normalization statements.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Core.lean.boundary: SafeStep fires only when its deltaFlag and kappaM guards are satisfied, so guarded traces rewrite while guard-violating traces are stuck at the root. The Dershowitz-Manna payload is well-founded, placing allowed root steps on the terminating side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Core.lean.conclusion: The file establishes the guarded SafeStep root relation together with a well-founded Dershowitz-Manna payload that can orient its steps.
assumptions: classical tactic in DM extension lemmas
WellFoundedLT Nat instance from Mathlib

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Ctx.lean.summary: This file defines SafeStepCtx as the one-step contextual closure of SafeStep and SafeStepCtxStar as its reflexive-transitive closure, with lifting lemmas through integrate, merge, app and recursor arguments. It defines LocalJoinSafe_ctx for joins after two root steps and proves vacuous or unique joins for shapes with zero or one applicable root rule, including void, delta, app, integrate and recursor cases. It then proves conditional joins for the eqW reflexive peak that require a merge-to-delta or normalize-to-delta premise with cancel guards.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Ctx.lean.boundary: Local joins proved here hold for the safe root and context-closed fragment only. Nothing here asserts confluence or joinability for the full kernel Step relation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeStep_Ctx.lean.conclusion: The file reduces context-closed local joins for the safe fragment to vacuous or unique cases plus explicit merge-to-delta conditions for the reflexive equality peak.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_CertificateAu.summary: This file defines an eight-row finite audit over safe-trace certificate and complexity surfaces and the evidence proposition carried by each row, covering root endpoints, context chains, externalized recovery, realized exactness, full-carrier obstruction and three quantitative bounds. It proves membership characterization and completeness of the audit list and defines a function that projects theorem-backed evidence for every listed row. It packages these into a certificate audit catalog with completeness and evidence projection.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_CertificateAu.boundary: Each row projects evidence only for the realized trace image and its certified bounds. Surjectivity onto the full calibrated carrier fails and is recorded as an obstruction rather than claimed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_CertificateAu.conclusion: The canonical audit catalog projects theorem-backed evidence for all eight certificate surfaces without claiming full-carrier surjectivity.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_RealizableOrd.summary: This file builds tower-closed trace realizations of finite DM payloads and shows that prefix-tower closure preserves strict Dershowitz-Manna comparisons. It constructs phase-zero and phase-one tower carriers and proves both preserve DM order with every phase-zero point preceding every phase-one point. It embeds two complete omega-omega blocks into the realizable carrier and the realizable carrier into the calibrated interval to prove the realizable and ambient images have order type omega-omega times two.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_RealizableOrd.boundary: The trace image is a proper subset of the calibrated carrier, yet tower closure shows this gap does not lower the well-order type. Non-surjectivity holds on one side while order-type equality at omega-omega times two holds on the other.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_RealizableOrd.conclusion: The trace-realizable carrier has exact order type omega-omega times two despite missing points of the full calibrated carrier.

noncomputable ordinal embeddings with autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexAmbi.summary: This file defines the ambient trace image as the range subtype of the trace-to-carrier map and shows it coincides with the trace-realizable carrier through an equivalence and a relation isomorphism. It proves the calibrated code is injective on the image, induces a well-order, and stays below the calibrated bound, so both subtypes share the same ordinal type. It retains the established non-surjectivity witness as the remaining residual.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexAmbi.boundary: The ambient image is properly contained in the full calibrated carrier via the compiled obstruction witness, while its code order is isomorphic to the realizable carrier order. Proper inclusion holds on one side and order-type equality holds on the other.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexAmbi.conclusion: The ambient trace image and the realizable carrier have equal ordinal order types while remaining proper subsets of the calibrated carrier.
assumptions: noncomputable ordinal codes with no sorry or axiom visible

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexExac.summary: This file defines a general realization framework from trace-like objects into the calibrated binary-phase carrier with ordinal codes, orders and exact-order-type packages, and instantiates it for KO7 traces via mu3c. It exhibits three constructive realizable families and proves phase-one traces must carry one in their DM component, so an explicit phase-one zero-DM carrier is unrealizable and the trace code is not injective. It packages exactness on the realized subtype together with explicit non-surjectivity and non-faithfulness obstructions.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexExac.boundary: Traces realize exactly the subtype where phase-one points contain one in their DM component, while phase-one zero-DM carriers and faithful coding of ambient syntax fail. Exactness and faithfulness hold on the realized subtype but fail on the full carrier.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexExac.conclusion: The trace-to-carrier map is neither surjective nor injective on ambient syntax, so it admits no exact order-type package, though its realized subtype is exact.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexExac.summary: This file builds a single catalog structure that collects the theorem-backed safe-trace exactness surface on top of calibrated carriers. It defines SafeTraceExactnessFinalCatalog with fields for code-carrier equality, order exactness, image bounds, faithfulness obstructions, exact-order-type residuals, image statuses and embedded certificate, complexity, audit and closeout catalogs. It then constructs the canonical catalog and proves projection theorems exposing each field, including collisions, non-injectivity, unrealized carriers, realizable-subtype exactness, endpoint and context bounds, and finite audit and closeout rows.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexExac.boundary: Exact code-carrier and order correspondence hold on the trace-realizable image subtype but fail on the full triple-lex carrier, which is not surjective. An exact order-type package for the full carrier would require a surjectivity residual that the file refutes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SafeTrace_TripleLexExac.conclusion: The catalog shows exactness holds on the realizable image subtype while the full carrier is not realizable and admits no unconditional exact order-type package.
assumptions: classical choice via noncomputable catalog definitions

OperatorKO7/Meta/ScalarProjectionBarrier.summary: This file packages a reusable scalar-projection template for vector-valued orientation barriers. It proves that if every R-decrease forces a strict decrease of a scalar projection and that scalar decrease is already impossible on the duplicating step, then R cannot orient the step, with a global-root variant. It then instantiates the template for tracked componentwise pairs via the first coordinate, weighted functional matrix measures via weighted sums, and balanced mixed-coordinate pairs via coordinate sums using unbounded-range scalar barriers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ScalarProjectionBarrier.boundary: A vector-valued orienter is blocked whenever its decreases force a blocked scalar decrease. The file thus limits tracked-pair, weighted-matrix and mixed-sum measures to cases where their scalar projections escape the affine barrier.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ScalarProjectionBarrier.conclusion: No vector-valued measure whose decreases force a blocked scalar decrease can orient the duplicating step.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaBarrier_OrderedCa.summary: This file develops orientation barriers over ordered carriers. It defines additive measures over partially ordered commutative monoids and compositional measures over preorders, proving that additive orientation is impossible when the successor weight is attained and that compositional orientation is impossible under successor transparency at the base. It shows the attainment hypothesis is necessary via a strictly negative integer model that orients every instance while attaining nothing, and it instantiates the barriers in NatOrdinals with Hessenberg addition plus an affine omega-times-n reading that orients finite payloads but fails at omega.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaBarrier_OrderedCa.boundary: Additive orientation fails when the successor weight is attained, automatic for nonnegative base weight, but can succeed without attainment as the negative-integer model shows. Ordinal affine orientation holds for finite payloads yet fails at payload omega without transparency.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaBarrier_OrderedCa.conclusion: Attainability and transparency exactly delimit where ordered additive and compositional orientation barriers apply, with explicit counterexamples beyond the boundary.

Preorder for compositional measures
noncomputable NatOrdinal embeddings

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaBarriersClassAxio.summary: States constructor-local max-plus equations for succ, wrap and recur with free offsets and zero wrapper scaling. Proves by splitting on the successor offset that the wrapper returns at least its recursive argument, using constancy at zero offset and pumping along successor iteration otherwise. Concludes no such evaluation strictly orients the duplicating step at any offsets.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaBarriersClassAxio.boundary: No constructor-local max-plus evaluation orients the duplicating step strictly at any offsets, including all-zero offsets with zero wrapper scaling.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaBarriersClassAxio.conclusion: Constructor-local max-plus measures at any offsets cannot orient the duplicating step.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaCanonicalTrace.le.summary: This file introduces base duplicating systems with an explicit base-step rule and builds the canonical wrapper trace from counters, wrap chains and recursors. It defines reflexive-transitive StepStar closure with context-closure hypotheses and proves stagewise and full reachability from recur terms to wrapped bases. It also defines independent counter, payload and wrap coordinates with per-step exchange and offset conservation identities.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaCanonicalTrace.le.conclusion: Every canonical trace reaches its wrapped base by reflexive-transitive steps under wrap-context closure.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaConfessionDominan.summary: This file defines abstract burden and entropy numerics for canonical-trace analysis, including doubled confessed burdens, quadratic and linear normalizers, and proof-entropy size, value and overhead functions. It proves closed-form summation identities and real-limit behaviour where quadratic and linear normalizers tend to p over two and w over two, burden ratios eventually dominate any bound for positive payload, and proof entropy tends to one for positive steps as payload grows while staying monotone. The header stresses these are stipulated numeric models and that a bridge to trace-term observations needs separate declarations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaConfessionDominan.conclusion: Doubled burdens grow quadratically with limits p over two and w over two while proof entropy is monotone and tends to one as payload grows.
assumptions: noncomputable real-valued invariants
1 ≤ p for ratio dominance
1 ≤ i for entropy limit

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaExplicitDescripti.summary: This file compares a repeated-carrier envelope of i plus one cells of weight beta plus gamma with an explicit description length of seed plus wrapper plus binary index code plus glue. It proves an additive rearrangement identity and shows the unqualified gap reading is false because the explicit description is strictly longer at stage zero. It then proves a threshold theorem where the envelope strictly exceeds the description once weight, index and glue conditions hold, with a linear-growth strengthening and an attained witness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaExplicitDescripti.boundary: The gap is negative at stage zero but becomes positive and growing once 2 is at most beta plus gamma, 2 is at most i and c0 is less than i hold.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaExplicitDescripti.conclusion: Above an explicit small-index threshold the repeated-carrier envelope strictly and increasingly exceeds the explicit description, while the unqualified claim fails at zero.
assumptions: 2 ≤ beta+gamma, 2 ≤ i and c0 < i for positivity and growth

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaForgettingWitness.summary: This file defines a schema-generic forgetting witness as a rank that orients the duplicating step while explicitly violating wrapper sensitivity on both payload positions. It provides constructors from projection ranks, confession-core witnesses, semantic profiles with four hypotheses, and route evidence, each preserving the rank. It also adds a ConfessionMethod adapter that yields a forgetting witness via its projection rank, noting the package records counterexamples and orientation without claiming causation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaForgettingWitness.boundary: Orientation and sensitivity violations are packaged together without proving that orientation succeeds because of the violations, and concrete method coverage needs typed adapters.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaForgettingWitness.conclusion: Every projection, confession-core, semantic, route and confession-method rank yields a forgetting witness with the same rank.
assumptions: NormalizedAtBase, TracksSuccessorDepth, ForgetsWrapperPayload and FollowsRecursiveCounter for semantic construction

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaNormMismatch.lean.summary: This file studies diagonal wrapper stacks with seed-rank, maximum and additive coordinates, proving they coincide degenerately but separate strictly for i at least 2 and p at least 2 while maximum is always at most additive and seed rank needs positive size. It defines stipulated logarithmic gauge entropies and a quadratic-over-log inefficiency coefficient, proving linear lower bounds, unboundedness and Theta characterizations for direct, per-residual and per-step rates. It also defines repeated-carrier mass and explicit description length, proving a logarithmic upper bound, an exact balance identity and its linear-gap rearrangement.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaNormMismatch.lean.boundary: The three diagonal coordinates agree on empty or unit stacks but are pairwise strictly ordered once i is at least 2 and p is at least 2, while the stipulated inefficiency coefficient is unbounded and Theta-quadratic-over-log without claiming Shannon uniqueness or convergence to infinity.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaNormMismatch.lean.conclusion: On nonempty diagonal stacks the three norm-like coordinates separate strictly above small thresholds while the stipulated inefficiency grows Theta-quadratically over log and without bound.
assumptions: 1 ≤ p, 2 ≤ i and 2 ≤ p for norm orderings
1 ≤ k and 1 ≤ w for inefficiency bounds and Theta results
noncomputable real logarithm and division

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaOffsetAndWrapper..summary: This file mechanizes wrapper cells, stacks and payload tuples for base duplicating systems, proving stack length, diagonal entries and offset conservation against the payload coordinate. It proves permutation gauge symmetry where constant tuples are fixed by every payload permutation and additive mass is permutation-invariant while recording multiplicity exactly and strictly increasingly for positive size. It proves the counter is the unique gauge-invariant retained coordinate that strictly descends and reverses, whereas payload and wrap multiplicities ascend.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaOffsetAndWrapper..boundary: Only the counter both is gauge-invariant and strictly descends when i is less than k, while payload mass and wrap multiplicity strictly ascend and cannot serve as descending coordinates.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaOffsetAndWrapper..conclusion: The counter is the gauge-invariant strictly descending retained coordinate along the canonical trace, while payload multiplicity is gauge-symmetric but ascending.
assumptions: 0 < size b and i < j for strict monotonicity
i < k for counter descent and reversibility
classical reasoning in payloadMass_permute

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaOperationalIncomp.summary: Defines an abstract operational question interface and the predicate for being operationally incomplete, plus a direct-aggregation claim language for step-duplicating systems. Proves the direct-aggregation language is incomplete once the dimension is present, using additive, transparent-compositional and unbounded-affine barriers, and packages a concrete evidence bundle from any projection rank. Separates construction methods from confession methods and shows no response can be both, with both classes inhabited on the free schema by W1 and the counter-depth projection. Adds a projection-transaction reading of the boundary as a static map from trace to verdict.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaOperationalIncomp.boundary: When the duplicating dimension is present, no derivable direct-aggregation claim both uses that dimension and constrains termination. Construction ranks and forgetting confession ranks are mutually exclusive: no rank can satisfy both.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaOperationalIncomp.conclusion: The direct-aggregation language is operationally incomplete, projection ranks yield the exact incompleteness bundle, and construction and confession responses are disjoint yet both inhabited on the free schema.
assumptions: requires a StepDuplicatingSystem Sys
direct-aggregation incompleteness requires dimensionPresent
canonical bundle requires a ProjectionRank R
no sorry, axiom or native_decide appears in the code

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaSeedCarrierFactor.summary: Defines diagonal submodules, collapse maps forgetting carrier multiplicity, and families of payload observables. Proves a payload family is insensitive to carrier multiplicity along the diagonal if and only if it factors through the collapse maps, with a unique factoring map. Shows the seed-only observable factors while the direct additive l1 reading does not when some seed has positive size.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaSeedCarrierFactor.boundary: A payload family factors through the seed-collapse maps exactly when it is insensitive to carrier multiplicity along the diagonal. The seed-only observable lies on the factoring side while the additive l1 reading lies outside when some seed has positive size.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaSeedCarrierFactor.conclusion: Carrier-insensitivity along the diagonal is equivalent to factoring through seed-collapse maps, with the seed-only observable factoring and the additive reading not factoring under positive size.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaWitnessOrder.lean.summary: Defines a coarse four-level witness hierarchy and a schema-parametric witness tower with minimal-order predicates and the orientation-boundary predicate as absence of a direct whole-term witness. Proves the boundary is equivalent to having no direct whole-term witness and gives threshold forms locating the first available witness at the transformed-call layer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaWitnessOrder.lean.boundary: The orientation boundary holds exactly when the direct whole-term witness language is empty, with the first available witness at most the transformed-call layer when such a witness exists.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SchemaWitnessOrder.lean.conclusion: The orientation boundary is equivalent to absence of a direct whole-term witness, with a transformed-call witness placing the minimal order at that layer.

OperatorKO7/Meta/ScopeBoundaryWitnesses..summary: Packages compiled witnesses for six scope bullets: generic rank-based dependency-pair soundness versus sharp failure of source transport, weak matrix readings with zero orienters, arbitrary weak semantic readings, r-ary duplicator coverage, and a cross-coupled nonlinear weight orienting the step. Proves each bullet with an explicit object, including two distinct KO7 reduction pairs, an empty pair problem versus a non-wellfounded source, and the r-ary quantitative laws at all arities.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ScopeBoundaryWitnesses..boundary: Each scope bullet marks a limit of the claim surface: pair soundness is generic but does not imply source termination, weak readings and zerowrapper matrices lie outside the strict barrier, and the r-ary shape and cross-term witness now delimit the boundary from inside.
OperatorKO7/Meta/ScopeBoundaryWitnesses..conclusion: All six scope bullets are backed by compiled witnesses, including nonunique KO7 reduction pairs and a strictly orienting cross-coupled weight.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SemanticMethodBoundary..summary: Defines a three-constructor registry of semantic method classes with route and status metadata and a support predicate linking each class to existing theorems or certificates. Proves every class is supported, the three-member list is exact and complete, and packages the whole catalog and its certificate with the imported method separated from direct W0.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SemanticMethodBoundary..boundary: Transparent whole-term measures reduce to existing W0 theorems, while the imported model remains a licensed W1 escape and never a direct W0 route.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SemanticMethodBoundary..conclusion: Every one of the three semantic method classes is supported with its exact route and status, and the imported method is certified as a licensed escape distinct from direct W0.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SemanticMethodGrammar.l.summary: Defines a three-constructor exact grammar for semantic methods and a total classifier assigning every constructor a W1 licensed-escape status. Proves universal coverage and classification, conjoins the six-constructor DP grammar with this three-constructor grammar into a single 9-type universal classification, and embeds the boundary catalog into the grammar injectively.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SemanticMethodGrammar.l.boundary: In the exact-grammar sense every semantic method imports structure from outside, so all three constructors lie on the W1 licensed-escape side and none on the direct W0 side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SemanticMethodGrammar.l.conclusion: All DP plus semantic methods admit universal coverage and classification across exactly nine types, with every semantic method classified as W1 licensed escape.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SharingBarrierLift.lean.summary: Defines a minimal sharing-aware syntax with a shared application node and a step that references rather than copies the payload. Defines a counter that ignores the shared payload and proves it strictly decreases on the step, giving well-foundedness, so the additive-style direct obstruction disappears under sharing.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SharingBarrierLift.lean.boundary: The tree and no-sharing assumption is load-bearing: the additive-style direct counter succeeds once the payload is shared rather than copied, so the tree barrier fails on the sharing side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SharingBarrierLift.lean.conclusion: Under sharing the direct counter orients the duplicating step and the reverse step is well-founded, showing the tree assumption is genuine.

OperatorKO7/Meta/StepDuplicatingSchema.l.summary: Defines the generic step-duplicating schema with base, successor, wrapper and duplicating recursor, plus additive, affine, compositional and projection-rank measures and global orientation. Proves no additive, transparent-successor compositional or unbounded-affine measure can orient the duplicating step or orient a system containing it globally, and that any global Nat orienter is not representable in those classes. Shows projection ranks orient the step while violating wrapper subterm sensitivity, with uniqueness on generated schemas via a shared confession-core and route-evidence layer.
OperatorKO7/Meta/StepDuplicatingSchema.l.boundary: No additive, transparent-compositional or unbounded-affine measure can orient the duplicating step, while projection ranks that forget wrapper payload do orient it. Any Nat global orienter is therefore not representable in those direct classes.
OperatorKO7/Meta/StepDuplicatingSchema.l.conclusion: Direct additive, transparent compositional and unbounded affine measures all fail to orient the duplicating step globally, whereas forgetting projection ranks succeed and are unique on generated schemas.
assumptions: compositional barrier requires transparent successor at base with c_succ c_base equal c_base
affine barrier requires HasUnboundedRange or positive succ or wrap pump with 1 le drift
additive wrapper weight satisfies w_wrap at least 1 and affine wrapper coefficients at least 1
uniqueness requires GeneratedByConstructors

OperatorKO7/Meta/Step_Complexity_LowerBo.summary: Lifts a guarded exponential lower family to full contextual Step, solves its exact length recurrence as 2^(n+2)-3, and proves every full derivation is bounded by 8^termSize via a polynomial weight. Combines these into a single-exponential sandwich with linear source size and proves no linear-in-size bound covers all derivations.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Step_Complexity_LowerBo.boundary: Linear-size sources already force exponential derivation length, so no linear bound holds, yet every derivation lies below the single-exponential upper bound 8^termSize.
OperatorKO7/Meta/Step_Complexity_LowerBo.conclusion: Unguarded StepCtxFull has single-exponential derivational complexity that is tight below 8^termSize and not linear.
assumptions: relies on imported guarded lower-family facts termSize_ctxLowerFamily, ctxLowerFamily_pow_nf and two_pow_le_ctxLowerLen
relies on imported upper-bound stepCtxFullPow_length_lt_W
no sorry, admit, axiom or native_decide

Proves no variable-condition order can orient the duplicating rule, while exhibiting a size-plus-dominance order that is well-founded, orients the successor peel and zero rule, and rejects the duplicating rule.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SymbolicComparatorBarri.conclusion: No variable-condition order orients the duplicating rule, yet the class is nonempty with a well-founded member orienting non-duplicating rules.

OperatorKO7/Meta/SymbolicComparatorBarri.summary: Extends the symbolic barrier with argument coefficients, weighted occurrence counts and subterm-coefficient positivity, computing the payload counts as recur2 versus wrap1+wrap2*recur2. Proves the weighted condition fails for every positive assignment, shows each wrapper positivity is load-bearing via degenerate assignments, and recovers the unweighted count at unit coefficients.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SymbolicComparatorBarri.boundary: For every positive coefficient assignment the weighted payload count strictly increases, so no subterm-coefficient order orients the rule, while dropping either wrapper positivity lets the condition hold.

degenerate sharpness uses wrap1 equal zero or wrap2 equal zero

OperatorKO7/Meta/SynthesisOracle.lean.summary: This file defines a small synthesis-oracle interface that returns a concrete barrier certificate for a candidate direct measure. It packages candidate types for transparent-compositional and affine-with-pump measures and defines certificate-side values with a changes-at-certificate predicate. It proves that any refinement succeeding on the returned triple must change at least one certificate side. It instantiates the interface with additive, transparent-compositional, affine, and automatic affine-with-pump oracles.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SynthesisOracle.lean.boundary: A refinement that preserves both certificate-side values cannot turn the oracle triple into a strict decrease; any successful refinement must change at least one side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/SynthesisOracle.lean.conclusion: Any refinement that succeeds on the oracle certificate triple must change at least one certificate-side value.
assumptions: strict success hypothesis that eval1 makes the certificate triple strictly decrease

OperatorKO7/Meta/TextbookDupInstance.lea.summary: This file instantiates the step-duplicating schema on the textbook rule f of x and successor y to g of x and f of x y with a dummy base. It defines the term syntax, schema view, root step, and packaged system. It proves three barrier corollaries for additive, unbounded affine, and transparent compositional measures. It specializes the generic additive, compositional, and affine witness extractors to this carrier.

OperatorKO7/Meta/TextbookDupInstance_Ful.summary: This file instantiates every schema barrier at the textbook system across scalar, matrix, arctic and tropical, ordered-carrier, and unconstrained direct families. It defines a cross-coupled weight that strictly orients the rule and packages it as quadratic, multilinear, and polynomial measures violating exactly the dominance premises. It proves those three premises sharp and assembles a full barrier-stack record carried by the textbook rule with an exact boundary theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TextbookDupInstance_Ful.boundary: Bounded and dominated nonlinear classes cannot orient the textbook rule, while a cross-coupled interpretation violating exactly those dominance premises does orient it. The dominance hypotheses are therefore sharp and cannot be dropped.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TextbookDupInstance_Ful.conclusion: The textbook rule carries the full barrier stack, and the three dominance premises are exactly sharp via one orienting cross-coupled interpretation.
assumptions: dominance premises CrossTermBoundedAtBase and MultilinearDominatedAtBase and EventuallyDominatedAtBase
uncoupled subclasses with no cross term and no coupling and no counter exponent
matrix positivity and dominance with WrapDiagPositive and primary positivity and EWZ monotonicity and scalar dominance plus unbounded range
ordered-carrier attainability and transparency premises

OperatorKO7/Meta/TransformedCallClassifi.summary: This file defines a two-constructor W2 route class with theorem-bearing evidence and success structures packaging transformed-call witnesses. It proves every W2 success yields a permitted transform and an underlying transformed-call witness, instantiated by canonical duplicating and linear successes. It shows the duplicating W2 route stays separated from direct whole-term search and catalogs both witnesses plus a confession-route agreement conjunction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TransformedCallClassifi.boundary: Direct whole-term search fails on the duplicating member while the W2 transformed-call routes succeed; every W2 success carries a transformed-call witness and no direct witness exists for the duplicating case.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TransformedCallClassifi.conclusion: Every theorem-backed W2 success realizes a permitted transformed-call route with an underlying witness, instantiated by canonical duplicating and linear successes separated from direct search.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The permitted W2 routes are exactly two cases: ko7DPProjection and benchmarkFamilyTransformedCall.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A W2 success is a construction route equal to W2 with target, transform class, and theorem-level transform evidence for that class and target.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.TransformedCallClassification.PermittedW2Transform
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The permitted W2 transform proposition has a ko7DPProjection case on fullDuplicating carrying a projection route and witness, and a benchmarkFamilyTransformedCall case on cfg carrying a witness.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.TransformedCallClassification.fullLinear_w2_success
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Canonical W2 success with route W2, target fullLinear, class benchmarkFamilyTransformedCall, and evidence from the linear transformed-call witness.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The linear canonical success yields a transformed-call witness for fullLinear.

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: The duplicating W2 route is not W0 and has a transformed-call witness for fullDuplicating while having no direct witness for fullDuplicating.

OperatorKO7/Meta/TropicalBarrier.lean.summary: This file specializes the tropical primary-projection barrier to the KO7 schema and system. It proves that no tropical primary measure with unbounded projected max globally orients KO7.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TropicalBarrier.lean.boundary: A tropical primary measure whose projected max has unbounded range cannot orient the duplicating step or globally orient the KO7 system.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TropicalBarrier.lean.conclusion: No tropical primary measure with unbounded projected max globally orients the KO7 system.
assumptions: unbounded range of projected max (hunbounded)

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.TropicalBarrier.no_global_step_orientation_tropical_primary_of_unbounded
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every tropical primary measure M on ko7Schema with unbounded projected max, it is false that M globally orients ko7System with eval and lt.

relations.explanation: The KO7 theorem specializes the schema-generic tropical barrier to the KO7 system.

OperatorKO7/Meta/TropicalBarrier_Schema..summary: This file defines tropical primary measures as eval with a Nat primary projection identified with a max measure. It proves three schema-generic barriers showing no such measure orients the duplicating step under unbounded, successor-pump, or wrap-pump hypotheses. Each proof reduces strict lt orientation to a max-measure inequality already ruled out.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TropicalBarrier_Schema..boundary: Under unboundedness, successor-pump, or wrap-pump hypotheses on the projected max, a tropical primary measure cannot orient the duplicating schema step. The strict primary projection reduces orientation to a max-barrier violation.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TropicalBarrier_Schema..conclusion: No tropical primary measure orients the duplicating schema step under any of the three stated max-pump conditions.
assumptions: unbounded range of projected max
successor-pump constant at least one
wrap-pump constants summing to at least one

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.TropicalPrimaryMeasure
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: A tropical primary measure has eval, strict comparison lt, primary projection to Nat, projected MaxMeasure, equality of primary with projected eval, and strict monotonicity of primary in lt.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.no_tropical_primary_orients_dup_step_of_unbounded
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: For every tropical primary measure M with unbounded projected max, it is false that M.lt orients wrap s (recur b s n) below recur b s (succ n) for all b s n.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.no_tropical_primary_orients_dup_step_of_succ_pump
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If the projected max successor constant is at least one, then no tropical primary measure orients the duplicating step for all b s n.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.no_tropical_primary_orients_dup_step_of_wrap_pump
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: If wrap constant plus wrap left is at least one for the projected max, then no tropical primary measure orients the duplicating step for all b s n.

relations.explanation: Tropical orientation would induce max-measure orientation, which the max barrier already forbids.

OperatorKO7/Meta/TupleDecomposition.lean.summary: This file defines a three-kind tuple disposition and a decomposition carrying row tags with canonical scalar and matrix observers plus a licensed-escape status witness. It proves every row tag resolves to scalar, matrix, or status. The capstone bundles vector projection identity, matrix-over-polynomial non-orientation, and tuple-row resolution for families with a payload pump.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TupleDecomposition.lean.boundary: Matrix-over-polynomial relations cannot globally orient the family through the canonical exposure-matrix lift, while every tuple row resolves into scalar, matrix, or licensed-escape status closure.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TupleDecomposition.lean.conclusion: Every tuple row resolves to scalar, matrix, or status and the capstone bundles vector projection, matrix reduction, and row resolution.
assumptions: payload pump at distinguished coordinate for the capstone (hPump)

OperatorKO7/Meta/TupleInterpretationDeco.conclusion: Every formal tuple row decomposes into finitely many scalar direct-measure observations with a designated strict coordinate and row-local classification.

OperatorKO7/Meta/TypedBarrierSurvival.le.summary: This file tests whether direct-measure barriers survive in a simply-typed recursor fragment with res, step, and cnt sorts. It defines additive and affine constructor-local measures with a typed step iterator and explicit pump hypothesis. It proves the additive barrier survives outright and the affine barrier survives under an unbounded typed step pump.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TypedBarrierSurvival.le.boundary: No additive typed measure orients the typed duplicating step, and no affine typed measure does once an unbounded typed step pump exists; simple typing alone is not an escape.
OperatorKO7/Meta/TypedBarrierSurvival.le.conclusion: Additive typed barriers hold outright and affine typed barriers hold under an explicit step pump, so simple typing does not escape the barrier.
assumptions: additive weight positivity h_wrap_pos and h_step_succ_pos
affine side positivity h_wrap_left_pos and h_wrap_right_pos
explicit typed step pump hpump for the affine case

OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Probability/Channe.summary: This file defines a finite stochastic channel as a family of normalized finite distributions, one output law for each input outcome. It constructs deterministic channels from ordinary functions via point-mass distributions, with the identity channel as a special case. It proves that every channel row assigns mass at most one to each output. It therefore proves that no row assigns mass above one.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Probability/Channe.boundary: Every channel row has mass at most one at each output, so mass above one is impossible for any stochastic row.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Probability/Channe.conclusion: No row of a finite stochastic channel ever assigns mass greater than one.
assumptions: Fintype α and Fintype β for channel rows
DecidableEq β for deterministic channels
DecidableEq α for the identity channel
set_option autoImplicit false

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UUET.Probability.Channel
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given types α and β with Fintype α and Fintype β instances, a Channel consists of a row function assigning to each x : α a FiniteDistribution on β.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UUET.Probability.Channel.deterministic
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given types α and β with Fintype α, Fintype β and DecidableEq β instances and a function f : α -> β, deterministic f is the Channel whose row at x is the point-mass distribution at f x.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UUET.Probability.Channel.identity
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given a type α with Fintype α and DecidableEq α instances, identity α is the Channel defined as deterministic applied to the identity function.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UUET.Probability.Channel.row_mass_le_one
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given types α and β with Fintype instances and any channel K : Channel α β, for all x : α and y : β, the mass of row x at y is at most 1.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UUET.Probability.Channel.no_channel_row_mass_above_one
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Given types α and β with Fintype instances and any channel K : Channel α β, for all x : α and y : β, it is not the case that 1 is strictly less than the mass of row x at y.

relations.explanation: The deterministic map construction produces a Channel via point-mass rows.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Statistics/Bernoul.summary: This file defines a Bernoulli family and estimator at interior parameters and their half-parameter fixtures. It computes Fisher information four and variance one quarter with exact Cramer-Rao equality. It shows the biased constant-zero estimator has derivative zero, outside the theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Statistics/Bernoul.boundary: Strictly interior Bernoulli parameters give regular unbiased estimation attaining the bound, while the constant-zero derivative lies outside the theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Statistics/Bernoul.conclusion: The half-Bernoulli family has Fisher information four and variance one quarter, attaining Cramer-Rao, while the constant-zero estimator lies outside.

noncomputable definitions

OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Statistics/FisherD.summary: Defines finite parametric families, Fisher information, finite Markov kernels, and a FisherMarkovCertificate recording pushforward identities for probability and tangent plus a contraction field. Proves Fisher information contracts under a fixed kernel with the loss equal to the mean squared score residual, and characterizes equality as preservation of scores on every possible output or fiber. Provides pushforward, curve, and certificate constructions, and shows probability transfer alone does not imply contraction via a Bernoulli versus constant binary counterexample.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Statistics/FisherD.boundary: Fisher information never increases under a fixed finite Markov kernel and is zero for parameter-insensitive outputs. Equality holds only when input scores are preserved on every possible output, so probability transfer without the tangent identity does not enforce contraction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UUET/Statistics/FisherD.conclusion: Fisher information contracts under a fixed finite Markov kernel with loss equal to the mean squared score residual, equality holds exactly when scores are preserved on every possible output, and probability transfer alone does not imply contraction.
assumptions: Fintype sample spaces
DecidableEq for the deterministic-fiber result
positive attained support and normalized parameter-independent kernel
noncomputable definitions; classical tactic in the fiber-constant proof
set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Cer.summary: The file fixes the three-rule system R-infinity with rules P(S(x)) -> x, H(x,x) -> A and H(C,S(P(C))) -> B and its hub linearization. It defines a model certificate as a carrier interpretation satisfying the rules and refuting every non-trivial hub overlap. It proves every certificate separates C from S(P(C)), forcing an injective Nat orbit, and conversely every infinite carrier yields a split-ray interpretation satisfying the rules and refuting all overlaps, so certificates exist exactly on infinite carriers. It also proves R-infinity is non-omega-overlapping with determined right-hand sides, has unique normal forms for conversion from the countable Nat certificate, and that products, closed subsets and surjective images of finite section-law models admit no certificate.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Cer.boundary: A carrier admits a certificate exactly when it is infinite; finite carriers admit rule models but no certificate. The divide is separation C != S(P(C)) versus the section law S(P(x)) = x, which holds on finite models and excludes certificates.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Cer.conclusion: For R-infinity a carrier admits a model certificate exactly when it is infinite, and R-infinity has unique normal forms for conversion.
assumptions: Infinite carriers for the construction direction
Finite carriers for the no-certificate direction
Classical.choice for SplitRay.ofEmbedding index selection and the H equality test

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Cer.summary: The file adjoins to R-infinity the F45 rules and parameterized rules Z -> G(Z,A) and D(x) -> J(x,...,x,D(x)) to form the seven-rule family family_rules r. It proves the F45 system and every family member are non-omega-overlapping with determined right-hand sides, using head-symbol separation for cross pairs. It constructs a FamilyRay interpretation on Option Nat and on any infinite carrier, refutes all hub overlaps including the F and H root overlaps, and deduces unique normal forms for conversion, an infinite Z-tower reduction, duplication exactly when r is positive, and carrier classification with certificates exactly on infinite carriers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Cer.boundary: For every duplication count r, a carrier admits a family certificate exactly when it is infinite; finite carriers admit rule models but no certificate. Separately the D rule duplicates exactly when r is positive, with r = 0 giving the erasing frame D(x) -> J(D(x)).
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Cer.conclusion: For every duplication count r, a carrier admits a family certificate exactly when it is infinite, and every family member has unique normal forms for conversion.
assumptions: Infinite carriers for the construction direction
Finite carriers for the no-certificate direction
Classical.choice for FamilyRay.ofEmbedding and the H equality test

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Coa.summary: The file defines term-coalgebras as subterm-closed lists of finite terms and the relativized invariant DownOn A R as the least fixed point of DownStepOn on a carrier A. It proves introduction, membership, monotonicity and induction principles, that DownOn implies global Down, and that rewrite steps inside a coalgebra belong to DownOn. It builds the subterm closure coalgebraOf and proves every global Down proof occurs on some finite coalgebra, with a common finite support for pairs, so global transitivity follows from local transitivity on finite carriers.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Coa.conclusion: Every global Down proof occurs on some finite subterm-closed coalgebra, so global transitivity reduces to transitivity on finite carriers.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Com.summary: The file defines DeterminedBy, rule and system RHS-determinedness, and common generalisations of two rules. It proves agreement on a term is equivalent to agreement on its variables and that DeterminedBy coincides with variable inclusion on infinite variable carriers. It proves non-omega-overlapping plus RHS-determined implies deterministic root steps and almost non-omega-overlap. It exhibits the one-rule system F(x) -> y, non-omega-overlapping but with a fresh right-hand-side variable, which identifies all variables and fails consistency, unique normal forms and RHS-determinedness.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Com.boundary: Determinism and almost non-omega-overlap hold for non-omega-overlapping systems with right-hand-side determined rules and fail without that hypothesis. The one-rule system F(x) -> y is non-omega-overlapping but identifies all variables, so it is inconsistent and lacks unique normal forms.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Com.conclusion: Non-omega-overlap plus right-hand-side determinedness gives deterministic root steps, and the variable condition cannot be dropped as F(x) -> y shows.
assumptions: DecidableEq nu for substitution agreement lemmas
Infinite nu for DeterminedBy iff variable inclusion

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Con.summary: The file defines minimal conditional levels and the zero-based minimalLevelStep labelling with zero unifier rank. It defines ConditionalLabelRefinement as soundness plus completeness with respect to CStep and proves forgetting any such refinement gives exactly CStep. It proves confluence of a refinement is equivalent to conditional confluence and that local decreasingness of any refinement, in particular the minimal-level one, implies conditional confluence and unique normal forms for any linearization.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Con.boundary: Confluence transfers from a labelled refinement to the conditional system exactly when forgetting labels gives back CStep. The intrinsic minimal-level labelling satisfies this soundness and completeness, while a peak-dependent unifier rank is not yet an intrinsic step label.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Con.conclusion: Local decreasingness of any sound and complete stepwise labelling, in particular minimal conditional levels, implies conditional confluence and unique normal forms for the linearized TRS.
assumptions: classical reasoning for minimal-level existence via Nat.find
