OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Tra.summary: The file proves that original steps embed as level-1 conditional steps and that conditional steps at any level project to original conversions, so the two systems share the same equational theory. It proves by size induction that under confluence of the linearization an original normal form admits no conditional step. From these it deduces the transfer theorem that confluence of a conditional linearization implies UNconv and UNred, and it records that the linearizations of Huet's system and the KO7 kernel are not confluent.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Tra.boundary: A confluent conditional linearization is sufficient for UN= of the original system, while Huet's system and the KO7 kernel lie on the failing side with non-confluent linearizations and no UN=. The converse fails, so confluence of the linearization is not necessary for UN=.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Tra.conclusion: Confluence of a conditional linearization implies UNconv and UNred of the original system, while the linearizations of Huet's system and the KO7 kernel are not confluent.
assumptions: IsLinearization R C
cconfluent C

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/UNS.summary: The file defines conversion as the reflexive-transitive closure of symmetric rewriting and defines normal forms, UNconv, UNred, the normal form property, confluence and variable-only consistency. It proves confluence implies NFP implies UNconv, UNconv implies UNred and consistency, and the contrapositive that inconsistency refutes UNconv, with no non-implications claimed. A one-rule example f(x) to g(x) exhibits g(c) as a normal form convertible from f(c), showing the predicates are not vacuous.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/UNS.boundary: Conversion that relates two distinct variables rules out UNconv, so consistent systems lie on the side where UNconv is possible and systems identifying distinct variables lie on the failing side.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/UNS.conclusion: Confluence implies the normal form property which implies UNconv which implies both UNred and consistency, so relating distinct variables refutes UNconv.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Uni.summary: The file defines the pushforward of a unification closure along a symbol map and its equivalence closure with a four-shape witness preserved by reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity. It proves the pushforward closure is again a unification closure, so omega-unifiability is preserved by any relabelling and preserved and reflected exactly along split embeddings with a left inverse, with label erasure as instance. It also proves symmetry under swapping rename-apart tags and that omega-unifiable applications share their root symbol.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Uni.boundary: An arbitrary symbol relabelling preserves omega-unifiability only forward, while the split-embedding side with an explicit left inverse preserves and reflects it exactly.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniqueNormalization/Uni.conclusion: Omega-unifiability is preserved by any symbol relabelling, reflected exactly along split embeddings with label erasure as instance, and is symmetric with shared root symbols.
assumptions: UnifClosure E
Function.LeftInverse g f for exact reflection

keyDeclarations.plain_statement: PushWitness f E distinguishes app-app requiring equal roots and Forall_2 pushEqv arguments, app-var and var-app lifting through E with relabelled arguments, and var-var as direct E or a bridge through two applications with equal relabelled roots and related relabelled arguments.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Bound.summary: This file defines the TypedMismatch carrier with payload, control, verdict and license types and the TypedBoundary primitive of two states with equal cheap observations but different true verdicts, and proves the universal boundary law that the verdict is not a function of the observation. It defines a projection from any boundary to its mismatch carrier with license Unit. It constructs three facet instances, the duplicating-recursor mass boundary, the provenance-versus-license boundary and the machine confidence-versus-certificate boundary, and proves that all three obey the universal law.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Bound.boundary: At a boundary two states share the same cheap observation yet require different verdicts, so no observation-only rule can decide the verdict and a licensed change of witness channel is required.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Bound.conclusion: For every typed boundary the true verdict is not a function of the cheap observation.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Byzan.summary: This file defines a three-node one-traitor Byzantine model with Bool values, lieutenant views, loyalty and IC1/IC2 requirements. It constructs three explicit scenarios sA, sB, sC with pairwise view equalities across different required decisions. It proves no symmetric one-round decision function satisfies IC1 and IC2 together, by chaining and by 16-table decide, and packages the sA/sB collision as a universal typed boundary. It also shows IC2 alone is satisfiable while the first-projection rule fails IC1 at sB.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Byzan.boundary: IC2 alone is satisfiable by returning the received value, but no single symmetric lieutenant rule satisfies IC1 and IC2 together; the L1 view merging sA with sB and the L2 view merging sB with sC marks the limit.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Byzan.conclusion: No symmetric one-relay decision function satisfies both IC1 and IC2 on the three-node one-traitor model.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UniversalBoundary.ByzantineThreeNodeBoundary.View
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: View is defined as Bool times Bool, the lieutenant observation of commander value then relay value.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UniversalBoundary.ByzantineThreeNodeBoundary.viewL2
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: viewL2 s is defined as the pair (s.cToL2, s.l1ToL2) for every Scenario s.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UniversalBoundary.ByzantineThreeNodeBoundary.Loyal
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: Loyal s means each non-traitor channel preserves its prescribed value: commander equality when traitor is not 0, L1 relay equality when traitor is not 1, L2 relay equality when traitor is not 2.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UniversalBoundary.ByzantineThreeNodeBoundary.sA
keyDeclarations.plain_statement: sA is the constructed Scenario with loyal commander true and traitor L2 relaying false.

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UniversalBoundary.ByzantineThreeNodeBoundary.sB

keyDeclarations.name: OperatorKO7.Meta.UniversalBoundary.ByzantineThreeNodeBoundary.IC2

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/CapPa.summary: This file defines a reduced two-replica CAP model with wrote and partitioned flags, history and latest-value maps, and availability and consistency predicates. It proves the two partitioned runs collide on empty history with different latest values when values differ, so no responder is both available and consistent there. It proves a healed-partition license plus total responder on unpartitioned runs and a refusing responder that is consistent when it answers but not available. It packages the Boolean collision as a universal typed boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/CapPa.boundary: On unpartitioned runs history determines the latest value, but on partitioned runs the empty history collides between written and unwritten values; no responder is both available everywhere and consistent on partitioned runs.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/CapPa.conclusion: No responder is both available on every history and consistent on every partitioned run when the new and old values differ.
assumptions: propext (baseline axiom used by partition and CAP proofs)

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Compr.summary: This module defines fixed-length Boolean words and strictly shorter outputs with cardinalities 2^n and 2^n-1, plus a lossless compressor structure. It proves every shorter-output map collides and no positive-length lossless shrinking compressor exists, via fiber-capacity counting, and packages collisions as a universal typed boundary. It also exhibits a lossless escape encoding into a larger sum and a lossless injective encoding of an explicit two-word restriction, with the n=2 count 3<4 and no compressor at n=2.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Compr.boundary: Every map from length-n words to strictly shorter words collides, so no lossless all-input shrinking encoder exists; losslessness returns only with an escape summand or a restricted input set.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Compr.conclusion: For positive n no lossless encoder maps every length-n Boolean word to a strictly shorter word.
assumptions: Classical.choice via Classical.choose in compressionBoundary (noncomputable packaging of colliding pair)

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Gradu.summary: This file defines a small gradual calculus with nat bool dyn types, static typing, inference, evaluation with cast failure, and safety. It proves inference sound and complete and exhibits good and bad terms sharing static type nat but differing on safety. It proves static types do not license safety, packages that collision as a universal boundary, proves a cast succeeds exactly when its local tag matches, proves the augmented static-plus-tag observer licenses safety on well-typed terms with safe subterms, and proves cast-free well-typed terms are safe.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Gradu.boundary: Static type alone collides on safe good versus failing bad, so it does not license safety; adding the local run-time cast tag licenses safety on well-typed terms with safe subterms, while cast-free well-typed terms are safe outright.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Gradu.conclusion: Static inference alone does not determine cast safety, but the static type plus local tag does on the retained set and cast-free well-typed terms never fail.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Gramm.summary: This file states a carrier-level pump barrier with no grammar syntax: any Nat to Nat to Nat measure with an unbounded payload section at one counter fails to orient the duplicating step. It derives payload-monotone and grammar-measure forms, noting monotonicity is unused. It defines an even-payload measure that is not monotone but has an unbounded section, so the premise-free barrier blocks it.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Gramm.boundary: Any measure with an unbounded payload section at one counter fails to orient the duplicating step; measures bounded at every counter are not ruled out by this theorem.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Gramm.conclusion: Every measure with an unbounded payload section at some counter does not orient the duplicating step, including a non-monotone example.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Hammi.summary: This file formalizes the binary Hamming sphere-packing bound as a fiber-capacity instance with received word as observer and codeword-error pair as state. It proves minimum distance implies correction, joint-observer licensing, state counting, and the packing product C.card times ball card at most 2^n. It exhibits the length-3 repetition code correcting one error, attaining the bound, and failing at radius two via an explicit received collision packaged as a typed boundary.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Hammi.boundary: A code correcting t errors must pack its codeword-error states into 2^n words; rep3 attains the bound at radius one but at radius two two states share a received word with different sent codewords.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Hammi.conclusion: Every binary code correcting t errors satisfies the Hamming packing product bound, attained by rep3 at radius one and violated as correction at radius two.
assumptions: propext
Classical.choice
Quot.sound (join of imported license and fiber-capacity theorems)

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Shann.summary: This file defines ciphers with encryption, decryption and correctness, support-level perfect secrecy in which every ciphertext reachable from one message is reachable from every message, and the ciphertext observer, message verdict and key channel on key-message pairs. It proves that the joint ciphertext-key observer licenses the message by decryption, that perfect secrecy yields colliding states with distinct messages so the ciphertext alone does not license the message, and that on finite types the ciphertext fiber holds every message, giving fiber multiplicity at least the message cardinality and hence the support-level Shannon bound through the fiber-capacity law. Shannon's probabilistic theorem is cited and never re-derived. It instantiates the bound with the binary one-time pad, which is perfectly secret with fiber multiplicity two and yields a typed boundary obeying the universal law, and contrasts the identity cipher, which fails perfect secrecy although its ciphertext already licenses the message.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Shann.boundary: Under support-level perfect secrecy, one ciphertext is reachable from every message, so the ciphertext alone cannot determine the message and only the added key channel licenses it. This forces the finite capacity bound that message cardinality does not exceed key cardinality.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Shann.conclusion: Any support-level perfectly secret cipher on nonempty finite types satisfies that message cardinality does not exceed key cardinality, with the one-time pad attaining perfect secrecy and the identity cipher failing it.
assumptions: Classical.choice for witnesses k0 and m0
Fintype K and Fintype M
DecidableEq C and DecidableEq M
Nonempty K and Nonempty M
Shannon 1949 probabilistic theorem cited, not proved
finite Bool facts checked by decide

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Sorti.summary: This file defines non-adaptive comparison algorithms with Boolean transcripts and correctness as licensing the sorting permutation. It proves sorting transcripts need at least n factorial capacity, so short transcripts collide and cannot sort, and packages collisions as a universal typed boundary. It computes the n=3 factorial as six, shows two comparisons are insufficient and three meet the count without claiming sufficiency, and exhibits a concrete two-comparison algorithm that does not sort.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Sorti.boundary: When 2^k is below n factorial the transcript collides with distinct sorting verdicts so no algorithm sorts; meeting the count is not shown sufficient for sorting.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Sorti.conclusion: Every fixed non-adaptive k-comparison algorithm with 2^k below n factorial cannot sort all permutations.
assumptions: Classical.choice via Classical.choose in sortingBoundary (noncomputable colliding pair)

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Syndr.summary: This file defines binary error vectors, radius-t balls, syndromes, bounded error states, and syndrome correction as licensing. It proves correction is equivalent to syndrome injectivity and implies the syndrome bound ball card at most 2^r via fiber capacity. It proves the Hamming [7,4] matrix corrects one error with a perfect count eight equals eight, and exhibits a colliding matrix Hbad whose two weight-one errors share a syndrome, packaged as a typed boundary that fails one-error correction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Syndr.boundary: When syndromes are injective on the radius-t ball, ball size is bounded by 2^r; H74 attains this at length seven radius one while Hbad collides and fails one-error correction.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Syndr.conclusion: Syndrome correction of radius-t errors implies the ball-count bound, attained by H74 and refuted for Hbad at radius one.

Classical.choice
Quot.sound (join of imported license and fiber-capacity theorems)

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Timin.summary: This file defines a System T recursor drain family that always returns zero with step count 3n+1, with fuelled normalization, output and beta-cost observers. It proves exact drain costs, collisions of distinct bounds on output with different costs, non-factorization of timing through output, and a typed boundary at drain 2 versus 5 at fuel 200. It proves timing fibers contain arbitrarily large finite sets with distinct costs and that output licenses cost on numerals alone.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Timin.boundary: All drain bounds output zero yet have distinct step counts, so output does not license timing and fibers are unbounded; numerals alone are constant-time and licensed.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/Timin.conclusion: Functional output does not factor through running time on drain bounds, with unbounded timing fibers and a licensed numeral-only refusal.

OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/TwoGe.summary: This file defines alternating views, sender identity, delivery, and finite deterministic protocols with agreement, validity and no-information-no-attack. It proves each sender view is equal with and without its message, so delivery never factors through that view. It proves agreement plus validity forces attack in every run by downward induction, hence no protocol satisfies all three requirements, packages the first rung as a typed boundary, and exhibits protocols satisfying each proper subset of requirements.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/TwoGe.boundary: Each message sender cannot distinguish delivery from loss from its own view, so agreement plus validity forces attack everywhere including the uninformed run, contradicting silence-implies-no-attack.
OperatorKO7/Meta/UniversalBoundary/TwoGe.conclusion: No finite deterministic alternating protocol satisfies agreement, validity, and no-information-no-attack together.

Quot.sound (baseline from omega and sender-view arithmetic; no Classical.choice)

OperatorKO7/Meta/WPO_PolynomialBarrier.l.summary: This file specializes the bounded polynomial barrier to WPO polynomial direct orders on KO7. It proves three no-global-orientation corollaries under unbounded, successor-pump, and wrap-pump assumptions with eventual base dominance. It proves any successful global orienter must violate base dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/WPO_PolynomialBarrier.l.boundary: Under unboundedness plus eventual base dominance, the direct WPO polynomial branch cannot globally orient KO7; successful orientation would force failure of base dominance.
OperatorKO7/Meta/WPO_PolynomialBarrier.l.conclusion: No WPO polynomial direct order with unbounded measure and base dominance globally orients KO7, and escape requires failure of base dominance.

eventual base dominance (hdom)

theory.name: Finite Channels, Fisher Information and Cramér-Rao Bounds

OperatorKO7/QEC/Bounds/CramerRao.lean.summary: The file defines differential entropy, weighted expectation and variance on finite sample spaces, binary Fisher information, the epsilon-N sample-count gate, and a Gaussian witness density. It proves a Gaussian maximum-entropy theorem under fixed normalization and centered second moment, with KL-gap entropy bounds and a measure-uniqueness equality case. It proves a finite-sample Cramér–Rao variance lower bound from Cauchy–Schwarz, its binary specialization at Fisher information four, an explicit two-point saturating instance, and a gate-rewritten variance floor.
OperatorKO7/QEC/Bounds/CramerRao.lean.boundary: Variance cannot lie below one over N times Fisher information, and entropy under fixed normalization and second moment cannot exceed the Gaussian value. At or above the epsilon gate the Cramér–Rao floor is at most epsilon squared over twice log two, with the exact gate giving equality.
OperatorKO7/QEC/Bounds/CramerRao.lean.conclusion: Under fixed normalization and second moment the Gaussian density maximizes differential entropy, and any finite unbiased score model obeys variance at least one over N times Fisher information with an explicit binary gate saturation.
assumptions: normalization ∫ p = 1
centered second moment ∫ p (x - μ)^2 = σ^2
integrability of p, second-moment, p log p and p log g terms
IsFiniteMeasure for KL-gap measures and klDiv ≠ ⊤ for uniqueness
0 < N and 0 < FI with Fintype score identities
ε ≠ 0 for gate identities

OperatorKO7/RH/Screw/BasedKernel.lean.summary: This file defines based Hermitian kernels: complex kernels with a distinguished base point where the kernel vanishes, Hermitian symmetry, and positive-semidefinite finite quadratic forms, together with their Gram matrices and quadratic forms. It proves that every finite-sample Gram matrix is Hermitian and positive semidefinite. It then proves a finite Kolmogorov realization giving Euclidean feature vectors whose inner products reproduce the kernel values, packaged with the PSD claim. It also proves the feature-distance identity expressing squared feature distance through kernel values, and constructs a nonzero two-point example on Fin 2 with value 1 at (1, 1).
OperatorKO7/RH/Screw/BasedKernel.lean.conclusion: Every finite sample of a based Hermitian kernel has a positive semidefinite Gram matrix realized by Euclidean feature vectors whose squared distances are given by kernel values.
assumptions: noncomputable section
classical reasoning via the classical tactic in finite_realization
main theorems assume a BasedHermitianKernel with Hermitian symmetry, vanishing at the base point, and finite positive semidefiniteness

OperatorKO7/SchemaAPI.lean.summary: The file is a broad convenience import root for step-duplicating schemas, nonlinear scalar barriers, vector and matrix barriers, symbolic comparators, pump infrastructure, executable witness tooling, textbook instances, confession-method families, dependency-pair fragments, graph SCC utilities, mutual-duplication families, and cross-paper interfaces. It re-exports the listed modules for direct application of any barrier theorem. It states it remains for downstream users but should not be treated as the strict primitive boundary, with KO7-specific certification and complexity results excluded.
OperatorKO7/SchemaAPI.lean.conclusion: The file proves nothing itself and serves only as the broad convenience import surface for schema barriers.

OperatorKO7/SchemaExtendedAPI.lean.summary: The file extends PrimitiveSchemaAPI with reusable barrier, matrix, mutual-duplication, higher-order sharing, and escape-trichotomy schema modules. It imports schema variants of quadratic, multilinear, polynomial, max, arctic, tropical, depth, ordered-field, LPO, witness, classifier, and call-graph layers. It introduces no new definitions, with the listed modules supplying the extended surface.
OperatorKO7/SchemaExtendedAPI.lean.conclusion: The file adds no theorems and serves only as the extended schema import root over the primitive core.

OperatorKO7/Test/ArtsGieslDerivationalRe.summary: This file exercises the Arts-Giesl derivational-complexity certificate machinery and instantiates it for the KO7 kernel. It provides a Fintype instance for the seven-symbol kernel signature, an identity affine base-order bound, and two canonical single-application audits for the KO7 first-order and head engines. It then checks license-overhead equalities, residual-work equations, and polynomial total-length bounds, including quadratic-in-rules bounds scaled by signature size.
OperatorKO7/Test/ArtsGieslDerivationalRe.boundary: Total certificate length is bounded by a polynomial in rule count and signature size (graph-construction plus affine base-order plus soundness); the file shows the bound holds for the KO7 audits and does not exhibit failure beyond it.
OperatorKO7/Test/ArtsGieslDerivationalRe.conclusion: The KO7 first-order and head audits satisfy explicit polynomial total-length bounds in rule count and signature size plus residual cost.
assumptions: noncomputable audit definitions (classical choice)

OperatorKO7/Test/AumannAgreementReach.le.summary: This file is a reach and axiom audit for the AumannAgreement module. It checks mass, fiber-ratio and probability assignments, meet cells and common knowledge, and Aumann agreement theorems with their required hypotheses. It also checks counterexamples showing positive mass and common knowledge are each required.
OperatorKO7/Test/AumannAgreementReach.le.boundary: Posterior agreement holds under common knowledge with positive mass and saturated fiber ratios, and fails without positive mass or without common knowledge.
OperatorKO7/Test/AumannAgreementReach.le.conclusion: Common knowledge with positive mass forces agreement, and each hypothesis is shown necessary.

OperatorKO7/Test/BareNewmanPi11Calibrati.summary: This file is a reach gate for the Pi11 calibration of bare Newman. It checks the single declaration bareNewman_pi11_calibration with `#check @` and `#print axioms`. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/BareNewmanPi11Calibrati.boundary: Bare Newman is calibrated at the Pi11 level, recording the logical-strength limit this gate pins.
OperatorKO7/Test/BareNewmanPi11Calibrati.conclusion: The gate certifies reachability and axiom closure for the bare Newman Pi11 calibration.

OperatorKO7/Test/BethDefinabilityInstanc.summary: This file gives full reach and axiom coverage for the BethDefinabilityInstances module. It checks the orienting class, grammar and projection languages, the Beth gap object with its orienting and non-denotability facts, and the projection Beth property with its explicit-definability equivalence. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/BethDefinabilityInstanc.boundary: The Beth gap is implicitly definable but not grammar-denotable and the grammar counter fails the Beth property, while the projection language has the Beth property on orienting states.
OperatorKO7/Test/BethDefinabilityInstanc.conclusion: The projection language satisfies the Beth property where the grammar language fails, as witnessed by the Beth gap.

OperatorKO7/Test/BethDefinabilityReach.l.summary: This file gives full reach and axiom coverage for the BethDefinability framework. It checks explicit definability, Beth property on a class, postcomposition closure and licensing lemmas, plus constant-function and identity-statement counterexamples. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/BethDefinabilityReach.l.boundary: Explicit definability follows from the Beth property only with completeness and postcomposition closure, and fails without them as the constant and identity counterexamples show.
OperatorKO7/Test/BethDefinabilityReach.l.conclusion: Completeness and postcomposition closure are shown necessary for the Beth property to yield explicit definitions.

OperatorKO7/Test/BlackwellOrderReach.lea.summary: This file is a permanent reach and axiom audit for the BlackwellOrder module. It checks deterministic models, simulating decoders, Bayes-risk monotonicity under refinement, half-half priors, two-point and self characterizations of refinement, and garbling constructions. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/BlackwellOrderReach.lea.boundary: Refinement is equivalent to uniform Bayes-risk dominance for two-point and self families, but a single target does not determine refinement.
OperatorKO7/Test/BlackwellOrderReach.lea.conclusion: Bayes-risk dominance characterizes refinement for the stated families, with singleton targets insufficient.

OperatorKO7/Test/BlackwellStochasticReac.summary: This file is a reach and axiom check for the BlackwellStochastic module. It checks real experiments, garbling versus dominance, convex-hull constructors, observer and rational experiments, gain vulnerability, and noisy binary experiments. It also checks that nonempty output is required and that noisy garbles perfect but not conversely.
OperatorKO7/Test/BlackwellStochasticReac.boundary: Garbling coincides with dominance and gain-vulnerability dominance, yet noisy garbles perfect without converse, and empty output is excluded.
OperatorKO7/Test/BlackwellStochasticReac.conclusion: Garbling, dominance and vulnerability coincide with a one-way noisy-perfect separation.

OperatorKO7/Test/BoundaryInfiniteCostCon.summary: This file gates retained-record and limiting-cost results for conditional boundary observers. It checks independent exclusive seeds with joint, survival, stopping, information and exact-cost facts, conditional indicator protocols with split information and cost, blindness characterizations, and seeded disjoint-reading frontiers with finite information but infinite extended cost. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/BoundaryInfiniteCostCon.boundary: Finite limiting information can coexist with infinite extended cost on seeded branches, and the boundary is exactly conditional blindness with positive-target infeasibility.
OperatorKO7/Test/BoundaryInfiniteCostCon.conclusion: Seeded disjoint readings give a finite-information frontier with infinite extended cost and a blindness characterization of the boundary.

OperatorKO7/Test/BoundaryTheoremMathReac.summary: This file pairs check with print-axioms for the mathematics-only boundary-theorem core, without rewriting or kernel imports. It covers recursor decidability and pass chains, Godel kernel cases, boundary poles and goals, boundary factorization descriptions, counted-recursion laws, kinematic and orbit clauses, fair-reading and Pinsker bounds, erasure-reading recovery, deterministic conflict graphs, record-choice orbits, Rice boundaries, and licensed demand selectors.

OperatorKO7/Test/BudgetedNoisyRecoveryRe.conclusion: The budgeted noisy-recovery interface is present with paired axiom audits.

OperatorKO7/Test/DefinitionUnificationIn.summary: This file is a permanent reach and axiom audit for DefinitionUnificationInstances. It checks fixed-input boundary languages, soundness, observer and language inexpressibility and equivalence with operational incompleteness. It also checks KO7 fixed-input and step-argument license-face instances.
OperatorKO7/Test/DefinitionUnificationIn.boundary: Fixed-input observations are sound but observer- and language-inexpressible, with inexpressibility equivalent to operational incompleteness via an unlicensed license face.
OperatorKO7/Test/DefinitionUnificationIn.conclusion: Fixed-input and KO7 instances are sound yet inexpressible with incompleteness tied to the license face.

OperatorKO7/Test/DefinitionUnificationRe.summary: This file is a permanent reach and axiom audit for DefinitionUnification. It checks observed-language predicates for dimension, dependence, constraining, inexpressibility, collision, licensing, soundness and completeness. It also checks incorporation, blind and constant examples, and identity and coordinate unification instances.
OperatorKO7/Test/DefinitionUnificationRe.boundary: Context collision equals unlicensed status and blocks constraining the target, while licensed incorporation without collision constrains, separating colliding contexts from licensed ones.
OperatorKO7/Test/DefinitionUnificationRe.conclusion: Context collision equals unlicensed status and blocks constraining with observer and language inexpressibility equivalent.

OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyLicenseReach..summary: This reach gate audits the DependencyLicense module without adding definitions. It checks Armstrong soundness, Armstrong completeness for semantic implication, and the two-tuple and universal-attribute variants. It also checks restriction, FD satisfaction, licensing lemmas, Armstrong rules, and family tuple and dependency infrastructure, each paired with an axiom print.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyLicenseReach..boundary: Armstrong-derivable dependencies coincide with semantically implied dependencies, while one-tuple instances satisfy every dependency and two-tuple families are required to expose a violation.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyLicenseReach..conclusion: The DependencyLicense completeness package is reachable with its stated types and axiom footprints.

OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyPairEquivalen.summary: This reach gate audits the DependencyPairEquivalence module without adding definitions. It checks argument steps, minimal-chain well-foundedness, termination equivalences, and the NoRunOfLength and BoundedRunsAt characterizations of accessibility and strong normalization. It also checks decidability and the free-recursor bounded-runs lemmas.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyPairEquivalen.boundary: Termination holds exactly when minimal chains are well-founded and runs are uniformly bounded; nontermination appears as an infinite minimal chain or unbounded run lengths.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyPairEquivalen.conclusion: The termination equivalences via well-founded chains and bounded runs are reachable with baseline axioms.

OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyPairsNormaliz.summary: This reach gate audits DependencyPairs_Normalization without adding definitions. It checks projection-pair rank, free-pair well-foundedness, the rank versus length separation with counter encoding, and deterministic step and machine structure. It also checks normalization reachability, normality, idempotence, confluence certificates, and the parallel free-pair analogues.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyPairsNormaliz.boundary: Normalization reaches a unique normal form on one side, while rank and length are distinguished and unnormalized pairs remain reducible on the other.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyPairsNormaliz.conclusion: The normalization certificates and confluence infrastructure are reachable with baseline axioms.

OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyRepairReach.l.summary: This reach gate audits the DependencyRepair module without adding definitions. It checks subset repairs, maximum licensed cardinality, fiber and cell counts, and the g1, g2 and g3 counts with their orderings and licensed-iff-zero characterizations. It also checks Bayes-risk equality, fiber sums, and the repair and answer fixtures.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyRepairReach.l.boundary: A family is licensed exactly when the g1, g2 and g3 violation counts vanish; positive counts mark repairable cells or refused mass.
OperatorKO7/Test/DependencyRepairReach.l.conclusion: The repair measures and licensed-iff-zero characterizations are reachable with baseline axioms.

OperatorKO7/Test/DirectBarrierScopeReach.summary: This reach file exercises the DirectBarrierScope layer. It checks that the scope record, InScope predicate and fullScope sentinel elaborate, that fullScope is in scope, and that sharing, binder, innermost-only, co-order, computability and AC-quotient scopes are each out of scope. Every theorem identifier for those exclusions is also checked for reachability.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectBarrierScopeReach.boundary: fullScope lies inside the direct barrier on one side, while sharing, binder, innermost-only, co-order, computability and AC-quotient scopes each lie outside.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectBarrierScopeReach.conclusion: The positive in-scope sentinel and all six out-of-scope exclusions type-check.

OperatorKO7/Test/DirectGrammarBoundaryRe.summary: This reach gate audits DirectGrammarBoundary without adding definitions. It checks direct derivations and derivability with completeness, payload use versus adequacy for dup orientation, and the no-go that no direct measure both uses payload and orients. It also checks payload-sensitive orienters, non-emptiness sides, and denotational-subgrammar necessity.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectGrammarBoundaryRe.boundary: Payload-blind measures can orient while payload-using measures cannot be both adequate and grammar-denotable; a payload-sensitive orienter exists only outside the licensed grammar.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectGrammarBoundaryRe.conclusion: The payload-orientation impossibility with its sharp subgrammar premise is reachable.

OperatorKO7/Test/DirectGrammarLicenseRea.summary: This reach gate audits the DirectGrammarLicense lemmas on DirectGrammarBoundary without adding definitions. It checks payload-blindness iff counter-licensed, payload use iff counter-unlicensed, and that direct orienting denotations are counter-licensed. It also checks the counter-payload collision, target-side non-licensing, and the licensed projection versus unlicensed sensitive orienter.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectGrammarLicenseRea.boundary: Denotations licensed by the counter orient on one side, while payload-using denotations collide with the counter and remain unlicensed on the other.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectGrammarLicenseRea.conclusion: The counter-licensing classification of orienting denotations is reachable.

OperatorKO7/Test/DirectToolSearchMapping.summary: This reach gate audits DirectToolSearchMapping without adding definitions. It checks the thirteen additive, affine, quadratic, multilinear and polynomial fragments with unbounded, successor-pump and wrap-pump search. It also checks the matching no-global-orientation theorem for each fragment.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectToolSearchMapping.boundary: Each listed additive, affine, quadratic, multilinear and polynomial fragment with unbounded, successor-pump or wrap-pump search lacks a global orientation.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectToolSearchMapping.conclusion: All thirteen tool-search fragments are shown without global orientation.

OperatorKO7/Test/DirectWholeTermObserver.summary: This reach file confirms every public name of DirectWholeTermObserver and specializes it to a concrete Bool family. It defines a single-payload single-position schema and family with step from false to true and strict count increase from 1 to 2. It then checks non-orientation of the payload-count observer both through the additive corollary and directly through the main theorem.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectWholeTermObserver.boundary: Carrier-sensitive and payload-exposing observers orient only by dropping payload; any payload-count observer fails to globally orient a duplicating step.
OperatorKO7/Test/DirectWholeTermObserver.conclusion: The payload-count observer cannot globally orient the concrete duplicating family.

OperatorKO7/Test/DistinctionFunctorFacto.summary: This file pairs check with print-axioms for distinction-functor factorization. It covers the verdict abstract rewriting system, distinction verdict and its void value, verdict morphisms, partial distinction, canonical factorization, kernel totality and merging, subsingleton quotient, image equality, non-injectivity, and quotient-image isomorphism.
OperatorKO7/Test/DistinctionFunctorFacto.boundary: The distinction verdict is total but not injective, merging void and delta-void while factoring through a subsingleton kernel quotient onto its image; the boundary is what the verdict can and cannot distinguish.
OperatorKO7/Test/DistinctionFunctorFacto.conclusion: The file records reachability and axiom footprints for canonical distinction factorization with non-injective verdict and quotient-image isomorphism.

OperatorKO7/Test/DynamicLicenseGaloisRea.summary: This paired reach and axiom gate audits DynamicLicenseGalois without adding definitions. It checks the rule-predicate Galois connection with antitonicity, rule and predicate closures with monotonicity and idempotence, and greatest invariant repairs with least exclusions. It also checks family repairs, completeness, positional universality and recDOnly non-confluence.
OperatorKO7/Test/DynamicLicenseGaloisRea.boundary: Invariant-preserving rules admit a greatest repair contained in every invariant, while excluded rules form a least obstruction disjoint from it.
OperatorKO7/Test/DynamicLicenseGaloisRea.conclusion: The dynamic license Galois connection with complete invariant repair is reachable.

It checks stopping MDP structure, continuation and compute advantages, dynamic and horizon policies with value theory, and echo-license stopping lemmas. OperatorKO7/Test/EchoStoppingMDPReach.le.conclusion: Optimal stopping values are attained and the averaging fixture witnesses a 3/2 adaptive value.

It also prints axioms for the bind, evaluation and non-definability results.
OperatorKO7/Test/HomomorphicInexpressibi.boundary: Predicates that separate points identified by a homomorphism cannot factor through it, so projection and disequality are not term-definable under homomorphic collapse.
OperatorKO7/Test/HomomorphicInexpressibi.conclusion: Homomorphic collapse yields a general obstruction to factoring projections and defining disequality by terms.

OperatorKO7/Test/HomomorphicProjectionBa.conclusion: The file records reachability and axiom footprints for the projection barrier that blocks factorization of the counter projection.

OperatorKO7/Test/HypothesisNecessityCata.conclusion: The catalog records compatibility, finiteness and certificate existence as necessary hypotheses.

It checks statements, fixed and world inputs, denotation and derivability, the fixed-input boundary, a counterfactual witness, absence of a derivable termination decider, an imported verdict that decides but is underivable, and nonemptiness of derivables. It also prints axioms.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7FixedInputLanguageRe.boundary: No derivable statement of the fixed input language decides termination, while an imported verdict decides the target yet is itself underivable. Fixed derivability is nonempty but bounded away from the true termination verdict.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7FixedInputLanguageRe.conclusion: The fixed KO7 language cannot derive a termination decider though an underivable imported verdict decides it.

OperatorKO7/Test/KO7LicensedChannelReach.summary: This file pins the licensed-channel construction and separation without proving new theorems. It checks recursor and self-embedding relations, uniform priors and posteriors with totality and calibration, direct and licensed channels with common fibers, certificates and decisions with separation and verdict equality, entropies, residuals and deficit, and headline nonvacuous separation with separate provenance. It also prints axioms.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7LicensedChannelReach.boundary: Direct observation leaves log-two residual with half target mass on a common fiber, while licensed observation resolves to zero residual with full mass. The recursor is licensable and separates, whereas self-embedding is rejected by soundness and nontermination.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7LicensedChannelReach.conclusion: The licensed channel achieves zero residual and full target mass with log-two deficit over the direct channel.

OperatorKO7/Test/KO7ObservationVerdictRe.summary: This file pins the observation-verdict universe without proving new theorems. It checks declared orienters, candidates, universes and ledgers with lengths and coverage, orientation characterizations with pumps, well-founded orders, non-orientation of KO7 and self-embedding, relation systems, direct profiles, meta-observation, strong normalization and termination verdicts, and inexpressibility as non-function and non-factorization. It also prints axioms.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7ObservationVerdictRe.boundary: Declared candidates never orient KO7 or self-embedding steps under well-founded orders, and no candidate profile captures the termination verdict. The verdict separates recursor from self-embedding but is not a candidate-profile function nor a quotient factorization.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7ObservationVerdictRe.conclusion: The KO7 profile is operationally inexpressible by declared candidates despite full ledger coverage.

OperatorKO7/Test/KO7StepArgumentInstance.summary: This file pins the step-argument instance without proving new theorems. It checks step-argument projection, fixed duplicating carrier steps and systems, global orientation with payload and counter witnesses, dimension presence, the step-argument question, derivability as typed grammar derivation with payload and counter derivations, dimension and target characterizations, nonconstant predicates, the derivability boundary, and operational incompleteness. It also prints axioms.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7StepArgumentInstance.boundary: The counter globally orients the fixed duplicating carrier while the payload projection does not. Derivability coincides with typed direct-grammar derivation yet remains operationally incomplete on the step-argument dimension.
OperatorKO7/Test/KO7StepArgumentInstance.conclusion: Payload evaluation fails global orientation where the counter succeeds, yielding step-argument operational incompleteness.

OperatorKO7/Test/KTryVulnerabilityReach..summary: This file pins the KTry vulnerability calculus without proving new theorems. It checks repair-frontier equations, exact vulnerability, the two-void value, kept and refused mass with monotonicity, bounded and exact lists with membership and nonemptiness, unit vulnerability, and concavity. It also prints axioms for each declaration.
OperatorKO7/Test/KTryVulnerabilityReach..boundary: Kept and refused mass trade off through concavity, with repair frontier equal to one minus vulnerability. Bounded and exact lists quantify this frontier, attaining one on singletons and the exact value on two voids.
OperatorKO7/Test/KTryVulnerabilityReach..conclusion: KTry vulnerability is concave with repair frontier complementary to it.

OperatorKO7/Test/KalmanSideRecordReach.l.summary: This file pins the linear-system side-record module without proving new theorems. It checks unobservable characterizations, behavioral-record equivalences via unobservable and kernel forms, merged pairs, stabilizers, translation, emptiness via finite rank, value agreement, injective and separating projections, resolving side channels, state determination, existence of unobservable projections, and the Kalman example. It also prints axioms.
OperatorKO7/Test/KalmanSideRecordReach.l.boundary: Behavioral records agree exactly up to the unobservable subspace or kernel of stacked observability, and the boundary is empty exactly for full-rank observable ranges. Otherwise merged pairs exist and only a resolving projection determines state.
OperatorKO7/Test/KalmanSideRecordReach.l.conclusion: Side-record indistinguishability is characterized by the unobservable subspace with resolving projections when observable.

OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseCoreReach.lean.summary: This file pins the license-criterion core without proving new theorems. It checks licensed characterizations via factorization, decoders with uniqueness and agreement, nonempty-domain existence, collision for unlicensed maps, observer refinement with order and kernel lemmas, injectivity and coarsening lemmas, and the first-loss existence, uniqueness, cutoff and dichotomy. It also prints axioms.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseCoreReach.lean.boundary: A map is licensed exactly when it factors through quotient or attained image with a decoder, otherwise a collision witnesses unlicensed status. Coarsening loses license once at a unique first-loss cutoff with a dichotomy on either side.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseCoreReach.lean.conclusion: Licensing is factorization with a unique coarsening cutoff separating licensed from unlicensed stages.

OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseCriterionReach.l.summary: This file is a reach check for the license-criterion theory. It re-elaborates Licensed, ObserverRefines and their factorization, kernel and chain characterizations and prints their axiom inventories. It adds two private Boolean observers, delayedCollapse and temporaryCollapse, and verifies fixed-codomain inclusion, binary license theory, payload-loop termination and license loss and regain with example blocks.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseCriterionReach.l.boundary: An observer licenses a payload when it separates every collision the payload separates, and refinement preserves license. The delayed collapse licenses the identity below a cutoff but not beyond, and the temporary collapse shows license can be lost and regained, so loss is not monotone.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseCriterionReach.l.conclusion: The temporary-collapse witness shows license can be lost and regained, so coarsening chains need not lose license monotonically.

OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseEntropyReach.lea.summary: This file is a reach gate for LicenseEntropy. It checks Hartley and Shannon measures for choice, role and residual frame, including two-power evaluation, unboundedness, unit value, nonnegativity, upper bounds and chain rules. It proves no new theorems and only prints axiom inventories.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseEntropyReach.lea.boundary: Finite-choice Hartley information grows without bound with alphabet size while binary active-flag Shannon information is bounded by one, so counting versus probabilistic information separate.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseEntropyReach.lea.conclusion: The checked profile separates unbounded finite-choice Hartley growth from Shannon information bounded by one with a chain rule.

OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseGaloisReach.lean.summary: This file is a paired reach and axiom gate for the license Galois connection. It checks licensedBy, kerFamily, the Galois connection, antitonicity, singleton kernels, class indicators, closure idempotence, injectivity, strictness correspondences and completeness. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseGaloisReach.lean.boundary: Finer setoids license fewer predicates and coarser setoids license more, with strict setoid inclusion exactly matching strict inclusion of license families, so equality of Boolean license families detects kernel equality.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseGaloisReach.lean.conclusion: License families and kernels form a complete Galois connection whose strict inclusions correspond.

OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseLatticeReach.lea.summary: This file is a permanent reach and axiom audit for LicenseLattice. It checks observer kernels, refinement order, quotient structure, partition equivalences, joint pairs, common coarsenings, meet and join licensing lemmas and a parity join-only witness. It proves no new theorems.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseLatticeReach.lea.boundary: Joint observers license what either component licenses while common coarsenings license only shared content, and the parity target is licensed by the join only and not by either factor alone.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseLatticeReach.lea.conclusion: Observers form a lattice where meets preserve license, joins extend it, and parity needs the join.

OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseStabilizerReach..summary: This file is a paired reach and axiom gate for observer-relative license stabilizers. It checks stabilizers, swaps, invariance and orbit characterizations, refinement and injectivity correspondences, fiber equivalences, factorial counting and the pointed-bit strict subgroup witness. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseStabilizerReach..boundary: An observer licenses exactly the stabilizer-invariant predicates, with injectivity matching trivial stabilizer and strict refinement matching strict stabilizer inclusion. The pointed-bit swap lies in the observer stabilizer but outside the pointed automorphism group, giving a strict subgroup boundary.
OperatorKO7/Test/LicenseStabilizerReach..conclusion: License structure is captured by stabilizers with the pointed-bit swap witnessing a strict subgroup gap.

OperatorKO7/Test/LiftOrRefuseInstancesRe.summary: This file is a permanent reach and axiom audit for LiftOrRefuseInstances. It checks sum roles, generator values, role-gate lift and refusal characterizations, diagonal collisions and maximality, sigma-void non-lift and disequality inexpressibility, safe-step membership and guard dichotomies. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/LiftOrRefuseInstancesRe.boundary: Collisions force either a lift separating them or a maximal refusal, and the diagonal and sigma-void witnesses show disequality is not sigma-expressible when no lift exists, bounding lift-or-refuse repair.
OperatorKO7/Test/LiftOrRefuseInstancesRe.conclusion: Role-gate and diagonal instances realize the lift-or-refuse dichotomy with maximal refusals and inexpressibility where lifts fail.

OperatorKO7/Test/LiftOrRefuseReach.lean.summary: This file is a permanent reach and axiom audit for LiftOrRefuse. It checks licensed sets, correct sets, maximality, fiber attainment, retained decoders, refused mass, Bayes-risk and multiplicity identities, bounded menus, repair frontiers and convexity, the lift-or-refuse theorem and whole-fiber acceptance. It proves no new theorems.
OperatorKO7/Test/LiftOrRefuseReach.lean.boundary: Any collision is either lifted to a separating decoder or refused by a maximal set, with least refusal equal to Bayes risk and repair frontiers tracing the optimal mass-versus-menu tradeoff, so exact acceptance has a minimum refused weight.
OperatorKO7/Test/LiftOrRefuseReach.lean.conclusion: Every collision lifts or is refused with optimal refused mass and exactly attained frontiers.

OperatorKO7/Test/LiftUniversalPropertyRe.summary: This file is a reach and axiom check for LiftUniversalProperty. It checks the joint-pair greatest-refinement theorem, kernel equality from universality, nonexistence of a greatest licensed set under collision, and the complete refinement and refusal characterizations. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/LiftUniversalPropertyRe.boundary: The joint pair is the greatest licensing refinement, but under a collision no greatest licensed set exists, so universality holds jointly while maximal refusal fails locally.
OperatorKO7/Test/LiftUniversalPropertyRe.conclusion: Joint observation is universally greatest yet collisions obstruct any greatest refused-free licensed set.

OperatorKO7/Test/MatrixBarrierArbitraryI.summary: This file checks MatrixBarrierArbitrary instances. It elaborates unit and all-ones weights, fixed-row and column-sum respect lemmas, local no-orientation theorems for unit and row-sum pumps and the corresponding global no-orientation theorems. It proves no new content.
OperatorKO7/Test/MatrixBarrierArbitraryI.boundary: With an unbounded scalarized pump, no matrix-arbitrary measure orients the duplicating step or the whole system, so scalar dominance cannot globally orient.

OperatorKO7/Test/MatrixBarrierArbitraryR.boundary: With an unbounded scalarized pump, no matrix-arbitrary measure orients the duplicating step and no global orientation exists, so scalar dominance cannot orient the KO7 system.
OperatorKO7/Test/MatrixBarrierArbitraryR.conclusion: The simple-size matrix measure with an unbounded pump witnesses that no scalar-dominance order globally orients the duplicating step.

OperatorKO7/Test/NewmanComplexityReach.l.summary: This file gates Newman complexity classifications. It checks arithmetical closure under negation, infinitary conjunction and disjunction, Newman conclusion, step and body sentences, set-guarded arithmetical and Pi11 notions, arithmetical and Pi11 classifications of Newman components, and lowness and Sigma0 classifications of confluent joinability.
OperatorKO7/Test/NewmanComplexityReach.l.boundary: Newman body components are arithmetical while the Newman sentence is Pi11, and confluent joinability is low Sigma0; the boundary is arithmetical versus Pi11 and low versus higher complexity.
OperatorKO7/Test/NewmanComplexityReach.l.conclusion: The file records reachability and axiom footprints for Newman arithmetical and Pi11 classifications and low Sigma0 joinability.

OperatorKO7/Test/NewmanRCA0UpperReach.le.summary: The file is a paired reach and axiom gate for the RCA0 upper bound with no new definitions. It checks that the standard model satisfies the Newman sentence, satisfies RCA0 basic and Simpson basic axioms with Newman, and that both axiom sets are consistent with Newman, printing axioms for each. It proves nothing; it confirms reachability and axiom footprints.
OperatorKO7/Test/NewmanRCA0UpperReach.le.boundary: The standard model satisfies RCA0 basic and Simpson basic axioms together with the Newman sentence, so those RCA0 fragments are consistent with Newman and do not refute it.
OperatorKO7/Test/NewmanRCA0UpperReach.le.conclusion: RCA0 basic and Simpson basic fragments are each consistent with the Newman sentence in the standard model.

OperatorKO7/Test/NoisyRecoveryReach.lean.summary: The file is a reach and axiom inventory for noisy recovery with no new definitions. It checks rational observation models, joints, observation masses, posteriors, argmax and argmin operators, Bayes targets, decoders and risks with optimality and unit-interval lemmas, randomized decoders, target-purity and licensed-on-support characterizations of zero risk, deterministic and full-carrier models, collision and fully-noisy examples, post-processing monotonicity, and optimal side encoders with axiom prints for each. It proves nothing; it confirms reachability and axiom footprints.
OperatorKO7/Test/NoisyRecoveryReach.lean.boundary: Bayes risk is zero exactly on the target-pure and licensed-on-joint-support side and positive otherwise; deterministic post-processing cannot reduce it, with the fully noisy binary model attaining risk one half as the recovery limit.
OperatorKO7/Test/NoisyRecoveryReach.lean.conclusion: Bayes decoding is optimal with zero risk exactly under target-purity and licensed-on-support and with monotone risk under post-processing.

OperatorKO7/Test/NormalFormFaithfulTrans.summary: The file is a paired reach and axiom inventory for normal-form faithful transport with no new definitions. It checks normal and UNred relations, step-star simulations with ReflTransGen mapping and UNred and UNconv transfer, stuttering and ranked simulations with well-foundedness transfer, loop and empty-unit steps with well-foundedness contrasts and descent requirements, and fork states and steps with collapse simulations, normality preservation and injectivity requirements, printing axioms for each. It proves nothing; it confirms reachability and axiom footprints.
OperatorKO7/Test/NormalFormFaithfulTrans.boundary: UNred, UNconv and well-foundedness transfer across simulations on the faithful side, but transfer fails without normal-form injectivity witnessed by the fork and without stutter descent witnessed by the loop unit.
OperatorKO7/Test/NormalFormFaithfulTrans.conclusion: Faithful transport of normal forms, confluence and termination holds under simulations but injectivity and stutter descent are each necessary.

OperatorKO7/Test/NormalFormTargetReach.l.summary: This file pairs check with print-axioms for the normal-form-target proposition. OperatorKO7/Test/NormalFormTargetReach.l.boundary: Normal form is determined exactly by step-invariant conditions and kernel or uncased ambient classes, but not by five ambient classes that admit counterexamples; the boundary is determining versus non-determining invariants.
OperatorKO7/Test/NormalFormTargetReach.l.conclusion: The file records reachability and axiom footprints for normal-form-target characterizations and five non-determination counterexamples.

OperatorKO7/Test/OBAuditUpgradesReach.le.summary: This file checks orientation-boundary audit upgrades and claim-index declarations. OperatorKO7/Test/OBAuditUpgradesReach.le.boundary: Many direct measures cannot orient duplication or KO7 recursion steps under scalar dominance, unbounded sections, or payload-sensitive conditions, while normalization, escape, and exact checking succeed in their stated domains; the boundary is orientable versus non-orientable measures and escaping versus universe-contained representations.
OperatorKO7/Test/OBAuditUpgradesReach.le.conclusion: The file records declaration and axiom checks for orientation-closure audit upgrades and related no-orientation, normalization, escape, and exact-checking results.

OperatorKO7/Test/OIAuditUpgradesReach.le.summary: This file imports twenty audit-upgrade and method modules and runs #check and #print axioms for each listed public declaration, from direct step certificates and Lawvere obstructions to Godel LCEL instances, DP projections, hierarchy transport and Klop nontermination, plus cited base-order and cycle-flow theorems. OperatorKO7/Test/OIClosureBoundaryCases..summary: This check file defines a coverable repair input sharedRepair with one intervention closing two defects, an uncoverable repair input uncoverableRepair with one defect and no interventions, and a nonuniform two-frame law skewFrame, and it verifies decidable examples for repair covers, witness search, cost ties, channels, noisy recovery, role laws and certificate parsing. It then runs #check and #print axioms lines for imported lemmas on transition conservation, relational recovery, side channels, normal-form transport, workload semantics, budgeted recovery, joint capacity and sequential memory. The file header states it introduces no new theorem.
OperatorKO7/Test/OIClosureBoundaryCases..boundary: A repair cover exists when an intervention closes every defect, and minimumRepairCover? returns none when a nonempty defect set has no intervention. Bounded witness search, cost ratios, alphabet size and Bayes risk behave similarly, returning a value on the feasible side and none or an extremal risk on the infeasible side.
OperatorKO7/Test/OIClosureBoundaryCases..conclusion: Decidable examples hold as stated, with the shared repair returning a cover and the uncoverable repair returning none, and no new theorem is proved.
assumptions: autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Test/OIControlsReach.lean.summary: The file lists predeclared controls for operational inexpressibility, one block per control, with no new definitions. It checks empty-type channels, unattained observations, zero payload, price, depth and arity controls, weak-versus-strict crossings and ties, bounded-search exhaustion versus global impossibility, support-relative recovery, nonuniform laws, enumeration independence, pairwise-versus-global witnesses, classical-versus-executable synthesis, duplicated-target capacity, history-versus-observation horizons, serialization versus parser input, malformed certificates, cost bounds, finite embeddings versus arbitrary TRSs, root-versus-contextual rewriting, uniqueness and termination transport requirements, relative obstruction, a positive free-recursor measure and the hypothesis-necessity catalog, printing axioms for each. It proves nothing; it confirms reachability and axiom footprints.
OperatorKO7/Test/OIControlsReach.lean.boundary: Each control pairs a degenerate attainable side against an obstruction: empty types, zero payloads and prices, bounded-search exhaustion versus global impossibility, pairwise versus global witnesses, and classical existence versus executable synthesis.
OperatorKO7/Test/OIControlsReach.lean.conclusion: All listed operational-inexpressibility controls are reachable with axiom footprints separating degenerate or bounded sides from impossibility sides.

OperatorKO7/Test/OIGenericCoreImportClos.summary: This file defines no new objects; it imports the generic Operational Inexpressibility core modules and certifies their import closure. The header comment records that the closure avoids OperatorKO7.Kernel, Meta.SafeStep_Core and Meta.DependencyPairs_Works, with recursor-trace modules stated on the leaf schema. It then adds cited names from Sections 2 to 6, the confluence transport theorem, and carriers such as InformationAccess and ObserverSufficiency.
OperatorKO7/Test/OIGenericCoreImportClos.boundary: The checked theorems separate licensed, sufficient or resolvable observers and channels, where factorization, recovery or coloring exists, from unlicensed ones where pairwise compatibility, single targets or history alone do not suffice.
OperatorKO7/Test/OIGenericCoreImportClos.conclusion: The file records type and axiom checks certifying the generic core import closure while avoiding the three forbidden modules.

OperatorKO7/Test/ObservationPrincipleDem.conclusion: The file records checks that licensed finite selectors have a least alphabet and that trace-only certificate floors admit no morphism.

OperatorKO7/Test/ObservationPrincipleFis.boundary: Quadratic discrimination attains repetition bounds yet is not little-o, and zero Fisher cost exceeds every multiple.
OperatorKO7/Test/ObservationPrincipleFis.conclusion: The file records checks linking discrimination generators to f-divergences with quadratic Fisher behavior and attaining repetition bounds.

OperatorKO7/Test/ObservationPrincipleLog.summary: The file is a declaration and axiom check for the logic, computability and rewriting sentences module, running `#check` and `#print axioms` on its Beth, explicit-definition, Goedel, Rice, uniform-evaluation, rewriting and bounded-halting statements without proving new results. OperatorKO7/Test/ObservationPrincipleLog.boundary: Uniform semantic evaluation fails in general while bounded halting is decided, marking the limit between unbounded reasoning and bounded observation.
OperatorKO7/Test/ObservationPrincipleLog.conclusion: The file records checks that uniform semantic evaluation fails while bounded halting is decided, with Goedel and Rice pairs marking licensing limits.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.summary: This file imports the abstract ordered-semiring matrix-lift barrier module and checks ten public declarations for the Boolean one-dimensional lift. It contains six examples showing the arctic and tropical semirings satisfy the lift barrier predicate, the Boolean semiring lifts to the Boolean matrix tag yet fails the predicate, and a monotone Boolean matrix schema both has an orienting instance and refutes a uniform certificate-free barrier. The examples are derived from the boundary theorem and the certificate-free barrier statement.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.boundary: The lift barrier predicate holds for the arctic and tropical semirings and fails for the boolean semiring. A monotone Boolean matrix measure can orient a duplicating system, so no uniform certificate-free barrier holds.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrderedSemiringMatrixLi.conclusion: The strongest checked claim is that the arctic and tropical semirings admit the lift barrier while the boolean semiring does not, although some monotone Boolean instance does orient.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBoundaryObje.summary: This file imports the orientation-boundary object module and issues #check and #print axioms commands for orienters, growth cells, in-cell predicates and barrier partitions. It contains two examples proving non-vacuity at concrete carriers where counter belongs to orienters at Bool while payload does not, and orienters at Bool equals orienters at Nat. It proves no further content.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBoundaryObje.boundary: Counter expressions orient while payload and constant expressions do not, and growth cells separate bounded from unbounded cost and gain.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBoundaryObje.conclusion: Counter orients while payload does not, and orienters are independent of the carrier as shown at Bool and Nat.
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBoundaryPubl.summary: This file imports the publication-capstone module for free successor orientation and checks its main equivalences and no-certificate result. It contains two examples at carrier Bool showing the counter projection strictly increases along free successor steps while the payload projection does not. It proves no further content.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBoundaryPubl.boundary: Free successor orientation holds exactly when a measure is payload-blind and counter-strict, with counter satisfying both and payload failing blindness, and payload erasure admits no decisive certificate.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBoundaryPubl.conclusion: Free successor orientation is equivalent to payload-blindness plus counter-strictness, so counter orients while payload does not and payload erasure yields no decisive certificate.
assumptions: set_option autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBulletproofM.summary: This file checks reachability and axiom footprints for the public declarations of eight Orientation Bulletproof method and evidence modules covering path orders, algebraic interpretations, semantic structural methods, typed dependency pairs, admittance and inapplicability, substrate change, exact promotion carriers and the RDRS coverage evidence ledger. Each listed declaration is exercised with a paired fully qualified check and print axioms command. A final block repeats the paired checks for auxiliary witnesses and interpretations such as permutation statuses, affine measures, tuple evaluations, sorted transports and curated evidence resolutions.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBulletproofM.boundary: The checked material separates methods that orient or certify the KO7 duplication step from explicit failures such as standard KBO being unable to orient rec-succ and finite-model and linear-complexity certificates being impossible. Richer orders, quasi-interpretations with sharing awareness and exact strict substrate extensions are checked on the positive side with well-foundedness and decrease witnesses.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationBulletproofM.conclusion: Every listed Bulletproof method and evidence declaration is reachable with its axiom footprint displayed.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureAblat.summary: This file checks reachability and axiom footprints for the ablation comparison module. It covers tree size, non-duplicating steps, decrease on non-duplicating steps, reverse well-foundedness and the original duplication control. It also covers counter rank, its payload blindness and wrapper insensitivity, its orientation of the original successor and the independence of duplication and payload-sensitivity obligations with the two step constructors.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureAblat.boundary: Tree size decreases and is well-founded only on the non-duplicating side while duplicating steps escape it and require counter rank. Duplication control and payload sensitivity are independent obligations rather than consequences of each other.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureAblat.conclusion: Tree size handles non-duplicating steps while counter rank handles the original duplicating successor with the two obligations independent.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureAttai.summary: This file checks reachability and axiom footprints for the attained-pairs module including successor prefixes, counter and payload observations and terms, profile measures, closed embeddings and their preservation lemmas, attainment, restriction to closed terms, orientation equivalence and carrier independence. It adds three non-vacuity controls at carrier Bool beyond the Empty carrier. The controls instantiate attainment for profile 2 3 4, counter-projection orientation and preservation of counter observation under closed embedding.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureAttai.boundary: A successor orientation that holds freely over all carriers forces the profile to be payload-blind, so non-blind measures orient only after restriction to closed embeddings with carrier-independent profiles.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureAttai.conclusion: Every successor profile is attained at Bool with orientation and closed-embedding preservation witnessed by explicit examples.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCaptu.summary: This file checks reachability and axiom footprints for the capture-avoiding substitution module. It covers free variables, all names, maximum names, term depth, bound renaming, fresh names and fuel-bounded substitution with its soundness lemmas. It also covers the capture-avoiding derivation constructors and control lemmas for legacy capture, avoidance, free-variable preservation and binder shadowing.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCaptu.boundary: Naive substitution can capture on the shadowing side while capture-avoiding substitution with fresh renaming preserves inserted free variables and avoids capture.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCaptu.conclusion: Capture-avoiding substitution with fresh renaming is sound and avoids the capture exhibited by naive substitution.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCellC.summary: This file checks reachability and axiom footprints for the cell-classification families module. It covers failure at a point, cell-or-pointwise failure, barrier cells and their exclusion of orientation including non-strict orientation. It covers additive, affine, quadratic, max, compositional, cross-term, multilinear, polynomial and matrix families with their zero-or-barrier, eventual-failure and no-orientation-via-cells lemmas. It also covers grammar profiles with barrier-cell characterization and the equivalence between orientation, absence of barrier cells and counter strictness.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCellC.boundary: A barrier cell or pointwise failure excludes orientation of the duplication step including non-strict orientation. Grammar profiles therefore orient exactly when no barrier cell occurs and the counter is strict, so all listed additive through matrix families fail via cells.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCellC.conclusion: No additive, affine, quadratic, max, compositional, cross-term, multilinear, polynomial or matrix family orients the duplication step via cells with grammar orientation characterized by absence of barrier cells and counter strictness.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCellC.summary: This file checks reachability and axiom footprints for the cell-classification module. It covers wrap-bounded and unbounded growth, gain-bounded and unbounded growth, their dichotomies, four-cell coverage and barrier-cell exclusion of orientation. It also covers closed evaluation with counter-rank, zero, coupled, doubled-wrapper, bounded-wrapper and alternating-gain measures distinguishing orienters from non-orienters and the catalog that every non-barrier cell admits both verdicts.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCellC.boundary: Barrier cells exclude orientation while every non-barrier cell admits both an orienter and a non-orienter, giving four-cell coverage with no uniform measure.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCellC.conclusion: The four wrap and gain cells cover all measures with barrier cells excluding orientation and non-barrier cells admitting both orienters and non-orienters.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCerti.summary: This file checks reachability for the certificate-controls module with paired checks and axiom prints. It covers dependent native certificate canonicity and uniqueness, absence of such certificates for standard KBO and Cichon, canonicity for KBO with status and erasure length properties. It also covers source, right-hand side and call extraction with occurrence and rejection controls together with size-change strictness and neutral-transfer rejections.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCerti.boundary: Standard KBO and Cichon admit no dependent native certificates and only well-formed extractions with strict counter decrease are accepted, while call-as-right-hand-side, altered payloads and pair-only source transfers are rejected.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCerti.conclusion: Dependent native certificates are canonical and unique when they exist, absent for standard KBO and Cichon, and only well-formed extractions with strict counter decrease are accepted.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCerti.summary: The file imports the CertificateLanguage module for orientation closure and performs reachability and axiom checks. It checks certificate datatypes for matrices, Knuth-Bendix orders and the general certificate type, together with polynomial, matrix, Knuth-Bendix and dependency-pair checkers and their soundness and completeness lemmas. It also checks control examples that are accepted or rejected, including multilinearity, square-wrapper and variable-condition cases.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCerti.conclusion: The file checks that the certificate-language declarations are reachable and prints their axiom dependencies without proving a new result.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureConte.summary: The file imports the ContextLiftMetatheorem module and runs reachability and axiom checks for free-context orientation, barrier cells and context-lift controls. It checks that root orientation follows from free-context orientation and that barrier cells exclude context orientation, including tree-size and minimum-wrap interpretation controls. It then gives a non-vacuity example at carrier Nat showing treeSize with strict less-than is not a free-context orienter.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureConte.boundary: A barrier cell excludes free-context orientation. At carrier Nat the treeSize barrier applies at a variable-carrying pair, so treeSize with strict less-than is not a free-context orienter.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureConte.conclusion: At carrier Nat, treeSize with strict less-than is not a free-context orienter.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureContr.summary: The file imports the ControlCatalog module and runs reachability and axiom checks. It checks singleton and unit schemas, payload and counter controls, ascending and rational shrinking steps, and loop, linear and fan extensions with their barrier and termination properties. It also checks altered-rule, dropped-rule and empty-system cases.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureContr.conclusion: The file checks reachability and axiom dependencies of the control-catalog declarations without proving a new result.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCount.summary: The file defines a lex-status Knuth-Bendix order fixture and two associative-commutative representative terms. It proves the provisional associative-commutative comparison is reflexive on the left term and therefore not well-founded. It also proves the provisional generalized Knuth-Bendix comparison holds before a unary context but is lost after adding a common successor context.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCount.boundary: Well-founded comparison fails on the reflexive side: the provisional associative-commutative comparison admits a self-loop and is not well-founded. Context closure fails across the context boundary: the generalized comparison holds for the base pair but disappears under a common successor context.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCount.conclusion: The provisional associative-commutative comparison is reflexive and hence not well-founded, and the provisional generalized comparison is lost under a common successor context.
