OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCoupl.summary: The file imports the CouplingControls module and runs reachability and axiom checks. It checks retentive-orienter unboundedness, counter-rank and recursive-drop measures with their wrapper-cost and counter-gain values, and orientation versus non-retentiveness controls.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCoupl.conclusion: The file checks reachability and axiom dependencies of the coupling-control declarations without proving a new result.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCoupl.summary: The file imports the CouplingTheorem module and runs reachability and axiom checks. It checks wrapper-cost and counter-gain characterizations of orientation, retention and bounded-gain limits, and exact polynomial-gain coupling results.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureCoupl.conclusion: The file checks reachability and axiom dependencies of the coupling-theorem declarations without proving a new result.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureDepen.summary: The file imports the DependencyPairSoundness module and runs reachability and axiom checks. It checks strong normalization, argument steps, defined symbols, subterms, minimal chains, call reduction pairs and the subterm criterion with its termination consequences. It also checks fresh-rule, free-recursor and projection controls for termination and well-foundedness.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureDepen.conclusion: The file checks reachability and axiom dependencies of the dependency-pair soundness declarations without proving a new result.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureDepen.summary: The file imports the DependentMethodEvidence module and runs reachability and axiom checks. It checks law structures and instances for methods ORI1 through ORI6, native method laws and row witnesses, and dependent native certificates with their row counts and certificate coverage. It also checks constructor and projection declarations for each law structure.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureDepen.conclusion: The file checks reachability and axiom dependencies of the dependent-method-evidence declarations without proving a new result.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureDirec.summary: This file reachability- and axiom-checks the DirectFamilyHypothesisNecessity theory. It checks each DirectBarrierFamily construction and its additive, transparent, affine, quadratic, cross-term, multilinear, polynomial, max-plus, pair, lexicographic, mixed-coordinate, functional and depth variants, together with the all-families enumeration. It also checks the orientation, unboundedness, restoration, deletion-countermodel and slot-necessity lemmas, printing axioms for every checked declaration.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureDirec.boundary: When a hypothesis slot is present the corresponding barrier is restored; when that slot is deleted the barrier is false. The checked necessity lemmas therefore mark each hypothesis as exactly necessary.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureDirec.conclusion: All direct barrier families and their per-hypothesis restoration and deletion countermodels are present with printable axiom dependencies.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeD.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for free derivational complexity and instantiates its general bounds at natural-number variables. It verifies the upper bound that an m-step context derivation satisfies m + 2 ≤ 3 ^ termSize and the exponential sandwich with exact nest sizes and lower bounds. It also checks call-chain length equality and non-vacuity at closed, Boolean and string variable types with concrete size and step examples.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeD.boundary: Derivation lengths are at most exponential in term size, with m + 2 ≤ 3 ^ termSize for every context derivation. This is tight because the nest family attains lengths at least 2 ^ d, so no subexponential uniform bound holds.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeD.conclusion: Context derivations satisfy the exponential upper bound m + 2 ≤ 3 ^ termSize and the nest family shows this exponential behaviour is attained.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeO.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for free ordinal calibration and instantiates its general statements at natural-number variables. It verifies that context and call heights are bounded by omega yet unbounded below omega, with suprema equal to omega and every finite height attained. It also checks non-vacuity at closed terms and universe-lifted Boolean variables with suprema and range membership examples.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeO.boundary: Every context and call height is finite below omega, yet every finite ordinal occurs as a height. Hence omega is the exact supremum and is itself unattained as a height.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeO.conclusion: Context and call heights are calibrated exactly at omega with all finite heights attained.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeP.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for the coupled polynomial interpretation of free terms. It checks the interpretation, root-rule orientation, successor, wrapper and recursor strictness lemmas, and strict-context laws with context-step decrease. It also checks reverse well-foundedness and the main contextual and root termination theorems.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureFreeP.conclusion: The coupled polynomial interpretation decreases on context steps and yields contextual and root termination.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureGramm.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for the grammar-license bridge between orientation grammars and payload-blind licenses. It checks equivalences for payload blindness, adequacy, license criterion and separation. It also checks the orientation grammar with oi license, the swapAdd example with its evaluation and distinctness, and aggregation orienting through counter projection.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureGramm.boundary: Adequacy coincides with orientation for payload-blind methods, with licensing and separation characterized by explicit iff criteria. Payload-using aggregation is licensable only when factored through counter projection.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureGramm.conclusion: Payload-blind adequacy is equivalent to orientation and yields an explicit license and separation criterion.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureHypot.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for the hypothesis-necessity base framework. It checks row necessity kinds, deleted-premise countermodels with refutation of deleted barriers, and retained, law-free, universal and covered barrier necessity structures. It also checks feature lenses, feature change controls with restore, escape and no-hypothesis reasons, and the point lens.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureHypot.boundary: Retaining barrier premises preserves barriers while deleting a premise admits a countermodel refuting the barrier. With no applicable hypothesis there is no feature control.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureHypot.conclusion: Barrier premises are necessary since their deletion is refuted by countermodels and absence of hypotheses removes control.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureIncre.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for increment-cost bounds on orientation. It checks iteration, natural and ordered wrapper orientation equivalences, attainment, and the no-uniform-orientation result for bounded increment with unbounded cost. It also checks one-step and iterated lower bounds, geometric sums, affine specializations, truncated subtraction control, and two-step and coupled recursor cost controls.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureIncre.boundary: Uniform orientation is impossible under bounded increment with unbounded cost. Orientation then forces one-step and iterated geometric and affine lower bounds.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureIncre.conclusion: Bounded increment with unbounded cost rules out uniform orientation and forces geometric and affine cost lower bounds.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureInter.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for the interpretation laws of free terms. It checks the Interpretation structure with evaluation on variables, zero, successor, wrapper and recursor, plus substitution. It also checks strict and weak context laws, root-rule orientation, root and context decrease lemmas, and reverse well-foundedness with constructor lemmas.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureInter.conclusion: Evaluations respecting strict laws strictly decrease on root and context steps, giving well-foundedness of context steps.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureLicen.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for the license-event module. It checks the confession-distinction license-event declaration.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureLicen.conclusion: The confession distinction is present as a license event.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureMetho.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for method-data factoring. It checks the MethodData, MethodLaws and MethodResult structures. It also checks factoring of laws through results, factoring from interpretations, row factors, coverage counts and row equality.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureMetho.conclusion: Method data satisfying laws factors through a result with countable coverage and determined rows.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureMetho.summary: The file checks reachability and axioms for the method hypothesis-necessity catalog. OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSepar.conclusion: The file confirms reachability of the residual decision layer, its transfer to bivariate zero deciders, and monotone certificates with out-of-stratum controls.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSepar.conclusion: The file confirms reachability of the exact residual embedding from signed bivariate positivity to open residual goals with orienting and open controls.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSepar.summary: This file is a reach and axiom gate for SeparableSlopes. OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSepar.conclusion: The file confirms reachability of the separable-difference characterization of successor orientation and its residual goal form.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSizeC.summary: This file is a reach and axiom gate for SizeChangeTermination. OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSizeC.conclusion: The file confirms reachability of the size-change criterion, its well-foundedness and termination consequences, and loop controls for the free recursor system.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSourc.summary: This file is a reach and axiom gate for SourceChainSoundness. OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureSyste.summary: This file is a reach, axiom and example gate for SystemTRecursor. OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureTrans.summary: This file is a reach and axiom check for the TransportLaws module of orientation closure. It elaborates OrientsRelation, PositiveSimulation, ReflexiveSimulation and related constructions such as LoopSource, EmptyTarget and FourState models. It checks no-go and transfer results including no orienter of a subrelation, well-foundedness transfer, injectivity not required, and failure of reflexive-simulation transfer. It also checks control-size orientation, root-barrier failure without root inclusion, and reflection without preservation breaking confluence. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureTrans.boundary: Positive simulations transfer well-foundedness while reflexive simulations do not, and root-inclusion and preservation hypotheses mark the boundary for barrier transfer and confluence.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureTrans.conclusion: The file confirms that every named TransportLaws declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureVecto.summary: This file is a paired reach and axiom check for the VectorComparison module. It checks payload-blindness requirements for all-strict, lexicographic and strict-primary orders, cyclicity and separation results, and blocking results for payload-reading measures. It also checks the counter-then-payload measure and its orientation of vector lexicographic order. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureVecto.boundary: Vector orders orient only when blind to payload on the compared coordinates; any payload observation on those coordinates blocks orientation and separates the orders.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationClosureVecto.conclusion: The file confirms that every named VectorComparison declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationOrdersReach..summary: This file defines no new objects; it runs type and axiom queries for every public declaration of Meta/BoundaryObserver/OrientationOrders.lean. It checks the orientation goals, the PassDecreases predicate and adjacency facts, and the theorems on existence of natural orientations. It also checks characterizations of content-determined decreasing measures and strict-order versus reflexive controls.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationOrdersReach..boundary: A content-determined decreasing orientation exists on one side and is obstructed on the other by irreflexive, well-founded or strict-order measures.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationOrdersReach..conclusion: The file records the expected types and axiom dependencies for all OrientationOrders declarations.

OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationSchemaUpgrad.summary: This file checks reachability and axioms for projection, rank and affine-interpretation declarations across several Meta modules. It covers projection orientation of the duplicating step, violations of wrap-subterm properties, projection ranks, and unit affine measures over naturals and rationals and reals. It also checks row claims, anchors, and the closed RDRS coverage evidence ledger. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationSchemaUpgrad.boundary: Projection orients the duplicating step yet violates wrap-subterm closure, and affine measures are nonconstant exactly for the closing rows.
OperatorKO7/Test/OrientationSchemaUpgrad.conclusion: The file confirms that every named schema-upgrade and affine-row declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.

OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapChainR.summary: This file is a paired reachability and axiom check for OverproductionGapChainRule. It checks incremental gain bits, the evidence chain rule, equality of omega drop with incremental gain, antitonicity in licensed gain, strict drop with strict gain, and the fork-echo to resolving chain rule. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapChainR.boundary: Licensed evidence gain strictly reduces the omega gap by the incremental gain, while unlicensed gain does not; the chain rule quantifies the drop.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapChainR.conclusion: The file confirms that every named OverproductionGapChainRule declaration is reachable and reports its axioms without adding new content.

OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapRoleEx.summary: This file checks reachability and axioms for general role exchange. It covers role weights, role-resolving mixtures, general value-blind and role gaps, exchange and nonnegativity and zero-characterization results, finite-relation specializations, and uniform-frame entropy lemmas. It also checks the dependency-pair channel calculations, one-bit exchange, full resolution closure, and the rary occurrence separation from value-factoring. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapRoleEx.boundary: Full role resolution closes the gap to zero while role-blind or unresolved channels retain positive gap; the rary channel separates role information from value information.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapRoleEx.conclusion: The file confirms that every named general role-exchange declaration is reachable and reports its axioms without adding new content.
assumptions: autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapRoleEx.summary: This file is a reachability check for the m-ary role-exchange module and proves no new content. It checks star-step reachability, terminal normality and support and entropy, zero-source behavior, uniform role weights, role echo and role resolving channels, and logarithmic gap calculations. It also checks mixture, entropy, deficit and zero-gap results culminating in m-ary exchange and the binary case. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapRoleEx.boundary: Role-blind and role-echo channels retain logarithmic gap while the role-resolving channel closes it to zero for every arity.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapRoleEx.conclusion: The file confirms that every named m-ary role-exchange declaration is reachable and reports its axioms while proving no new content.
assumptions: autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapShanno.summary: This file checks reachability and axioms for the Shannon overproduction-gap module. It covers terminal points and schedulers, entropy definitions, the Shannon gap and its Hartley bound, uniform schedulers attaining Hartley entropy, and licensed-entropy alignment with zero-residual closure. It also checks fork-three uniform gap values and the Shannon law. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapShanno.boundary: The Shannon gap is bounded above by the Hartley gap and vanishes under aligned zero residual, with uniform schedulers attaining the Hartley value.
OperatorKO7/Test/OverproductionGapShanno.conclusion: The file confirms that every named Shannon-gap declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.

OperatorKO7/Test/PairResolutionReach.lea.summary: This file provides paired checks for every public PairResolution declaration. It checks repeat protocols, likelihood multiplicativity and nonnegativity, prefix and stopped masses, costs, Bhattacharyya bounds and discrimination inequalities, and decoder error bounds. It also checks exponential error decay, two-sided resolution, and deterministic split versus merged examples. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/PairResolutionReach.lea.boundary: Repeated observations drive error down exponentially via Bhattacharyya and discrimination bounds, while the merged deterministic pair yields no information and the split pair yields one reading.
OperatorKO7/Test/PairResolutionReach.lea.conclusion: The file confirms that every named PairResolution declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.
assumptions: autoImplicit false

OperatorKO7/Test/PaperClauseCompletionsR.summary: The file imports the four completed clauses of the Operational Inexpressibility paper. It runs #check and #print axioms for retained-coordinate uniqueness, gauge invariance, shared-generator bridges, frame- and active-slot uniqueness, licensed-quotient points and nontriviality, and void-step and join uniqueness. It defines nothing and proves nothing itself; it records types and axiom dependencies.
OperatorKO7/Test/PaperClauseCompletionsR.conclusion: The file records types and axiom dependencies for the four completed paper-clause declarations without proving anything new.

OperatorKO7/Test/PhaseCVectorMatrixTuple.summary: This file confirms reachability of the Phase C vector, matrix and tuple lift on a concrete carrier. It defines a single-payload single-position Bool family with payload count rising from 1 to 2 and checks projection identity. It exhibits the canonical exposure matrix, its DWO lift, matrix-over-polynomial non-orientability and correspondence, tuple row trichotomy, and the phase-C capstone on that carrier.

OperatorKO7/Test/PhaseCVectorMatrixTuple.conclusion: The concrete Bool/Unit family witnesses projection identity, matrix-over-polynomial non-orientability, correspondence, row trichotomy, and phase-C closure.

OperatorKO7/Test/ProgressOrbitEquivalenc.summary: This file provides declaration, axiom, direction and zero-length checks for ProgressOrbitEquivalence. It checks indexed orbit systems, progress observations and quotients, recursor and circular states and orbits, wrap expansions, reverse isomorphisms and quotient equalities, and no-simulation results. OperatorKO7/Test/RCA0DerivationSharpness.summary: This file gives full reach and axiom coverage for finite sharpness models. It checks the two-induction fragment, its two-element countermodel validating Simpson arithmetic and the fragment while refuting irreflexivity, and the resulting non-entailment and non-derivability. It also checks the base-insufficiency countermodel refuting zero-or-succ and the resulting non-entailment and non-derivability. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/RCA0DerivationSharpness.boundary: Simpson arithmetic with two-induction does not entail irreflexivity and Simpson arithmetic alone does not entail zero-or-succ, with finite countermodels marking derivability limits.
OperatorKO7/Test/RCA0DerivationSharpness.conclusion: The file confirms that every named sharpness-model declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.

OperatorKO7/Test/RCA0DerivationsReach.le.summary: This file gives full reach and axiom coverage for the RCA0Derivations module. It checks successor, addition, multiplication and order axioms, Simpson basic theory and relativizations, induction and bounded-quantifier notions, and two induction formulas with boundedness proofs. It also checks derivations of successor and zero-or-succ laws and predecessor descent within zero-or-succ and bounded-induction fragments. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
OperatorKO7/Test/RCA0DerivationsReach.le.boundary: Bounded-induction fragments derive successor and predecessor laws that weaker bases lack, marking a derivability hierarchy among subtheories.
OperatorKO7/Test/RCA0DerivationsReach.le.conclusion: The file confirms that every named RCA0Derivations declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.

OperatorKO7/Test/RDRSAlgebraicInterpreta.summary: The file resolves every public name of the algebraic-interpretation atlas and adds four sanity theorems. OperatorKO7/Test/RDRSAlgebraicInterpreta.boundary: Each algebraic row falls on one side of a barrier or escape divide, with conditional barriers passing toward escape under a named hypothesis and otherwise remaining barriers.
OperatorKO7/Test/RDRSAlgebraicInterpreta.conclusion: The algebraic-interpretation atlas has a row list of length 14 whose rows take barrier, conditional-barrier or escape status with the stated mechanism and hypothesis carriers.

OperatorKO7/Test/RDRSUniversalPayloadSen.summary: This file exercises the public surface of the universal payload-sensitive barrier capstone without proving new mathematics. It checks the closure structure, conditional retained-coordinate re-exports and anchor strings. It proves anchor equalities and capstone field equalities by `rfl` and replays the conditional factorisation shape with its required factor hypothesis. Its honesty record limits scope to the closed-grammar surface.
OperatorKO7/Test/RDRSUniversalPayloadSen.boundary: Retained-coordinate factorisation through the counter holds only under a caller-supplied factor hypothesis; without it no unconditional factorisation is claimed, and the capstone covers only the closed-grammar direct-payload-sensitive surface, not unrestricted monotone, MSPO, DP, WPO or semantic-quotient coverage.
OperatorKO7/Test/RDRSUniversalPayloadSen.conclusion: The capstone surface is reachable with exact anchors and fields, and its retained-coordinate factorisation is explicitly conditional on a caller-supplied factor hypothesis.

OperatorKO7/Test/RankOrderClassification.summary: This file checks the full named surface of rank-order classification with paired `#check` and `#print axioms` commands. It covers natural ranks, setoids and quotients, counter systems and recodings, invariant-separated ranks and infiniteness theorems. Five examples instantiate infiniteness, uniqueness to PUnit, empty-relation separation and a concrete strictly monotone function.
OperatorKO7/Test/RankOrderClassification.boundary: Some rank-order quotients are infinite while the counter-order quotient collapses to one class; the empty relation distinguishes orders, so classification can be trivial or infinite depending on the system.
OperatorKO7/Test/RankOrderClassification.conclusion: The file exhibits both an infinite rank-order quotient and a unique counter-order class alongside a separating empty-relation example.

OperatorKO7/Test/RaryCertificateReach.le.summary: This file checks reachability and axioms for the Rary certificate module. It covers decidable equality, root steps, depth, the checker and its zero and successor certificates, soundness lemmas and serialized-bit strict certificates. It includes the equivalence between strict certificates and root or F-steps and the no-certificate theorem for G-sources. It proves nothing new.
OperatorKO7/Test/RaryCertificateReach.le.boundary: Strict binary certificates exist exactly for root steps and F-steps, while the G source admits no strict certificate, separating certifiable sources from an uncertifiable one.
OperatorKO7/Test/RaryCertificateReach.le.conclusion: The file confirms the Rary certificate checker surface resolves, including the existence equivalence for F-sources and the no-certificate result for G-sources.

It resolves the recursor term, the void collapse of dependency pairs, and the partial-progress claim. It prints axiom dependencies for the statements that dependency-pair projection fails substitution invariance, lies outside the recursor signature, and governs termination and soundness through an external observer license.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorDPConfessionLic.boundary: Reasoning provable inside the recursor signature is separated from reasoning that requires accepting an external dependency-pair license, with projection collapse and termination soundness placed on the external side.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorDPConfessionLic.conclusion: The file records that the recursor dependency-pair license definitions and external-observer termination statements resolve and reports their axiom dependencies.

OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorFreeAlgebraReac.summary: This file checks the recursor free-algebra and unconditional DP-license modules. It covers folds as sigma homomorphisms, substitution invariance, collapse factors with no distinguishing witnesses, unconditional exclusion of DP projection from the signature, direct-measure normalization indistinguishability and the equivalence between external-license acceptance and normalization verdicts. Axioms are printed for the six central theorems.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorFreeAlgebraReac.boundary: DP projection is unconditionally outside the recursor signature and constant homomorphisms factor through collapse with no distinguishing power, so orbit-mass indistinguishability and termination equivalence hold only with an accepted external DP license.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorFreeAlgebraReac.conclusion: The file confirms the free-algebra substitution-invariance and unconditional DP-exclusion surface resolves.

OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorInformationEqui.summary: This file checks the information-equivalence module with paired `#check` and `#print axioms`. It covers entropy measures, discarded information, equivalence modulo DP, growth-implied equalities and canonical confession invariance. It defines a zero entropy measure and a constant-one direct measure and instantiates discarded-information equality and the DP-projection equivalence as examples.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorInformationEqui.boundary: Step-duplicator and circular-reference orbits are information-equivalent modulo DP projection, with discarded-information equality following from linear growth or mass indistinguishability and invariant under orbit choice.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorInformationEqui.conclusion: The step duplicator is information-equivalent to the circular reference under DP projection with orbit-invariant discarded bits.

OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorPayloadGrowthBl.summary: This file checks the payload-growth blindness module. It covers growth and drop rates, mass indistinguishability, linear payload growth with linear counter drop, inability of direct measures to separate payload growth from circular growth, and operational inexpressibility at the step duplicator. Axioms are printed only for the inexpressibility theorem.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorPayloadGrowthBl.boundary: Payload grows linearly while the counter drops linearly, yet direct measures cannot separate growing payload from circular growth, yielding operational inexpressibility at the step duplicator.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorPayloadGrowthBl.conclusion: The file confirms the payload-growth blindness surface resolves with its inexpressibility axiom check.

OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorRatioLimitsReac.summary: This file gives full reachability and axiom coverage for the recursor ratio-limits module. It checks two concentration-mass identities, convergence of the inverse-square ratio and a lower bound on the odd-index inefficiency coefficient. Each entry has paired `#check` and `#print axioms`.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorRatioLimitsReac.boundary: The concentration-mass ratio satisfies the stated doubling and inverse-square identities with convergence, and the odd-index inefficiency coefficient is bounded below.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorRatioLimitsReac.conclusion: The file confirms the recursor ratio-limit identities and bounds resolve.

OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorStoppingReach.l.summary: This file checks the execution-derived recursor stopping law with paired `#check` and `#print axioms`. It covers rary and binary cumulative and marginal costs, cutoff specifications and ties, stopping models with Bellman identities and finite-horizon maxima, optimal stopping-time existence, after-cutoff optimality and constant-benefit and zero-cost controls. Fourteen `decide` and rewriting examples evaluate exact costs, cutoffs and control values.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorStoppingReach.l.boundary: Stop versus continue is separated by marginal-cost cutoffs with optimal stopping after cutoff; zero-cost, zero-payload and zero-benefit controls delimit when stopping is forced or continuing is forced.
OperatorKO7/Test/RecursorStoppingReach.l.conclusion: The recursor stopping law is complete with an attainable optimal policy crown separating stopping from continuation by cutoff.

OperatorKO7/Test/SafeTraceTripleLexExact.summary: This file checks the safe-trace triple-lex exactness theory through its certificate-audit import. It verifies the carrier-tuple identity, code and order equivalences, realizability of zero and tower carriers, and phase-one membership and blockage lemmas. It checks range and subtype statuses, endpoint and complexity bounds, bridge and audit catalogs, and the conditional passage from surjectivity to exact order type. It also checks the obstructions that code faithfulness, residual exactness, surjectivity and exact packages all fail.

VerifyTpdbExport.lean.summary: This file defines the IO entry point main for the TPDB export verifier. It compares the ko7_full_step_tpdb exporter against its embedded checked literal and the on-disk Artifacts/ttt2/KO7_full_step.trs file. It then repeats the same embedded-versus-disk check for the free_recursor_tpdb export at Artifacts/ttt2/free_recursor.trs, returning nonzero on any mismatch.
VerifyTpdbExport.lean.conclusion: If main returns 0, both TPDB exporters match their embedded literals and on-disk artifacts.
